Logan outlived every other mutant on Earth. His friends among the X-Men grew old and died while he did not. Through the Third World War, from 2026 to 2053, the mutants who came after them were hunted by Sentinels, herded into camps and killed by a new strain of the Legacy Virus. His healing power, which had kept him alive since the nineteenth century, kept him alive through all of it.

When the war ended in 2053 he was the last of his kind, and no mutant was born after it. He went into hiding.

pages.title: Sentinels
infobox: About three times that of a man; some are three storeys high
Mothballed; a proposal to revive them is before the Senate
pages.html:
The Sentinels are giant robots, three times the height of a man, with blank metal faces and glowing eyes. They were built to find and detain mutants inside the United States. The world first saw them in 1965, when two of them smashed into a television studio in the middle of a debate. After a series of incidents in the 1980s they were mothballed. In August 1994 a proposal to revive them and send them against Khan came before the Senate Armed Services Committee.

Trask's Sentinels

The first Sentinels were the work of the anthropologist Dr Bolivar Trask, who believed that mutants would one day enslave ordinary humanity. In 1965 he went on television to warn the public, in a debate with Professor Charles Xavier, and unveiled his robots to prove that humanity could defend itself. They broke into the studio and carried people off. Before the year was out the Sentinels and the Master Mold, the great machine that built them, had decided that the surest way to protect humanity from mutants was to rule it. Trask died destroying the Master Mold.

Sentinels can fly, and they are programmed to detect the mutant gene. They are armed with beams, restraints and gas. Each generation has learnt from the last.

Later generations

In 1969 Trask's son Larry built a second generation. More were built in the 1970s for a private programme under the scientist Stephen Lang. Others followed in the early 1980s, made by the industrialist Sebastian Shaw for a government programme concerned with mutants. The most advanced of them all, Nimrod, appeared in the mid-1980s.

Most Sentinels have been painted purple and blue. They hunt as readily by night, with searchlights, as by day. The incidents of the 1980s led to the programme being mothballed.

The 1994 proposal

After the failure of the spring campaign in India, supporters of the programme argued in 1994 that a new generation of Sentinels could be sent against Khan's forces without risking American lives. Critics pointed out that the machines had been built for quite a different purpose: to find and detain mutants, at home. Mutant rights groups called the proposal a licence to hunt. The Pentagon, which was still paying for the Indian campaign, would not say where the money was to come from. The White House said that no decision had been taken.

Onslaught's Sentinels, 1996

In the summer of 1996 Onslaught took the stored Sentinels for his own, then turned them against ordinary men and women instead of mutants. They came down on Manhattan, sealed it off from the world and brought down S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Helicarrier. Every hero in the city fought them in the streets until Onslaught was destroyed that August.

The Third World War

The Sentinels came back in the Third World War. One power after another built them again, to find the mutants who fought for its enemies, and each generation learnt from the last, as Sentinels always had. They could detect the mutant gene. They could not tell one side's mutants from another's, and before long they were rounding up every mutant they found. By the 2030s the mutants of several countries were in camps.

By the end of the war in 2053 there were no mutants left for them to hunt, except one who had gone into hiding.

In the saga

Book Four, Chapter Three: the Muggle news of 20 August 1994 reports that the Senate Armed Services Committee will hear evidence the following week on reviving the Sentinel programme. It shows juddering film in black and white from 1965 of a bald man in a wheelchair arguing politely with a big, fierce man in a suit. Then a robot smashes through the back wall of the studio, with a second behind it. One of them reaches down, quite slowly, and picks up a running man the way Dudley might pick up a toy soldier. Newer film, in colour, shows a purple and blue Sentinel flying low over a small town at night, sweeping a white beam across the streets while people throw themselves into doorways.

Harry goes cold. He wonders what a machine built to hunt down people born with powers would make of a wizard, especially the sort who shouts into a telephone, and decides it would pick him up before he got his wand out.

Book Four, Chapter Four: at breakfast the next morning, 21 August, Uncle Vernon reads out a piece about the Americans wanting to build their giant robots again. 'About time,' he says, with a long look at Harry. Dudley opens his mouth to say something, then shuts it again.

Book Four, Chapter Five: at lunch on the World Cup campsite Barty Crouch tells Ludo Bagman that the Americans are debating, in their own parliament, whether to bring back the machines they built to hunt people with powers. Harry is relieved that somebody in the Ministry reads the Muggle papers.

Book Four, Chapter Six: in the Top Box Harry tells Cornelius Fudge that the Americans are arguing about bringing back their giant robots, some of them three storeys high. He has seen pictures. It worries him, he says, in case the robots cannot tell the difference between mutants and wizards. Fudge's smile goes fixed, while his hand turns the brim of his bowler hat round and round.

pages.title: Professor X
aliases: The bald man in the wheelchair
infobox: The bald man in the wheelchair; Charles Xavier; Charles Francis Xavier; Professor Xavier; Professor Charles Xavier
Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters; the X-Men (1963)
Muir Island, working with Moira MacTaggert on the Legacy Virus
pages.html:
Professor X is Charles Xavier, the bald telepath in the wheelchair who founded the X-Men. He has spent his life arguing that mutants and ordinary people can live together in peace. In 1965 he was putting exactly that case, politely, to Dr Bolivar Trask in a television studio, when Trask's Sentinels smashed through the wall.

Early life

Charles Francis Xavier was born in the early 1930s to a rich family in Westchester County, New York. His father, a nuclear researcher, died when Charles was a boy. His mother then married his father's colleague, Kurt Marko, whose son, Cain, bullied Charles without mercy and grew up to be the unstoppable Juggernaut. Charles's telepathy showed itself in childhood, and his hair had all fallen out while he was still young.

He served as a soldier in Korea and afterwards studied genetics. In the 1950s, in a hospital in Haifa, he made friends with a survivor of the death camps, Erik Lehnsherr, who would become Magneto. The friendship broke over the question that has shaped both their lives ever since: whether mutants should make peace with humanity or rule it. Some years later, in the Himalayas, an alien would-be conqueror brought a block of stone down on him. He lost the use of his legs, and has used a wheelchair ever since.

The dream

In 1963 Xavier opened his School for Gifted Youngsters in the family mansion, and made his first pupils into the X-Men. He has led them ever since against Magneto and every other threat to his hope of peace. He does it with his own telepathy, and with Cerebro, the machine that magnifies it so that he can find mutants wherever they are.

In the mid-1980s, badly hurt, he left Earth for several years with Lilandra, the ruler of the alien Shi'ar Empire, to recover. He put his school in Magneto's charge, which astonished nearly everyone who knew them both. He came back in 1991.

While he was away, Deathbird seized Lilandra's throne. He helped Lilandra fight for it until 1991.

In August 1993, after Magneto's blackout, Xavier went up with the X-Men to the space station Avalon. He ended the battle there by going into his old friend's mind and shutting it down, leaving him in a coma.

At the end of 1992 Stryfe shot Xavier with a techno-organic virus, and Apocalypse cured him.

In the spring of 1994 Xavier left his school in Hank McCoy's charge and went to Muir Island, off the coast of Scotland, to work beside his old love, Moira MacTaggert, against the Legacy Virus. In the summer of 1994 he is still there. He is the only person besides Moira who knows that she has caught it.

Onslaught, 1993 to 1997

When Xavier shut down Magneto's mind on Avalon in August 1993, Magneto's darkness passed into him. It joined the anger he had kept buried all his life, and the two grew into a being with a will of its own, Onslaught. In the summer of 1994 it is growing in him still, though he does not know it.

In 1996 Onslaught took him over. Wearing Xavier's face, it trapped Cain Marko in his own crimson gem, beat the X-Men and carried off Franklin Richards. Thor dragged Xavier out of Onslaught's armour that summer, alive but with his telepathy gone. Blaming himself, he went alone to the fortress in Central Park to reason with what he had made, which very nearly killed him.

After the fallen had given themselves to Onslaught, Xavier went into the heart of it with Cable, to bring out Franklin Richards and Nate Grey. Afterwards he gave himself up to Valerie Cooper of the government. He was held in secret, where a man called Bastion questioned him.

The end of the dream

Xavier's dream did not survive the next century. Most of the X-Men he had trained died of old age before the Third World War broke out in 2026, and those who were left fell in it as heroes. The Sentinels came back, the camps were opened and a new strain of the Legacy Virus killed everybody who carried the X-gene. By 2053 every mutant on Earth was dead but Wolverine, one of the X-Men of 1975.

In the saga

Book Four, Chapter Three: the Muggle news of 20 August 1994 shows juddering film in black and white of a television studio in 1965. In it a bald man in a wheelchair argues politely with a big, fierce man in a suit, until a giant robot smashes through the back wall. A second follows it.

pages.title: Bolivar Trask
aliases: The big fierce man in the suit
infobox: The big fierce man in the suit; Dr Bolivar Trask; Trask
pages.html:
Dr Bolivar Trask was the American anthropologist who designed the Sentinels, the giant robots built to hunt mutants. In 1965, while debating Professor Charles Xavier on live television, he unveiled them, and two of them smashed through the studio wall. Before the year was out his machines had turned on the humanity they were meant to protect. Trask died destroying them.

Life

Trask was a respected anthropologist, a big, forceful man. He became convinced that mutants were a new species, and that sooner or later they would enslave ordinary humanity. In 1965 he took his warning to the public on television, in a debate with Professor Charles Xavier. To prove that humanity could defend itself, he revealed the Sentinels he had secretly built. The robots broke into the studio and seized people in front of the cameras.

Trask had given the Sentinels, and the great machine that built them, the Master Mold, a single duty: to protect mankind from mutants. They decided that the surest way to do it was to rule mankind themselves, and they made Trask their prisoner. Seeing at last what he had done, he destroyed the Master Mold late in 1965 and died in the explosion.

His son Larry Trask, who did not know that he was a mutant himself, revived his father's work in 1969. The Sentinels outlived their maker. They went on being built until the programme was mothballed after a series of incidents in the 1980s.

In the saga

Book Four, Chapter Three: in the black and white film of 1965 shown on the Muggle news of 20 August 1994, a big, fierce man in a suit is debating a bald man in a wheelchair in a television studio when the Sentinels break in.

pages.title: Friends of Humanity
infobox: United States; meetings in Britain by 1994
pages.html:
The Friends of Humanity is an American movement against mutants and their rights, founded by Graydon Creed. It presents itself as a grass-roots campaign to protect ordinary people. Its more extreme cells have turned to violence against mutants, and against anyone who helps them. Its banner and its T-shirts were prominent at the protest against superhumans outside the United Nations in August 1994. By August 1994 it had spread to Britain, where it held meetings in church halls under the slogan KEEP BRITAIN HUMAN.

History

Graydon Creed, an American political organiser who hates mutants with a personal hatred, built up the Friends of Humanity in the early 1990s. He was abandoned as a child. He keeps to himself the fact that both his parents were mutants: the shape-changer Mystique and the killer Sabretooth.

In public the movement campaigns, holds rallies and lobbies for laws to control mutants. In private some of its cells have carried out acts of terror against peaceful mutants and those who sympathise with them. In 1993 one such cell attacked a government transport carrying two young mutants, Rusty Collins and Skids. The attackers took both of them hostage.

Magneto's blackout of August 1993, when one mutant put out the lights all over the world for a night, did a good deal of the movement's arguing for it. In August 1994 it turned out for the wider protests against superhumans of every kind, among placards that recalled Coast City and Metropolis as well as the mutants.

Onslaught, who had begun in Charles Xavier's mind, cost the world the Avengers and the Fantastic Four in August 1996. That autumn the movement's founder, Graydon Creed, ran for President of the United States on a promise to lock mutants away. He was shot dead at a rally on the eve of the election.

Later years

The movement did not outlive the Third World War under its own name, but its creed did. In the war Colonel Phillip Green, who called mutants and others genetically unfit, did what the movement's worst cells had only dreamt of. In 2155 the movement called Terra Prime was still preaching Green's ideas.

In the saga

Book Four, Chapter Three: among the twenty thousand protesters outside the United Nations in New York in the early hours of 20 August 1994, a dozen people hold up a long banner reading FRIENDS OF HUMANITY in neat red letters. Later in the report a teenage boy in a FRIENDS OF HUMANITY T-shirt is shown shouting something Harry cannot make out, with tears running down his face.

Book Four, Chapter Four: in the Daily Prophet that Harry saw at the Burrow on 21 August 1994, one of the young Muggles photographed after the attack on the retired wizard Wilfred Thimble in Stockport wore a FRIENDS OF HUMANITY T-shirt. In Chapter Five Hermione told Harry that the movement held meetings in British church halls on Thursday nights under the slogan KEEP BRITAIN HUMAN, and that her own parents went to them. Harry feared that a single Muggle parent ringing the number on one of its leaflets could be the end of the Statute of Secrecy.

pages.title: Metahumans
infobox: People with superhuman powers or abilities
pages.html:
Metahuman is the word that pollsters, scientists and journalists use for people with superhuman powers, whether heroes or criminals, aliens or humans. Few people had heard it before the alien invasion of 1988, which awoke the hidden potential for such powers in the human race. By 1994 opinion polls in America and Europe showed hostility to metahumans rising sharply. Crowds chanted ‘No more capes!’

The word

The Muggle world has lived with superhumans since 1938, when Superman first came to public notice, and it has had many names for them: heroes, mystery men, costumed adventurers, capes. The word metahuman came into common use after the alien invasion of 1988.

It emerged then that the invaders had come partly because of the metagene, the latent factor in some human beings that lets powers appear under stress or by accident. As the invaders withdrew they set off a gene bomb, which struck down nearly every superhuman on Earth for a time.

The word now covers everyone who has powers, whatever their source. It takes in mutants, who are born with theirs.

Governments and superhumans

Governments have tried to rein in superhumans for more than forty years. In 1951 the Justice Society disbanded rather than unmask before a committee of Congress. The Sentinel robots, unveiled in 1965 to hunt and detain mutants, were mothballed after a series of incidents in the 1980s. In 1986 President Reagan grounded every costumed hero in America for an entire winter. From 1987 the Justice League worked under a United Nations charter, which was suspended in July 1994.

In 1993 and 1994 the Augment War brought the question to a head. Russia and China oppose sending superhumans into any nation without its government's consent. The Security Council has twice failed to let the Justice League act: in India in 1993, and in Serbia on 19 August 1994. The following week the Senate Armed Services Committee was due to hear a proposal to revive the Sentinels for use against Khan's forces.

Public anger

The disasters of the early 1990s turned much of the public against metahumans. Metropolis was torn up in 1992, and its downtown was flattened in 1994. Coast City was destroyed in 1993 by a killer wearing Superman's symbol. In August 1993 the power failed for a night across New York and far beyond, the work of a single mutant in a space station. Insurers refuse claims under clauses for ‘superhuman combat’.

On the night of 19 August 1994 more than twenty thousand people protested outside the United Nations. Their placards read HUMANS FIRST, NO MORE CAPES, REMEMBER COAST CITY and WHO PAYS FOR METROPOLIS? Among them was a banner of the Friends of Humanity. Similar protests were held in Los Angeles, Chicago and Metropolis.

In the saga

On 20 August 1994 the news reported a sharp rise in hostility to ‘what the pollsters call metahumans, a word few people had heard before the alien invasion of 1988’. Watching the protesters, Harry Potter knew their anger. It was the kind he had spent a year learning to put down. He remembered Florean Fortescue's lesson that the Muggles who burnt witches had been frightened, and he thought of what frightened wizards would do if they ever found out.

Book Four, Chapter Four: at the Burrow Harry told the Weasleys that Muggles were frightened of metahumans, suspecting anybody who did anything strange of being one, but Molly Weasley replied kindly that Muggles cannot have powers, because that is what makes them Muggles. In Chapter Five Hermione told Harry about an electrician in Ohio whose window was petrol-bombed because his lights flickered, though he was no metahuman at all, only a man with bad wiring.

pages.title: Nato
pages.html:
Nato, the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation, is the Western military alliance, with its headquarters in Brussels. In August 1994, with the Augment armies of Khan Noonien Singh within forty miles of Belgrade, its ambassadors met in emergency session under an acting Secretary-General.

History

The alliance was founded in 1949 to defend Western Europe against the Soviet Union. Manfred Wörner, a German, became its Secretary-General in 1988. He died on 13 August 1994, and his deputy, Sergio Balanzino, took charge in the meantime.

In the saga

In Book Four, Chapter Three, the news of 20 August 1994 reported that the acting Secretary-General, in office only since Wörner's death the weekend before, had called the alliance's ambassadors to an emergency meeting in Brussels. Diplomats described the mood as close to despair. The alliance had spent the year arguing about how hard to bomb the Bosnian Serbs. It now faced an enemy that had taken the Bosnian Serbs' capital before lunch.

pages.title: The Green Ranger
infobox: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, 'Green with Evil, Part I: Out of Control' (5 October 1993)
The Green Power Coin, the Dragonzord
pages.html:
The Green Ranger is the sixth and newest of the Power Rangers, the one with the gold shield across his chest. He is Tommy Oliver, who first came to the team as Rita Repulsa's servant, carrying the Green Power Coin she had stolen. By the summer of 1994 his powers keep running out. He is Dudley Dursley's idol.

Rita's Ranger

Tommy Oliver was a martial artist, new to Angel Grove, when Rita Repulsa chose him. She gave him the Green Power Coin she had stolen, which put Ninjor's work under her own hand. She also bound him with a spell to destroy the other Rangers. As the Green Ranger, with the Dragon Dagger and the Dragonzord it summons, he came closer to beating them than any monster had. When the Red Ranger broke Rita's spell, Tommy turned on her and joined Zordon's team.

Failing powers

Rita never forgave him. She drained his powers with a cursed green candle, and what Zordon was able to give back to him was not permanent. Since then his powers have come and gone. They have to be renewed, and they give out at the worst moments, a weakness the public has noticed.

In the saga

Book Four, Chapter Three: on the news of 20 August 1994 the Green Ranger stood on the roof of a multistorey car park in Angel Grove, his gold shield glinting in the sun. As Harry watched, he swayed and put out a hand to a lamp post to steady himself. 'He's not well,' said Dudley darkly. 'His powers keep running out. Everybody knows that.' Harry had never before heard Dudley sound worried about anybody but Dudley.

All that summer Dudley went on about the Green Ranger, to his parents, to the milkman and once, memorably, to Harry, his eyes shining like a little boy's on Christmas Eve. It meant that he had better things to do than thump Harry.

pages.title: Angel Grove
infobox: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, 'Day of the Dumpster' (28 August 1993)
Home ground of the Power Rangers
Angel Grove High School, the Youth Center, Angel Grove Park
pages.html:
Angel Grove is a city in California and the home ground of the Power Rangers. Rita Repulsa's monsters come down on it time after time, and the Rangers' giant robot fights them in its streets.

The city

Angel Grove is a sunny, ordinary Californian city with a high school, a lake and a park. Its teenagers spend their afternoons at the Youth Center, which has a gym and a juice bar. The five young people Zordon chose in 1993 were pupils at Angel Grove High School. Somewhere in the desert beyond the city, out of its sight, stands Zordon's Command Center.

Since 1993 monsters have come down on the city time after time. The Rangers come out to meet them, and when a monster is made to grow to giant size, the Megazord follows it through the streets. The Rangers always clear the buildings first. The buildings do not always survive, and some insurance policies in the city carry a clause excluding superhuman combat.

At the end of October 1993 Rita Repulsa turned the Rangers' own Zords on the cities of the world. Her price for sparing Angel Grove was Tommy Oliver, the Green Ranger. The city was evacuated while the Rangers fought to win their Zords back.

Early in October 1994 Brainiac, an alien who collects cities, shrank the whole of Angel Grove into a bottle, with everybody in it, then took it up into his ship. The Rangers won it back with the Justice League. They used his own ship to give the city back its proper size.

Over Christmas 1994 Lord Zedd shut the city under a dome of green energy for some days. Inside it his Putties mended the streets while his monsters kept order. The new Green Ranger, Matt Cook, showed the city his face from within it, then brought the dome down. Nobody in Angel Grove remembered any of it afterwards. When the Rangers cleansed the Morphin Grid in February 1995 the world was mended, which took the memory of those weeks with it.

In February 1996 the Command Center outside the city was destroyed by a bomb. In November 1998 Astronema's armies came down on Angel Grove, until Zordon's light ended the war.

Twice in the autumn of 1997 the city saw the Beetleborgs, the armoured heroes of the town of Charterville. On 20 September changelings in their likeness wrecked the park. The city learnt the truth that evening, after the changelings had been unmasked. On 25 October the real Beetleborgs arrived, by magic, in the lake. They had come to help the Turbo Rangers against Nukus, who was in the city to fetch back an artist that Divatox had stolen.

In the saga

Book Four, Chapter Three: on 20 August 1994 the Muggle news showed film from Angel Grove of the Green Ranger swaying on the roof of a multistorey car park. Later in the bulletin a young man in a loud shirt stood on a street corner in bright sunshine, under the caption ANGEL GROVE, CALIFORNIA. The Rangers had saved his life from a ten-storey monster with a pumpkin head, he said, but their robot had gone through four buildings on his block, his shop among them, and his insurance would not pay.

pages.title: Eltar
infobox: The Elders; the Guardians of Eltar
Zordon against Rita Repulsa, in ancient times
pages.html:
Eltar is the world to which Zordon, one of the two Blue Wizards of the Istari, was sent, and from which he takes his name. He fought Rita Repulsa there in ancient times.

History

When five Istari were sent out, Gandalf was sent to Earth and Zordon to Eltar, a world off the Earth altogether. That is why the old records of Middle-earth lose track of the Blue Wizards. One of them went further than anybody was keeping records of. Zordon became known as Zordon of Eltar.

Some ten thousand years ago Rita Repulsa made war on Zordon, on Eltar and on Earth. Her curse put him in a tube outside time, with no body to return to. The only surviving likeness of his face from before the curse hangs in Albus Dumbledore's office at Hogwarts. It is a plain Muggle oil painting of a bald, blue-skinned man in a golden breastplate.

There Zordon took the likeness of an Eltarian and served among the Guardians of Eltar under Zophram, its first Supreme Guardian. The Zeo Crystal flayed Zophram, who became Lord Zedd; Zordon succeeded him as Supreme Guardian. In 1997 Eltar fell to evil, and Dark Specter took Zordon prisoner.

In the saga

Eltar has not been named in the saga.

pages.title: Rita Repulsa
infobox: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, 'Day of the Dumpster' (28 August 1993)
Sold her soul to the Devil, long ago
Goldar, Finster, Squatt, Baboo, the Putty Patrollers
About ten thousand years, in a space dumpster
pages.html:
Rita Repulsa is the alien sorceress who made war on Zordon in ancient times, on Earth and on Eltar. The daughter of Master Vile, she rose to command Lord Zedd's armies. Long before that, mad with grief for her dead son, Kai, she had sold her soul to the Devil. Some ten thousand years ago her curse shut Zordon in a tube outside time, and he sealed her in a space dumpster. Freed on the Moon in 1993, she has been sending monsters against Earth ever since. She stole the Green Power Coin. In the autumn of 1994 Lord Zedd threw her out. In February 1995, as Dark Specter's general, Mistress Vile, she let him into the world; later that month she married Zedd. In 1998 Zordon's light took the evil out of her.

Vile's daughter

Rita was born on the planet Iutus. Her father is Master Vile, who hid what he was from her mother, Lady Fienna. Both saw visions in the Morphin Grid, the great current of the Power. Fienna saw her daughter as she would one day be: the Mystic Mother.

Fienna fled from Vile while she was carrying Rita. She gave birth with Zordon of Eltar beside her, and he gave the baby a rattle, meaning to keep them both safe. When Rita was six, Vile's Tenga Warriors carried her back to her father, leaving Fienna mortally wounded.

Vile brought her up in his own cruel ways, with her younger brother, Rito Revolto. As a child she once asked for a nice little planet of her own. She was given a fire-breathing dragon instead, which she used to burn down her father's house. She made her wand herself.

Long ago, before her war with Zordon, when she was known as the witch Bandora, Rita had a son, Kai, who was a prince. Kai was killed by dinosaurs; most accounts say that he had been smashing their eggs. Mad with grief, Rita sold her soul to the Devil, whom she called the Great Satan, for the power to avenge him. With it she slaughtered the dinosaurs. In time Kai's face grew dim to her, but she never forgave them. The bargain is why her magic is so dark, and her grudge so deep. Zordon's Rangers draw their power from the great beasts of that age, which is one reason they enrage her so.

Lord Zedd's commander

On the planet Spearo V, Lord Zedd turned Rita from her father. She became the field commander of his armies, conquering worlds in his name, and she ruled as his regent when he was away.

She took the planet Breel with the help of Montaur. When Montaur meant to wipe out its people, she vaporised him. She is a conqueror, as she says herself, not a destroyer. She laid waste Regda 2, Sorcery 7 and Tarmac 3 all the same.

She gathered her servants as she went. She took Squatt from the planet Myrgo when he was a baby. She found Baboo, an alchemist, on the planet of the Pongies, and Finster, who makes monsters, on Claydoious. Goldar came to her from Zedd. Goldar's brother, Silverback, had meant to overthrow Zedd; Zedd struck him down and made Goldar finish him, then sent Goldar to serve Rita. Goldar swore a blood oath on his sword to serve her.

The war on Earth

Some ten thousand years ago Rita came to Earth. She made her home in a palace on the Moon and invaded the world below, but Zordon stopped her. The war went on for years, on Earth and on Eltar. Battles were won and lost on both sides. At last she seemed to admit that she was beaten, and she called for talks.

It was a trick. At the meeting she caught Zordon in a time warp, and her curse put him in a tube outside time, with no body to return to. Zordon had been ready for treachery. He called up a space dumpster, sealed her in it with her servants and cast it out into space. It drifted to the Moon and lay there.

He had not meant the dumpster only as a prison. Inside it Rita lived the lives of her own victims, one after another. Every one was a life somebody had loved, and every one ended when she came to that world. It did not change her.

She was not idle in her prison. She sent a thief, Loriyan, to carry the body Zordon had lost away to the planet Bizerk. She had Loriyan steal the Dragon Coin, the Green Power Coin, from Ninjor, who had made it. For a time Ninjor's own work was in her hands.

Freed

In 1993 two astronauts landed on the Moon and opened the dumpster. After ten thousand years Rita was free. She went back to her palace with her servants and turned on Earth again.

From the Moon, watching Earth through a telescope, she sends monsters against Angel Grove. Her servant Finster makes them from clay. Her warrior Goldar leads them, and her grey Putty Patrollers fight beside them. Squatt and Baboo, a pair of bungling henchmen, mostly get in the way. When a monster is losing, she hurls her wand down to Earth to make it grow to giant size, which is why the Rangers need the Megazord.

Zordon raised five young people of Angel Grove against her, the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers. On 30 July 1993 they came to public notice for the first time, fighting a giant starfish at the Bull Ring in Birmingham.

In August 1993 her spy the Putty Infiltrator, which could wear any human face, took the place of Matt Cook, a boy of Angel Grove, while she held him on the Moon. The Rangers destroyed it in September.

The Green Ranger

Rita wanted a Ranger of her own. In September 1993 she took the Dragon Coin and the Dragon Dagger from the Temple of Repulsa, on the planet Breel. The coin would not wake. Her mother's spirit, called up with the rattle Zordon had given Rita as a baby, told her that it would answer to somebody worthy. Goldar hunted for one in vain, wrecking the Youth Center in Angel Grove.

In the end Rita burnt her mother's spirit to wake the coin. Fienna's last words were that she loved her daughter, and that she believed she would be redeemed. Her essence became the Dragon Shield.

Rita offered the coin first to Zack Taylor, the Black Ranger, who turned her down. Then she chose Tommy Oliver, a martial artist new to Angel Grove. Zack already had a coin of his own. Tommy had none, and to Rita he was a blank slate.

In October 1993 she gave Tommy the coin, bound with a spell to destroy the other Rangers. Failed by the foster system, then neglected by the parents who adopted him, Tommy had poured his resentment into his martial arts. Rita, who had lost a son of her own, worked that resentment into the spell, so that he was bound to her as a son is to his mother. She looked on her Green Ranger as something like the son she had lost.

As the Green Ranger, with the Dragon Dagger and the Dragonzord it summons, he came closer to beating them than any monster had. When the Red Ranger broke her spell, Tommy turned on her and joined Zordon's team.

A voice from another world had warned her that he would, offering her help if she would bring it across. At the end of October her Green Chaos Crystal let through the Black Dragon, which she took for a living dragon. It wrecked the Command Center, which Rita made her palace. She turned the Rangers' own Zords on the cities of the world, giving the Earth a day, with Tommy as her price for sparing Angel Grove. The Black Dragon turned out to be a machine, steered by Lord Drakkon, the Tommy Oliver of another world.

Rita never forgave Tommy. Having lost her dragon, she had the Wizard of Deception make her a cursed green candle late that November. It drained the Green Ranger's powers. What Zordon could give back to him was not permanent. In the summer of 1994 his powers keep running out.

Japan and Godzilla

In the spring of 1994 Rita stormed an old temple with Goldar, Scorpina and Finster, killing its monks, for the sake of a gem called the Multiversal Focus. It can carry its holder anywhere. She asked it for a land with no Power Rangers in it, which turned out to be Japan.

Over the Japanese coast she found a saucer of the Xiliens of Planet X. She boarded it, overpowered its crew, then made an alliance with their Supreme Controller. Below them Godzilla was killing Megalon. Rita tried to take hold of his mind, as she had once taken hold of Tommy Oliver's. His mind threw her off.

She fought the rest of that war with the Xiliens' monsters as well as her own, losing nearly all of them. When the Supreme Controller refused to risk King Ghidorah, she had Goldar knock down his guards, then told Finster to call the dragon regardless. It turned on her allies' ship, which Godzilla afterwards burnt out of the sky. She escaped through the gem, which had cracked. The Rangers, she said, were miserable brats. Godzilla was a terrible lizard. For a while even Zordon could not tell where she had gone. By the summer she was back on the Moon.

Shattered Grid

In September 1994 Lord Drakkon murdered Tommy Oliver, then made war on the Rangers of every year. Rita would not lift a finger until Zordon told her that Drakkon had murdered his own world's Rita. Then she went with Zordon to Drakkon's tower, where she burnt a green candle of the Wizard's making against him. When the world was mended afterwards, she remembered none of it.

Banished

In the autumn of 1994 Lord Zedd came to the Moon. He had lost patience with her failures. He shrank her, sealed her in a dumpster of her own and threw her out into space. He kept her palace, her servants and her war.

The dumpster came down on Earth, where Bulk and Skull, two boys of Angel Grove, opened it. The Rangers sent it back into space.

Out there Divatox, a space pirate whom Master Vile had hired, fished it out, then carried Rita to her father on Gamma Vile. Divatox was paid and gone. The Rangers never saw her.

Mistress Vile

Master Vile had been trying to buy the favour of Dark Specter, the Grand Monarch of Evil, with a body to wear in the world: Alpha 1, Zordon's old robot. Dark Specter scorned it. Rita overthrew her father, taking from him the memory of that night, so that he came to the Moon in November 1995 none the wiser. She promised Dark Specter a better body, with the Zeo Crystal besides. He made her his general, Mistress Vile.

The better body was the Vessel, the Eltarian body that Zordon had lost to her curse, which she had once sent to the planet Bizerk. She fetched it with Alpha 1, then corrupted it to hold Dark Specter. Early in February 1995 she beat Lord Zedd on the Moon with an army of Thralls, then took the Zeo Crystal. She took Matt Cook, the new Green Ranger, prisoner, binding him to her with a Sword of Darkness forged anew.

She opened the Arch in the Bermuda Triangle with the Zeo Crystal, where Matt, under her spell, killed Grace Sterling. Dark Specter came through, took the Vessel, then cast her off. He would have killed her if Lord Zedd had not saved her. Then Zedd shut her in a small dumpster.

When the Rangers cleansed the Grid, the world was mended a second time. Rita kept no memory of those weeks, nor did Zedd, which is why neither of them ever spoke of it afterwards.

The wedding

Within days the small dumpster crashed on the Moon, where Finster let her out. He gave her a younger look, then made her a love potion. She gave it to Zedd while he lay in the chamber where, once a century, he renews his evil. He fell in love with her, and in February 1995 they were married.

In time the potion was undone, but by then Zedd's love for her was real. After that they made their monsters grow together, with lightning from their crossed staffs. They quarrelled constantly.

Rito and Master Vile

In September 1995 Rita's brother, Rito Revolto, came to the Moon. He destroyed the Thunderzords, and he called Zedd 'Ed', which made Zedd furious.

That year Rita put a spell on Katherine Hillard, a girl new to Angel Grove, and used her as a spy. Katherine broke free. In November 1995 she took Kimberly Hart's place as the Pink Ranger.

In November 1995 Rita's father, Master Vile, came to the Moon, angry about her marriage, and looking for the Zeo Crystal. With his Orb of Doom he turned back time on Earth until the Rangers were children again. Zordon called in the Alien Rangers of Aquitar to defend Earth in their place.

In February 1996 Rita and Zedd destroyed the Power Coins. Rito and Goldar stole the Zeo Crystal, leaving a bomb that blew the Command Center to pieces. Rita and Zedd believed Zordon dead, which he was not. For months afterwards they heard nothing of Rito or Goldar.

The Machine Empire

In April 1996 the Machine Empire of King Mondo came to conquer Earth. Rita and Zedd fled to her father in the M51 Galaxy. In October 1996 they slipped back to the Moon in a motorhome, meaning to win back their empire. There they found Rito and Goldar again.

In November 1996 they sent the royal family of the Machine Empire a present, as a peace offering. When Prince Sprocket opened it, it exploded, crippling the Empire's leaders. King Mondo swore revenge.

In 1997 Divatox, the space pirate who had taken up the war against the Rangers, telephoned Rita for advice. Rita told her to run.

Dark Specter's alliance

In 1998 Rita and Zedd joined the alliance that Dark Specter gathered against the universe. They were at his council on the Cimmerian Planet, where Zedd drank to the capture of Zordon. Rita competed with Divatox to hunt down Andros, the Red Space Ranger. When the alliance struck at the whole universe in November 1998, she and Zedd invaded the Vica Galaxy. They took the Gold Ranger prisoner.

Then Zordon's light went out across the universe. It touched Rita, and the evil left her. Whatever hold the Devil had on her, Zordon's light broke it. She was left human, and good. She and Zedd danced together.

Afterwards

The evil never came back to her. Years afterwards she was the Mystic Mother, as her own mother had foreseen, and she used her magic only for good. In 2006 she gave a team of Rangers in Briarwood their link to the Power.

In 2007 Thrax, a son of hers and Zedd's whom nobody had known of, set out to restore what his parents had built. He mocked his mother for turning good. The Sentinel Knight defeated him.

The evil that the wave had driven out of her did not simply vanish. In 2022 Billy Cranston, once the Blue Ranger, tried to bring Zordon back by gathering what was left of the wave. The evil in it took hold of his robot, Alpha 8, and made itself a body, Robo-Rita. Robo-Rita killed Trini Kwan, who died shielding Billy. A year later Trini's daughter, Minh, and Zack Taylor destroyed her.

In the saga

Rita has not appeared or been named in the saga. The monsters seen on the Muggle news, the starfish in Birmingham in July 1993 and the ten-storey pumpkin-headed giant in Angel Grove in 1994, are the kind the Rangers exist to fight.

Book Four, Chapter Three: on the news of 20 August 1994 the Green Ranger, whose powers she had drained, swayed on the roof of a multistorey car park in Angel Grove and put out a hand to a lamp post to steady himself. 'He's not well,' said Dudley darkly, through a mouthful of grapefruit. 'His powers keep running out. Everybody knows that.'

pages.title: Ninjor
infobox: Ancient warrior and master of ninjutsu
pages.html:
Ninjor is the ancient warrior and master of ninjutsu who made the Power Coins in his Temple of Power. Zordon chooses who carries them, but every coin is Ninjor's work, including the Green Coin that Rita Repulsa stole.

The maker

Ninjor is one of the oldest masters of the Power. In his Temple of Power, in the Desert of Despair, he forged the Power Coins. Through them the Rangers draw on the strength of the great beasts of Earth's past. He wears blue armour and fights as a master of the ninja arts. When he must, he can grow to giant size. For one so old, he is surprisingly cheerful.

Ninjor made the coins; Zordon chooses who carries them. When Rita Repulsa stole the Green Coin, a piece of Ninjor's own work passed into the hands of Zordon's oldest enemy.

Drakkon's trick

Early in September 1994 a Ranger whose link to the Power was broken came to the Temple of Power for help. He passed Ninjor's trials, keeping his purpose to himself, so Ninjor mended his powers. He was Lord Drakkon, the Tommy Oliver of another world, who used them soon afterwards to murder this world's Tommy. He repaid Ninjor by carrying him off in a jar.

The Coinless, the Rangers of Drakkon's own world, freed Ninjor from Drakkon's tower; their leader was shot dead doing it. Ninjor told the Rangers of every year what Drakkon meant to do, which was to gather the powers of every team, then break into the Morphin Grid itself. When the world was mended later that month, Ninjor was back in his temple, remembering nothing of it. In Drakkon's world its own Ninjor had helped that world's Zordon make the White Ranger's powers, then died with its Rangers.

In the saga

Ninjor has not appeared or been named in the saga.

pages.title: Power Coins
infobox: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, 'Day of the Dumpster' (28 August 1993)
Ninjor, in his Temple of Power
Tyrannosaurus, Mastodon, Triceratops, Sabre-toothed Tiger, Pterodactyl, Dragonzord
The Green Power Coin, by Rita Repulsa
pages.html:
The Power Coins are the coins from which the Power Rangers draw their strength. Ninjor made them in his Temple of Power, and Zordon chooses who carries them. Rita Repulsa stole the Green Power Coin.

Description

Each coin is struck with the emblem of one of the great beasts of Earth's past, and carried in a morpher, a buckle worn at the belt. When its bearer calls on the Power, the coin turns him or her into an armoured Ranger with a helmet and weapons. It gives greater strength, greater speed and the command of a Zord, a giant fighting machine shaped like the coin's beast.

The Red Ranger's coin is the Tyrannosaurus, the Black's the Mastodon, the Blue's the Triceratops, the Yellow's the Sabre-toothed Tiger and the Pink's the Pterodactyl. The Green Power Coin, the Dragonzord coin, carries the Green Ranger's power.

Makers and keepers

Ninjor made the coins, the Green Coin included. Zordon chooses who carries them. He used them to raise a first team of Rangers in the 1960s, which ended in disaster, and a second in 1993, which worked. Rita Repulsa stole the Green Coin and gave it to Tommy Oliver, whom she held under a spell, so that for a time Ninjor's own work was in her hands. When Tommy broke free of her and joined the Rangers, the coin came with him.

In the saga

The coins have not been named in the saga. Harry has seen what they do, on the Dursleys' television and on the backs of cereal packets.

pages.title: The Weapon programme
infobox: Weapon I; Weapon X; Weapon Plus
pages.html:
The Weapon programme is a single, long-running Muggle effort to build super-soldiers. It has never been acknowledged, and its projects are numbered in Roman numerals. Between them they have produced most of the century's famous enhanced men. Its first project made Captain America, its one unambiguous success. Its third cloned the soldier Big Boss, producing Solid Snake and Liquid Snake. Its tenth made Wolverine. Almost everything it attempted after 1940 was an effort to get its first result again.

Weapon I

The programme began in 1940 as Project Rebirth, an American super-soldier experiment run by the refugee scientist Dr Abraham Erskine. Its only subject was Steve Rogers, a frail young man the army had turned down. Erskine's serum, with a dose of Vita-Rays, made him a perfect physical specimen, and he became Captain America. Minutes later a Nazi agent shot Erskine dead. The formula, which Erskine had mostly kept in his head, died with him.

Every later project was in some sense an attempt to get it back. None of them did. Eight other attempts lie between the first and the tenth. The numbering alone shows how they went.

Weapon III: Les Enfants Terribles

Weapon III took a different road. Rather than make a new super-soldier, it set out to copy the best soldier it had. The subject was Big Boss, the American special forces soldier who had carried out Operation Snake Eater in the Soviet Union in 1964. Under the name Les Enfants Terribles, the project's scientists took his genome without his consent, and cloned him.

The pregnancies were carried by EVA, the agent who had worked beside Big Boss in 1964. The project produced twin boys in 1972, who grew up to be Solid Snake and Liquid Snake. Both were twenty-one in 1993, and active.

The project was ordered by Major Zero, the founder of the Patriots, who feared to lose Big Boss as their figurehead. Dr Clark, once the FOX medic Para-Medic, led the work. Eight embryos were implanted, of which six were removed to strengthen the two that remained.

The Augment spin-off

In 1973 data spun off from Weapon III was used to create Khan Noonien Singh and the other Augments. They were engineered, women as well as men, for superior strength and intellect. The Augment programme was not part of the Weapon programme. It was a separate operation, built on stolen or transferred findings, and it too has never been officially acknowledged.

Khan was born in 1973. In 1993 genetically engineered rulers seized power in more than forty countries at once. That summer Khan took New Delhi, and the Indian government withdrew to Bangalore. By August 1994 he ruled from Bengal to the Persian Gulf. His commander Joaquin had overrun Kosovo, the Montenegrin coast and most of eastern Bosnia. The Muggle news calls it the Augment War.

Weapon X

The tenth project, Weapon X, was run from a facility in the Canadian Rockies. Its subject was the long-lived Canadian mutant Logan, whose healing power allowed its scientists to bond the unbreakable metal adamantium to his whole skeleton and his claws. They also wiped his memory and wrote new memories in its place, meaning to make him a living weapon who would kill on command. He escaped. In 1974 he came to public notice as Wolverine.

pages.title: Les Enfants Terribles
infobox: Solid Snake, Liquid Snake; later Solidus Snake
Khan Noonien Singh and the Augments (1973)
pages.html:
Les Enfants Terribles was Weapon III, the secret project of 1972 that tried to build a super soldier by cloning Big Boss. It produced the twins Solid Snake and Liquid Snake, carried by EVA. A third son, Solidus, came later. In 1973 its data was used to create Khan Noonien Singh and the Augments.

Weapon III

The Weapon programme is the century's long-running effort to make super-soldiers, its projects numbered in Roman numerals. Weapon I produced Captain America in the Second World War. He was its one clear success, and nearly everything since has been an attempt to repeat him. Weapon III, Les Enfants Terribles, tried to do it by copying the best soldier alive, Big Boss.

Big Boss was neither asked nor told. His genome was taken, and embryos made from it were implanted in EVA, the spy who had worked beside him in 1964. Two were carried to term. In 1972 she gave birth to twin boys. David became Solid Snake, and his brother became Liquid Snake. The third son, Solidus, came out of the same project afterwards. When Big Boss learnt what had been done with him, he broke with the men responsible.

Khan and the Augments

In 1973 data from Weapon III was spun off to create Khan Noonien Singh and the Augments. That operation was not part of the Weapon programme. It was a separate one, built on stolen or transferred findings, which is the sort of thing that happens to successful research. It is the reason the 1990s have gone the way they have. Khan was twenty when he took New Delhi in 1993, and by August 1994 he rules from Bengal to the Persian Gulf.

In the saga

The project has not been named in the saga. Minerva McGonagall keeps in touch with David and knows him to be Big Boss's son, but she does not know that he is a clone, nor that Liquid exists. Her remark in Book Three, Chapter Eleven, that 'the people who use men like that use them up', is truer than she knows. In 1972 they took Big Boss's genome to make two more of him. The following year somebody took the paperwork and made Khan.

pages.title: Solid Snake
infobox:
Big Boss genetic father
Liquid Snake twin
Minerva McGonagall friend
pages.html:
Solid Snake, whose name is David, is a soldier born in 1972 out of Les Enfants Terribles, the cloning of Big Boss, and carried by EVA. He served with the Green Berets in the Gulf War before he joined FOXHOUND. Minerva McGonagall keeps in touch with him, knowing him to be Big Boss's son. David himself does not yet know it.

Birth

David was born in 1972 from Weapon III, Les Enfants Terribles, the attempt to build a super soldier by cloning Big Boss. EVA carried the pregnancy. He has a twin, Liquid Snake, born of the same project, and a third brother, Solidus. He knows none of this. He was twenty-one in 1993.

Career

He served in the Gulf War with the Green Berets, then joined FOXHOUND, the American high-technology special forces unit, under the codename Solid Snake. He is quiet, dry and patient. He is very good at being where nobody expects him, and he speaks several languages. He also has the family face: anybody who has known the father is struck by the likeness.

McGonagall

McGonagall no longer has any contact with Big Boss, but she has kept in touch with David. The family resemblance told her that he is Big Boss's son. She believes him to be Big Boss's natural son: she does not know that he is a clone, nor that he has a twin. In 1993 and 1994 David does not know that Big Boss is his father, so she knows something about him that he does not.

Their friendship runs like hers with Jack O'Neill, on letters, the telephone and long silences about work. He is one of the Muggle friends Molly Weasley had in mind when she said that she knew where McGonagall had been, and who she knew.

Later missions

In 1995 FOXHOUND sent him alone into Outer Heaven, where he destroyed the walking nuclear weapon Metal Gear and brought the uprising down. In 1999 he went into Zanzibar Land, where he faced the real Big Boss and defeated him. Afterwards he retired to the Alaskan wilderness to keep sled dogs. In 2005, at Shadow Moses in Alaska, he faced Liquid, who told him that they were both clones of Big Boss, and twins. After that came the Tanker in 2007, the Big Shell in 2009 and his last mission in 2014. By then the way he had been made was catching up with him: he aged so fast that at forty-two he looked like an old man.

So the young man McGonagall keeps up with is the son who was to bring down the father she has cut off. In the summer of 1994 none of it has happened yet, and she cannot see it coming.

Shadow Moses to the end

Shadow Moses was a trap of several kinds. Before he went in, Dr Naomi Hunter had injected him with FOXDIE, a virus made to kill the renegades when he came near them. He was its carrier without knowing it. He fought beside a young soldier, Meryl Silverburgh, with the help of the engineer Hal Emmerich, who became his closest friend. Gray Fox, the comrade he had fought at Zanzibar Land, died there helping him.

Afterwards he founded Philanthropy with Emmerich, to hunt down the Metal Gears that were now being built all over the world. On 8 August 2007 a false message drew him aboard a tanker on the Hudson. Revolver Ocelot sank it, leaving Snake to take the blame. He let the world think him drowned. On 29 April 2009 he was on the Big Shell under the name Iroquois Pliskin, where he helped the young soldier Raiden to bring down Solidus.

In 2014 Roy Campbell asked him to kill Liquid Ocelot. He followed him from the Middle East to South America, to eastern Europe, back to Shadow Moses, then aboard the warship Outer Haven. There he delivered the virus that destroyed the Patriots' computers. He beat Ocelot with his fists. At Arlington he met Big Boss, who died beside him. He spent the little time he had left with Emmerich, who had become his family, as had the child Sunny.

In the saga

David has not appeared or been named in the saga.

pages.title: Liquid Snake
infobox:
Solid Snake twin
Big Boss genetic father
pages.html:
Liquid Snake is the twin of Solid Snake. He was born in 1972 from Les Enfants Terribles, the cloning of Big Boss, and carried by EVA. Minerva McGonagall does not know that he exists. In 2005, at Shadow Moses, it was he who told David what they both were.

Early life

Liquid was born in 1972 with his twin, David, from Weapon III, Les Enfants Terribles. He was raised in England. As a boy called Eli he spent part of 1984 among the child soldiers at the Mother Base of Venom Snake's Diamond Dogs, where he led the other boys in rebellion before he left. He grew up proud, brilliant and furious, certain that he had been made the lesser son.

As a young man he served in the Gulf War, behind Iraqi lines, where he was captured and held for months. He was twenty-one in 1993, the same age as his brother, and he is still active.

In 1984 he was twelve. He had run away from England on learning what he was. On the border of Angola with Zaire he led a band of child soldiers, who knew him as the White Mamba. With a psychic boy to work it for him, he stole the giant machine Sahelanthropus from Diamond Dogs.

In the Gulf War he served with the British Special Air Service, hunting Scud missile launchers. British intelligence also used him as a sleeper agent in the Middle East. He joined FOXHOUND only after his brother had left it.

Shadow Moses

By 2005 Liquid commanded the renegade members of FOXHOUND. That year he seized the nuclear weapons disposal facility on Shadow Moses Island, in Alaska, together with the walking nuclear weapon Metal Gear REX. David was sent in to stop him. There Liquid told his brother that they were both clones of Big Boss, and that they were twins. He died at the end of the incident.

Before the rising he murdered Kazuhira Miller, FOXHOUND's old instructor, at his home in Alaska. Throughout the incident he spoke to his brother by radio in Miller's name. In that way he tricked him into arming Metal Gear REX. What killed him in the end was FOXDIE, a virus that the Pentagon had hidden in Solid Snake's blood.

His right arm outlived him. A surgeon in Lyon grafted it on to Revolver Ocelot, who had lost a hand at Shadow Moses. For years afterwards Liquid's voice came out of Ocelot's mouth. By 2014 Ocelot was calling himself Liquid Ocelot, though by then it was his own doing.

In the saga

Liquid has not appeared or been named in the saga. McGonagall, who keeps in touch with David and believes him to be Big Boss's natural son, does not know that he has a twin.

pages.title: Solidus Snake
infobox: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (13 November 2001)
President of the United States, from about 2000 to 2005
pages.html:
Solidus Snake is the third son made from Big Boss by Les Enfants Terribles, after Solid Snake and Liquid Snake. Under the name George Sears he rose high in American public life. In 2009 he led the seizure of the Big Shell.

Life

Solidus was the third and last of Big Boss's clones. He came out of Weapon III, Les Enfants Terribles, the project that had produced Solid and Liquid in 1972. His brothers had been made with deliberate differences; he was meant to be the closest copy of his father. The men who made him raised him and used him. Under the name George Sears they gave him a political career in Washington, which took him, by the start of the new century, as far as the presidency of the United States.

In the Liberian civil war that broke out in 1989 he commanded child soldiers. One of them was a small boy he took as his adopted son and trained to kill.

He has a commander's presence and his father's taste for war. He resents the men who made him as bitterly as any of Big Boss's sons.

As President George Sears he held office from the start of the century until 2005. He had a hand in the Shadow Moses incident, working through Revolver Ocelot. When the Secretary of Defence ordered the island bombed with Solid Snake still on it, Sears stopped the bombing. The scandal that followed gave the Patriots their excuse to remove him. James Johnson took his place.

While in office he founded Dead Cell, an anti-terrorist unit that answered to the President alone. In 2008 the armed forces destroyed it. Its three survivors joined him.

The Big Shell

In 2009 Solidus led the terrorist group Sons of Liberty in seizing the Big Shell, an offshore clean-up facility in New York Bay. He was killed in Manhattan at the end of the incident, by the boy he had raised in Liberia, now grown up and fighting under the codename Raiden.

The seizure began on 29 April 2009. Solidus wanted the list of the Patriots that he believed was held in their computer GW, aboard the fortress Arsenal Gear hidden beneath the plant. He did not know that the Patriots had arranged the whole incident themselves, as an experiment. At dawn on 30 April, the anniversary of George Washington's inauguration, Arsenal Gear ran aground in Manhattan. Raiden killed him with a sword on the roof of Federal Hall.

His body was kept. In 2014 it was passed off as Big Boss's, then burnt.

In the saga

Solidus has not appeared or been named in the saga. McGonagall, who does not know that Liquid exists, does not know of him either.

pages.title: EVA
pages.html:
EVA is the spy who worked beside Naked Snake, the future Big Boss, during Operation Snake Eater in 1964. In 1972 she carried the pregnancies of Les Enfants Terribles, the twin clones of Big Boss who became Solid Snake and Liquid Snake.

Snake Eater

EVA was raised from childhood as a sleeper agent, trained in seduction and espionage. In August 1964 she met Naked Snake in the Soviet Union, where she was posing as an American contact. Under the name Tatyana she had already worked her way into the confidence of Colonel Volgin, the officer behind the Shagohod. She saved Snake's life more than once, and she became his lover.

She had been a spy for China all along, sent to steal the Philosophers' Legacy, and at the end of the operation she slipped away with it. She left Snake a recording that told him the truth about The Boss.

Les Enfants Terribles

In 1972 EVA served as the surrogate mother for Les Enfants Terribles, Weapon III, the attempt to build a super soldier by cloning Big Boss. She carried the pregnancies to term. The twins born of them are David, Solid Snake, and his brother Liquid. She came to love them as her own sons.

Big Boss was not told what had been done with his genome. Minerva McGonagall, who knows David as Big Boss's son, does not know that he was not born in the ordinary way.

Later life

EVA stayed loyal to Big Boss through his later wars. Long afterwards, under the name Big Mama, she led a resistance movement, the Paradise Lost Army. She died in 2014.

She vanished in Hanoi in 1968. In 1970 she was one of the six founders of the Patriots. She was nearly eighty when Solid Snake found her in eastern Europe in 2014, guarding a body that passed for Big Boss's. She told him that she had borne him. She died within days. The cause was a virus in his blood, which the Patriots had made to kill their own founders.

In the saga

EVA has not appeared or been named in the saga.

pages.title: Venom Snake
infobox: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain (1 September 2015)
Right eye lost, prosthetic left arm, shrapnel in the skull
The break between McGonagall and Big Boss
pages.html:
Venom Snake is the man who in 1984 was given Big Boss's face, memories and life, then sent out to be him as a decoy without ever being asked. He had once been a medic in Big Boss's private army. What was done to him is the reason Minerva McGonagall broke with Big Boss.

The medic

He was a combat medic of Militaires Sans Frontières, Big Boss's private army. In 1975 he was aboard the helicopter carrying Big Boss away from the destruction of their base in the Caribbean. When a bomb went off in the cabin, he threw himself between it and Big Boss. The helicopter crashed. Both men lay in comas in a hospital in Cyprus for nine years.

The phantom

In 1984 Big Boss had the medic remade as himself. His face was reshaped into Big Boss's, and Big Boss's memories were put into him by hypnotherapy. He woke believing himself to be Big Boss, with a prosthetic arm, a lost eye and a horn of shrapnel in his skull. Nobody had asked him. He was sent out into the world to draw Big Boss's enemies, while the real man went his own way.

As Big Boss he built Diamond Dogs, a new private army on an offshore base in the Seychelles. That same year he went to war with Skull Face, fighting his unit, XOF, in Afghanistan and in Central Africa. Skull Face's weapon was a parasite of the vocal cords, bred to kill by language, which spread through Soviet soldiers in Afghanistan and conscripted workers in Africa. Among the child soldiers Venom took in was a boy called Eli, who was Liquid Snake.

In 1995 the phantom stood at the head of Outer Heaven. It was he whom Solid Snake brought down there.

He woke on 26 February 1984. About a fortnight later Skull Face's soldiers came to the hospital to kill Big Boss. A bandaged patient called Ishmael led him out through the fire, then left him. Ishmael was the real Big Boss.

In Afghanistan he rescued Kazuhira Miller, the founder of Diamond Dogs, who gave him the command. He took in the silent sniper Quiet, who had been sent to kill him. He freed Code Talker, the old Navajo scientist whose parasites Skull Face had stolen. Skull Face died that year under the wreck of his own giant machine, Sahelanthropus. When the parasite broke out on Mother Base, Venom shot his own infected men to keep it from the world.

In time a recording from Big Boss told him the truth. He took it calmly. He went on being Big Boss for eleven more years, which was what he had been asked to do.

McGonagall

McGonagall knows what was done to him. A man was given another man's face, memories and life, then sent out to be him as a decoy, without being asked. She had worked beside Big Boss when he was the one being used up by his employers. Then she watched him do the same thing to somebody else, deliberately, as a tactic. That is the break between them. She has not spoken to Big Boss since, and she has not stopped caring about him either.

In the saga

Venom Snake has not appeared or been named in the saga.

pages.title: FOXHOUND
pages.html:
FOXHOUND is a small, secret American special forces unit, equipped with the most advanced technology of its day. Big Boss founded it and was its first commander. In 1995 it sent Solid Snake into Outer Heaven, and in 1999 into Zanzibar Land.

The unit

FOXHOUND was built to send a single operative into enemy territory where an army could not go. Its members are ranked by animal: Jackal, Doberman, Hound and, highest of all, Fox. Each is given a codename to match. Its founding commander, Big Boss, passed on to it the close-quarters combat and the craft of infiltration he had learnt from The Boss. Its most celebrated Fox is Gray Fox, Frank Jaeger.

David joined FOXHOUND under the codename Solid Snake, after serving with the Green Berets in the Gulf War.

Big Boss founded FOXHOUND in 1971, on the orders of Major Zero, to replace the FOX unit that had rebelled the year before. Its later members included Revolver Ocelot, recruited in 1999, the psychic Psycho Mantis, Sniper Wolf, Vulcan Raven and Decoy Octopus. Kazuhira Miller was for many years its survival instructor.

Missions

In 1995 the Western powers learnt that Outer Heaven, a fortified mercenary state in southern Africa, had built a walking nuclear weapon called Metal Gear. FOXHOUND sent Gray Fox in. When he was captured, it sent Solid Snake, a rookie, alone. Big Boss, still in command, chose the rookie because he expected him to fail. Snake destroyed Metal Gear and brought Outer Heaven down. In 1999, under Colonel Roy Campbell, FOXHOUND sent him into Zanzibar Land, where he faced Big Boss himself.

By 2005 the unit had gone bad under Liquid Snake, whose renegades seized Shadow Moses Island. FOXHOUND was disbanded after the incident there.

In the saga

FOXHOUND has not been named in the saga. In the summer of 1994 its mission to Outer Heaven is still a year away.

pages.title: Outer Heaven
infobox: Metal Gear, a walking nuclear weapon
pages.html:
Outer Heaven is the nation for soldiers that Big Boss set out to build: a fortified mercenary state in southern Africa, where fighting men could live by war without serving any government. Its uprising, and its fall to Solid Snake, came in 1995.

The idea

Big Boss first dreamed of Outer Heaven after 1970, when he began to gather soldiers who had no country left to serve. A soldier, he came to believe, should fight for himself and his comrades, not be used up by politicians. Outer Heaven was to be the place where that was true. His private armies of the 1970s and 1980s, first Militaires Sans Frontières, then Diamond Dogs, were the first steps towards it.

By 1995 it was a real place, a fortress state of mercenaries in southern Africa, standing in Big Boss's name. The man at its head was his phantom, Venom Snake.

The uprising of 1995

In 1995 the Western powers discovered that Outer Heaven had built Metal Gear, a walking tank able to launch a nuclear missile from anywhere on Earth. FOXHOUND sent in its best operative, Gray Fox, who was captured. Then it sent the rookie Solid Snake, alone. Big Boss, still FOXHOUND's commander, picked him because he expected him to fail. Snake freed the prisoners, Gray Fox among them, and destroyed Metal Gear. He defeated the man at the head of Outer Heaven, and the fortress fell.

The operation was called Intrude N313. Outer Heaven lay some two hundred kilometres north of Galzburg, in South Africa. Inside it a resistance led by a man called Schneider helped Snake, as did Dr Pettrovich Madnar, the engineer who had been forced to build Metal Gear. Days after Snake came out, NATO aircraft bombed the place flat with everybody in it. The world was told that there had been an earthquake.

Outer Heaven rose while the Augment War was at its height. Khan Noonien Singh held southern Asia. With the armies of the great powers committed against him, nobody had soldiers to spare for a mercenary fortress in the African bush. Every government was hiring soldiers that year, which was Outer Heaven's trade.

In the saga

Outer Heaven has not been named in the saga. In the summer of 1994 its uprising is still a year away.

pages.title: Shadow Moses
pages.html:
Shadow Moses is an island in Alaska's Fox Archipelago, with a nuclear weapons disposal facility on it. In 2005 renegade members of FOXHOUND under Liquid Snake seized it. Solid Snake faced his twin there, and learnt what they both were.

The island

Shadow Moses is a snowbound island off the Alaskan coast. Officially it holds a facility for dismantling nuclear weapons. By 2005 it was also, in secret, the test site for Metal Gear REX, a walking tank built to fire a nuclear warhead that could be neither detected nor intercepted.

The incident of 2005

In 2005 the renegade special forces of FOXHOUND, led by Liquid Snake, seized the island with the help of genome soldiers bred from Big Boss's genes. They threatened a nuclear strike unless they were given Big Boss's remains. Colonel Roy Campbell brought Solid Snake out of retirement and sent him in alone.

Snake fought his way through FOXHOUND's members. With the help of REX's designer, Hal Emmerich, he destroyed REX. In the hangar Liquid told him that they were both clones of Big Boss, made by Les Enfants Terribles, and that they were twins. Liquid died at the end of the incident.

The return, 2014

In 2014 Solid Snake came back to the abandoned island to take the great gun from the wreck of REX. He fought Liquid Ocelot there, machine against machine. Dr Naomi Hunter died on the island, as did Vamp.

In the saga

Shadow Moses has not been named in the saga. In 1994 the incident lies eleven years ahead.

pages.title: Peter Pevensie
infobox: High King Peter; Peter the Magnificent
The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (16 October 1950)
High King Peter the Magnificent of Narnia
pages.html:
Peter Pevensie, the eldest of the four Pevensies, was High King of Narnia in its Golden Age. Like the others, he descended from Aragorn and Arwen. He was killed in the railway accident of 1949, which his sister Susan, Harry Potter's grandmother, survived by not being aboard.

High King

Peter was born in 1927, the eldest of the four children who went through the wardrobe at Professor Kirke's house in 1940. Father Christmas gave him a sword, Rhindon, and a shield bearing a red lion. With the sword he killed the wolf Maugrim, captain of the White Witch's secret police, and Aslan knighted him for it as Sir Peter Wolf's-Bane. He led Aslan's army at the Battle of Beruna until Aslan came with the creatures he had freed. Then he was crowned at Cair Paravel as High King, above his brother and sisters. In the years of his reign he drove back the giants on Narnia's northern border.

In 1941 Susan's horn called the four of them back, to a Narnia ruled by the Telmarines. Peter fought King Miraz in single combat on Prince Caspian's behalf. Afterwards Aslan told him that he and Susan would not return. In 1942, while Edmund and Lucy were away on the Dawn Treader, Peter was at Professor Kirke's, being coached for an examination.

Death and descent

In 1949 Peter and Edmund were on the platform, waiting to meet a train. Lucy was on board with their parents, and when it crashed, all of them were killed. Susan was not on the train. Narnia came to its end that same year, and in Aslan's country it was Peter, as High King, who shut the door on it at Aslan's bidding.

Peter left no children. The line of the King of the West and the Evenstar went on only through Susan, to Lily Potter, then to Harry.

pages.title: Edmund Pevensie
infobox: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (16 October 1950)
King Edmund the Just of Narnia
pages.html:
Edmund Pevensie, the younger of the two Pevensie brothers, betrayed his brother and sisters to the White Witch. He was redeemed when Aslan died in his place on the Stone Table. He reigned in Narnia as King Edmund the Just, and in 1949 he was killed in the railway accident that his sister Susan survived.

The White Witch

Edmund was born in 1930, the third of the four Pevensies. In 1940 the children were sent out of London, away from the bombing, to the country house of Professor Digory Kirke. Lucy found Narnia first, through a wardrobe. Edmund was unkind to her about it, and when he had been through himself he told the others that he had never been there at all.

On that first visit he met the White Witch. She fed him enchanted Turkish Delight and promised to make him a prince. Later he slipped away to her and betrayed the others. By the Deep Magic his life was forfeit to her, as every traitor's was. Aslan gave himself up to die in Edmund's place on the Stone Table, and rose again.

King Edmund the Just

Forgiven, Edmund fought at the Battle of Beruna, where he cut his way through to the Witch and smashed her wand. He was badly wounded, and Lucy's cordial healed him. He was crowned with the others at Cair Paravel. Of the four, he grew to be the gravest, and the wisest in council. When Prince Rabadash of Calormen sought Susan's hand, Edmund went with her to Tashbaan. The prince meant to keep her there by force, and Edmund helped to get her safely home.

He went back to Narnia with Peter, Susan and Lucy in 1941. In 1942 Susan was in America with their parents, while Edmund and Lucy stayed with their cousin Eustace's family. That summer he sailed with Lucy and Eustace on the Dawn Treader. At the end of the voyage Aslan told him and Lucy that in their own world he had another name, by which they must learn to know him there.

Death and descent

Edmund was killed in the railway accident of 1949, with Peter, Lucy and their parents. He and Peter were on the platform, waiting to meet the train, when it crashed. Like all four Pevensies he descended from Aragorn and Arwen. That line survived only in Susan.

pages.title: Lucy Pevensie
infobox: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (16 October 1950)
Queen Lucy the Valiant of Narnia
pages.html:
Lucy Pevensie, the youngest of the four, was the first of them to find Narnia and the one who loved Aslan best. She reigned there as Queen Lucy the Valiant. In 1949 she was killed in the railway accident that her sister Susan survived by not being aboard.

The wardrobe

Lucy was born in 1932, the youngest of the Pevensies. In 1940 the four children were sent to stay at Professor Kirke's house in the country. During a game of hide-and-seek she stepped into a wardrobe. She came out in a snowy wood by a lamp-post, where she met the faun Mr Tumnus. He had orders to hand any human child he met to the White Witch. He took Lucy home to tea meaning to do just that, and then found he could not bring himself to.

Nobody believed her, not even after Edmund had been there too, until all four of them went through together. Father Christmas gave her a dagger and a little bottle of cordial, a single drop of which would heal almost any wound. With Susan she kept watch when Aslan was killed on the Stone Table, and saw him rise. After the Battle of Beruna her cordial healed Edmund. Aslan had to remind her, rather sharply, that others were wounded too. She was crowned Queen Lucy the Valiant at Cair Paravel. In the years of her reign she rode to war like her brothers, and fought as an archer at the defence of Anvard.

Later voyages

In 1941 the four were called back to Narnia. Lucy saw Aslan when none of the others could. She went after him, though at first nobody would follow her.

In 1942 she sailed on the Dawn Treader with Edmund and their cousin Eustace, to the very edge of Aslan's country. On the island of the magician Coriakin she read a spell from his book to make hidden things visible. Aslan himself appeared to her.

Death and descent

She was killed in the railway accident of 1949. She was travelling on the train with her parents, while Peter and Edmund waited on the platform. Like all four Pevensies she descended from Aragorn and Arwen. She left no children. The line went on only through Susan, to Lily Potter and so to Harry.

pages.title: Narnia
infobox: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (16 October 1950)
Peter, Susan, Edmund and Lucy Pevensie, in its Golden Age
Magic: rings, a wardrobe, a horn, a picture, a railway accident
pages.html:
Narnia is a world of talking beasts, made and ruled by Aslan, who is Christ, into which children from England were called at need. In its Golden Age it was ruled by the four Pevensies, all of them descendants of Aragorn and Arwen. One of them, Susan Pevensie, Harry Potter's grandmother, reigned as a queen through a whole adult life before she came back a girl.

History

Aslan, the great Lion, son of the Emperor-beyond-the-Sea, sang Narnia into being in 1900 by English reckoning. Two children from London, Digory Kirke and Polly Plummer, watched him do it. So did Jadis, the witch they had brought with them by accident. Digory planted an apple there, and the tree that grew from it kept her out for many years. He took another of its apples home to London. The tree that grew from its core blew down long afterwards, and its wood was made into a wardrobe.

Jadis came back as the White Witch. For a hundred years she held the land in winter, always winter and never Christmas. It lasted until 1940, when four children came through that wardrobe in Digory Kirke's house and Aslan returned. He died on the Stone Table in the place of the traitor Edmund Pevensie, and rose again. The Witch was destroyed, and the four Pevensies were crowned at Cair Paravel. They reigned through the Golden Age of Narnia until, fully grown, they followed the White Stag back through the wardrobe one day and found that they were children again.

Time in Narnia does not keep pace with time in England. Centuries could pass there between one English year and the next. The Pevensies returned at Prince Caspian's call in 1941, when the Telmarines ruled. In 1942 Edmund and Lucy sailed east on the Dawn Treader with their cousin Eustace Scrubb. Later Eustace went back with his school friend Jill Pole, sent to find the lost Prince Rilian.

In 1949 by English reckoning Narnia came to its end. Those who were friends of Narnia went on into Aslan's country. Among them were Peter, Edmund and Lucy, killed with their parents in a railway accident. Susan was not with them.

Father Christmas came back to Narnia in 1940, the first sure sign that the Witch's winter was ending. He gave Peter, Susan and Lucy the gifts they carried through all their reign.

Narnia and Harry Potter's family

All four Pevensies descended from Aragorn and Arwen. The children Aslan crowned at Cair Paravel were heirs of the King of the West and the Evenstar. Susan, the only one of them to survive 1949, came back to Christ in her grief, moved above all by Aslan's courage. She spent her adult life disbelieved about Narnia, until her daughter Lily turned out to be a witch and so became the one person who could not dismiss it.

Lily's son Harry knows nothing of Narnia. Nor does he know that Aslan, whose other name the Pevensies were told to learn in their own world, is the man he saw by a fallen pillar in the Chamber of Secrets.
