    Goldar carried Kimberly Hart off to the Moon, where Lord Zedd meant to make her his queen. The Rangers brought her home.
  106. Autumn 1994
    Margali Szardos takes the Soulsword
    Amanda Sefton gave the Soulsword to her mother, Margali Szardos, which was what Margali had wanted all along. With it Margali killed every witch and wizard who stood ahead of her on the Winding Way.
  107. October 1994
    Tommy Oliver becomes the White Ranger
    Tommy Oliver came back to the Rangers as the White Ranger, and their leader.
  108. 15 November 1994
    Dark Heart is shown to be Tyler Steele
    Grimlord's cyborg warrior Dark Heart, whom Ryan Steele had beaten and spared, proved to be Ryan's own father with his memory wiped. Professor Hart restored his mind, though not his body, by giving him Ryan's memories.
  109. November 1994
    The power transfer
    Jason, Zack and Trini told everybody they knew, Zordon first, that they were leaving for the World Peace Conference in Geneva. With the Sword of Light their powers passed to Rocky, Adam and Aisha. The three never went to Geneva: on Safehaven, far out in space, they took up the Omega powers in secret.
  110. November 1994
    The Omega Rangers carry off Lord Zedd
    Late in November the Omega Rangers took Dayne, the bounty hunter Lord Zedd had hired, then stormed the Moon Palace. Jason Lee Scott brought the Red Omegazord down on the giant Zedd, who was carried off to a cell on Safehaven.
  111. 17 November 1994
    Grimlord blows up his dungeon
    While Grimlord's aircraft bombed Professor Hart's laboratory, Ryan Steele went into virtual reality with his father to face Grimlord, who blew up his own dungeon round them. Tyler Steele, wounded by Decimator, came back to human shape, only for Grimlord to carry him off again.
  112. December 1994
    Kiya kills the Blue Emissary
    Kiya Kyatyl, the Blue Omega Ranger, murdered the Blue Emissary on Safehaven, then freed the prisoners in its vault, calling them the Anointed. The first of the Empyreals rose from the Emissary's death.
  113. December 1994
    Pete Wisdom leaves Black Air
    Sickened by what he had done for it at Ronsaphan, in Thailand, Pete Wisdom asked to leave Black Air. It let him go on condition that he went first with the Excalibur team to Genosha as its observer.
  114. December 1994
    The Omega Rangers' secret comes out
    Kiya struck Jason Lee Scott down. Xi brought the three Omega Rangers of Earth to the Command Center with their faces bare, which is how Zordon and the Rangers learnt that the peace conference had been a lie. Zordon forgave them at once.
  115. December 1994
    Kurt Wagner learns Moira's secret
    Kurt Wagner worked out that Moira MacTaggert had the Legacy Virus, and she told him the truth.
  116. December 1994
    The Anointed are beaten
    Both teams of Rangers, helped by the Ranger Slayer, beat Kiya's Anointed at Safehaven. The Solarix drained the Empowered of their stolen Power. Kiya went back into a cell, while Dayne let Lord Zedd go free.
  117. December 1994
    The team on Genosha
    Black Air sent the team to Genosha to look into bullets made to pierce mutant skin. There, fighting beside the island's refugees, Pete Wisdom showed for the first time that he was a mutant himself, with knives of heat at his fingertips.
  118. December 1994
    The Red Emissary dies in the wreck
    The Red Emissary went into the ruin of Lord Drakkon's made world to look for him, where an Empyreal tore the Emissary to pieces. The Empyreals offered Drakkon his freedom if he would bring them to the Yellow Emissary.
  119. December 1994
    Lord Drakkon falls to Earth
    In the middle of December Lord Drakkon fell beside the Command Center inside what looked like a meteor, half mad with terror. Tommy Oliver knocked him senseless. Zordon locked him in a cell under the Command Center.
  120. December 1994
    Matt Cook becomes the Green Ranger
    Grace Sterling and Billy Cranston woke the dead Dragon Coin with the energy of Psycho Green's dagger. In a battle with Lord Zedd's Dark Rangers, Grace's teleporter snatched Matt Cook from under a falling wall, and he became the second Green Ranger.
  121. December 1994
    The dome over Angel Grove
    Over Christmas Lord Zedd shut Angel Grove under a dome of green Chaos energy. From inside it Matt Cook took off his helmet on every screen in the city, the first Ranger whose name the public knew, then brought the dome down with the Dragonzord. Zordon barred Billy Cranston from the Command Center for his part in making Matt a Ranger.
  122. 1995
    The fall of Outer Heaven
    The Western powers learnt that Outer Heaven, Big Boss's fortified mercenary state two hundred kilometres north of Galzburg in South Africa, had built the walking nuclear weapon Metal Gear. FOXHOUND sent in Gray Fox, who was captured. Then Big Boss, who secretly ruled the place through his phantom, sent the rookie Solid Snake alone on Operation Intrude N313, expecting him to fail. Helped by a resistance inside the fortress, Snake freed Gray Fox, destroyed Metal Gear and brought down Venom Snake at its head.
  123. 1995
    Apocalypse returns
    Apocalypse came back from the Moon, where he had been left for dead.
  124. 1995
    Outer Heaven is bombed
    Days after Solid Snake came out, NATO aircraft bombed what was left of Outer Heaven flat. Mercenaries, resistance fighters and civilians died alike. The world was told that there had been an earthquake in southern Africa.
  125. 1995
    Roy Campbell takes command of FOXHOUND
    With Big Boss unmasked, command of FOXHOUND passed to his deputy, Colonel Roy Campbell. Solid Snake left the unit. Gray Fox, whom he had rescued, disappeared.
  126. January 1995
    The Omega Rangers take Lord Drakkon
    Against Zordon's orders, Jason, Zack and Trini took Lord Drakkon from his cell under the Command Center to guide them against the Empyreals. Zordon called it a betrayal, then disowned them.
  127. January 1995
    The Empyreals destroy Hartunia
    The Orange Empyreal, which answered to Zartus of Eltar, burnt the world of Hartunia while the Omega Rangers got its people away. Its empress, Evor Til, died saving them.
  128. January 1995
    Lord Drakkon betrays the Yellow Emissary
    Lord Drakkon led the Omega Rangers to the Yellow Emissary's hiding place, having led the Empyreals there too. They killed the Emissary. Drakkon slipped his collar, took back his powers, wrecked Xi, then flew off in the Omega Rangers' ship, leaving them stranded.
  129. January 1995
    Zartus breaks Zordon's tube
    Zartus, Supreme Guardian of Eltar, came to the Command Center, smashed Zordon's tube and claimed the Earth for Eltar. Zordon, a Maia, lost only the form he wore. He came back in a body of metal.
  130. January 1995
    The Empyreals destroy the Command Center
    Zartus's Empyreals destroyed Promethea's headquarters, Lord Zedd's palace on the Moon and the Command Center. Eltarian ships held the sky for a matter of days.
  131. January 1995
    The Empyreals are destroyed
    Once Grace Sterling had broken Zartus's hold on them, the Rangers of both teams destroyed all three Empyreals. The Blue Emissary rose alive from the first to fall.
  132. January 1995
    Zordon kills Zartus
    On the Moon Zordon laid down his weapon before Lord Zedd, who saw at last that Zartus had cursed the Zeo Crystal. Together they turned on Zartus, and Zordon killed him with a piece of the Crystal.
  133. January 1995
    Zordon goes into a new tube
    Eltar called its armies home. Zordon gave up his failing body of metal for a new tube that Grace Sterling made, then made his peace with her.
  134. January 1995
    The Death Ranger wakes
    A visitor to Safehaven took the Gold Omega morpher from its vault to wake a friend. What woke was Spa'ark, the Death Ranger, who struck down Jason Lee Scott and Yale, then wore their bodies.
  135. January 1995
    Jason Lee Scott loses his link to the Power
    Shown his mother alive, days after her death at home, Jason refused the vision and broke the Gold morpher from within. It ended the Death Ranger's hold, but it tore out his own link to the Power.
  136. January 1995
    Trini Kwan becomes the Red Omega Ranger
    Trini Kwan sent Jason home to his father, then took the Red Omega powers herself. Kevor Vrin, a Hartunian orphan, became the Yellow Omega Ranger.
  137. February 1995
    Rita Repulsa becomes Mistress Vile
    Fished out of her dumpster by Divatox, Rita Repulsa overthrew her father, Master Vile, to become Dark Specter's general, Mistress Vile. With Alpha 1 she fetched the Vessel, the body Zordon had lost long ago, from the planet Bizerk.
  138. February 1995
    Mistress Vile takes the Zeo Crystal
    Mistress Vile beat Lord Zedd on the Moon with an army of Thralls, then seized the Zeo Crystal. Matt Cook stayed behind to hold her off while the other Rangers got away, which is how she took him prisoner.
  139. February 1995
    Matt Cook is bound with the Sword of Darkness
    Mistress Vile bound Matt Cook to her with a new Sword of Darkness. Under her spell he led her Putties against the Youth Center in Angel Grove. Breaking the sword, which had once freed Tommy Oliver, did not free him.
  140. February 1995
    Lord Drakkon frees Kiya Kyatyl
    At the beginning of February Lord Drakkon walked into the vault on Safehaven, let out Kiya Kyatyl, then took her through the Master Arch to his own world.
  141. February 1995
    The Drakkon Rangers
    In his own world, which Dark Specter's creatures were overrunning, Lord Drakkon talked the Ranger Slayer round. Finster-5 made six suits of Ranger armour, for Drakkon, Bulk, Trini, Scorpina, Kiya and the Ranger Slayer. Five of them came through into this world to fight Dark Specter.
  142. February 1995
    Grace Sterling is killed at the Arch
    Mistress Vile opened the Arch, an ancient gate into the Morphin Grid in the Bermuda Triangle, with the Zeo Crystal. There Matt Cook, still under her spell, killed Grace Sterling of Promethea.
  143. February 1995
    Dark Specter comes through the Arch
    Made to choose between saving Matt Cook and shutting the gate, the Rangers saved Matt. Dark Specter came through the Arch to take the Vessel for his body. His corruption spread through the Morphin Grid, turning every Ranger who morphed.
  144. February 1995
    The death of Lord Drakkon
    Inside the Morphin Grid Lord Drakkon burnt Dark Specter's corruption out of the Ranger Slayer with his White Tiger coin, as her arrow went through his heart. Dying, he gave her the coin, telling her to save the universe. He stayed dead when the world was mended.
  145. February 1995
    The Grid is cleansed and the world mended
    The Rangers of both teams cleansed the Morphin Grid. The Vessel was destroyed, while Dark Specter was thrown back into the dark, much reduced. The world was mended a second time, keeping no memory of the weeks since Lord Zedd's dome. Grace Sterling stayed dead; the world remembered her as lost with a Promethea research ship.
  146. February 1995
    Zordon wards the Zeo Crystal
    Zordon put the Zeo Crystal back in the caves beneath the Moon Palace and set on it a ward that no evil hand can pass. Master Vile found it there in November 1995.
  147. February 1995
    Jason Lee Scott goes to Geneva in earnest
    After his mother's funeral Jason Lee Scott took up his place at the peace conference in Geneva, months late, so that the lie became the truth for him. He stayed in Switzerland until the autumn of 1996.
  148. February 1995
    Rita Repulsa marries Lord Zedd
    Rita Repulsa came back to the Moon and, with the help of a love potion, married Lord Zedd.
  149. 22 February 1995
    Proof that Tyler Steele is alive
    Dr Monroe of the National Space Laboratory found a film of Tyler Steele on an old satellite, for which Grimlord's Skugs kidnapped him. The VR Troopers freed him, and the film showed Ryan Steele that his father was still alive.
  150. February 1995
    The Wizard of Deception takes the Dragon Coin
    The Wizard of Deception took the Dragon Coin from Matt Cook to arm his evil copy of Tommy Oliver. When Tommy destroyed the Wizard, the freed copy stayed in the Angel Grove of the 1700s with the coin and the Dragonzord.
  151. 28 February 1995
    The Red Python is destroyed
    Grimlord had shut Amy, a friend of Kaitlin Star's, inside the Red Python, an armoured warrior built from Tyler Steele's stolen knowledge. It nearly killed Kaitlin on 27 February. The next day its powers failed, and the Troopers brought Amy out alive before it destroyed itself.
  152. Spring 1995
    The Juggernaut is found beaten in Hoboken
    The X-Men found the Juggernaut lying beaten in Hoboken, New Jersey, after something stronger than himself had attacked him in Canada. He could say only one word before he passed out: 'Onslaught'.
  153. May 1995
    Kimberly in the Old West
    Kimberly Hart fell through a hole in time into the Angel Grove of the Old West. She found her way home again.
  154. Summer 1995
    Operation ALICE finds the Night Floors
    The painter Abigail Wright vanished from the Macallistar Building in Manhattan, where a copy of The King in Yellow had been passing from tenant to tenant. Delta Green sent agents under the name Operation ALICE. After dark they found the Night Floors above the building, and beyond them the Night World of the King.
  155. Summer 1995
    The Cooks move to Florida
    Matt Cook's family moved from Angel Grove to Florida. He had been close to Aisha Campbell that spring. He kept the Rangers' secret.
  156. Summer 1995
    Avalon falls from the sky
    Magneto's space station, Avalon, was wrecked and fell from the sky. Piotr Rasputin got the helpless Magneto into an escape pod with him, which came down in Antarctica. There Magneto disappeared.
  157. Summer 1995
    Death of Thunderstrike
    Eric Masterson took up the cursed Bloodaxe to stop a demon that threatened every life on Earth, and the curse took him. Thor came home from the war to face him. Inside his own mind Masterson broke the curse, but the blast that destroyed the axe and the mace Thunderstrike killed him.
  158. Summer 1995
    Dream Nails is blown up
    Kitty Pryde went with Pete Wisdom to find out what had killed his friend Ed Culley, and the trail led to Dream Nails, a Black Air base in the Midlands. There a Black Air telepath, Shrine, all but killed him, before the two of them blew the place up.

Characters introduced

  • Amos Diggory
  • Bartemius Crouch
  • Ludo Bagman

pages.title: Book 5
pages.html:
Front page · The Books

Book 5

Book Five of the Malfoid Saga · 1995 to 1996 · Untitled

This book has not been written yet and has no title. Events already fixed for its years are listed below and on the timeline.

Events in these years

  1. August 1995
    Rahne Sinclair comes home to Muir Island
    Rahne Sinclair came to Muir Island on leave from X-Factor, and stayed to look after Moira MacTaggert. She joined the Excalibur team that autumn.
  2. August 1995
    Rory Campbell loses a leg
    Rory Campbell lost a leg to a laser on Muir Island, in a struggle with Spoor, the Acolyte he had been trying to treat.
  3. August 1995
    Pete Wisdom joins the team
    After Dream Nails, Kitty Pryde asked Pete Wisdom to join the team, and kissed him.
  4. 12 September 1995
    Ryan Steele goes back to his boyhood
    Strickland, an inventor of Karl Ziktor's, went back through time to do away with Ryan Steele as a boy. Ryan followed him, fought beside his own younger self, and saw his father, though he had to return before he could speak to him.
  5. September 1995
    Rito Revolto destroys the Thunderzords
    Rita's brother Rito Revolto destroyed the Rangers' Thunderzords, and Ninjor gave them new powers.
  6. September 1995
    Piotr Rasputin attacks Pete Wisdom
    Having crossed half the world to find Kitty Pryde, Piotr Rasputin reached Muir Island and saw her kiss Pete Wisdom on the quay. He went for him. Pete burnt his spine with his knives of heat before Brian Braddock and Meggan could stop the fight.
  7. September 1995
    The Ninja coins
    After the Thunderzords were destroyed, Ninjor gave the Rangers new powers, the Ninja coins. Tommy Oliver became the White Ninja Ranger with the Falconzord. Kimberly Hart took the Crane.
  8. 18 September 1995
    Grimlord drains Tyler Steele's knowledge
    Grimlord began to draw Tyler Steele's knowledge of virtual reality into a prism, making the VR Troopers watch. The next day he blew up his dungeon with Ryan Steele inside it. Ryan survived, as did his dog, Jeb.
  9. 20 September 1995
    Ryan Steele rescues his father
    In a cavern where Grimlord was holding him, Ryan Steele freed his father, Tyler Steele, after more than ten years. He brought out Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese as well. Grimlord's lightning destroyed Ryan's Virtualizer, leaving him without his armour.
  10. 21 September 1995
    Grimlord raises the Virtual Dark Fortress
    With the prism Grimlord gave himself new strength, abandoned his ruined dungeon and raised the Virtual Dark Fortress on the far side of the reality barrier. He made new commanders, Despera, Doom Master and Oraclon. In Crossworld City the karate master Tao Chong nursed Tyler Steele back to health.
  11. 22 September 1995
    Ryan Steele's second armour
    Tyler Steele built his son a new suit of blue armour, powered by a crystal that Tao Chong supplied. Ryan Steele wore it for the first time that day, when the three VR Troopers beat Doom Master's army in a quarry.
  12. 2 October 1995
    The Skybase becomes the Troopertron
    Grimlord trapped Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese between the worlds, meaning to send the whole Earth after them. With a command given him by his father, Ryan Steele turned the Troopers' Skybase into the Troopertron, a fighting robot, then broke Grimlord's machine.
  13. 4 October 1995
    Kaitlin Star becomes two
    A mirror machine of Grimlord's had split Kaitlin Star into herself and an evil double. The double turned against Grimlord, Professor Hart joined the two again, and Kaitlin kept the power to become two Troopers at will.
  14. 11 October 1995
    Tyler Steele leaves Crossworld City
    Tyler Steele said goodbye to his son, then went away to secret work on a way of destroying Grimlord's world. He came home that Christmas.
  15. Autumn 1995
    Onslaught gathers the Sentinels
    The word Onslaught turned up in a Sentinel laboratory in Kentucky whose best scientists had vanished, and on the walls of a Sentinel base stripped bare. Through the winter Onslaught's herald, Post, fought the X-Men in his name.
  16. 3 November 1995
    Ryan Steele passes up Grimlord's secret
    Inside a pyramid opened by the archaeologist Nebraska Smith, Ryan Steele came within reach of learning who Grimlord was. He turned back to save Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese instead. Oraclon sealed the doorway behind them.
  17. November 1995
    Kimberly leaves for the Pan Global Games
    Kimberly Hart left Angel Grove to train for the Pan Global Games in Florida. She gave her coin to Katherine Hillard, the new Pink Ranger.
  18. November 1995
    Master Vile's Orb of Doom
    Rita's father, Master Vile, came to the Moon and used the Orb of Doom to turn back time on Earth.
  19. Autumn 1995
    Sabretooth nearly kills Psylocke
    Sabretooth broke out of his cell at Professor Xavier's school and nearly killed Psylocke. A draught from the dark realm of the Crimson Dawn saved her life. It left a red mark over her left eye.
  20. November 1995
    Rahne Sinclair learns who her father is
    After a fire in the Kinross woods across the water from Muir Island, Rahne Sinclair faced the Reverend Craig, who had brought her up, and learnt that he was her father.
  21. November 1995
    Kimberly Hart in France
    Days after leaving for Florida, Kimberly Hart went to St Moineau in France, where her mother and stepfather had vanished. Zack Taylor and Trini Kwan came from the Omega Rangers to help her. With two young people of the town, Serge and his sister, Britt, they beat Goldar, who had a new ally, Verto.
  22. 1996
    John Mason helps retake Alcatraz
    John Mason was brought out of Wolfburg to guide a naval team into Alcatraz, which renegade Marines had seized with rockets of poison gas aimed at San Francisco.
  23. 1996
    Buffy Summers is called as the Slayer
    Buffy Summers, a fifteen-year-old Los Angeles schoolgirl, was called as the Slayer and trained by the Watcher Merrick. After he was killed and she burned down her school gymnasium full of vampires, her parents' marriage broke up.
  24. 1996
    Whistler shows Angel the Slayer
    A demon named Whistler found Angel starving in the streets of New York and showed him the newly called Slayer, Buffy Summers.
  25. c. 1996
    A Prague mob nearly destroys Drusilla
    Shortly before 1997 a mob in Prague nearly destroyed Drusilla, leaving her weakened.
  26. 1996
    Elias Zandi dies
    Elias Zandi died of a massive heart attack, leaving his fortune to the restoration of D'ni with Richard Watson as sole chairman, and his land round the Cleft to his estranged son, Jeff.
  27. 1996
    Bond retakes Alcatraz
    When renegade Marines under General Francis Hummel seized Alcatraz and threatened San Francisco with rockets of VX gas, James Bond was brought out of Wolfburg as the only man who had ever escaped the island, to take a team back in.
  28. February 1996
    The Command Center is destroyed
    A bomb destroyed the Command Center outside Angel Grove.
  29. February 1996
    Black Air hunts Alistaire Stuart
    Black Air hunted Alistaire Stuart, once of the Weird Happenings Organisation. It shot down the aircraft that was bringing him to Muir Island with Kurt Wagner and Meggan, but all three lived. Alistaire told the team that Black Air had begun in the Ministry of Defence, and had taken over his old organisation's work by a vote that the Hellfire Club had bought.
  30. 20 February 1996
    Knighttime stops time
    Grimlord's ally Knighttime betrayed him by stopping time over the whole Earth, which nobody else in the world noticed. Ryan Steele destroyed his machine with Grimlord's help, after which Grimlord kept Knighttime a prisoner.
  31. 21 February 1996
    The raid on the Virtual Dark Fortress
    Skugs stole Galileo, a robot the VR Troopers had built to hold the knowledge of their laboratory. The Troopers followed it into the Virtual Dark Fortress, where Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese overloaded Oraclon, leaving the fortress crippled. Grimlord was neither beaten nor unmasked, and nothing more is recorded of the VR Troopers.
  32. March 1996
    Brian Braddock joins the Hellfire Club
    Brian Braddock took the seat of Black Bishop in the London Inner Circle of the Hellfire Club, his father's old society, winning it in a duel.
  33. April 1996
    The Machine Empire arrives
    The Machine Empire drove Rita and Zedd from the Moon, and the Rangers took up the powers of the Zeo Crystal.
  34. April 1996
    Black Air takes Douglock
    Black Air harpooned Douglock from a jet and carried him off to be taken apart. The team raided its Acquisition Station in North Yorkshire, where Meggan buried the place in molten rock, but Douglock had already been moved to London.
  35. April 1996
    Tommy Oliver becomes the Red Zeo Ranger
    The Zeo Crystal gave the Rangers new powers. Tommy Oliver became the Red Zeo Ranger, the leader of the Zeo Rangers.
  36. May 1996
    Kimberly's letter
    Kimberly Hart wrote to Tommy Oliver from Florida to tell him that she had met someone else.
  37. May 1996
    Tommy Oliver finds his brother
    Tommy Oliver found the brother he had never known, David Trueheart, whom Sam Trueheart had brought up.
  38. June 1996
    Britanic becomes Captain Britain again
    Brian Braddock, who had called himself Britanic since 1994, took up the name of Captain Britain again.
  39. June 1996
    Charles Xavier is revealed as Onslaught
    The Juggernaut came back to Xavier's school and asked Jean Grey to look into his mind, where she learnt that Charles Xavier was Onslaught. Onslaught shut the Juggernaut inside his own crimson gem, beat the X-Men and left their mansion in ruins.
  40. June 1996
    London burns
    Black Air and the London Inner Circle of the Hellfire Club, which had been buying votes in Parliament, joined Douglock's captive body to a demon that lay beneath London. The city broke out in fires and riots. Then the team stormed Blackwall, Black Air's headquarters, and Amanda Sefton bound the demon.
  41. June 1996
    Onslaught carries off Franklin Richards
    Wearing Xavier's face, Onslaught came to Four Freedoms Plaza for Franklin Richards, the grown son of Reed and Sue Richards. He struck down the Fantastic Four and the Avengers who came to help, then carried Franklin away to use his power.
  42. July 1996
    Moira MacTaggert keeps the team at home
    The X-Men came to Muir Island to tell the team that Charles Xavier had become Onslaught, and Moira MacTaggert forbade it to go to America. That summer the battle with Onslaught in New York ended with the Avengers and the Fantastic Four giving their lives.
  43. Summer 1996
    Thor comes home to fight Onslaught
    Heimdall saw the shadow of Onslaught fall over New York, so Odin called Thor home from the war in the Pegasus galaxy. He came down the Rainbow Bridge to stand with the Avengers and the Fantastic Four.
  44. July 1996
    Alistaire Stuart heads a new department
    The government folded what was left of Black Air and of the Weird Happenings Organisation into a new department under Alistaire Stuart. He offered Rory Campbell its work with mutants.
  45. Summer 1996
    Retired heroes answer the Avengers' call
    With Franklin Richards in Onslaught's hands, the Avengers called on everyone who had ever served. Tony Stark put on the armour one last time. Hank Pym, Janet van Dyne, Clint Barton, Wanda Maximoff, the Vision, Pietro Maximoff and Sam Wilson came out of retirement with him. Spider-Man declined, to go on raising his little daughter.
  46. Summer 1996
    Onslaught's Sentinels seal off Manhattan
    Onslaught's Sentinels came down on Manhattan and sealed it off from the world. He made Franklin Richards raise a black fortress in Central Park, then loosed a pulse that killed every machine in New York and brought down S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Helicarrier.
  47. Summer 1996
    Thor drags Charles Xavier out of Onslaught
    Thor smashed through the crack that Cable, Cyclops and Sue Richards had made in Onslaught's armour, then dragged Charles Xavier out alive. Xavier's telepathy was gone.

pages.title: Book 6
pages.html:
Front page · The Books

Book 6

Book Six of the Malfoid Saga · 1996 to 1997 · Untitled

This book has not been written yet and has no title. Events already fixed for its years are listed below and on the timeline.

Events in these years

  1. August 1996
    The heroes give themselves to Onslaught
    In Central Park the Hulk's blow broke Onslaught's armour and tore Bruce Banner from him, leaving Onslaught as pure force. To give it a body that could be struck, Thor, the Fantastic Four, eight more Avengers, Banner and Victor von Doom went into it. The X-Men destroyed it, and the world believed the heroes dead with it.
  2. August 1996
    Franklin Richards makes a world
    As Onslaught came apart, Franklin Richards fell free with Nate Grey. Without knowing it, he caught the fallen and carried them into a world of his own making, held in a small blue ball.
  3. August 1996
    Charles Xavier gives himself up
    Blaming himself for Onslaught, Charles Xavier gave himself up to Valerie Cooper of the American government. He was held in secret, where a man called Bastion questioned him.
  4. 7 September 1996
    The wish at Hillhurst Mansion
    At Hillhurst Mansion, outside Charterville, Drew McCormick, his sister, Jo, and their friend Roland Williams let the phasm Flabber out of a pipe organ. He granted their wish to be the Beetleborgs, the heroes of a comic book. The wish also let the comic's villains, Vexor's Magnavores, out into the town.
  5. 12 September 1996
    Wolfgang Smith comes to Hillhurst
    Wolfgang Smith, a Garou whose mind was gone, turned up in Charterville. The Magnavores tried to recruit him, but he settled at Hillhurst Mansion as the household's pet.
  6. 5 October 1996
    Art Fortunes meets the Beetleborgs
    At a comic convention Vexor tried to have the artist Art Fortunes kidnapped. The Beetleborgs, whom Art had invented, fought the monsters off in front of him.
  7. October 1996
    Jason Lee Scott becomes the Gold Ranger
    Home from Switzerland, Jason Lee Scott took up the Gold Ranger's powers from the injured Trey of Triforia. He had been without powers since January 1995, but these were Triforia's, held in a staff, and did not need the link he had lost. They had been meant for Billy Cranston.
  8. October 1996
    The Mutant Liberation Front raids Muir Island
    The Mutant Liberation Front raided Muir Island for Charles Xavier's secret files on his X-Men. Moira MacTaggert held them off behind a force field, and Dani Moonstar, who had been among the raiders as an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., called the raid off.
  9. Autumn 1996
    The Black Widow stands the Avengers down
    Every hero the Black Widow asked to join a new team of Avengers turned her down, so she stood the team down and went back to the life of a spy.
  10. October 1996
    Kitty Pryde opens Doug Ramsey's grave
    In Salem Center Kitty Pryde phased into the grave of Doug Ramsey and found his bones still in it, so Douglock could not be Doug come back. She said goodbye to her old friend, then introduced herself to Douglock.
  11. Autumn 1996
    The Thunderbolts appear in New York
    A new band of heroes called the Thunderbolts appeared in New York, and the city gave them the Fantastic Four's empty headquarters. They were the Masters of Evil in new masks, under Baron Helmut Zemo.
  12. 19 October 1996
    The Zeo Rangers come to Charterville
    Prince Sprocket of the Machine Empire sent Klank, Orbus and a company of Cogs to Charterville, where Vexor supplied a monster for them to make into a giant. Jason Lee Scott, the Gold Ranger, came with Tommy Oliver's Zeo Rangers to help the Beetleborgs. The Zeo Megazord destroyed the monster, Scrapjaw.
  13. 11 November 1996
    Shadowborg takes the Beetleborgs' powers
    Vexor made Shadowborg, a black Beetleborg, from a piece of the Blue Stinger's armour. Shadowborg beat Drew McCormick, Jo McCormick and Roland Williams, then took their powers.
  14. 13 November 1996
    Josh Baldwin becomes the White Blaster Beetleborg
    Art Fortunes drew a fourth Beetleborg, the White Blaster, which Flabber brought to life for Josh Baldwin, a boy new to Charterville. Josh won back the powers that Shadowborg had taken.
  15. November 1996
    Billy Cranston leaves for Aquitar
    Billy Cranston, ageing at great speed, was made young again in the Eternal Falls on Aquitar. He stayed there with Cestria.
  16. November 1996
    Graydon Creed is shot dead
    Graydon Creed, the founder of the Friends of Humanity, who had run for President of the United States on a promise to lock mutants away, was shot dead at a rally on the eve of the election.
  17. 16 November 1996
    Shadowborg is destroyed
    Drew McCormick, in the Mega Blue armour, destroyed Shadowborg in Charterville. The White Blaster's powers ended with the enemy they had been made to fight, so Josh Baldwin was an ordinary boy again.
  18. 23 November 1996
    The Gold powers go back to Trey
    The Gold Ranger's powers, which were draining Jason Lee Scott's life, went back to Trey of Triforia.
  19. Winter 1996
    The Sullivan murders begin again
    Two and a half years after the suicide of Walter Sullivan, Peter Walls, a schoolboy, was beaten to death in a hotel room in South Ashfield. His body was found six months later, in the summer of 1997, with 12121 cut into it. The police blamed an imitator.
  20. December 1996
    Flabber keeps his first Christmas
    At Hillhurst Mansion the three Beetleborgs helped Flabber to keep Christmas for the first time. The Magnavores tried to steal it, without success.
  21. December 1996
    Piotr Rasputin refuses the Acolytes
    The Acolytes, rebuilding Avalon from its wreckage under Exodus, asked Piotr Rasputin to come back to them. He met two of them under the Australian outback and refused.
  22. 1997
    Riven released
    The game Riven was released.
  23. 1997
    Buffy Summers moves to Sunnydale
    Buffy and her mother moved to Sunnydale, California, a town built over a Hellmouth, where her new Watcher, Rupert Giles, worked as the school librarian.
  24. 1997
    Angel goes to Sunnydale
    Angel went to Sunnydale to help Buffy, and fought beside her against the Master's followers and his own former companions.
  25. 1997
    Jenny Calendar watches Angel for the Kalderash
    Janna of the Kalderash, living as the computer teacher Jenny Calendar, was in Sunnydale on her clan's orders to watch Angel, and her uncle Enyos came to hold her to the task.
  26. 1997
    Spike brings Drusilla to Sunnydale
    William the Bloody brought the weakened Drusilla to Sunnydale, where he met Angel again.
  27. 1997
    The D'ni Restoration Council is founded
    Richard Watson founded the D'ni Restoration Council with Dr Ikuro Kodama, Victor Laxman and Dr Marie Sutherland to survey the city, make it safe, restore its machinery and record what it found.
  28. 1997
    The Goa'uld return through the Stargate
    Apophis, who had been taking over Ra's domains since Ra's death and had heard that Thor was busy elsewhere, broke Ra's ban on Earth and came through the Stargate. His Jaffa killed the soldiers guarding it and carried one off. On Abydos he took Sha'uri and Skaara as hosts. The programme was reopened with teams sent out to other worlds; Jack O'Neill was recalled to command SG-1, and Daniel Jackson returned to Earth.
  29. 1997
    Zanzibar Land declares independence
    Zanzibar Land in Central Asia rose against the Commonwealth of Independent States, beat back its armies with mercenaries gathered from all over the world and declared itself an independent military state with Big Boss behind it.
  30. 1997
    Teal'c turns against Apophis
    Teal'c, Bra'tac's best pupil and his successor as First Prime of Apophis, turned against his master and joined SG-1, and Bra'tac became one of Earth's closest allies and a leader of the free Jaffa.
  31. 1997
    Darla is destroyed in Sunnydale
    Serving the imprisoned Master in Sunnydale, Darla was staked by Angel as she tried to kill the Slayer Buffy Summers.
  32. 1997
    Thor's Hammer destroyed
    On Cimmeria the device called Thor's Hammer seized the Jaffa Teal'c for the larva he carried, and SG-1 destroyed it to free him.
  33. 1997
    Nirrti wipes out Hanka
    To hide her breeding of a perfect host, Nirrti killed the people of Hanka with a plague. Only Cassandra survived.
  34. 1997
    The Supreme Intelligence returns
    The Supreme Intelligence, believed dead since the Avengers executed it in 1992, was found to have survived.
  35. c. 1997
    Joseph Schreiber writes about Wish House
    The journalist Joseph Schreiber published five pages in the magazine Concord about Wish House, the orphanage at Silent Hill. He accused the charity that ran it of being a mask for a cult called the Order.
  36. 1997
    Huey Emmerich drowns himself
    Huey Emmerich drowned himself in his family's swimming pool, nearly drowning his six-year-old stepdaughter, Emma, with him. His son Hal, who was seventeen, left home soon afterwards.
  37. January 1997
    Brian Braddock gives Meggan a ring
    In London, where many people blamed the team for the losses of the year before, Brian Braddock told Meggan that he wanted to be a scientist rather than a hero. He gave her a diamond ring. Then Spiral attacked them in the street for the Dragons of the Crimson Dawn.
  38. February 1997
    The Dragons of the Crimson Dawn take Brian Braddock
    At Piccadilly Circus the three Dragons of the Crimson Dawn carried Brian Braddock off. The same month Amanda Sefton left the team, saying goodbye to nobody but Piotr Rasputin.
  39. Spring 1997
    Divatox kidnaps Jason and Kimberly
    The space pirate Divatox took Jason Lee Scott and Kimberly Hart prisoner, meaning them as sacrifices to Maligore.
  40. March 1997
    Tommy Oliver becomes the Red Turbo Ranger
    With the Turbo powers the Rangers beat Divatox. Tommy Oliver became the Red Turbo Ranger.
  41. 10 April 1997
    Jo McCormick's face is changed
    Wolfgang Smith set off a spell from Flabber's spellbook that changed Jo McCormick's face for good. Flabber laid a second spell over it, so that Charterville went on seeing the girl it knew.
  42. Spring 1997
    Buffy Summers destroys the Master
    In the spring the Master fed on Buffy and left her to drown, and her brief death freed him; revived the same night, she destroyed him, and later ground his bones to powder when his followers tried to raise him.
  43. April 1997
    Zordon returns to Eltar
    Zordon went back to Eltar and left Earth in the keeping of others.
  44. April 1997
    Brian Braddock loses his powers
    Spiral took the team to the Dragons' fortress in Hong Kong. Brian Braddock turned their machine against them while Meggan took in the power that broke loose, so that the rift between the worlds could be sealed. It cost Brian his powers, and he left the team to find himself.
  45. 3 May 1997
    Divatox's wish
    The space pirate Divatox had her nephew, Elgar, carry Flabber off from Hillhurst Mansion, with Vexor's help, to grant her a wish. Her wish for treasure brought a monster out of a comic book with it, which Tommy Oliver's Turbo Rangers destroyed beside the Beetleborgs. That evening the Blue Turbo Ranger, Justin Stewart, made friends with the three.
  46. 20 May 1997
    Nukus is brought to life
    The Magnavores stole a drawing by Les Fortunes from the office of his brother, Art, then brought it to life. It was Nukus, who built the giant Borgslayer from every monster the Beetleborgs had beaten.
  47. 21 May 1997
    The Magnavores go back into the comics
    The Beetleborgs destroyed Borgslayer in Charterville with their lasers fired together. The blast swept Vexor, Typhus, Noxic and Jara back into the comic book they had come from. Nukus, who had planned it, was left without rivals.
  48. June 1997
    A bomb over the Swiss Alps
    A bomb brought down the aeroplane carrying Piotr Rasputin and Meggan over the Swiss Alps. Both lived. Piotr carried Meggan through the snow until the Knights of Wundagore took them in.
  49. c. 1997
    Asgard loses ground without Thor
    With its supreme commander believed dead, Asgard's fleet fought on in the Pegasus galaxy. It lost ships, worlds and Aesir that it could not replace. Asgard told the Goa'uld nothing, so that its bluff should hold.
  50. Summer 1997
    The thirteenth sacrament
    Sharon Blake, whose family belonged to the Order of Silent Hill, went into the woods by Wish House to look for them. She was drowned there, the thirteenth sacrament of the dead Walter Sullivan. Her body was not found until 2001.
  51. Summer 1997
    Archangel frees Psylocke from Kuragari
    Kuragari, the master of the Crimson Dawn, tried to take Psylocke as his bride. Warren Worthington, Archangel, beat him, and paid for her freedom with part of his own life.
  52. Summer 1997
    Delta Green reads the twelfth number
    When Peter Walls was found in South Ashfield with 12121 cut into him, Hollis Tibbetts of Delta Green read it as the police had not, as twelve of twenty-one. He never found out who the other nine were to be.

pages.title: Book 7
pages.html:
Front page · The Books

Book 7

Book Seven of the Malfoid Saga · 1997 to 1998 · Untitled

This book has not been written yet and has no title. Events already fixed for its years are listed below and on the timeline.

Events in these years

  1. August 1997
    Sari St Hubbins takes Pete Wisdom
    In Kassel, in Germany, Pete Wisdom fell into the hands of Sari St Hubbins, a contract killer and his old lover, who was working for what was left of Black Air. He burnt through his shackles and walked away.
  2. 8 September 1997
    Nukus destroys the Beetleborgs' armour
    In Charterville Nukus beat the Beetleborgs in a single fight, destroying their armour, weapons and powers. He turned Flabber to ice.
  3. 9 September 1997
    The Metallix armour
    The Crustaceans broke Les Fortunes out of Charterville Prison to draw monsters for Nukus. The same day Art Fortunes drew new armour for the Beetleborgs, which Flabber brought to life: Chromium Gold for Drew McCormick, Titanium Silver for Roland Williams, Platinum Purple for Jo McCormick.
  4. September 1997
    Tommy Oliver passes on the Red Turbo powers
    When he finished school, Tommy Oliver handed the Red Turbo powers to T.J. Johnson.
  5. 20 September 1997
    The changelings
    Divatox and Nukus made changelings that wrecked the park at Angel Grove as false Beetleborgs, while others wrecked Charterville as false Power Rangers. The two teams fought briefly until Justin Stewart stopped them. They joined the Turbozords to the Beetleborgs' Battle Vehicles to destroy the changelings.
  6. October 1997
    Moira MacTaggert goes into quarantine
    Moira MacTaggert, who had found that the Legacy Virus could now pass through the air to any mutant, sealed herself into quarantine in her laboratory on Muir Island. Rahne Sinclair leapt in after her as the doors closed.
  7. Autumn 1997
    Ashema comes to Franklin Richards
    As the weather went wrong all over the Earth, Ashema the Listener, a Celestial in the shape of a woman, came to Franklin Richards. She told him that his family was alive in the world in his blue ball, and that the Celestials meant him to choose between the two Earths.
  8. Autumn 1997
    The fallen of Onslaught come home
    Ashema took Franklin Richards into his world, where the fallen learnt who they were. They came home through the Negative Zone in a ship that Reed Richards, Tony Stark and Victor von Doom had built, each of them exactly as old as on the day they fell.
  9. Autumn 1997
    Doom is left in Franklin's world
    On the way home Victor von Doom tried to seize Franklin Richards's power. Thor stopped him with Reed Richards, then put him off the ship before it crossed into this world.
  10. Autumn 1997
    The Hulk and Bruce Banner are made one
    When the fallen came home, the Hulk and Bruce Banner, parted since Central Park, were joined into one being again.
  11. Autumn 1997
    Tony Stark retires again
    Home from Franklin's world, Tony Stark took off the armour he had put on one last time against Onslaught, and went back to his retirement. James Rhodes kept War Machine.
  12. 25 October 1997
    Divatox steals Les Fortunes
    Divatox carried Les Fortunes off to Angel Grove to draw monsters for her, not knowing that only Nukus could bring his drawings to life. Nukus came to fetch him, with the Beetleborgs behind him. The Turbo Rangers destroyed the one monster that came of it, Cutlass, with the Rescue Megazord.
  13. 7 November 1997
    The hunt for the Lost Comic
    Les Fortunes led the Crustaceans to the comic that he had made as a boy with his brother, Art, who took the Beetleborgs after them. Its Astral Coins called up the four Astralborgs to help the Beetleborgs. They also called up the four Mantrons, who served Nukus.
  14. Autumn 1997
    Drusilla is restored with her sire's blood
    Late in the year Drusilla was restored to strength in Sunnydale with the blood of her own sire, Angel.
  15. November 1997
    Dark Specter captures Zordon
    Eltar fell to evil, and Dark Specter took Zordon prisoner.
  16. November 1997
    The Sidri in Venice
    Black Air handed Kurt Wagner over to the Sidri, alien hunters whom he had once helped to save, and the team followed them to their ship beneath the Grand Canal in Venice. Douglock's Phalanx parts healed the Sidri, who left for space. Douglock declared himself his own person at last.
  17. 26 November 1997
    Roboborg is summoned
    Drew McCormick brought the Astral Sword together with all eight Astral Coins, which summoned the giant Roboborg. Roboborg sent the Mantrons back into the Lost Comic.
  18. December 1997
    The Avengers come together again
    A little over a year after the Black Widow had stood them down, the Avengers came together again.
  19. c. 1997
    Thor returns to Asgard's fleet
    Brought home by Franklin Richards with the other fallen heroes, Thor went straight back to the war in the Pegasus galaxy. He found Asgard losing it.
  20. 1998
    Angelus kills Jenny Calendar and Enyos
    After the curse broke, Angelus killed Janna, the Kalderash woman known as Jenny Calendar, and her uncle Enyos; her translation of the ritual survived her.
  21. 1998
    Buffy sends Angel into a hell dimension
    Buffy Summers was forced to send Angel into a hell dimension.
  22. 1998
    Apophis's motherships destroyed above Earth
    Apophis and Klorel brought two motherships against Earth. SG-1 and Bra'tac destroyed both. Apophis and Klorel escaped through the Stargate on board.
  23. January 1998
    Nightmare traps the team in dreams
    A fortnight after New Year the creatures called Bamfs ran riot on Muir Island and carried off Lockheed the dragon for Nightmare, a demon of dreams. He trapped the team in their worst dreams until Pete Wisdom broke out and beat him.
  24. 19 January 1998
    Angel's curse breaks
    On Buffy's seventeenth birthday Angel knew a moment of true happiness with her, the Kalderash curse broke, and Angelus returned and turned on everyone who had trusted Angel.
  25. 9 February 1998
    The Mega Spectra armour
    A machine built by Les Fortunes made Nukus far stronger. Roboborg answered by joining the Beetleborgs' first powers to their Metallix armour, which gave them the winged Mega Spectra armour.
  26. 10 February 1998
    Boron is summoned
    Les Fortunes drew the Astral Axe, which summoned Boron, a giant made to match Roboborg. Boron obeyed whoever held the Axe.
  27. 16 February 1998
    Roboborg fights Boron on the Moon
    Roboborg fought Boron on the Moon while the Beetleborgs fought the Crustaceans in Charterville.
  28. 21 February 1998
    Ecliptor takes the Astral Axe
    Astronema sent Ecliptor to the Charterville cemetery with her Quantrons to take the Astral Axe from Nukus. The Space Rangers followed him. Andros, the Red Space Ranger, pulled the Axe out of his hand with the help of Drew McCormick, but it went back to the Crustaceans.
  29. 2 March 1998
    Repgillian is destroyed
    Nukus loosed his worst monster, Repgillian, which emptied Urbana City. Roland Williams took the Astral Axe from the Crustaceans, so that Boron changed sides. Roboborg, Boron and the Beetleborgs destroyed the monster together.
  30. 2 March 1998
    Les Fortunes goes back to prison
    Les Fortunes walked back into Charterville Prison of his own accord, which left Nukus with nobody to draw monsters for him. Nukus was still at large, but the Beetleborgs had both giants.
  31. March 1998
    Pete Wisdom leaves Muir Island
    Pete Wisdom's love affair with Kitty Pryde ended, and he left Muir Island on a fishing boat while she watched from a window.
  32. Spring 1998
    Willow Rosenberg restores Angel's soul
    In the spring the witch Willow Rosenberg used Jenny Calendar's translation to restore the Kalderash curse.
  33. April 1998
    Legion in Jerusalem
    At the asking of Sabra, the Israeli heroine, the team went to Jerusalem, where three of the personalities of David Haller, called Legion, had seized the ground by the Wailing Wall. Meggan calmed them until they faded away.
  34. Spring 1998
    Amanda Sefton takes Limbo
    In Limbo Amanda Sefton and Kurt Wagner beat Belasco, who had held her mother prisoner there. Amanda stayed to rule it, so that its demons could not use its stepping discs to reach the Earth.
  35. May 1998
    Psylocke cages the Shadow King
    The Shadow King tricked Psylocke into a blow that silenced every telepath on Earth. She caught him in turn, but to keep him caged she could use her telepathy for nothing else.
  36. July 1998
    Heru'ur driven from Cimmeria again
    Heru'ur invaded Cimmeria after Thor's Hammer fell. Thor came himself in his ship, the Biliskner, and met SG-1 for the first time. Heru'ur escaped through the gate, leaving his army behind.

pages.title: Timeline
pages.html:
Front page

Timeline of the Malfoid Saga

From the Elder Days to the years still to come. 2743 entries.

Before the Sun: the Music, the Lamps and the Trees

  1. c. 80,000 BC
    Ilúvatar makes the Ainur
    Before the world was made, God, whom the Elves would call Eru Ilúvatar, the One, made the Ainur, the Holy Ones, the offspring of His thought, and they sang before Him in the Timeless Halls.
  2. c. 79,990 BC
    The Music of the Ainur
    Ilúvatar set a mighty theme before the Ainur, and out of it they made the Ainulindalë, the Great Music, from which the shape of the world would come.
  3. c. 79,985 BC
    Melkor sings out of tune
    Melkor, mightiest of the Ainur, the being whom Scripture calls Lucifer, the light-bearer, and Satan, and whom the Garou call the Wyrm, wove thoughts of his own into the Music in his pride, and the discord spread about him. It was the first rebellion against God and the first of all falls, and dark magic began with it.
  4. c. 79,980 BC
    Eä is given Being
    Ilúvatar showed the Ainur a Vision of the world their Music had foretold, then sent the Flame Imperishable into the Void and said 'Eä! Let these things Be', and the world was made.
  5. c. 79,000 BC
    The Valar enter the world
    Those of the Ainur who loved the Vision went down into Eä to labour on Arda; the mightiest were the Valar, among them Manwë, Varda, Ulmo, Aulë and Yavanna, and with them came the lesser spirits called the Maiar. Melkor came down too, claiming the world for his own.
  6. c. 78,000 BC
    The First War
    Melkor made war on the Valar for the mastery of Arda and marred whatever they made, raising mountains where they dug valleys, and he poured his own malice and power into the very substance of the world, so that nothing in it was afterwards wholly untouched by him.
  7. c. 77,000 BC
    Tulkas drives Melkor out
    Tulkas the Strong came laughing into Arda to aid the Valar, and Melkor fled before his wrath out of the world into the outer darkness, where he brooded for a long age.
  8. c. 76,000 BC
    Olórin among the Maiar
    Olórin, wisest of the Maiar, dwelt in the gardens of Lórien in the Undying Lands and went often to the house of Nienna, from whom he learned pity and patience; in a far later age Men would call him Gandalf.
  9. c. 70,000 BC
    Melkor seduces Sauron and the Balrogs
    Melkor drew many of the Maiar into his service, among them the spirits of fire later called Balrogs and Mairon of the people of Aulë the Smith, who became Sauron, his chief servant and lieutenant.
  10. c. 60,000 BC
    The Two Lamps are raised
    Aulë wrought two vast lamps, Illuin in the north and Ormal in the south, and Varda filled them with light; under them came the Spring of Arda, and the Valar dwelt on the isle of Almaren in the Great Lake.
  11. c. 58,000 BC
    Melkor delves Utumno
    Melkor returned in secret with his servants and delved the fortress of Utumno beneath the mountains of the north, with the outpost of Angband to the west of it, and his blight crept over the Spring of Arda.
  12. c. 55,000 BC
    Melkor throws down the Lamps
    Melkor came out of the north and threw down the pillars of the Lamps; their flames poured over the earth, Almaren was destroyed, and the lands and seas were broken and marred.
  13. c. 54,500 BC
    The Valar remove to Valinor
    The Valar left Middle-earth to the dark and went into Aman in the uttermost West, where they raised the mountain wall of the Pelóri and founded the guarded realm of Valinor and the city of Valmar.
  14. c. 52,020 BC
    The Two Trees of Valinor
    On the green mound of Ezellohar Yavanna sang into being the Two Trees, silver Telperion and golden Laurelin, whose waxing and waning light measured the Years of the Trees in Valinor while Middle-earth lay under the stars.
  15. c. 41,540 BC
    Varda kindles the stars
    Foreseeing the coming of the Elves, Varda made new and brighter stars from the silver dews of Telperion and set the Seven Stars of the Sickle of the Valar in the northern sky as a sign of doom to Melkor.
  16. c. 41,530 BC
    The Elves awaken at Cuiviénen
    In the year 1050 of the Trees the Elves, the Firstborn of Ilúvatar, awoke by the starlit water of Cuiviénen in the far east of Middle-earth, and the first things they saw were the stars.
  17. c. 41,450 BC
    Melkor breeds the Orcs
    Melkor's servants took Elves from the shores of Cuiviénen and carried them to Utumno, where by slow arts of cruelty he bred from them the race of Orcs in mockery of the Firstborn.
  18. c. 41,180 BC
    Oromë finds the Elves
    In the year 1085 of the Trees Oromë, the huntsman of the Valar, came upon the Elves while riding in Middle-earth and named them Eldar, the people of the stars.
  19. c. 41,030 BC
    Melkor is chained with Angainor
    In the Battle of the Powers, fought for the Elves' sake from the year 1090 of the Trees, the Valar broke Utumno; Tulkas wrestled Melkor down, and in 1100 he was bound with the chain Angainor and shut in the Halls of Mandos for three ages. Sauron was never found.
  20. c. 40,980 BC
    The Great Journey begins
    In the year 1105 of the Trees the Eldar set out westward from Cuiviénen at the summons of the Valar, the Vanyar, the Noldor and the Teleri, while those who refused remained in the east as the Avari.
  21. c. 40,730 BC
    Thingol meets Melian
    On the long march Elwë of the Teleri wandered into the wood of Nan Elmoth, met Melian the Maia among the nightingales and stood entranced for many years; he became Thingol, King of the Sindar of Beleriand, and she his queen.
  22. c. 40,710 BC
    The Eldar come to Aman
    In the year 1132 of the Trees the Vanyar and the Noldor were ferried over the Great Sea to Aman, and built the white city of Tirion upon the hill of Túna in the light of the Trees.
  23. c. 40,340 BC
    Fëanor is born
    In the year 1169 of the Trees Fëanor was born in Tirion to Finwë, King of the Noldor, and his mother Míriel spent so much of her spirit in bearing him that she laid down her life and went to the Halls of Mandos.
  24. c. 38,030 BC
    Melkor is released
    In the year 1400 of the Trees, his three ages of captivity over, Melkor was released by Manwë after feigning repentance, and went among the Noldor offering counsel and sowing lies.
  25. c. 37,530 BC
    Fëanor makes the Silmarils
    About the year 1450 of the Trees Fëanor wrought the three Silmarils, jewels that held the blended light of the Two Trees, and Varda hallowed them so that no evil hand could touch them unburnt; Melkor lusted for them from that day.
  26. c. 37,130 BC
    Fëanor is banished to Formenos
    In the year 1490 of the Trees, inflamed by Melkor's lies, Fëanor drew his sword on his half-brother Fingolfin in Tirion and was banished for twelve years to his northern stronghold of Formenos, where Finwë followed him with the Silmarils.
  27. c. 37,080 BC
    The Darkening of Valinor
    In the year 1495 of the Trees, during a festival in Valmar, Melkor came with Ungoliant, the great spider of darkness; he smote the Two Trees with his black spear and she drank their light, and Valinor was plunged into darkness.
  28. c. 37,080 BC
    Finwë slain and the Silmarils stolen
    Melkor went on to Formenos, slew Finwë, King of the Noldor, before his doors and carried off the Silmarils, the first blood shed in the Blessed Realm; Fëanor cursed him and named him Morgoth, the Black Foe of the World.
  29. c. 37,080 BC
    The Oath of Fëanor
    In Tirion by torchlight Fëanor and his seven sons swore a dreadful oath to pursue with vengeance and hatred anyone who withheld a Silmaril from them, and the greater part of the Noldor followed him into exile.
  30. c. 37,078 BC
    Morgoth crowns himself with the Silmarils
    Rescued from Ungoliant in Lammoth by his Balrogs, Morgoth returned to Angband, raised the reeking towers of Thangorodrim above it, and set the Silmarils in an iron crown which he wore on his throne.
  31. c. 37,075 BC
    The Kinslaying at Alqualondë
    When the Teleri refused them their ships, the Noldor of Fëanor fell upon them at the Swan Haven of Alqualondë and took the white ships by force, the first slaying of Elves by Elves.
  32. c. 37,070 BC
    The Doom of Mandos
    In the year 1496 of the Trees, as the Noldor marched north along the coast of Aman, Mandos pronounced their Doom: tears unnumbered, and the betrayal of kin by kin, would follow their oath.
  33. c. 37,060 BC
    The ships are burned at Losgar
    In the year 1497 of the Trees Fëanor crossed to Middle-earth with his own host and burned the ships at Losgar, abandoning Fingolfin and his people, who crossed the grinding ice of the Helcaraxë on foot at the cost of many lives.
  34. c. 37,060 BC
    The Battle under Stars
    Fëanor routed the hosts of Morgoth in Dagor-nuin-Giliath in Mithrim, but pursued too far towards Angband and was mortally wounded by Gothmog, Lord of Balrogs, and his body fell to ash; soon after, his eldest son Maedhros was taken by treachery at a parley and hung by his right wrist from a cliff of Thangorodrim.
  35. c. 37,030 BC
    The Moon rises and Fingolfin arrives
    From the last silver flower of Telperion the Valar made the Moon, and at its first rising Fingolfin's host came at last over the ice into Middle-earth and marched to Mithrim with trumpets blowing.

The First Age: Beleriand, Eden and the curse of Cain

  1. c. 37,029 BC
    The Sun rises for the first time
    From the last golden fruit of Laurelin the Valar made the Sun, and at its first rising the Years of the Sun began; the First Age of the Sun is reckoned from that dawn.
  2. c. 37,028 BC
    God forms Adam
    In the first years of the Sun, when Men awoke in the far east of the world, God formed Adam, the first man, of the dust of the ground, breathed into his nostrils the breath of life and set him in the garden of Eden, eastward, to tend it.
  3. c. 37,027 BC
    Eve is made
    God cast Adam into a deep sleep and made Eve from his rib to be his wife, and they lived in Eden together, naked and unashamed.
  4. c. 37,026 BC
    The serpent in Eden
    Morgoth came to Eve in the garden as the serpent and beguiled her into eating the fruit of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, which God had forbidden; she gave the fruit to Adam, and he ate.
  5. c. 37,025 BC
    Adam and Eve driven from Eden
    God drove Adam and Eve out of Eden and set cherubim and a flaming sword at its east gate to keep the way of the tree of life, and Men went out into the world with a darkness behind them.
  6. c. 37,024 BC
    Cain and Abel are born
    Eve bore Adam two sons: Cain, the elder, who became a tiller of the ground, and Abel, who became a keeper of sheep.
  7. c. 37,013 BC
    The offerings of Cain and Abel
    Cain brought an offering of the fruit of the ground and Abel the firstlings of his flock; God had respect to Abel's offering and not to Cain's, and warned the angry Cain that sin lay at his door, that its desire was for him, and that he must rule over it.
  8. c. 37,012 BC
    Cain murders Abel
    Cain talked with his brother in the field, rose up against him and killed him, the first murder among Men, and Abel's blood cried out to God from the ground.
  9. c. 37,012 BC
    God curses Cain and sets the mark
    God cursed Cain from the ground that had drunk Abel's blood: he would be immortal, repelled and burned by the sun, and a wanderer without rest or home for ever, and beneath those three the sentence was soullessness. When Cain cried that whoever found him would slay him, God set a mark upon him so that none who met him would kill him.
  10. c. 37,011 BC
    Cain goes out into Nod
    Cain went out from the presence of the Lord and dwelt in the land of Nod, east of Eden, and from there began his wandering through the world, a cursed, deathless, sun-shy man with no soul and no powers, not yet a vampire.
  11. c. 37,011 BC
    Maedhros is rescued
    In the first years of the Sun Fingon the Valiant climbed Thangorodrim alone and, with the help of Thorondor, King of Eagles, freed Maedhros by cutting off his hand; Maedhros waived his claim, and Fingolfin became High King of the Noldor.
  12. c. 37,010 BC
    The Feast of Reuniting
    In the year 20 of the First Age Fingolfin held the Mereth Aderthad at the pools of Ivrin, where the Noldor and the Sindar of Beleriand feasted together in friendship.
  13. c. 36,978 BC
    Nargothrond and Gondolin begun
    After Ulmo sent them dreams by the river Sirion in the year 50, Finrod began in 52 to delve Nargothrond by the river Narog, and was named Felagund, Hewer of Caves, while Turgon began in secret to build Gondolin, the Hidden City, in the vale of Tumladen.
  14. c. 36,970 BC
    The Glorious Battle
    In the year 60 the Noldor destroyed an army of Morgoth in Dagor Aglareb, the Glorious Battle, and laid the Siege of Angband, which held for almost four hundred years.
  15. c. 36,914 BC
    Turgon's people enter Gondolin
    In the year 116 Gondolin was complete, and Turgon led his people secretly out of Nevrast into the Hidden City, which no enemy found for nearly four hundred years.
  16. c. 36,899 BC
    Seth is born
    When Adam was a hundred and thirty years old, far away in the east, Eve bore him Seth in place of Abel; from the line of Seth, long ages afterwards, Noah would come.
  17. c. 36,800 BC
    Telchar forges Narsil
    In the First Age Telchar, the Dwarf smith of Nogrod in the Blue Mountains, forged the sword Narsil, whose name joined the words for fire and white light; it would come down to Elendil.
  18. c. 36,770 BC
    Glaurung comes forth
    In the year 260 Glaurung, first of the fire-drakes of Morgoth, issued young from Angband and burned the plain of Ard-galen, but Fingon's mounted archers drove him back.
  19. c. 36,720 BC
    Finrod finds the first Men
    In the year 310 Finrod Felagund came upon Bëor and his people in the hills of Ossiriand, the first Men to come into Beleriand; they spoke little of their past, saying only that a darkness lay behind them in the east, and that they had turned their backs on it.
  20. c. 36,600 BC
    Cain wanders through the First Age
    Through the wars of the First Age Cain wandered the wild places of the east, deathless, soulless and shunning the sun, unknown to the Elves and to the chroniclers of Beleriand.
  21. c. 36,575 BC
    The Battle of Sudden Flame
    In the midwinter of the year 455 Morgoth broke the Siege of Angband in Dagor Bragollach, sending rivers of flame over Ard-galen, with Glaurung grown to his full might and Balrogs before his hosts.
  22. c. 36,574 BC
    Fingolfin duels Morgoth
    In the year 456 Fingolfin rode alone to the gates of Angband and challenged Morgoth to single combat; he wounded him seven times and was slain, Thorondor marred Morgoth's face, and Morgoth went halt for ever after.
  23. c. 36,573 BC
    Sauron takes Tol Sirion
    In the year 457 Sauron, Morgoth's lieutenant and master of werewolves, took the tower of Minas Tirith on the isle of Tol Sirion and filled it with wolves, and it was called Tol-in-Gaurhoth, the Isle of Werewolves.
  24. c. 36,566 BC
    Beren sees Lúthien
    In the year 464, after the betrayal and death of his father Barahir, Beren came over the Mountains of Terror into Doriath and saw Lúthien, daughter of Thingol and Melian, dancing in the woods of Neldoreth, and loved her; Thingol set the price of her hand at a Silmaril from Morgoth's crown.
  25. c. 36,566 BC
    Túrin is born
    In the winter of the year 464 Túrin was born in Dor-lómin to Húrin of the House of Hador and his wife Morwen.
  26. c. 36,565 BC
    Finrod dies in Sauron's dungeons
    In the year 465 Finrod Felagund went with Beren on his quest, was taken by Sauron and cast into the pits of Tol-in-Gaurhoth, and died there wrestling the werewolf that came for Beren.
  27. c. 36,565 BC
    Lúthien overthrows Sauron
    Lúthien came to Tol-in-Gaurhoth with Huan, the hound of Valinor, who throttled Sauron until he yielded the isle and fled in the shape of a vampire; she threw down his tower and freed Beren.
  28. c. 36,564 BC
    A Silmaril out of the Iron Crown
    In the year 466 Beren and Lúthien entered Angband in disguise; she sang Morgoth and all his court to sleep, and Beren cut a Silmaril from the iron crown, though the great wolf Carcharoth bit off his hand with the jewel in it.
  29. c. 36,564 BC
    The Hunting of the Wolf
    Carcharoth, maddened by the Silmaril, broke into Doriath; in the hunt Beren was mortally wounded and Huan slew the wolf and died, and the jewel was cut from its belly and given to Thingol.
  30. c. 36,561 BC
    Beren and Lúthien return
    Lúthien's spirit followed Beren to the Halls of Mandos and sang her grief before him, and she was granted to return with him to life as a mortal woman; they dwelt on the isle of Tol Galen in Ossiriand.
  31. c. 36,558 BC
    The Battle of Unnumbered Tears
    In the year 472 the Union of Maedhros marched on Angband in the Nirnaeth Arnoediad and was destroyed through the treachery of the Easterling Men; Fingon was slain by Gothmog, and the Noldor never recovered their strength.
  32. c. 36,558 BC
    Húrin's last stand
    Húrin and his brother Huor held the fens of Serech so that Turgon could escape to Gondolin; Huor fell, and Húrin slew seventy Trolls crying 'Aurë entuluva! Day shall come again!' until he was taken alive.
  33. c. 36,557 BC
    Morgoth curses Húrin's kin
    Morgoth set Húrin in a chair upon Thangorodrim and cursed him and all his kin, compelling him to see through Morgoth's eyes everything that befell them for twenty-eight years.
  34. c. 36,535 BC
    The fall of Nargothrond
    In the year 495 Morgoth's host and Glaurung defeated the Elves at Tumhalad and sacked Nargothrond, where Túrin had counselled open war; the dragon laid a spell of forgetting on Túrin and couched upon the treasure.
  35. c. 36,534 BC
    Tuor comes to Gondolin
    In the year 496 Tuor son of Huor, guided by Ulmo, found the hidden way to Gondolin and brought Turgon the warning of the Vala, which Turgon did not heed.
  36. c. 36,529 BC
    Túrin slays Glaurung
    In the year 501 Túrin stabbed Glaurung from beneath at the ravine of Cabed-en-Aras; dying, the dragon revealed that Túrin's wife Níniel was his sister Nienor, who cast herself into the torrent, and Túrin fell upon his sword.
  37. c. 36,528 BC
    Thingol slain over the Nauglamír
    In the year 502, after the freed Húrin brought him treasure out of Nargothrond, Thingol had the Dwarves of Nogrod set the Silmaril in the necklace Nauglamír, and they slew him in Menegroth for it; Melian left Middle-earth and her Girdle about Doriath failed.
  38. c. 36,527 BC
    Eärendil is born
    In the year 503 Tuor wedded Idril, daughter of Turgon, in Gondolin, the second union of Elves and Men, and their son Eärendil was born there.
  39. c. 36,525 BC
    The second death of Beren and Lúthien
    Beren took back the Nauglamír from the Dwarves at the ford of Sarn Athrad, and Lúthien wore the Silmaril on Tol Galen until the two of them died the death of mortals together; the jewel was brought by night to their son Dior in Doriath.
  40. c. 36,524 BC
    The Ruin of Doriath
    In the year 506 the sons of Fëanor, bound by their oath, attacked Doriath to claim the Silmaril in the Second Kinslaying; Dior and his queen were slain, and his daughter Elwing escaped with the jewel to the Mouths of Sirion.
  41. c. 36,520 BC
    The Fall of Gondolin
    In the year 510, betrayed by Turgon's nephew Maeglin, Gondolin was stormed by Balrogs, dragons and Orcs; Ecthelion and Gothmog slew one another, Glorfindel fell with a Balrog at Cirith Thoronath, Turgon perished, and Tuor and Idril escaped with Eärendil.
  42. c. 36,498 BC
    Elrond and Elros are born
    In the year 532 Elwing bore twin sons to Eärendil at the Havens of Sirion: Elrond and Elros, the Half-elven.
  43. c. 36,492 BC
    The Third Kinslaying
    In the year 538, while Eärendil was at sea, the sons of Fëanor fell upon the Havens of Sirion; Elwing cast herself into the sea with the Silmaril and Ulmo bore her up in the shape of a white bird, and Maglor took Elrond and Elros.
  44. c. 36,488 BC
    Eärendil reaches Valinor
    In the year 542 Eärendil came with Elwing and the Silmaril on his ship Vingilot to Valinor, the first of mortal kin to set foot there, and pleaded before the Valar for Elves and Men; they set him to sail the heavens with the Silmaril on his brow, and he rose in the west as the Evening Star.
  45. c. 36,485 BC
    The War of Wrath begins
    In the year 545 the host of the Valar under Eönwë landed in Beleriand, and the War of Wrath began, the Great Battle that would break the north of the world.
  46. c. 36,443 BC
    Ancalagon falls and Morgoth is taken
    In the year 587 Morgoth loosed his winged dragons, but Eärendil and the Eagles fought them all day in the sky, and Eärendil slew Ancalagon the Black, who fell upon Thangorodrim and broke its towers. Morgoth fled into his deepest pits and sued for peace, but was taken and bound again with Angainor, and his iron crown was beaten into a collar for his neck.
  47. c. 36,442 BC
    The fate of the Silmarils
    Maedhros and Maglor stole the last two Silmarils from the camp of Eönwë, but the jewels burned their hands; Maedhros cast himself into a fiery chasm and Maglor flung his into the sea, so that one jewel came to rest in the sky, one in the fire and one in the water.

The Second Age: Númenor and the Rings

  1. c. 36,441 BC
    Morgoth thrust into the Void
    At the end of the First Age the Valar thrust Morgoth out of the world through the Door of Night into the Timeless Void, and the lands of Beleriand, broken in the war, went under the sea; but the malice he had poured into the world remained, and the lies he had sown went on bearing fruit.
  2. c. 36,441 BC
    Elros and Elrond choose
    The Valar gave the Half-elven sons of Eärendil the choice of their kindred: Elros chose to be counted among Men and Elrond among the Elves, so that Aragorn would one day come of Elros's line and Arwen of Elrond's.
  3. c. 36,441 BC
    Sauron hides in Middle-earth
    Sauron put on a fair form and repented before Eönwë, but would not go to Valinor for judgement, and fled and hid himself in Middle-earth.
  4. c. 36,440 BC
    The Grey Havens founded
    In the first year of the Second Age Círdan the Shipwright founded the Grey Havens of Mithlond, and Gil-galad dwelt in Lindon as High King of the Noldor in Middle-earth.
  5. c. 36,409 BC
    Númenor is founded
    In the year 32 of the Second Age the Edain sailed, following the star of Eärendil, to the star-shaped isle of Elenna, which the Valar had raised from the sea as their reward, and Elros became the first King of Númenor as Tar-Minyatur.
  6. c. 36,000 BC
    The Eldar take to the stars
    Early in the Second Age a great host of the Noldor, Exiles who would neither return into the West nor fade in Middle-earth, built ships that could sail the sky and went out among the stars. They became the Eldar.
  7. c. 35,999 BC
    Elros dies
    In the year 442 Elros Tar-Minyatur died after five hundred years of life; the Númenóreans, granted lives three times as long as other Men, grew wise and mighty and became the greatest mariners in the world.
  8. c. 35,691 BC
    Eregion founded
    In the year 750 Noldor under Celebrimbor, grandson of Fëanor, founded Eregion near the west gate of Khazad-dûm, and its smiths were the greatest in Middle-earth.
  9. c. 35,441 BC
    Sauron fortifies Mordor
    About the year 1000 Sauron chose the land of Mordor for his stronghold and began to build the Dark Tower of Barad-dûr near the fire-mountain Orodruin.
  10. c. 35,241 BC
    Annatar, the Lord of Gifts
    About the year 1200 Sauron came among the Elves in fair form as Annatar, the Lord of Gifts. Gil-galad and Elrond refused him, but the smiths of Eregion took him in, and he began to teach them.
  11. c. 34,941 BC
    The Rings of Power are made
    About the year 1500 the Elven-smiths of Eregion, taught by Sauron, reached the height of their skill and began to forge the Rings of Power. After many lesser rings they made the Seven and the Nine with his help.
  12. c. 34,851 BC
    The Three Rings
    About the year 1590 Celebrimbor finished the Three Rings of the Elves alone: Narya, Nenya and Vilya. Sauron never touched them, though they were made by the craft he had taught, so they too were bound to the One.
  13. c. 34,841 BC
    Sauron forges the One Ring
    About the year 1600 Sauron forged the One Ring alone, in secret, in the Sammath Naur, the Chambers of Fire in Orodruin, to rule the other Rings and those who wore them. He let a great part of his own native power pass into it, so that while it lasted he could not be wholly ended: it was the first Horcrux. When he put it on, Celebrimbor perceived his purpose, and the Elves took off their rings. In the same years he finished Barad-dûr.
  14. c. 34,744 BC
    Eregion laid waste
    Sauron made war on the Elves in the year 1693 to seize the Rings, but the Three were hidden. In 1697 he laid Eregion waste and took the Nine from the house of the smiths. Under torment Celebrimbor told him where the Seven were kept, though never where the Three had gone, and he died of it. Elrond led the survivors north to found the refuge of Imladris, called Rivendell.
  15. c. 34,740 BC
    Sauron is driven out of Eriador
    Tar-Minastir of Númenor sent a great fleet to Lindon in the year 1700, and in 1701 Sauron was driven out of Eriador. Afterwards he dealt out the rings he had taken, the Nine to great kings of Men and the Seven to the lords of the Dwarves.
  16. c. 34,641 BC
    The Shadow falls on Númenor
    About the year 1800 the Númenóreans began to establish dominions on the coasts of Middle-earth, and the Shadow fell upon Númenor as its people began to envy the Elves their deathlessness.
  17. c. 34,190 BC
    The Nazgûl first appear
    In the year 2251 Tar-Atanamir took the sceptre and Númenor was divided; about this time the Nazgûl, the Ringwraiths, slaves of the Nine Rings that Sauron had given to great kings of Men, first appeared.
  18. c. 33,542 BC
    Ar-Adûnakhôr takes the sceptre
    In the year 2899 Ar-Adûnakhôr took the sceptre, the first king to take his royal name in the Adûnaic tongue, and the Faithful who kept the friendship of the Elves were persecuted.
  19. c. 33,500 BC
    Cain walks through the Second Age
    While Númenor rose and darkened and the Rings were made, Cain went on wandering the earth by night, older than the Rings and older than any king of Men, still without powers of any kind.
  20. c. 33,186 BC
    Ar-Pharazôn seizes the sceptre
    In the year 3255 Ar-Pharazôn the Golden took Tar-Palantír's daughter Míriel to wife against her will and seized the sceptre, the last and mightiest King of Númenor.
  21. c. 33,179 BC
    Sauron brought captive to Númenor
    Ar-Pharazôn landed at Umbar with a vast host in the year 3261, and in 3262 Sauron humbled himself before him and was taken as a hostage to Númenor.
  22. c. 33,165 BC
    Sauron seduces the King
    Within a few years Sauron had become the King's chief counsellor, and persuaded him that Morgoth, the Lord of the Darkness, was the true god, who could give him life without end.
  23. c. 33,150 BC
    Isildur saves the White Tree's fruit
    When Sauron urged Ar-Pharazôn to cut down Nimloth, the White Tree of Númenor, Isildur son of Elendil went in disguise into the King's courts by night and took a fruit from it, and was sorely wounded escaping.
  24. c. 33,148 BC
    The Temple of Morgoth
    Nimloth was cut down and burned, and on the hill of Armenelos Sauron raised a great domed temple to Morgoth, where Men of the Faithful were burned in sacrifice.
  25. c. 33,131 BC
    The Great Armament
    In the year 3310 Ar-Pharazôn, fearing death in his old age, began to build the Great Armament to wrest everlasting life from the Valar.
  26. c. 33,122 BC
    Ar-Pharazôn assails Valinor
    In the year 3319 Ar-Pharazôn broke the Ban of the Valar, sailed into the West and set foot on the shores of Aman; the Valar laid down their government of the world and called upon Ilúvatar.
  27. c. 33,122 BC
    The Downfall of Númenor
    Ilúvatar changed the fashion of the world: a chasm opened in the sea and swallowed the fleet, Ar-Pharazôn and his warriors were buried under falling hills, and Númenor went down beneath the waves. The Exiles called it the Akallabêth, Atalantë, the Downfallen.
  28. c. 33,122 BC
    The world is made round
    In the Downfall Aman was taken away out of the circles of the world, and the world was made round, so that only the Elves could find the Straight Road into the West.
  29. c. 33,122 BC
    Elendil escapes with nine ships
    Elendil the Faithful and his sons Isildur and Anárion escaped the Downfall with nine ships, bearing the Seeing-stones and a seedling of the White Tree, and were cast up on the shores of Middle-earth.
  30. c. 33,121 BC
    The Realms in Exile founded
    In the year 3320 Elendil founded Arnor in the north and his sons founded Gondor in the south, with Minas Ithil, Minas Anor and Osgiliath. Sauron, whose fair body had perished in the Downfall, came back to Mordor as a spirit and took up the One Ring again.
  31. c. 33,012 BC
    Sauron attacks Gondor
    In the year 3429 Sauron attacked Gondor, took Minas Ithil and burned the White Tree; Isildur escaped with a seedling, and Anárion held Osgiliath.
  32. c. 33,007 BC
    The Last Alliance at Dagorlad
    Gil-galad and Elendil formed the Last Alliance of Elves and Men in the year 3430, and in 3434 their host defeated Sauron on the plain of Dagorlad before the Black Gate and laid siege to Barad-dûr for seven years.

The Third Age: the War of the Ring

  1. c. 33,000 BC
    Sauron overthrown
    In the year 3441 Sauron came out to fight on the slopes of Orodruin. He slew Gil-galad and Elendil. Narsil broke beneath Elendil as he fell, but with its hilt-shard Isildur cut the One Ring from Sauron's hand. So Sauron was overthrown.
  2. c. 33,000 BC
    Isildur keeps the Ring
    Though Elrond and Círdan counselled him to cast it into the fire, Isildur kept the One Ring as weregild for his father and his brother. So the Second Age ended.
  3. c. 32,998 BC
    The Gladden Fields
    In October of the year 2 of the Third Age Isildur and his three elder sons were waylaid by Orcs at the Gladden Fields. He put on the Ring and fled into the Anduin. It slipped from his finger in the water, so the Orcs saw him and shot him dead. The Ring lay lost in the river for nearly two and a half thousand years.
  4. c. 32,998 BC
    Narsil kept at Rivendell
    The shards of Narsil were carried to Rivendell, where Isildur's youngest son Valandil was being fostered, and they were kept for three thousand years as the heirloom of Isildur's heirs.
  5. c. 32,900 BC
    The Elder Things come to the Earth
