    In December 1942 Delta Green and Britain's PISCES wrecked a bargain that the Karotechia, the occult section of the SS, was striking with the Deep Ones off the coast of France.
  141. c. 1943
    The Justice Society defeats Ian Karkull
    During the war the Justice Society defeated the sorcerer Ian Karkull, a master of shadow and time. The energies released at his defeat soaked into its members and some of those closest to them, and from then on they aged far more slowly than other people.
  142. 1943
    Riddle murders his father's family
    In the summer of 1943 Tom Riddle walked down into Little Hangleton, took his uncle Morfin Gaunt's wand and the Gaunt ring from the shack with a dead snake nailed to its door, and murdered his Muggle father Tom Riddle and his grandparents Thomas and Mary Riddle in the Riddle House on the hill.
  143. 1943
    Riddle opens the Chamber of Secrets
    In his fifth year Tom Riddle opened the Chamber of Secrets and set the Basilisk on Hogwarts, and a Muggle-born girl was killed in a bathroom.
  144. 1943
    Riddle makes his diary a Horcrux
    At sixteen Tom Riddle made a cheap diary bought from a newsagent's on Vauxhall Road, London, into a Horcrux to preserve his sixteen-year-old self.
  145. 1943
    Hagrid expelled and kept on as gamekeeper
    Blamed for opening the Chamber of Secrets and for the death of a girl, Rubeus Hagrid was expelled in his third year and his wand was snapped, but Albus Dumbledore believed in him and saw to it that he was kept on at Hogwarts as gamekeeper.
  146. c. 1943
    Chamber of Secrets opened in Riddle's fifth yearB2 Ch15
    The Chamber was opened and its monster attacked students, still unsolved at Easter.
  147. 1943
    Hagrid expelled; Riddle rewardedB2 Ch16
    Hagrid was expelled and Riddle received a Special Award for Services to the School; Aragog fled to the Forest.
  148. c. 1943
    Death of Moaning MyrtleB2 Ch18
    Myrtle Elizabeth Warren, a Muggle-born Ravenclaw teased by Olive Hornby over her glasses, was killed by the Basilisk's eyes in the second-floor girls' bathroom while Tom Riddle spoke Parseltongue to it, and the school was to be closed; she returned as a ghost to haunt Olive Hornby until the Ministry of Magic made her stop.
  149. c. 1943
    Hagrid expelledB3 Ch3
    About fifty years before 1993, Hagrid was expelled in his third year for a crime he did not commit and his wand was snapped.
  150. 13 June 1943
    Riddle frames Hagrid
    Refused permission by Headmaster Dippet to stay at the castle for the summer, Tom Riddle framed the young Rubeus Hagrid for the attacks by blasting open the box where Hagrid kept a young spider; Dippet hushed up the death and gave Riddle a Special Award for Services to the School.
  151. 13 June 1943
    Riddle confronts HagridB2 Ch15
    Refused permission to stay over the summer by Dippet, Riddle accused the young Hagrid of keeping the monster and drove Aragog from hiding.
  152. 1944
    Anarchs declare the Anarch Free States
    Anarchs led by the Brujah overthrew the princes of California and declared the Anarch Free States, which still stand.
  153. c. 1944
    Riddle becomes Head Boy
    Tom Riddle received a Medal for Magical Merit and became Head Boy of Hogwarts before leaving in 1945.
  154. c. 1944
    Jamie Braddock is born in Otherworld
    Jamie Braddock, the eldest child of Sir James Braddock and his wife, Elizabeth, was born in Otherworld, where his parents were staying at the end of the war. Sir James had spent part of his youth there as Merlin's guest.
  155. 1944
    Brauner raises Dracula's castle
    The vampire painter Brauner, who had lost his daughters in the Great War, gathered the souls of the new war's dead to raise Dracula's castle. He sealed its throne room with his paintings, meaning to keep the castle's power for himself while Dracula stayed unrisen.
  156. 1944
    Brauner kills Eric Lecarde
    Eric Lecarde, who had fought beside John Morris in 1917, went into the castle to learn what had raised it, where Brauner killed him. His twin daughters, Stella and Loretta, came looking for him. Brauner bound them to himself with his blood, keeping them as the daughters he had lost.
  157. 1944
    The Church sends Jonathan Morris and Charlotte Aulin
    The castle stood in lands the Axis held, where the Spear of Destiny kept the mightiest heroes of the Allies from following. The Church sent two young hunters of its own: Jonathan Morris, the eighteen-year-old son of John, with his childhood friend, the sorceress Charlotte Aulin.
  158. 1944
    Eric Lecarde's ghost guides the hunters
    At the castle gate the two hunters met a ghost who called himself Wind. He was Eric Lecarde, held in the castle by his own spell, though he hid his name at first.
  159. 1944
    Charlotte Aulin frees the Lecarde sisters
    Charlotte Aulin learnt a spell of sanctuary, which lifts curses, then used it to break Brauner's hold on Stella and Loretta Lecarde. The sisters remembered who they were.
  160. 1944
    Jonathan Morris masters the Vampire Killer
    The Lecarde sisters called up the memory that lives in the Vampire Killer, which took the shape of Richter Belmont. Jonathan Morris beat it. The whip's full power was his from then on, without the price his father had paid.
  161. 1944
    Death cuts down Brauner
    Jonathan Morris and Charlotte Aulin defeated Brauner in the painted world he used as his studio. Dracula's servant Death then cut him down, which broke the seal on the throne room.
  162. 1944
    Jonathan Morris and Charlotte Aulin destroy Dracula
    Dracula returned to his throne room, joining his power to that of his servant Death. Jonathan Morris and Charlotte Aulin destroyed them both, so the castle fell.
  163. 6 June 1944
    Birth of Revolver Ocelot
    On the day of the Normandy landings the Cobra Unit went ashore to destroy German rocket sites. On the battlefield The Boss gave birth to a son, whose father was The Sorrow. The Philosophers took the child, whom they brought up as their agent Adamska, later Revolver Ocelot.
  164. 1945
    Gandalf witnesses Greta Grindelwald's end
    Gandalf, who had been there at Greta Grindelwald's beginning, was there at her end, in the ruins with the smoke going up, when Albus Dumbledore defeated her; his regrets about her are not small.
  165. 1945
    Captain America is lost in the ice
    In the last weeks of the war in Europe, Steve Rogers and Bucky tried to stop an explosive-laden drone launched by Baron Heinrich Zemo. It blew up in mid-air, Bucky was lost, and Rogers fell into the North Atlantic, where the serum kept him alive in a block of ice.
  166. 1945
    Nick Fury receives the Infinity Formula
    Badly wounded by a land mine in France in the last months of the war in Europe, Nick Fury was saved by the scientist Berthold Sternberg with an experimental treatment, the Infinity Formula, which all but stopped his ageing as long as he took a fresh dose every year.
  167. 1945
    The Flash and Green Lantern rejoin the Society
    The Spectre gave up his place in the Justice Society, and the Flash and Green Lantern returned as full members.
  168. c. 1945
    Nick Fury goes into intelligence
    After the war Nick Fury went into intelligence, first with the Office of Strategic Services and then with its successor, the Central Intelligence Agency.
  169. c. 1945
    The Sub-Mariner loses his memory
    After the war Namor lost his memory and vanished from the world.
  170. c. 1945
    Riddle vanishes into the Dark Arts
    After leaving Hogwarts Tom Riddle vanished, travelled and sank deep into the Dark Arts, remaking his name as Lord Voldemort.
  171. 1945
    Ernest Littlefield goes through the Stargate
    Studying the Stargate as a possible weapon, a team including Paul Langford and Ernest Littlefield, Catherine Langford's fiancé, opened it by hand; Littlefield went through and did not come back, the programme was shut down and Catherine was told he had died in a laboratory explosion.
  172. 1945
    Operation SUMMER BREEZE
    As the Reich fell in 1945, Delta Green teams went into the Soviet zone to seize the Karotechia's files and people, against the opposition of Smersh. Someone else had reached several of its members first, killing them and burning their laboratories. Delta Green never learnt who it was.
  173. 1945
    The elder Volgin hides the Legacy
    In the confusion at the end of the war the Soviet officer who laundered the Philosophers' Legacy hid the whole fortune in banks round the world. His son, Colonel Volgin of the GRU, later inherited it.
  174. 1945
    Sir James Braddock builds Braddock Manor
    Sir James Braddock brought his wife and their baby son home from Otherworld, then built Braddock Manor at Maldon, in Essex. He kept his laboratory in the caverns beneath it.
  175. 1945
    Dumbledore defeats GrindelwaldB1 Ch2
    Albus Dumbledore overcame the Dark wizard Grindelwald, according to his Chocolate Frog card.
  176. c. 1945
    Mutants begin to appearB4 Ch6
    People born with powers began to appear among Muggles after the Second World War, according to Harry; few minded until the 1960s.
  177. 1945
    Dumbledore tells the two princes about Númenor
    After his duel with Greta Grindelwald, Albus Dumbledore told Namor, then Aquaman, that the Atlantis of the old story was Númenor. Neither believed him.
  178. 6 August 1945
    Birth of Huey Emmerich
    Huey Emmerich, the son of a Manhattan Project scientist, was born on the day the atomic bomb fell on Hiroshima. His spine was damaged from birth.
  179. October 1945
    Delta Green is disbanded with the OSS
    In the summer of 1945 Delta Green spent three months running down the last of the Karotechia in the ruins of Germany. In October it was disbanded with the rest of the Office of Strategic Services.

1946 to 1969

  1. 1946
    The All-Winners Squad is formed
    With the public not told that Captain America was gone, William Naslund, formerly the Spirit of '76, wore the costume at the government's request and led a new team, the All-Winners Squad, with the Human Torch, Toro, the Sub-Mariner, the Whizzer, Miss America and a new Bucky, Fred Davis.
  2. 1946
    Death of William Naslund
    William Naslund, the second man to wear Captain America's costume, was killed, and Jeff Mace, the Patriot, wore it after him until 1949.
  3. 1946
    The Maximoff twins are born on Wundagore
    Magda Eisenhardt, a Romani witch who had fled her husband, Magneto, gave birth to the twins Pietro and Wanda at the High Evolutionary's citadel on Wundagore Mountain in Transia, then walked out into the snow. The babies were given to Django and Marya Maximoff, of a Romani band in the foothills, who raised them as their own.
  4. 1947
    The Injustice Society first strikes
    The Justice Society first met the Injustice Society, a union of its own worst enemies, and was helped the same year by Black Canary, a young Gotham florist named Dinah Drake.
  5. 1947
    Eubulon falls to Earth near Roswell
    Eubulon of Karsh had armed twelve Ventarans as the Kamen Riders, to keep his old master, Xaviax, out of Ventara. In 1947 Xaviax struck him down. The blow threw him to Earth, where he came down near Roswell, New Mexico, to be kept in a frozen sleep by the No-Men.
  6. 1947
    The Cobra Unit is disbanded
    With the Philosophers of East and West now enemies, the Cobra Unit was broken up. Its leader was known from then on as The Boss, or in the East as Voyevoda.
  7. 1947
    RoswellB3 Interlude
    A fragment labelled as a No-Maj flying saucer from Roswell, New Mexico, 1947, later sat in Ephraim Shacklewell's trophy room; it was half a hubcap off a Ford.
  8. 1947
    Delta Green is revived under the Joint Chiefs
    After something came down near Roswell, President Truman had the Joint Chiefs of Staff set Delta Green up again as a military intelligence unit. He gave what had crashed to a new committee, Majestic 12, whose quarrel with Delta Green began that year.
  9. Summer 1947
    The Greys' craft comes down near Roswell
    In the summer of 1947, by Delta Green's account, a craft came down in the desert near Roswell, New Mexico, carrying small grey beings, all dead but one. They were the Greys, the Mi-go's puppets. It was not the only thing that came down near Roswell that summer.
  10. c. 1947
    McGonagall starts at Hogwarts
    Minerva McGonagall entered Hogwarts, was sorted into Gryffindor, was taught by Albus Dumbledore and played on the Gryffindor house team.
  11. 24 September 1947
    Truman founds Majestic 12
    On 24 September 1947, after the crash near Roswell, President Truman set up Majestic 12 by a secret order. It was a committee of twelve, answerable only to him, to take charge of what had been found and to keep it secret.
  12. December 1947
    Majestic 12 sets up Project SIGN
    At the end of 1947 Majestic 12 set up Project SIGN, the Air Force's study of flying saucer reports, to explain such sightings away.
  13. 1948
    Black Canary joins the Justice Society
    Dinah Drake, Black Canary, became a member of the Justice Society.
  14. 1948
    Delta Green hunts the Karotechia in South America
    From 1948 to 1956, in Operation SOUTHERN HOSPITALITY, Delta Green hunted former members of the Karotechia in Uruguay and Paraguay. They had escaped by the secret routes of Die Spinne and ODESSA.
  15. 1949
    Three Pevensies die in a railway accident
    Peter, Edmund and Lucy Pevensie and their parents were killed in a railway accident, Peter and Edmund waiting on the platform and Lucy aboard the train. Susan was not with them, and the line of Aragorn and Arwen went on only through her.
  16. 1949
    Narnia comes to its end
    By English reckoning Narnia came to its end, and those who were friends of Narnia, among them Peter, Edmund and Lucy, went on into Aslan's country.
  17. c. 1949
    Susan Pevensie comes back to Christ
    Broken by grief and moved above all by the courage of Aslan, Susan Pevensie came back to Christ with an adult faith arrived at late, and became an Anglican; she spent her adult life disbelieved about Narnia.
  18. c. 1949
    Birth of Wally West
    Wally West, later Kid Flash and the third Flash, was born in about 1949 and grew up in Blue Valley, Nebraska.
  19. 1949
    Stephen Strange leaves the wizarding world
    Leaving Ilvermorny at the top of his year, Stephen Strange was turned away by the Healers he had hoped to train under, in favour of pure-blood students with poorer marks. He put away his wand, then went back to the No-Maj world to study medicine.
  20. 30 October 1949
    Birth of Molly Prewett
    Molly Prewett, later Molly Weasley, was born into the pure-blood Prewett family, sister of Fabian and Gideon Prewett.
  21. 1950
    The Stargazers lose sacred sites in Tibet
    The Stargazers, the Garou tribe of the Himalayas, suffered badly when China occupied Tibet, and many of their sacred sites were destroyed.
  22. 1950s
    Justice Society veterans settle into private life
    Through the 1950s the Society's former members lived as private citizens: Jay Garrick married Joan Williams, Alan Scott ran a broadcasting company in Gotham, Carter Hall married Shiera Sanders, and Dinah Drake married the detective Larry Lance.
  23. 1950s
    Xavier and Lehnsherr meet in Haifa
    Working in a hospital in Haifa among survivors of the camps, Erik Lehnsherr, the future Magneto, befriended the young telepath Charles Xavier. They argued for nights on end about what humanity would do to mutants, and their friendship ended over whether mutants should seek peace or rule.
  24. 1950
    The Boss takes Jack as her pupil
    The Boss took on a boy of fifteen called Jack, the future Big Boss. She trained him for most of the next ten years, during which the two of them worked out close-quarters combat.
  25. 6 February 1950
    Birth of Arthur Weasley
    Arthur Weasley was born, the son of Septimus Weasley and Cedrella Black.
  26. c. 1951
    The Howling Commandos fight in Korea
    During the Korean War the Howling Commandos were brought together again for a time, and Nick Fury received a battlefield commission as a lieutenant; he rose in time to colonel.
  27. 1951
    The Boss is irradiated in Nevada
    The Boss was exposed to radiation at an atomic test in the Nevada desert.
  28. 1951
    The Justice Society disbandsB4 Ch3
    The Justice Society disbanded rather than unmask before a committee of Congress.
  29. April 1952
    Delta Green raids Queen Maud Land
    In April 1952 Delta Green raided a station in Queen Maud Land, in the Antarctic, where three former researchers of the Karotechia were at work for the Argentina of Juan Perón.
  30. 1953
    William Burnside becomes Captain America
    William Burnside, a young scholar obsessed with Steve Rogers, took a version of the super-soldier serum without the Vita-Rays and hunted communist agents in 1953 and 1954 as Captain America. The serum drove him and his partner mad, and they were put into suspended animation.
  31. 1953
    Birth of Brian and Betsy Braddock
    Elizabeth Braddock, called Betsy, was born in England to Sir James and Lady Elizabeth Braddock, a few minutes before her twin brother, Brian.
  32. c. 1953
    Birth of John ConstantineB3 Interlude
    John Constantine was born in Liverpool around 1952 or 1953; his mother died giving birth to him.
  33. February 1953
    Operation SIC SEMPER TYRANNIS
    Between November 1952 and February 1953 Delta Green destroyed a project of the Soviet secret police at Novosibirsk that was seeking a way to prolong life. It was said to be run by former scientists of the Karotechia. Stalin died the next month.
  34. c. 1954
    McGonagall becomes an Unspeakable
    After leaving Hogwarts Minerva McGonagall joined the Ministry of Magic and became an Unspeakable of the Department of Mysteries.
  35. 1954
    Jack is irradiated at Bikini Atoll
    Jack, the future Big Boss, was caught in the fallout of the hydrogen bomb test at Bikini Atoll. It left him unable to father children.
  36. 13 August 1954
    The Eiko-maru is lost off Odo Island
    The freighter Eiko-maru went down with all hands off Odo Island, south of Japan, in a flash of white light from the sea. The Bingo-maru, sent to search for her, was lost the same way. Both had been sunk by Godzilla, a giant reptile of the deep that the hydrogen bomb tests had woken.
  37. August 1954
    Godzilla comes ashore on Odo Island
    During a storm Godzilla came ashore on Odo Island, crushing houses with the families inside them. The palaeontologist Dr Kyohei Yamane led an expedition there, saw the creature over a hill, then gave it the islanders' name.
  38. 3 November 1954
    Godzilla burns Tokyo
    Godzilla came out of Tokyo Bay by night, walked through a line of electrified pylons, then burnt the centre of Tokyo. Superman reached the bay that night, but Godzilla's breath, which is the fire of the bomb, struck him out of the sky. He was days recovering.
  39. 5 November 1954
    Dr Serizawa uses the Oxygen Destroyer
    The chemist Dr Daisuke Serizawa burnt his notes, then took the only Oxygen Destroyer down into Tokyo Bay with the salvage officer Hideto Ogata. It killed Godzilla. Serizawa cut his own air line so that the secret would die with him.
  40. 1955
    J'onn J'onzz is stranded on Earth
    The Martian J'onn J'onzz, last of the green Martians, was drawn to Earth by the experimental teleportation beam of Dr Saul Erdel, who died of the shock of seeing him. Stranded, he took the name John Jones and worked as a police detective while fighting crime as the Manhunter from Mars.
  41. 1955
    Delta Green begins to recruit friendlies
    Delta Green began to deputise friendlies: officials, police officers and doctors who would help it on a single matter without ever being told the truth about Delta Green.
  42. January 1955
    A second Godzilla destroys Osaka
    Two pilots, Shoichi Tsukioka and Koji Kobayashi, found a second Godzilla fighting the monster Anguirus on Iwato Island. The fight moved to Osaka, where Godzilla killed Anguirus at Osaka Castle. Much of the city burnt.
  43. January 1955
    Daniel Fraser destroys the Innsmouth archives
    In January 1955 Daniel Fraser, a cryptographer who had worked on the Innsmouth tablets for the Black Chamber, went mad. He destroyed the archives of the raid, the tablets with them.
  44. Winter 1955
    Godzilla is buried in ice
    On Kamiko Island, in the far north of Japan, the Self-Defence Forces brought an ice cliff down on Godzilla with rockets. The pilot Koji Kobayashi had died showing them how. The ice held Godzilla for seven years.
  45. 1 September 1955
    Delta Green draws up the STATIC Protocol
    Delta Green's leaders drew up the STATIC Protocol against the King in Yellow. Under it everything his play has touched is to be destroyed: every copy, every work made by its readers and, at need, the readers themselves, Delta Green's own agents included.
  46. 1956
    Barry Allen becomes the Flash
    A bolt of lightning drenched the Central City police scientist Barry Allen in chemicals and gave him speed faster than sound. He took the name of the Flash from Jay Garrick, whom he had admired as a boy, in the red suit with the lightning flash.
  47. c. 1956
    The Maximoff twins are lost
    Villagers in Transia came after Django Maximoff with torches when he stole bread in a hard winter, burning the wagons of his Romani band. His foster children, the twins, were lost in the confusion, and he believed them dead.
  48. December 1956
    Rodan hatches in a Kyushu coal mine
    Monstrous insects killed miners in a flooded pit in Kyushu, where the engineer Shigeru Kawamura saw a giant flying reptile hatch from an egg. Two of the creatures, named Rodan, wrecked Fukuoka with the wind of their wings. The Self-Defence Forces shelled their nest in Mount Aso until the volcano erupted over them.
  49. 1957
    Hugh Everett proposes many worldsB3 Ch21
    The American physicist Hugh Everett proposed that the universe branches whenever something could happen more than one way, an idea close to the D'ni priests' teaching that a Maker made every possible world.
  50. Autumn 1957
    Vulcans come down at Carbon Creek
    A Vulcan survey ship, sent to watch the launch of Earth's first satellite, crashed near Carbon Creek, a mining town in Pennsylvania. Its survivors, T'Mir, Mestral and Stron, lived among the townspeople in secret for months. When a Vulcan ship came for them, Mestral chose to stay on Earth.
  51. 1959
    Hal Jordan receives Abin Sur's ring
    The dying Green Lantern Abin Sur crash-landed in the California desert, and his power ring chose Hal Jordan, a fearless test pilot of Ferris Aircraft in Coast City, as the Green Lantern of Earth's sector.
  52. 1959
    Wally West becomes Kid Flash
    Lightning struck the same rack of chemicals in Barry Allen's laboratory while Wally West, about ten, was visiting, and gave him the same speed. He became Kid Flash, Barry's partner.
  53. 1959
    Kara Zor-El becomes Supergirl
    Superman's cousin Kara Zor-El, another survivor of Krypton, joined him as Supergirl.
  54. 1959
    Nick Fury's covert Avengers hunt Nazis
    Nick Fury, then of the CIA, led a covert team that hunted surviving Nazis under the name of the Avengers, with Dum Dum Dugan, Namora, Dominic Fortune, Ulysses Bloodstone, Kraven the Hunter and the man later called Sabretooth. It was never made public.
  55. c. 1959
    Seven heroes fight the Appellaxians
    When seven alien Appellaxians came down in different parts of the world to compete for the right to rule it, the heroes who answered each of them found one another at the end and agreed to stay together.
  56. June 1959
    The Boss leaves her pupil
    The Boss left Jack for a secret mission. They did not meet again for more than five years.
  57. 3 November 1959
    Birth of Sirius Black
    Sirius Black was born, the elder son of Orion and Walburga Black of the House of Black; his younger brother Regulus later followed the family into Voldemort's service.
  58. 1960
    McGonagall's romance with James Bond
    Minerva McGonagall began a romance with the Scottish MI6 agent James Bond while working alongside him, once turning a vault's worth of gold into beetles for him; it lasted until 1962, when she ended it on discovering how much he had lied to her.
  59. 1960s
    Fenrir Greyback walks free from a Ministry hearing
    Brought before the Department for the Regulation and Control of Magical Creatures over the deaths of two Muggle children, the Garou Fenrir Greyback passed himself off as a Muggle vagrant and was let go. The wizard who questioned him, Lyall Lupin, told the hearing that werewolves were soulless and deserved nothing but death.
  60. 1960s
    Greyback bites Remus Lupin
    In revenge on Lyall Lupin, Fenrir Greyback, a Black Spiral Dancer who makes Garou by the bite, found Lyall's very small son Remus asleep in his bed and bit him; his parents tried everything to cure it.
  61. c. 1960
    The Justice League is founded
    At the turn of 1960 Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, the Flash (Barry Allen), Green Lantern (Hal Jordan), Aquaman and the Martian Manhunter founded the Justice League. Their first case was the alien starfish Starro, which had enslaved Happy Harbor, Rhode Island; they made the local teenager Snapper Carr an honorary member and set up the Secret Sanctuary in a mountain outside the town.
  62. c. 1960
    Births of Bellatrix and Narcissa Black
    Bellatrix and Narcissa Black were born within the same twelve months to Cygnus Black and Druella Rosier of the House of Black; a third sister, Andromeda, was later struck off the family for marrying the Muggle-born Ted Tonks.
  63. 1960
    The Boss's secret spaceflight
    Because she had already been irradiated, The Boss was chosen to fly an unannounced test of a Mercury capsule, before there was any shielding against the radiation of space. She came back believing that the world was one place.
  64. 1960s
    The Shacklewell fortuneB3 Interlude
    After the Americans abolished their old law against wizards dealing with No-Majs, Ephraim Shacklewell's father made a fortune selling a scouring potion to Arizona copper mines as a miracle cleaning fluid.
  65. 1960
    Aqualad joins Aquaman
    Aquaman took in Garth, an Atlantean boy abandoned for his purple eyes, who became his partner as Aqualad.
  66. 9 January 1960
    Birth of Severus Snape
    Severus Snape was born to Tobias Snape, a Muggle, and Eileen Prince, a witch, and grew up at Spinner's End in the mill town of Cokeworth.
  67. 30 January 1960
    Lily Evans is born
    Lily, daughter of Susan Pevensie and Mr Evans, was born into a household that took its Anglican faith seriously; she believed in Christ with all her heart, and her magic reconciled her mother to Narnia.
  68. 10 March 1960
    Birth of Remus Lupin
    Remus John Lupin was born to Lyall Lupin, a wizard, and Hope Howell, a Muggle.
  69. 27 March 1960
    Birth of James Potter
    James Potter was born, the only child of Fleamont and Euphemia Potter, who had him late in life; he grew up well loved and a little spoilt.
  70. 1960s
    Snape befriends Lily Evans
    As a boy in Cokeworth Severus Snape befriended Lily Evans, a Muggle-born girl from the same town.
  71. 1960s
    Hagrid befriends John Constantine
    In the 1960s Rubeus Hagrid, a shaggy gamekeeper in his thirties, gave the bullied Muggle-born Slytherin John Constantine tea, rock cakes and somewhere to hide, beginning a lasting friendship.
  72. 1960s
    Lucius reads to the poisoned Constantine
    When John Constantine was poisoned during their early years at Hogwarts, his friend Lucius Malfoy read aloud to him in the hospital wing, though in public Lucius still repeated his father's views on blood.
  73. 1961
    The Fantastic Four fly into space
    Reed Richards took an experimental rocket into space without permission with his fiancée Susan Storm, her brother Johnny and the pilot Ben Grimm. Cosmic rays changed all four, and as Mister Fantastic, the Invisible Girl, the Human Torch and the Thing they became the Fantastic Four, who never wore masks.
  74. 1961
    Barry Allen meets Jay Garrick
    Barry Allen sought out Jay Garrick in Keystone City and the two Flashes fought side by side, and the meeting drew Jay and several of his old Justice Society colleagues back into action.
  75. 1961
    Green Arrow joins the Justice League
    Oliver Queen, Green Arrow, who had fought crime since 1941, joined the Justice League.
  76. 1961
    New men take the names Atom and Hawkman
    The physicist Ray Palmer, who could shrink himself to any size, became the new Atom, and Katar Hol, a police officer of the planet Thanagar, the new Hawkman.
  77. 1961
    The Skrulls come to Earth
    Late in 1961 four Skrulls took the shapes of the Fantastic Four to turn the public against them. Reed Richards sent their fleet home and turned the four into cows.
  78. April 1961
    The Boss at the Bay of Pigs
    The Boss led a unit ashore in the invasion of Cuba at the Bay of Pigs. The President cancelled the promised air support, her unit was destroyed, and she went underground.
  79. July 1961
    Mothra comes for the Shobijin
    The showman Clark Nelson carried off the Shobijin, the twin priestesses of Infant Island, to exhibit them in Tokyo. Their goddess Mothra hatched, swam to Japan, broke down Tokyo Tower, then followed Nelson to New Kirk City in Rolisica as a giant moth. Nelson was shot dead by the police, so the twins went home with her.
  80. 1962
    Spider-Man debuts
    Spider-Man came to public notice as a teenager.
  81. c. 1962
    Bond imprisoned as John Mason
    Late in 1962 James Bond, posing as John Mason, a former SAS captain, stole the microfilm on which J. Edgar Hoover kept the secrets of the American establishment, refused to say where it was hidden and was sent to Alcatraz without trial, ending Minerva McGonagall's contact with him.
  82. 1962
    The Atom joins the Justice League
    Ray Palmer, the Atom, joined the Justice League.
  83. 1962
    Bruce Banner becomes the Hulk
    During a gamma bomb test at a desert base in New Mexico, the physicist Bruce Banner ran out to pull the teenager Rick Jones off the range and was caught in the blast. That night he first changed into the Hulk, and General Thaddeus Ross spent years hunting him with the army.
  84. 1962
    Death of Ben Parker
    Days after the schoolboy Peter Parker of Forest Hills, Queens, gained a spider's powers, a burglar he had let run past him shot and killed his Uncle Ben, and Parker learnt that great power brings great responsibility.
  85. 1962
    Asgard becomes known to the world
    Soon after Thor, Asgard, the realm of the Aesir ruled by Odin All-Father and joined to Earth by Bifrost, the Rainbow Bridge, came to the notice of the modern world.
  86. 1962
    Doctor Doom first attacks the Fantastic Four
    Victor von Doom, monarch of Latveria, who hid his scarred face behind a mask forged by Tibetan monks, came to public notice attacking his old university rival Reed Richards and the Fantastic Four in New York.
  87. 1962
    The Sub-Mariner is found in the Bowery
    Johnny Storm found Namor living as an amnesiac derelict in a Bowery flophouse and restored his memory. Finding Atlantis wrecked by surface nuclear tests, Namor attacked the surface world again.
  88. 1962
    Henry Pym comes to public notice
    The scientist Henry Pym, later Ant-Man, came to public notice.
  89. 1962
    Tony Stark builds his first armour
    At the end of 1962, wounded by a booby trap while demonstrating his weapons in Vietnam and taken prisoner by a local warlord, Tony Stark built a suit of armour with the physicist Ho Yinsen, who died covering his escape. The Marine pilot James Rhodes flew him out, and Iron Man came to public notice.
  90. 1962
    The Boss kills The Sorrow
    On the orders of the Philosophers The Boss killed The Sorrow, her lover, who had gone over to the Soviet side. He had been a true medium, able to hear the restless dead. Two years later he was seen among them himself.
  91. c. 1962
    Stephen Strange comes to Kamar-Taj
    His hands ruined in a car crash, the New York surgeon Stephen Strange found his way to Kamar-Taj in the Himalayas to beg the Ancient One for a cure. The gate, which lets only witches and wizards through, let him in. The Ancient One took him as a pupil, and Strange foiled Baron Mordo's plot against his master's life.
  92. June 1962
    Godzilla breaks out of the ice
    The submarine Seahawk struck a glowing iceberg in the Arctic. Godzilla broke out of it, sank the submarine, then swam south to Japan, where he came ashore at Matsushima.
  93. June 1962
    Green Lantern saves a crab fleet from Godzilla
    Swimming south from the Arctic, Godzilla came on a Japanese crab fleet in the Bering Sea. Hal Jordan, the Green Lantern, lifted the boats clear behind a wall of green light. His ring held against the breath, but it drained so fast that he let Godzilla go on.
  94. Summer 1962
    Donald Blake finds Mjolnir
    On holiday in Norway, the lame American doctor Donald Blake, who was Thor sent to Earth by Odin with no memory of himself, struck an old walking stick on the ground in a cave and it became the hammer Mjolnir. Thor came to public notice that summer.
  95. August 1962
    King Kong fights Godzilla on Mount Fuji
    Pacific Pharmaceuticals had brought King Kong, the giant ape of Faro Island, to Japan as an advertisement. The Self-Defence Forces flew him by balloon to Mount Fuji to meet Godzilla. The two fought down to the sea at Atami, where both fell in; only Kong came up, then swam home.
  96. 5 October 1962
    Bond stops Dr No at Crab Key
    James Bond went to Jamaica and stopped Dr Julius No, an agent of SPECTRE, from toppling American rockets from his base on Crab Key.
  97. October 1962
    Sokolov is handed back
    The Soviet rocket scientist Nikolai Sokolov, whom Major Zero had brought out through Berlin, was returned to the Soviet Union as a secret condition of the bargain that ended the Cuban missile crisis. He was set to work on the Shagohod, a tank able to fire a nuclear missile.
  98. 1963
    Charles Xavier founds the X-Men
    Charles Xavier opened his School for Gifted Youngsters in his family mansion in Westchester County, New York, and trained his first five teenage pupils, Cyclops, Marvel Girl, the Beast, the Angel and Iceman, as the X-Men.
  99. 1963
    Magneto seizes Cape Citadel
    Magneto seized the American missile base at Cape Citadel and was driven off by Xavier's new X-Men; it was the first the public learnt of mutants.
  100. 1963
    Doctor Strange comes to public notice
    The former neurosurgeon Stephen Strange, a No-Maj-born wizard of Ilvermorny taught anew by the Ancient One at Kamar-Taj in the Himalayas, came to the notice of the wider world from his Sanctum Sanctorum on Bleecker Street in Greenwich Village. The public took him for a showman with a stage name.
  101. 1963
    The Justice Society re-forms
    The Justice Society re-formed; its members were in their forties and fifties but looked and moved like much younger people. From then on the Society and the Justice League joined forces nearly every summer until the Crisis.
  102. 1963
    Janet van Dyne becomes the Wasp
    After her father's murder, the young heiress Janet van Dyne became the Wasp.
  103. 1963
    Nick Fury fights the Hate-Monger
    Colonel Nick Fury of the CIA worked with the Fantastic Four against the Hate-Monger, a demagogue who stirred up crowds with a ray that bred hatred.
  104. 1963
    Lester Pearson is kept from power
    In the general election of 1963 Lester Pearson's Liberals again failed to win power, and Pearson never became Prime Minister. Canada kept the Red Ensign as its flag, as it does to this day.
  105. 1963
    The Super-Skrull
    The Skrull emperor Dorrek VII sent Kl'rt, the Super-Skrull, against the Fantastic Four with all four of their powers. He was beaten.
  106. 1963
    Spider-Man is called a menace
    Spider-Man saved the astronaut John Jameson, whose space capsule had gone out of control. The astronaut's father, J. Jonah Jameson of the Daily Bugle, called him a menace all the same.
  107. 1963
    Mera comes to Aquaman
    Mera, the exiled queen of Xebel, a kingdom of water folk in another dimension, came to Aquaman for help and stayed.
  108. c. 1963
    The developers of Silent Hill die
    The men of a company that meant to develop the lakeside at Silent Hill died one after another, in accidents.
  109. 1963
    Magneto seizes an American missile baseB4 Ch6
    The mutant Magneto took over an American missile base, beginning a campaign he has waged ever since with the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants.
  110. 21 March 1963
    Bond escapes from Alcatraz
    Early in 1963, before the prison closed on 21 March, James Bond, held as John Mason, escaped from Alcatraz, the only man ever to do so.
  111. April 1963
    Operation RIPTIDE bombs Devil Reef
    After the submarine Thresher was lost off New England in April 1963, Delta Green linked the loss to Innsmouth. That spring it bombed what was left of Y'ha-nthlei, the Deep Ones' city under Devil Reef.
  112. Summer 1963
    The Avengers are founded
    Loki made the Hulk seem to have wrecked a train to draw Thor into a fight, and Rick Jones's radio call for help was answered by Thor, Iron Man, Ant-Man and the Wasp. They beat Loki together with the Hulk and stayed together; the Wasp named them the Avengers, Tony Stark gave them his family's mansion on Fifth Avenue, and the Hulk left within weeks.
  113. 10 October 1963
    Bond brings out the Lektor decoder
    James Bond went to Istanbul to bring out a Soviet cipher clerk, Tatiana Romanova, with the Lektor decoding machine, and survived the trap SPECTRE had laid for him aboard the Orient Express.
  114. December 1963
    The Gotengo destroys the Mu Empire
    The Mu Empire, a drowned kingdom under the Pacific, declared war on the surface of the world. Captain Hachiro Jinguji's flying submarine Gotengo froze Manda, the sea-dragon the empire worshipped, then destroyed its source of power. Its Empress swam back into the fire.
  115. 1964
    The Avengers find Captain America
    Early in 1964 the Avengers found Steve Rogers frozen in a block of ice that the Sub-Mariner had thrown into the sea in a temper. Forty-three by the calendar but still the young man of 1945, he joined at once and soon led the team.
  116. 1964
    Zemo gathers the Masters of Evil
    Baron Heinrich Zemo, who had launched the drone of 1945, gathered the first Masters of Evil against the Avengers.
  117. 1964
    The Brotherhood of Evil Mutants is founded
    Magneto gathered the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, among them his own children, though none of them knew it, the twins Pietro and Wanda, Quicksilver and the Scarlet Witch.
  118. 1964
    The Teen Titans are founded
    Robin, Kid Flash and Aqualad founded the Teen Titans, a team of young partners who wanted to work out of their mentors' shadows, and Dick Grayson led it for many years.
  119. 1964
    Hawkman joins the Justice League
    Katar Hol, the Hawkman of Thanagar, joined the Justice League.
  120. 1964
    The Sinister Six
    Six of Spider-Man's enemies, Doctor Octopus among them, banded together as the Sinister Six. They took Betty Brant hostage with Aunt May.
  121. 1964
    Aquaman becomes King of Atlantis
    The council of Poseidonis asked Aquaman to be its king. He married Mera in the city the same year. Albus Dumbledore wrote to both kings about Númenor.
  122. 1964
    Magneto saves Wanda Maximoff from the stake
    In a village of eastern Europe a mob tied a young Romani woman to a stake as a witch, after she had saved a child with a hex. Magneto tore the village apart to free her. He took the twins, Wanda and Pietro Maximoff, for mutants. They owed him their lives.
  123. 1964
    Lucius Malfoy starts at HogwartsB3 Interlude
    Lucius Malfoy, a small stammering boy, started at Hogwarts alongside the Muggle-born John Constantine, whom the Sorting Hat sent to Slytherin almost before it touched his hair; Lucius was sorted there minutes later and sat beside John in every lesson for four years, while the house persecuted Constantine for his birth for seven.
  124. c. 1964
    Britain last hosts the Quidditch World CupB4 Ch3
    Britain hosted the Quidditch World Cup thirty years before 1994.
  125. 1964
    Lucius Malfoy and John Constantine start at HogwartsB4 Ch6
    Lucius Malfoy and John Constantine began at Hogwarts together; Narcissa later called Constantine her husband's old school friend.
  126. 26 January 1964
    Birth of Gilderoy Lockhart
    Gilderoy Lockhart was born; sorted into Ravenclaw, he later built his fame on the Memory Charm by taking credit for other people's deeds and wiping their memories.
  127. April 1964
    Mothra dies defending her egg
    A typhoon washed Mothra's egg ashore in Japan, where a company called Happy Enterprises bought it for a sideshow. Godzilla rose out of reclaimed land, attacked Nagoya, then made for the egg. The old Mothra died defending it; the twin larvae that hatched bound Godzilla in silk until he fell into the sea off Iwa Island.
  128. April 1964
    The Flash clears the streets of Nagoya
    When Godzilla came ashore near Nagoya, the Flash, Barry Allen, ran across the Pacific to help. He never crossed in front of Godzilla. He spent the day carrying people out of the streets ahead of him, two at a time.
  129. 24 August 1964
    The Virtuous Mission
    On the first mission of FOX, the CIA unit of Major Zero, Naked Snake parachuted from a great height into Tselinoyarsk in the Soviet Union to bring out Sokolov. His mentor The Boss met him on a bridge, announced that she was defecting to Colonel Volgin of the GRU, then threw him into the river. Her Cobra Unit carried Sokolov off.
  130. 24 August 1964
    Volgin destroys Sokolov's design bureau
    Colonel Volgin fired an American Davy Crockett nuclear shell, a gift from The Boss, at the Soviet design bureau OKB-754. Soviet radar had picked up an American aircraft overhead, so Moscow blamed Washington.
  131. 30 August 1964
    Operation Snake Eater
    Khrushchev demanded the death of The Boss as proof of American innocence. Naked Snake was sent back into Tselinoyarsk to kill her, to destroy the Shagohod and to bring out Sokolov. His contact was the spy EVA, who was posing as Tatyana in Colonel Volgin's household.
  132. August 1964
    The Cobras die in Tselinoyarsk
    In the days after his return Naked Snake killed the Cobras one by one: The Pain with his hornets, The Fear, the ancient sniper The End, then The Fury with his flamethrower. Each carried a bomb that left no body behind.
  133. September 1964
    Naked Snake loses his eye
    Captured in Volgin's fortress of Groznyj Grad, Naked Snake was tortured by Volgin himself. He lost his right eye to a shot from the pistol of the young GRU major Ocelot, which he took while shielding EVA.
  134. 2 September 1964
    The Shagohod is destroyed
    Naked Snake blew up the Shagohod's hangar at Groznyj Grad, then fought Colonel Volgin, who could throw electricity from his hands. Volgin chased him in the burning machine until Snake and EVA wrecked it. A bolt of lightning struck Volgin down.
  135. 2 September 1964
    Death of The Boss
    In a field of white flowers beside a lake in Tselinoyarsk, The Boss gave Naked Snake the key to the Philosophers' Legacy. Then she fought him. He shot her with her own gun, as he had been ordered to. She was forty-two.
  136. September 1964
    EVA takes the Legacy to China
    Naked Snake escaped with EVA to Alaska. By morning she had gone, taking what she believed was the record of the Legacy to her true masters in China. She left a recording to tell him the truth: The Boss had never defected. Her own government had sent her to recover the Legacy, then required her to die as a traitor.
  137. September 1964
    Naked Snake is named Big Boss
    President Johnson gave Naked Snake the Distinguished Service Cross, with the title of Big Boss, meaning that he had surpassed The Boss. Afterwards he saluted her grave at Arlington, which bore no name.
  138. September 1964
    Ocelot reports to Washington
    Major Ocelot of the GRU, who also spied for the KGB, telephoned the Director of Central Intelligence, whose agent ADAM he really was. He reported that EVA's copy of the record was a fake. The true one was in American hands, with half the Legacy.
  139. 17 September 1964
    Bond stops Goldfinger at Fort Knox
    James Bond stopped the bullion dealer Auric Goldfinger from exploding an atomic device inside Fort Knox to make America's gold reserve worthless.
  140. 31 October 1964
    Constantine locked in a broom cupboardB3 Interlude
    At Hallowe'en in his first year, Slytherins locked John Constantine in a broom cupboard in the dungeons until the following lunchtime.
  141. 1965
    Watson leads the Cave Research Foundation
    Richard Watson, a long-standing explorer of the Mammoth Cave system of Kentucky, served as president of the Cave Research Foundation from 1965 to 1967.
  142. 1965
    Death of Baron Heinrich Zemo
    Baron Heinrich Zemo was killed in a rockslide in South America during a fight with Captain America.
  143. 1965
    The founding Avengers step down
    The founders left the Avengers in Captain America's charge with three newcomers who had criminal records: the circus archer Hawkeye and the mutant twins Quicksilver and the Scarlet Witch, formerly of Magneto's Brotherhood.
  144. 1965
    S.H.I.E.L.D. is founded
    S.H.I.E.L.D., the Supreme Headquarters, International Espionage and Law-Enforcement Division, was set up as an agency of no single country to fight enemies that ignored borders, above all Hydra, under a secret governing council on which Tony Stark sat. Within months its first director, Rick Stoner, was assassinated by Hydra.
  145. 1965
    Nick Fury becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
    On the President's recommendation S.H.I.E.L.D.'s council offered the directorship to Colonel Nick Fury of the CIA, who had not known the agency existed. He took it, and his old Howlers Dum Dum Dugan and Gabe Jones soon followed him.
  146. 1965
    Reed Richards marries Susan Storm
    Reed Richards and Susan Storm of the Fantastic Four were married.
  147. 1965
    Bolivar Trask dies destroying the Master Mold
    Late in 1965 Dr Bolivar Trask's Sentinels and the Master Mold that built them decided that the surest way to protect mankind from mutants was to rule it, and made Trask their prisoner. He destroyed the Master Mold and died in the explosion.
  148. 1965
    Birth of Daniel Jackson
    Daniel Jackson was born, the son of the archaeologists Melburn and Claire Jackson.
  149. 1965
    The Inhumans come to notice
    Medusa fought the Fantastic Four with the Frightful Four. In the autumn the Royal Family met the Fantastic Four, and Johnny Storm met Crystal.
  150. 1965
    The standoff on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge
    The armies of the two kingdoms that call themselves Atlantis faced each other over ruins on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. Superman and Captain America stood between them for three days until both kings went home. The ruins were a Portuguese fort.
  151. 1965
    Delta Green warns against arming the Tcho-Tcho
    In 1965 Delta Green warned the Central Intelligence Agency against arming the Tcho-Tcho of the hills of Vietnam as allies in the war. The warning was ignored.
  152. 1965
    The Sentinels unveiledB4 Ch3
    Two Sentinels smashed into a television studio during a debate and seized people.
  153. 1965
    Birth of Arthur Curry junior
    Aquaman and Mera's son, Arthur Curry junior, was born in Poseidonis.
  154. January 1965
    Three monsters drive off King Ghidorah
    King Ghidorah, a three-headed dragon from space, hatched from a meteorite in the Kurobe valley. A voice speaking through Princess Salno of Selgina warned that it had already destroyed the people of Venus. At Mount Fuji the Mothra larva shamed Godzilla, with Rodan, into fighting beside her, so that the three drove it back into space.
  155. January 1965
    The Justice League and the Avengers at Mount Fuji
    With Godzilla, Rodan and King Ghidorah all loose at once, Japan asked for help for the first time. The Justice League came, with the Avengers of Captain America, Iron Man, Thor, Giant-Man and the Wasp, to hold King Ghidorah off the towns. When the Mothra larva talked Godzilla round, with Rodan, the heroes stood aside to let the three monsters drive it away.
  156. 9 December 1965
    Bond recovers SPECTRE's stolen bombs
    James Bond recovered two atomic bombs stolen by SPECTRE's Emilio Largo and held to ransom against the West, in the waters off Nassau.
  157. Winter 1965
    Maximus seals the Great Refuge
    Maximus's Atmo-Gun failed, and he turned it into a barrier of negative energy round the Inhumans' city, days before Galactus came.
  158. December 1965
    The Xiliens borrow Godzilla and Rodan
    The Xiliens of Planet X, a world behind Jupiter, asked the Earth for the loan of Godzilla and Rodan to fight King Ghidorah. It was a trick: they sent all three monsters back to conquer the Earth. A sound that the Xiliens could not bear broke their control, after which the two Earth monsters threw King Ghidorah out.
  159. December 1965
    The sky catches fire over ManhattanB4 Ch3
    Just before Christmas something came to eat the world, and the Fantastic Four were said to have talked it out of it.
  160. 19 December 1965
    The League and the Avengers hold three monsters again
    The Xiliens had loosed Godzilla, Rodan and King Ghidorah on Japan under their own control. The Justice League came a second time, with Captain America's new Avengers, Hawkeye, Quicksilver and the Scarlet Witch. Knowing from January that they could not win, they kept the monsters out of Tokyo until the Xiliens' control was broken, then let Godzilla drive King Ghidorah away.
  161. 1966
    McGonagall and Big Boss in Siberia
    In the winter of 1966 Minerva McGonagall and the soldier known as Big Boss waited four days in the snow outside a village of dark wizards forty miles past the last road in Siberia, whose nine men had preyed on the valley below for thirty years, until the men came out to them.
  162. c. 1966
    Fury finds Strucker behind Hydra
    In S.H.I.E.L.D.'s first years Nick Fury found that the true master of Hydra was Baron Wolfgang von Strucker, the Prussian officer his Howlers had fought in the war.
  163. 1966
    Fury tries to recruit Captain America
    Nick Fury tried to recruit Steve Rogers into S.H.I.E.L.D. Rogers declined, but has worked with the agency ever since, and its Agent 13, Sharon Carter, was for years the woman he loved.
  164. 1966
    Death of Dan Garret
    The first Blue Beetle, Dan Garret, was killed on Pago Island fighting Jarvis Kord, and with his last breath passed the name, though not the scarab's power, to his student Ted Kord, an inventor without powers.
  165. c. 1966
    Mephisto begins tempting the Silver Surfer
    After Galactus imprisoned the Silver Surfer on Earth at the end of 1965, Mephisto, the Devil in one more mask, tempted him again and again and could not break him.
  166. 1966
    Black Bolt breaks the barrier
    Black Bolt's voice broke the barrier along with most of Attilan. The Royal Family went out to see the world.
  167. 1966
    The Green Goblin unmasked
    The Green Goblin learnt who Spider-Man was, then unmasked himself as Norman Osborn, the father of Peter Parker's friend Harry. A shock of electricity wiped out his memory of being the Goblin.
  168. 1966
    Namor wins the Trident of Neptune
    Namor brought home the Trident of Neptune, the sign of his kings, then was crowned King of Atlantis, two years after Aquaman.
  169. 1966
    The boy called Frank Jaeger
    Among the guerrillas fighting for Mozambique's independence was a boy who had killed dozens of soldiers with a knife. They knew him as Frank Jaeger, the hunter. The Philosophers took him for their Perfect Soldier experiment, renaming him Null.
  170. 1966
    McGonagall in SiberiaB3 Ch11
    In winter McGonagall and one young man raided a hidden Siberian village of nine men after four days' wait.
  171. 1966
    Peter Parker meets Mary Jane Watson
    After months of trying, Aunt May introduced Peter Parker to her neighbour's niece, Mary Jane Watson.
  172. 1966
    Ocean Master appears
    Aquaman's half-brother Orm, Tom Curry's son by a second wife, took to piracy as Ocean Master.
  173. December 1966
    Godzilla destroys the Red Bamboo's island
    On Letchi Island the Red Bamboo, a terrorist army, were making heavy water with slaves taken from Infant Island. Castaways woke Godzilla, who was asleep in a cave there. He tore the claws from the giant lobster Ebirah, wrecked the base, then leapt clear as the island blew up; Mothra carried the people away.
  174. December 1966
    S.H.I.E.L.D. reaches Letchi Island too late
    Nick Fury had tracked the Red Bamboo's heavy water to Letchi Island. S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Helicarrier arrived as the island blew up, in time to see Godzilla swim away from it. Fury ordered his agents to let him go.
  175. 1967
    Hercules joins the Avengers
    Hercules of Olympus joined the Avengers.
  176. 1967
    Ronan the Accuser comes to Earth
    After the Fantastic Four destroyed a Kree Sentry, Ronan the Accuser came to punish them, and was beaten.
  177. 1967
    Captain Mar-Vell comes to Earth
    The Kree officer Mar-Vell was sent to spy on Earth. He took the name Walter Lawson at Cape Kennedy and became known as Captain Marvel.
  178. 1967
    Spider-Man gives up for a time
    Peter Parker threw his costume into a dustbin as the Kingpin began to take over New York's gangs. Remembering Uncle Ben, he took it back.
  179. 1967
    Black Manta appears
    The treasure hunter Black Manta began his war on Aquaman.
  180. January 1967
    Batgirl first appears
    On her way to a fancy-dress party in a costume of her own making, Barbara Gordon stopped Killer Moth from kidnapping Bruce Wayne. She went on fighting crime in Gotham as Batgirl, though Batman did not want her to.
  181. 12 June 1967
    Bond destroys Blofeld's volcano base
    In Japan James Bond found the base inside a volcano from which Blofeld and SPECTRE had been stealing American and Soviet spacecraft in orbit, and destroyed it.
  182. December 1967
    Minilla hatches on Sollgel Island
    A weather experiment under Dr Tsunezo Kusumi went wrong on Sollgel Island, turning its mantises into giants. They broke open an egg, from which Minilla hatched. Godzilla came for the hatchling, taught him to breathe fire, then slept beside him in the snow when the experiment froze the island.
  183. 1968
    Henry Pym marries Janet van Dyne
    Henry Pym, by then Goliath, and Janet van Dyne, the Wasp, were married.
  184. 1968
    The Black Panther joins the Avengers
    T'Challa, king of the African nation of Wakanda, joined the Avengers as the Black Panther, the team's first Black member.
  185. 1968
    The Vision joins the Avengers
    The Vision, an android built to destroy the Avengers by Ultron, the robot Henry Pym had made and lost control of, joined them instead.
  186. 1968
    Wonder Woman gives up her powers
    Wonder Woman gave up her powers for a time and left the Justice League.
  187. 1968
    Birth of Franklin Richards
    Franklin Richards was born to Reed and Sue Richards of the Fantastic Four. The cosmic rays in his mother's blood put both their lives in danger, until Reed brought a device back from Annihilus in the Negative Zone that saw them safely through.
  188. 1968
    Crystal joins the Fantastic Four
    Crystal took Sue Richards's place in the team, staying until 1970.
  189. 1968
    PISCES raids Goatswood
    In 1968 PISCES, the British section for the unnatural, raided the Gloucestershire village of Goatswood to root out the insects from Shaggai. The insects escaped inside the heads of some of its agents.
  190. 1968
    EVA disappears in Hanoi
    The spy EVA, driven out by the Chinese masters she had failed, vanished in Hanoi.
  191. c. 1968
    Constantine and Lucius come back handsomeB3 Interlude
    Having both turned fifteen the same summer, John Constantine and Lucius Malfoy returned to Hogwarts tall and handsome; the girls began pursuing John, and Lucius drifted towards a set with old names.
  192. 1969
    Snapper Carr betrays the Secret Sanctuary
    Tricked by the Joker, the honorary member Snapper Carr betrayed the location of the Justice League's Secret Sanctuary, and the League abandoned it.
  193. 1969
    The new Black Canary joins the League
    Dinah Drake's daughter, as the new Black Canary, joined the Justice League and became one of its mainstays.
  194. 1969
    Larry Trask builds new Sentinels
    Bolivar Trask's son Larry, who did not know that he was himself a mutant, revived his father's work and built a second generation of Sentinels.
  195. 1969
    The Black Knight joins the Avengers
    Dane Whitman, the Black Knight, joined the Avengers.
  196. 1969
    The Falcon joins Captain America
    Sam Wilson, a Harlem social worker, began fighting beside Captain America as the Falcon.
  197. 1969
    Mar-Vell is bound to Rick Jones
    The Nega-Bands bound Mar-Vell to Rick Jones, so that only one of them could stand in the world at a time. The blast of the Psyche-Magnitron changed Carol Danvers.
  198. c. 1969
    Birth of Alessa Gillespie
    Alessa Gillespie was born at Silent Hill to Dahlia Gillespie, a priestess of the Order of Silent Hill. She was a witch, born with magic to a No-Maj mother, in a town where nobody knew what that meant.
  199. c. 1969
    Constantine poisonedB3 Interlude
    In his fifth year John Constantine was poisoned through his pumpkin juice and spent nine days in the hospital wing with his skin turning green, while Lucius Malfoy read to him.
  200. 1969
    Arthur Weasley marries Molly PrewettB3 Ch22
    Arthur Weasley married Molly Prewett; by 1994 they had been married twenty-five years and had seven children, Bill, Charlie, Percy, Fred, George, Ron and Ginny.
  201. 20 July 1969
    Zordon's first Power Rangers
    On the night of the Moon landing Dark Specter sent Psycho Green to the Moon to free Rita Repulsa. Zordon's first team of five Rangers, led by Grace Sterling of NASA, fought him there, and three of the five were killed. Grace kept Psycho Green's dagger. The team never came to public notice.
  202. Autumn 1969
    Agatha Harkness becomes Franklin Richards's governess
    At Whisper Hill, her house in the Adirondacks, the witch Agatha Harkness dealt with the Frightful Four without letting the Fantastic Four see how. She then became governess to Reed and Sue Richards's son, Franklin.
  203. 23 November 1969
    Operation OBSIDIAN ends in disaster
    A Delta Green operation against a temple complex behind the Cambodian border went wrong. More than three hundred Marines died.
  204. December 1969
    A boy dreams of Monster Island
    Ichiro Miki, a lonely schoolboy of Kawasaki, dreamt of Monster Island, where a monster called Gabara bullied Minilla. He took heart from the dream. He outwitted two bank robbers who had taken him hostage, then stood up to the bullies at his school.

The 1970s

  1. 1970s
    Greyback runs with Voldemort's followers
    In the First Wizarding War Fenrir Greyback ran with Lord Voldemort's supporters, who promised him prey, and spread terror by threatening the children of those who resisted.
  2. 1970s
    James Potter uses the Peverell Cloak at Hogwarts
    At Hogwarts James Potter used the Cloak of Invisibility mainly to sneak down to the kitchens, and with Sirius Black and Peter Pettigrew to slip out every month to join Remus Lupin.
  3. 1970
    The Justice League moves into orbit
    The Justice League began working from a satellite 22,300 miles above the Earth, reached by teleporter, its members keeping a rota of monitor duty on board.
  4. 1970
    Green Lantern and Green Arrow cross America
    Hal Jordan and Oliver Queen set out across America together by road to see the country for themselves, and found poverty, racism and polluted towns.
  5. 1970s
    Constantine fronts Mucous Membrane
    In London in the later 1970s John Constantine fronted a punk band, Mucous Membrane, and took up the occult in earnest among Muggles.
  6. 1970s
    Stephen Lang builds Sentinels
    Further Sentinels were built in the 1970s by a private programme under the scientist Stephen Lang.
  7. 1970
    Big Boss begins his own army
    On the San Hieronymo Peninsula in Colombia the FOX unit rebelled under its commander, Gene, seizing a Soviet missile base. Big Boss, held there as a prisoner, broke out with the young Green Beret Roy Campbell. He raised a force from the stranded Soviet garrison and put the rebellion down. From then on he began to gather soldiers who had no country left to serve, the first step towards Outer Heaven.
  8. 1970
    Death of Captain George Stacy
    Gwen Stacy's father, a retired police captain, was killed by falling bricks while shielding a boy during a fight between Spider-Man and Doctor Octopus. Dying, he called Spider-Man by his real name.
  9. 1970
    Walter Sullivan is born in Room 302
    A young couple abandoned their newborn son in Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights. The superintendent, Frank Sunderland, sent for an ambulance and kept the baby's cord. The child, Walter Sullivan, was sent to Wish House, the orphanage of the Order of Silent Hill.
  10. c. 1970
    McGonagall begins teaching at HogwartsB1 Ch11
    Minerva McGonagall began teaching Transfiguration at Hogwarts and was still very new to it when James Potter and Sirius Black were pupils.
  11. 1970s
    Whomping Willow plantedB3 Ch10
    The Whomping Willow was planted in Remus Lupin's first year at Hogwarts; after Davey Gudgeon nearly lost an eye to it, students were kept away.
  12. 1970s
    James Potter saves Severus SnapeB3 Ch14
    During their schooldays James Potter and his friends played a joke on Severus Snape that would have killed him; by Snape's account James backed out at the last moment to save his own skin as much as Snape's.
  13. 1970s
    Screams at the Shrieking ShackB3 Ch14
    According to rumour repeated by Ron Weasley, screaming was heard at the Shrieking Shack in the 1970s, and some said a mad old wizard killed people there.
  14. 1970s
    Narcissa and Bellatrix Black fight over James PotterB3 Ch16
    In the Hogwarts entrance hall Narcissa Black and her sister Bellatrix tried to hex each other's eyebrows off over James Potter, who stood between them; Remus Lupin witnessed it.
  15. 1970
    Gene's missile is stopped
    Gene, the rebel commander of FOX, meant to fire a nuclear missile from San Hieronymo at America to destroy the Philosophers. Big Boss wrecked the launcher, an early Metal Gear, then killed him. Dying, Gene left him the money he had gathered for a soldiers' nation of his own. Among the FOX soldiers Big Boss set free was Null, the future Gray Fox.
  16. 1970
    Ocelot kills the Director of Central Intelligence
    Ocelot shot the Director of Central Intelligence at Langley, made it look like suicide, then carried off the remaining records of the Philosophers' Legacy with the names of the Philosophers themselves.
  17. 1970
    Major Zero founds the Patriots
    With the Legacy Major Zero remade the American Philosophers as the Patriots, meaning to unite the world as he believed The Boss had wished. His fellow founders were Big Boss, Ocelot, EVA, Para-Medic and Sigint. The FOX unit was disbanded.
  18. 1970s
    Voldemort's first war
    Through the 1970s Lord Voldemort and his Death Eaters, branded with the Dark Mark, waged war on wizarding Britain until people would no longer speak his name.
  19. 1970s
    Dumbledore leads the Order of the Phoenix
    Through the first war against Lord Voldemort, Albus Dumbledore led those who resisted him as the Order of the Phoenix.
  20. 1970s
    Snape and Lily fall out
    By the lake at Hogwarts Severus Snape called Lily Evans 'that word', ending their friendship, while James Potter looked on with a face like thunder.
  21. 1970s
    Death of Daniel Jackson's parents
    When Daniel Jackson was a boy his parents Melburn and Claire were killed in an accident while installing an Egyptian exhibit at a museum in New York, and he grew up in foster homes.
  22. 1970s
    McGonagall and Big Boss kill a Goa'uld
    A long time ago and a very long way from Britain, Minerva McGonagall tried and failed to separate a Goa'uld symbiote from its human host by Transfiguration; in the end Big Boss's knife did it, the host and the creature both died, and she had the symbiote stuffed and hung in a lit case over her office fire.
  23. 1970s
    Deaths of Fabian and Gideon Prewett
    Molly Weasley's brothers Fabian and Gideon Prewett were killed fighting Death Eaters in the first war against Voldemort.
  24. 1970s
    Edgar Bones and his family killed
    During the first war Voldemort's followers killed Edgar Bones, uncle of Susan Bones, and his family, among several of her relatives lost in the war.
  25. 1970s
    The Black twins fight over James PotterB4 Ch6
    For years at Hogwarts Narcissa and Bellatrix Black both loved James Potter and fought over him, until Professor Flitwick hid behind his desk; then Lily came along.
  26. 24 July 1970
    Delta Green is officially shut down
    After the disaster in Cambodia the Delta Green clearance was withdrawn. Later that year forty of the men who had held it met in Washington, where they agreed to carry on without leave.
  27. 29 November 1970
    Birth of Bill Weasley
    William Arthur Weasley, known as Bill, was born, the eldest child of Arthur and Molly Weasley.
  28. 1971
    Speedy is found taking drugs
    Green Arrow's ward Roy Harper, Speedy, turned out to have been caught by the drugs that Green Lantern and Green Arrow had found on their journey across America.
  29. 1971
    John Stewart becomes a Green Lantern
    The Guardians of the Universe chose John Stewart, a Black architect from Detroit, as Hal Jordan's reserve, which brought questions of race and poverty to the Justice League's own table.
  30. 1971
    The Kree-Skrull War begins
    The Avengers sheltered the Kree officer Captain Marvel; Senator H. Warren Craddock's Alien Activities Commission turned the public against them, and S.H.I.E.L.D. hunted Captain Marvel and Carol Danvers. Three Skrulls posing as Captain America, Thor and Iron Man announced that the team was disbanded.
  31. 1971
    The Defenders are founded
    Stephen Strange founded the loose band of heroes called the Defenders with the Hulk and the Sub-Mariner.
  32. 1971
    Lucius Malfoy takes the Dark Mark
    After leaving Hogwarts Lucius Malfoy joined Lord Voldemort and took the Dark Mark on his left forearm; Arthur Weasley believed he stood in the inner circle.
  33. c. 1971
    Petunia Evans is refused a place at Hogwarts
    As a girl Petunia Evans wrote to Albus Dumbledore asking to be admitted to Hogwarts alongside her sister Lily, and was refused.
  34. c. 1971
    Dumbledore admits Remus Lupin
    On becoming Headmaster, Albus Dumbledore admitted Remus Lupin, a bitten Garou boy no other headmaster would have taken, had the Whomping Willow planted and the Shrieking Shack and its tunnel built, and encouraged the rumour that the Shack was haunted.
  35. 1971
    Highfather sends Orion to Earth
    On the word of the Source, Highfather sent Orion to fight Darkseid's servants on Earth. The Forever People came to rescue Beautiful Dreamer, and Superman helped them.
  36. 1971
    Susan tells Lily of Narnia
    When Lily Evans went to Hogwarts, her mother Susan, once Queen Susan of Narnia, began to tell her of Narnia, knowing that Lily would believe her. Petunia met the stories with scorn and derision, and her resentment of Lily deepened.
  37. 1971
    Death of the Lady Dorma
    Llyra of Lemuria murdered the Lady Dorma on the day of her wedding to Namor. Aquaman's wedding gift arrived the next morning. Namor sent it back unopened.
  38. 1971
    Big Boss founds FOXHOUND
    On Major Zero's orders Big Boss founded the special forces unit FOXHOUND to take the place of FOX. He was its first commander.
  39. 1971
    The Marauders' year starts at HogwartsB4 Ch6
    James Potter, Sirius Black, Remus Lupin, Peter Pettigrew and Lily Evans entered Hogwarts and were sorted into Gryffindor, Sirius the first Black in generations to go anywhere but Slytherin, while Severus Snape and the sisters Bellatrix and Narcissa Black went to Slytherin.
  40. March 1971
    Lucius Malfoy turns on John ConstantineB3 Interlude
    In March of their seventh year at Hogwarts, Lucius Malfoy ambushed John Constantine over a Ravenclaw girl, called him a Mudblood for the first time and fought him until the caretaker Pringle pulled them apart, swearing that Constantine would pay.
  41. March 1971
    Lucius Malfoy and Constantine swear blood oathsB4 Ch6
    At Hogwarts Lucius Malfoy and John Constantine each swore an oath on his blood against the other; Lucius still held himself bound to settle his in 1994.
  42. Summer 1971
    Constantine leaves HogwartsB3 Interlude
    John Constantine left Hogwarts, bellowing that he would never return; his Ravenclaw girlfriend ended things a month later.
  43. July 1971
    Godzilla destroys Hedorah
    Hedorah, a creature from space that fed on pollution, grew in the filth of Suruga Bay until its acid mist was killing people by the thousand. Dr Toru Yano found that it could be dried out. Godzilla finished it between two giant electrodes on the slopes of Mount Fuji.
  44. July 1971
    The Sub-Mariner fights Hedorah
    Namor, the Sub-Mariner, came into Suruga Bay because its sea was dying. He fought Hedorah under water for a night, was burnt by it, then left the creature to Godzilla. He went home counting Godzilla a fellow sufferer from the surface world's bombs.
  45. 17 December 1971
    Bond stops Blofeld's laser satellite
    James Bond followed a diamond-smuggling ring through Las Vegas to Blofeld and the laser satellite the diamonds had been gathered to build; afterwards he was recaptured as John Mason and sent to San Quentin.
  46. 25 December 1971
    Operation BINGO bombs the Tcho-Tcho
    On Christmas Day the outlawed Delta Green diverted American bombers on to every village and holy place of the Tcho-Tcho that it knew of. It was the first operation of the conspiracy.
  47. 1972
    Les Enfants Terribles
    Major Zero, fearing to lose Big Boss as the figurehead of the Patriots, had him cloned without his knowledge. Dr Clark, once the FOX medic Para-Medic, led the work, which the Weapon programme carried as Weapon III, Les Enfants Terribles. EVA gave birth to the twins later called Solid Snake and Liquid Snake. A third son, Solidus, came out of the same project afterwards.
  48. c. 1972
    Rick Jones ends the Kree-Skrull War
    The re-formed Avengers followed the war into space, where Rick Jones ended it with a power the Kree Supreme Intelligence had woken in him. Senator Craddock was revealed as a Skrull and killed by a mob.
  49. 1972
    Johnny Blaze sells his soul to Mephisto
    The motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sold his soul to Mephisto to save his foster father and was bound to the demon Zarathos, becoming the Ghost Rider.
  50. 1972
    Galactus returns to Earth
    Galactus came back to Earth for the first time since 1965, and was turned away again.
  51. 1972
    William Burnside is revived
    Revived from suspended animation, William Burnside, the Captain America of 1953 and 1954, fought the real Captain America and lost.
  52. 1972
    Thanos comes to notice on Earth
    At the end of 1972 Thanos, the Mad Titan, first came to notice on Earth. He was the purple-skinned Eternal who had fallen in love with Death as a young man and killed most of the people of Titan.
  53. 1972
    Barbara Gordon is elected to Congress
    Barbara Gordon, secretly Batgirl, was elected to Congress and moved to Washington, meaning to give up the cape. She could not keep away from the work for long.
  54. 1972
    Big Boss breaks with Major Zero
    On learning what had been done with his genome, Big Boss walked out of the organisation he had helped to found. He never served beside his old commander again. The two were enemies for the rest of their lives.
  55. 1972
    Big Boss meets Kazuhira Miller
    In Colombia Big Boss met Kazuhira Miller, the son of an American officer by a Japanese mother. Together they founded Militaires Sans Frontières, an army for hire that belonged to no country.
  56. March 1972
    The hunters of Nebula M bring Gigan
    Aliens from Nebula M, giant cockroaches in the likenesses of dead men, built a tower shaped like Godzilla in a Tokyo amusement park. From it they called down Gigan, with King Ghidorah. Godzilla came from Monster Island with Anguirus; once the cartoonist Gengo Odaka's friends had blown up the tower, the two drove the invaders' monsters off.
  57. March 1972
    The League's satellite sights Gigan
    The Atom, on watch in the Justice League's satellite, saw Gigan approaching the Earth with King Ghidorah. Superman met them above the atmosphere with Green Lantern but could not turn them. The League followed them to Tokyo, where it kept the crowds clear while Godzilla drove the pair off.
  58. 12 December 1972
    Birth of Charlie Weasley
    Charles Weasley, known as Charlie, second son of Arthur and Molly Weasley, was born.
  59. 1973
    Creation of Khan and the Augments
    Data from Weapon III was used to create Khan Noonien Singh and the Augments.
  60. 1973
    Thanos seizes the Cosmic Cube
    For Death's sake Thanos went to war for the Cosmic Cube in 1973 and 1974, and it made him all but omnipotent until Captain Mar-Vell and the Avengers broke its power.
  61. 1973
    Death of Gwen Stacy
    The Green Goblin threw Gwen Stacy, the woman Peter Parker loved, from a bridge, and she died.
  62. 1973
    The Black Widow joins the Avengers
    Natasha Romanoff, the Black Widow, a Soviet agent who had defected in the 1960s, joined the Avengers.
  63. 1973
    Loki sets the Avengers against the Defenders
    Loki and the demon Dormammu tricked the Avengers into a war with the Defenders.
  64. 1973
    Elongated Man and Red Tornado join the League
    Ralph Dibny, the Elongated Man, and the android Red Tornado joined the Justice League.
  65. 1973
    Stephen Strange becomes Sorcerer Supreme
    When the Ancient One died, Stephen Strange succeeded him as Sorcerer Supreme, the chief guardian of the Earth against magical attack.
  66. c. 1973
    Sirius explains Lupin's absences
    At thirteen Sirius Black spent nearly two months telling the Gryffindor common room that Remus Lupin's monthly absences were on account of a girl named Rita.
  67. 1973
    Darkseid tries to take the Cosmic Cube from Thanos
    Darkseid, the Lord of Apokolips, sent his son Kalibak with an army of Parademons to take the Cosmic Cube from Thanos, the Mad Titan. The Justice League fought the Parademons over the Pacific coast of America, while the Avengers and Captain Mar-Vell went into space after Thanos. Their feud began there.
  68. 1973
    Reed Richards shuts down his son's mind
    When Franklin Richards was about five, his power woke and drew Annihilus out of the Negative Zone to feed on it. Fearing that it would destroy all life on Earth, Reed Richards shut down his son's mind, and Sue Richards left him for a time.
  69. c. 1973
    Lupin watches James Potter at schoolB3 Ch7
    About twenty years before 1993, Remus Lupin watched a young James Potter at Hogwarts in circumstances that Harry's later reminded him of.
  70. c. 1973
    The Fat Friar helps Lily with her faithB3 Ch21
    When Lily Evans was about thirteen, the Fat Friar, the ghost of Hufflepuff, helped her with her faith; through all her school years she was the only believer among her friends.
  71. 1973
    Death of Norman Osborn
    Soon after Gwen Stacy's death the Green Goblin sent his glider at Spider-Man's back. Spider-Man jumped aside, so the glider killed Norman Osborn.
  72. March 1973
    Seatopia sends Megalon against Tokyo
    Seatopia, a kingdom under the sea bed that bomb tests had damaged, sent its giant beetle Megalon to destroy Tokyo. The hunters of Nebula M lent it Gigan. Godzilla beat them both beside Jet Jaguar, the inventor Goro Ibuki's robot, which had grown to their size of its own accord.
  73. 1974
    Wolverine debuts
    Wolverine, product of Weapon X, came to public notice, already very old.
  74. 1974
    The Secret Empire targets Captain America
    In the year of Watergate the Secret Empire, an offshoot of Hydra, smeared Captain America through its Committee to Regain America's Principles, framed him for murder and planned to seize the government. Rogers followed its leader, Number One, into the White House, where Number One shot himself, and the disillusioned Rogers fought for a time as Nomad.
  75. c. 1974
    James knocks Sirius off his broom
    In their fourth year at Hogwarts James Potter knocked Sirius Black off his broom with a tackle that Sirius ranked the worst he ever suffered.
  76. c. 1974
    Birth of Stan Shunpike
    Stan Shunpike, later conductor of the Knight Bus, was born; he was eighteen or nineteen in 1993.
  77. 1974
    Two weddings
    Crystal married Quicksilver, the first marriage between an Inhuman and an outsider. Scott Free, Mister Miracle, married Big Barda.
  78. 1974
    The Punisher hunts Spider-Man
    The Jackal set the Punisher on Spider-Man, whom some blamed for Norman Osborn's death. The same year Harry Osborn put on his father's mask as the Green Goblin.
  79. 1970s
    Longevity medicine begins
    From the 1970s Reed Richards, Hank Pym and the Wayne Foundation began the work that became longevity medicine. Over the decades it let men and women in their sixties look and feel about thirty.
  80. 1974
    Sir James and Lady Elizabeth Braddock are killed
    Sir James Braddock died with his wife in an explosion in his laboratory at Braddock Manor. It looked like an accident. Their son Brian, then twenty-one, had sat talking in a car outside with a girl that night instead of going in, so he blamed himself for years.
  81. c. 1974
    Sirius Black's trick on SnapeB3 Ch18
    About twenty years before 1994, Sirius Black told Severus Snape how to get past the Whomping Willow to Lupin's transformation; James Potter pulled Snape back, but Snape glimpsed Lupin and learnt his secret.
  82. c. 1974
    Lucius Malfoy begins cultivating Cornelius FudgeB4 Ch6
    Lucius Malfoy began the twenty years he spent learning to manage Cornelius Fudge.
  83. 1974
    Franklin Richards destroys Ultron
    The robot Ultron came uninvited to Quicksilver's wedding to Crystal. His beams woke Franklin Richards from the sleep his father had put him in. Franklin's power struck back through them and destroyed him.
  84. March 1974
    Mechagodzilla is unmasked
    A false Godzilla came out of Mount Fuji. The real one burnt off its skin: it was Mechagodzilla, a machine built by aliens from the Third Planet of the Black Hole. On Okinawa Godzilla tore off its head with the help of King Caesar, the island's ancient guardian.
  85. Summer 1974
    Agatha Harkness teaches the Scarlet Witch
