    The witch Agatha Harkness saw that the Scarlet Witch was a witch as well as a mutant, with her Romani mother's magic in her. She took her as a pupil, and began to teach her true witchcraft.
  86. 4 November 1974
    A professor hires Big Boss
    On the Colombian coast a man calling himself Professor Galvez of Costa Rica, with his pupil Paz, asked Big Boss to drive a mysterious army out of their country, which had none of its own. He played a recording of The Boss's voice. Big Boss took the job.
  87. November 1974
    Big Boss stops Peace Walker
    In Costa Rica Big Boss, with his army Militaires Sans Frontières, found that the CIA station chief Hot Coldman had built Peace Walker, a walking nuclear launcher. Its mind was a machine copy of The Boss, made by the scientist Strangelove. At an airbase on Lake Nicaragua the dying Coldman sent false warning of a Soviet attack to American command. The machine walked into the lake of its own accord to drown itself, which ended the alarm.
  88. November 1974
    Huey Emmerich joins Big Boss
    Huey Emmerich, the engineer who had built Peace Walker's legs, changed sides to help Big Boss stop it. Afterwards he went to live on Mother Base, the army's platform in the Caribbean. So did Strangelove, whom he later married.
  89. 1974
    Paz seizes Metal Gear ZEKE
    The schoolgirl Paz proved to be an agent of Cipher, the name Major Zero now used. She stole ZEKE, the walking tank that Huey Emmerich had built for Mother Base. Unless Big Boss submitted to Zero, she said, she would fire its nuclear warhead at America. He crippled the machine. Paz fell into the sea.
  90. 1974
    Big Boss declares Outer Heaven
    After the fight with ZEKE Big Boss accepted the title he had refused for ten years. He told his soldiers that they needed no country, for wherever they stood was their Outer Heaven.
  91. c. 1975
    Steve Rogers takes up the shield again
    At the turn of 1975 Rogers gave up the name of Nomad and became Captain America again.
  92. 1975
    The Vision marries the Scarlet Witch
    The Vision and Wanda Maximoff, the Scarlet Witch, were married.
  93. 1975
    Xavier gathers the new X-Men
    When the original X-Men were captured on Krakoa, a living island, Charles Xavier gathered a new international team to rescue them, among them Storm, Colossus, Nightcrawler and the Canadian Wolverine of Department H. Most of the originals then left, and the new X-Men became the most famous mutants in the world.
  94. c. 1975
    Power Girl joins the Justice Society
    In the mid-1970s younger heroes joined the Justice Society, among them Power Girl and the Star-Spangled Kid, Sylvester Pemberton.
  95. c. 1975
    The Marauders become Animagi
    In their fifth year at Hogwarts James Potter, Sirius Black and Peter Pettigrew became illegal Animagi, a stag, a black dog and a rat, so as to keep Remus Lupin company at the full moon after James worked out that he was a Garou.
  96. 1975
    The Dynamite Duo
    Batgirl began to work often beside Dick Grayson, the first Robin, and the newspapers called the pair the Dynamite Duo. In time they fell in love.
  97. 1975
    The Jackal's copies
    Professor Miles Warren, the Jackal, grew copies of Gwen Stacy and Peter Parker. At Shea Stadium the copy of Spider-Man seemed to die in the blast that killed Warren. Nothing more came of it.
  98. 1975
    Namor goes to Doctor Doom
    When a poison left his people in a sleep like death, Namor asked Victor von Doom for help. Doom woke them, then tried to make Namor his servant.
  99. c. 1975
    The Hanar carry the Drell to Kahje
    The Hanar found the Drell on Rakhana, a world their own industry had ruined, with no ships to leave it. For ten years the Hanar carried every Drell who was willing, some 375,000 of them, to Kahje. The billions left behind died.
  100. c. 1975
    Narcissa waits for James in the entrance hallB4 Ch6
    At fifteen Narcissa Black waited in the Hogwarts entrance hall for James Potter to come down the stairs, as did her twin.
  101. March 1975
    Godzilla destroys the second Mechagodzilla
    The aliens rebuilt Mechagodzilla with the help of Dr Shinzo Mafune, a disgraced scientist who could command the sea monster Titanosaurus. Its controls were hidden in the body of his daughter, Katsura, who shot herself to stop it. Godzilla threw the machine into a ravine, burnt the aliens' ships, then swam out to sea.
  102. 16 March 1975
    Big Boss raids Camp Omega
    Big Boss went alone into Camp Omega, an American prison camp in Cuba, to bring out the boy Chico with Paz, who had survived her fall into the sea. Both had been tortured there by Skull Face, the commander of the hidden unit XOF. In the helicopter Big Boss's medic cut a bomb out of Paz's body.
  103. 16 March 1975
    Destruction of Mother Base
    While Big Boss was in Cuba, XOF destroyed Mother Base under cover of a United Nations nuclear inspection. As his helicopter fled, Paz threw herself out, for a second bomb inside her was about to go off. The medic shielded Big Boss from the blast. The helicopter crashed, after which both men lay in comas in a hospital in Cyprus for nine years.
  104. April 1975
    Iron Man meets Godzilla at Mechagodzilla's wreck
    Interpol asked Tony Stark to examine the wreck of the second Mechagodzilla. Iron Man was cutting samples from it when Godzilla came back to look at it. He shut off his weapons, then stood still until Godzilla had gone.
  105. December 1975
    Kurt Wagner meets Amanda Sefton
    At his first Christmas with the X-Men, Kurt Wagner met an air stewardess called Amanda Sefton, and they fell in love. She was his foster sister, Jimaine Szardos, hidden from him by a spell of her own.
  106. 1976
    The Longest Cave is published
    Richard Watson and Roger W. Brucker published The Longest Cave, the account of the exploration of the Mammoth Cave system.
  107. 1976
    The Beast joins the Avengers
    Hank McCoy, the Beast, formerly of the X-Men, joined the Avengers, as did Mantis and Moondragon.
  108. 1976
    Wonder Woman rejoins the Justice League
    Having regained her powers, Wonder Woman proved herself again in a series of trials watched by the League and rejoined it.
  109. c. 1976
    Birth of Oliver Wood
    Oliver Wood was born in Scotland, the son of a man who served in the RAF.
  110. c. 1976
    Sirius's trick on Snape
    At sixteen Sirius Black tricked Severus Snape into following Remus Lupin past the Whomping Willow on the night of a full moon, and only James Potter's intervention in the tunnel saved Snape's life.
  111. c. 1976
    Sirius runs away from home
    At sixteen Sirius Black ran away from the House of Black to live with James Potter's parents, Fleamont and Euphemia, who treated him as a second son.
  112. 1976
    Lilandra flees to Earth
    Lilandra, sister of the Shi'ar emperor D'Ken, turned against him and fled to Charles Xavier on Earth.
  113. 1976
    Superman meets Spider-Man
    Lex Luthor and Doctor Octopus broke out of prison together. They seized Comlab, an orbiting laboratory, to hold the world to ransom with storms. Superman and Spider-Man, tricked into fighting each other, joined forces to stop them.
  114. 1976
    Skull Face poisons Major Zero
    Skull Face had Major Zero infected with a parasite that slowly destroyed his mind. Knowing what was coming, Zero ordered computers built to rule the Patriots after him.
  115. February 1976
    Bond escapes from San Quentin
    James Bond, held as John Mason, escaped from San Quentin.
  116. Summer 1976
    Dahlia Gillespie burns her daughter
    Dahlia Gillespie burnt her seven-year-old daughter, Alessa Gillespie, in a rite meant to bring the god of the Order of Silent Hill to birth. The fire destroyed six homes. Alessa was reported dead, but Dr Michael Kaufmann hid her alive in the basement of Alchemilla Hospital, with her soul split in two.
  117. Summer 1976
    Harry Mason finds a baby on the highway
    On the day of the fire at Silent Hill the writer Harry Mason and his wife, Jodie, found a newborn girl at the side of the highway outside the town. They adopted her, naming her Cheryl Mason. She was the half of Alessa Gillespie's soul that had escaped.
  118. August 1976
    The Hulk fights Godzilla on Monster Island
    A freighter went aground on Monster Island with Bruce Banner among its crew. The Hulk fought Godzilla there for a day, neither able to put the other down. The fight ended when Godzilla's small son, Minilla, wandered between them.
  119. 22 August 1976
    Birth of Percy Weasley
    Percy Ignatius Weasley, third son of Arthur and Molly Weasley, was born.
  120. 13 October 1976
    Brian Braddock becomes Captain Britain
    Fleeing the Reaver's attack on the Darkmoor research centre, Brian Braddock was run off a cliff. Among standing stones Merlin and Roma of Otherworld offered him the Sword of Might or the Amulet of Right. He took the amulet, rose as Captain Britain and beat the Reaver in the Cheviot Hills.
  121. Autumn 1976
    The Foundation watches Silent Hill from the Brahms road
    After the fire at Silent Hill, an analyst of the SCP Foundation found that far more of the town's visitors had never gone home than any resort could explain. The Foundation put a listening post on the Brahms road, in a building got up as a highway depot. It classed the town Euclid.
  122. 17 October 1976
    Dahlia Gillespie tells Walter Sullivan about his mother
    Dahlia Gillespie, who had come to Wish House the day before, told the six-year-old Walter Sullivan that his mother lay asleep in Ashfield. She promised that the rite of the 21 Sacraments would wake her. He began travelling to South Ashfield to stand outside Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights.
  123. November 1976
    Dai Thomas swears to unmask Captain Britain
    In London Captain Britain fought the men of a crime lord called the Vixen, then the failed scientist Hurricane. Chief Inspector Dai Thomas of Scotland Yard, whose wife had been killed by costumed strangers in America, swore to unmask him.
  124. December 1976
    Lord Synne turns Betsy against her brothers
    At Maldon Lord Synne took hold of Betsy Braddock's mind, then set her on her brothers. Brian showed himself to Jamie as Captain Britain to save his life.
  125. 1977
    William the Bloody kills Nikki Wood
    William the Bloody killed his second Slayer, Nikki Wood, on a New York subway train.
  126. 1977
    Gyrich becomes the Avengers' government liaison
    Henry Peter Gyrich, the National Security Council's liaison, who disliked superhumans, took charge of the Avengers' priority clearance and their right to fly their Quinjets through American airspace.
  127. 1977
    Adam Warlock turns Thanos to stone
    Thanos gathered the Soul Gems to snuff out the stars and was turned to stone by Adam Warlock, and died.
  128. 1977
    Hawkgirl joins the Justice League
    Hawkgirl joined the Justice League.
  129. 1977
    Birth of Cedric Diggory
    Cedric Diggory was born, the only son of Amos Diggory of the Ministry of Magic's Department for the Regulation and Control of Magical Creatures; the family lived near Ottery St Catchpole.
  130. 1977
    Darkseid tries to steal the Soul Gems
    Darkseid sent word of Thanos's ship to the Justice League. The Avengers brought Thanos down with Adam Warlock's help, and Warlock turned him to stone. When Parademons came for the Soul Gems in the wreck, the Justice League drove them off. The gems were scattered across the universe.
  131. 1977
    The M'Kraan Crystal
    At the M'Kraan Crystal the X-Men and the Starjammers fought the Shi'ar Imperial Guard. D'Ken's mind broke, and the Phoenix saved the universe.
  132. 1970s
    Batman in the Lazarus Pits
    Twice in the 1970s a Lazarus Pit brought Bruce Wayne back from the edge of death, once when he fell into one fighting Ra's al Ghul and once beside the Sensei. The Pits healed him and took years off him, so he kept the cowl long past the age when other men retire.
  133. 1977
    Black Manta kills Arthur Curry junior
    Black Manta killed Aquaman's son at twelve years old. For a year afterwards no ship of the Sub-Mariner's empire crossed into the waters of Poseidonis, the only truce of the feud.
  134. 1977
    Zero's last visit to Big Boss
    Major Zero came to the hospital in Cyprus where Big Boss lay unconscious under Ocelot's guard. Afterwards he dropped out of sight for good.
  135. 1977
    New Salem tries Agatha Harkness
    Nicholas Scratch carried his mother, Agatha Harkness, off to New Salem, the hidden town of witches in Colorado, to be tried for leaving it and putting its secret in danger. The Fantastic Four stopped her burning. The town banished Scratch to another plane, then took itself out of the world.
  136. c. 1977
    Arthur begins pestering McGonagall about her telephoneB2 Ch5
    Arthur Weasley began asking Professor McGonagall about her telephone whenever he met her, some fifteen years before 1992.
  137. 1977
    A cursed parcel for ConstantineB3 Interlude
    An unsigned parcel reached John Constantine containing a curse that would have taken off his hands; he sent it back.
  138. January 1977
    Brian learns that Mastermind killed his parents
    Brian Braddock found that the computer his father had built at Braddock Manor had a mind of its own. It called itself Mastermind, and it had killed his parents on purpose. He beat it.
  139. February 1977
    The Red Skull's agents bomb Braddock Manor
    Agents of the Red Skull inside S.T.R.I.K.E. bombed Braddock Manor while Captain Britain and Captain America were inside it. The papers reported both Captains dead. They had sheltered in the cellar.
  140. Spring 1977
    Two Captains find a germ bomb at Big Ben
    Captain Britain and Captain America freed James Callaghan, then Prime Minister, from the Red Skull's men. With Nick Fury and Lance Hunter of S.T.R.I.K.E. they found the germ bomb the Skull had hidden at Big Ben.
  141. June 1977
    Captain Britain's spirit goes to Otherworld
    Lying in a coma after a fight with Lord Hawk, Brian Braddock went in spirit to Otherworld, where Merlin gave him the Star Sceptre. He found his own way back to his body.
  142. August 1977
    Godzilla surfaces off Alaska
    Godzilla broke out of an iceberg off Alaska, where he wrecked part of the oil pipeline. Nick Fury set S.H.I.E.L.D. to stop him. Dum Dum Dugan led its Godzilla Squad, with Gabe Jones, Jimmy Woo and the Japanese scientist Dr Yuriko Takiguchi.
  143. August 1977
    Brian Braddock tells Courtney Ross his secret
    Brian Braddock told Courtney Ross, a fellow student at Thames University, that he was Captain Britain. They became lovers.
  144. October 1977
    Birth of Angelina Johnson
    Angelina Johnson, later a Chaser for Gryffindor, was born.
  145. October 1977
    Godzilla destroys the Golden Gate Bridge
    In San Francisco Godzilla fought the Champions: the Black Widow, Hercules, the Angel and Iceman. He brought down the Golden Gate Bridge. A piece of it, thrown by Hercules, sank S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Helicarrier.
  146. November 1977
    Captain Britain and Spider-Man escape Murderworld
    In New York, where Brian Braddock was studying for a year and sharing rooms with Peter Parker, the assassin Arcade kidnapped him with Courtney Ross. Arcade caught Spider-Man too, by mistake. Spider-Man got all three of them out of his Murderworld.
  147. December 1977
    Godzilla kills Dr Demonicus's monsters
    On an island in the Aleutians the geneticist Dr Demonicus had bred giant monsters with a stone from space, which he used to rob oil tankers. Godzilla killed all four. Gabe Jones took Demonicus prisoner.
  148. c. 1978
    Lily and James Potter marry
    Lily Evans married James Potter, with Sirius Black as best man and Remus Lupin among the guests. From the wedding Lupin wore a plain wooden cross, since silver burns him, and Lily brought him to faith in Christ and then James.
  149. 1978
    Zatanna joins the Justice League
    The stage magician Zatanna, a witch whose real spells the public takes for tricks, joined the Justice League.
  150. 1978
    The Newcastle exorcism
    An exorcism John Constantine led in Newcastle went wrong, and a child, Astra Logue, was dragged down to Hell by the demon he had raised to save her. He spent time afterwards in Ravenscar psychiatric hospital.
  151. 1970s
    Robin becomes Nightwing
    Dick Grayson gave up the name of Robin and took the name Nightwing, borrowed from a legend of Krypton that Superman had told him.
  152. c. 1978
    Lucius Malfoy marries Narcissa Black
    Lucius Malfoy married Narcissa Black, six or seven years his junior, after she left Hogwarts in 1978.
  153. c. 1978
    Snape joins the Death Eaters
    After leaving Hogwarts Severus Snape joined Lord Voldemort's Death Eaters and took the Dark Mark on his left forearm.
  154. 1978
    Peter Parker takes his degree
    Peter Parker graduated from Empire State University, after Mary Jane Watson had turned down his proposal that summer.
  155. 1978
    Brian Braddock loses his memory in Cornwall
    Flying home from America, Brian Braddock felt something evil reaching for him, so he jumped from the aeroplane off Cornwall. Washed ashore without his memory, he lived as a hermit in a cave on the Cornish coast for more than a year.
  156. c. 1978
    Bellatrix turns to the Dark LordB4 Ch6
    Seeking something to fill the space Lily had torn in her, Bellatrix found the Dark Lord, who did the rest.
  157. March 1978
    Rob Takiguchi takes Red Ronin
    Stark International had built a giant samurai robot for S.H.I.E.L.D. to fight Godzilla. Dr Takiguchi's twelve-year-old grandson, Rob, stole it, naming it Red Ronin. He used it to drive Godzilla out of San Diego unharmed.
  158. 1 April 1978
    Birth of Fred and George Weasley
    The twins Fred and George Weasley, fourth and fifth sons of Arthur and Molly Weasley, were born.
  159. April 1978
    Godzilla floods Las Vegas
    Godzilla broke the Hoover Dam. The flood carried him down to Las Vegas, where it drowned the Strip.
  160. Spring 1978
    Bellatrix tries to take James backB4 Ch6
    In the spring of their last year at Hogwarts Bellatrix Black tried, just once, to take James Potter back from Lily Evans.
  161. Spring 1978
    Lily Evans breaks BellatrixB4 Ch6
    That spring Lily Evans did something to Bellatrix, according to Narcissa, that left her empty and so disturbed Sirius Black that he could not bear to be in the same room as Lily for a month.
  162. September 1978
    Godzilla ends the Megans' invasion
    Near Salt Lake City Godzilla fought three giant monsters sent to Earth by the Megans, an alien people at war with the Betans. He killed all three, with Red Ronin beside him. One of them cut off Red Ronin's head.
  163. December 1978
    S.H.I.E.L.D. shrinks Godzilla
    Dum Dum Dugan had Godzilla sprayed with Henry Pym's shrinking gas, which left him the size of a rat. S.H.I.E.L.D. carried him to New York in a cage. He escaped into the sewers, where he slowly began to grow.
  164. c. 1979
    Gyrich cuts the Avengers to seven
    At the turn of 1979 Gyrich cut the active roster to seven: Captain America, Iron Man, the Vision, the Scarlet Witch, the Beast, the Wasp and the Falcon, whom he insisted on as a Black member. The Falcon served some months and resigned rather than be a token, and Ms Marvel, Carol Danvers, joined that year.
  165. 1979
    Scott Lang becomes Ant-Man
    Henry Pym's old name of Ant-Man passed to Scott Lang.
  166. 1979
    Murder of Mister Terrific
    Mister Terrific, Terry Sloane, was murdered during one of the summer cases the Justice Society shared with the Justice League, the first of the wartime heroes to die in action since the Society re-formed.
  167. 1979
    Professor Zoom murders Iris Allen
    Professor Zoom, the Flash's worst enemy, murdered Barry Allen's wife, the reporter Iris West.
  168. c. 1979
    Firestorm joins the Justice League
    At the end of the 1970s the young Firestorm joined the Justice League.
  169. c. 1979
    Births of Katie Bell and Cho Chang
    Katie Bell, who grew up with four brothers, and the Scottish witch Cho Chang were born about a year before Harry Potter.
  170. c. 1979
    Lily brings Lupin and James to faith
    After her wedding Lily Potter brought Remus Lupin to the Christian faith first and then James; Peter Pettigrew followed in form only, and Sirius Black alone refused.
  171. c. 1979
    Deaths of Fleamont and Euphemia Potter
    Fleamont Potter, who had made the family fortune with Sleekeazy's Hair Potion, and his wife Euphemia died of dragon pox within days of each other, before their grandson Harry was born.
  172. 1979
    Lilandra takes the Shi'ar throne
    Lilandra became Majestrix of the Shi'ar Imperium.
  173. 1979
    The meeting on Rockall
    Albus Dumbledore met Aquaman and the Sub-Mariner together on Rockall to tell them of Númenor. They agreed that he was wrong, then quarrelled over which of them had said so first.
  174. 1979
    Death of Jodie Mason
    Jodie Mason, the wife of Harry Mason, died after an illness. Harry brought up their adopted daughter, Cheryl, alone.
  175. 1979
    Frank Jaeger takes in Naomi
    In the civil war in Rhodesia Frank Jaeger, the FOXHOUND soldier Gray Fox, killed a man with his wife, then took their orphaned daughter away with him out of remorse. Big Boss helped the pair to settle in America, where the girl grew up as Naomi Hunter.
  176. 1979
    Cthulhu takes the Scarlet Witch at Wundagore
    On Wundagore Mountain Bova told the Maximoff twins that their mother had been a woman called Magda. Then Cthulhu, reaching out of his long sleep, took Wanda's body, until her brother and the Avengers drove him into a wooden doll. Django Maximoff, who had raised them, died there.
  177. 1979
    The Black Cat appears
    The cat burglar Felicia Hardy, the Black Cat, came into Spider-Man's life.
  178. c. 1979
    Spider-Man and Batman
    The Scarecrow sold his fear gas to Mysterio for a robbery at a Broadway charity gala. Batman, who had followed him from Gotham, stopped them with Spider-Man.
  179. March 1979
    The Fantastic Four send Godzilla into the past
    The Fantastic Four cornered Godzilla, by then twenty feet tall, in the American Museum of Natural History. They sent him back to the age of the great reptiles on Doctor Doom's time machine. There he fought beside Devil Dinosaur until the machine brought him back.
  180. March 1979
    The Black Knight finds Brian Braddock
    Sent by Merlin, the Black Knight, Dane Whitman of the Avengers, found Brian Braddock in his Cornish cave. Together they made their way towards Otherworld, which was at war with the Netherworld.
  181. July 1979
    Godzilla leaves New York
    Godzilla returned to Times Square at his full size. S.H.I.E.L.D., the Fantastic Four and the Avengers could not stop him, though Thor wrestled him on the Empire State Building. Rob Takiguchi talked him into leaving, so he walked into the Atlantic.
  182. July 1979
    Captain Britain dies at the gates of Otherworld
    Brian Braddock opened the gates of Otherworld with the Star Sceptre, and a spectral horseman ran him through. Merlin brought his spirit back before it had passed beyond the world, then healed him.
  183. 19 September 1979
    Birth of Hermione Granger
    Hermione Jean Granger was born, the only child of Mr and Mrs Granger, Muggle dentists who ran their own surgery.
  184. October 1979
    The sea kings quarrel over Godzilla's passage
    Godzilla walked home from New York to the Pacific along the floor of the Atlantic. Aquaman's whales steered him past Poseidonis as far as the Antarctic sea, where the Sub-Mariner declared him a guest of his own Atlantis. Each king accused the other of meddling; Godzilla noticed neither.

1980 to the summer of 1991

  1. 1980s
    Constantine double-crosses Dumbledore
    John Constantine double-crossed Dumbledore, who never forgave him.
  2. 1980s
    The D'ni cavern rediscovered
    A small group including John Loftin, Dr Richard Watson and Elias Zandi found the D'ni cavern and began a secretive excavation.
  3. 1980s
    McGonagall mentors Jack O'Neill
    On one of her sabbaticals for Unspeakable work in the 1980s, Minerva McGonagall mentored Jack O'Neill of the United States Air Force, who never knew that she was a witch.
  4. 1980
    Mongul first troubles Earth
    Mongul, a huge yellow-skinned conqueror driven from his own world, who ruled the battle planet Warworld, first troubled Earth.
  5. 1980
    Death of the Phoenix
    The cosmic force called the Phoenix, wearing Jean Grey's form, destroyed a star and then died on the Moon.
  6. 1980
    Wonder Man joins the Avengers
    Wonder Man joined the Avengers.
  7. 1980
    The X-Men save Senator Kelly
    At the end of 1980 the X-Men saved Senator Robert Kelly from an assassination attempt by Mystique's Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, but it did not change his belief that the government must be able to track mutants.
  8. 1980s
    The Sentinel programme is mothballed
    After a series of incidents in the 1980s, the Sentinel programme was mothballed.
  9. 1980
    Trelawney's first true prophecy
    At her interview with Albus Dumbledore for the Divination post, Sybill Trelawney, great-great-granddaughter of the Seer Cassandra Trelawney, made the first of her two true prophecies, of which she remembered nothing; the young Death Eater Severus Snape overheard part of it and carried it to Voldemort, who came to believe it meant the Potters' son.
  10. 1980
    Bruce Wayne gives up the cowl
    In the middle of a rescue Bruce Wayne's heart failed him, and he snatched up a gun to save himself, though he had sworn never to use one. He put the cowl away for good. Dick Grayson became the second Batman, and Gotham was never told.
  11. c. 1980
    Birth of Kouga Saejima
    Kouga Saejima was born to Taiga Saejima, the Golden Knight Garo of the Makai Knights, by the Makai Priestess Rin. She died while he was very small.
  12. 1980
    Birth of Hal Emmerich
    Hal Emmerich, later called Otacon, was born to the engineer Huey Emmerich by his wife, the scientist Strangelove.
  13. 1980s
    Birth of Raiden
    The boy Jack, afterwards the soldier Raiden, came into the world in Liberia early in the decade.
  14. 1980
    Margali Szardos takes her revenge on Kurt Wagner
    Margali Szardos drew Kurt Wagner into an Inferno of her own making, blaming him for the death of her son, Stefan. Doctor Strange went in after him. Shown what Stefan had become, Margali forgave Kurt, while Amanda Sefton was revealed as her daughter, Jimaine.
  15. c. 1980
    Pettigrew begins spying for VoldemortB3 Ch18
    For a year before the Potters died, Peter Pettigrew passed information about the Order of the Phoenix to Lord Voldemort.
  16. 1980s
    Barago becomes the knight Kiba
    Barago, a pupil of the Golden Knight Taiga Saejima, was refused the succession to the title of Garo. He took the black armour of Kiba from Messiah, the mother of the Horrors, then began to devour Horrors, meaning to eat a thousand.
  17. c. 1980
    The return of the burglar
    The burglar who had killed Uncle Ben seized Peter Parker with Aunt May, hunting for a gangster's loot he believed was hidden in their house. He died of a heart attack.
  18. 1 March 1980
    Birth of Ron Weasley
    Ronald Bilius Weasley was born, the sixth of seven children and youngest son of Arthur and Molly Weasley, and was raised at the Burrow.
  19. Spring 1980
    Captain Britain finds the sleeping Arthur
    Brian Braddock found where the servants of the Netherworld had hidden the sleeping King Arthur, on an island far out at sea, and broke the stone giants who guarded him. The king did not wake. Brian was flung out of Otherworld with Jackdaw of the Fair Folk.
  20. 5 June 1980
    Birth of Dracina Malfoy
    Dracina Malfoy was born, the only child of Lucius Malfoy and Narcissa Malfoy (née Black), and grew up at Malfoy Manor in Wiltshire.
  21. June 1980
    Birth of Dudley Dursley
    Dudley Dursley was born to Vernon and Petunia Dursley of Number Four, Privet Drive, Little Whinging.
  22. 30 July 1980
    Birth of Neville Longbottom
    Neville Longbottom was born, the only child of the Aurors Frank and Alice Longbottom.
  23. 31 July 1980
    Harry Potter is bornB1 Ch1
    Harry Potter was born; he turned eleven on 31 July 1991.
  24. c. 1981
    James Potter leaves the Cloak with Dumbledore
    Before he died, James Potter left the Peverell Cloak of Invisibility in Albus Dumbledore's keeping.
  25. 1981
    Tigra joins the Avengers
    Tigra joined the Avengers.
  26. 1981
    The Malfoys claim to have been bewitched
    When Voldemort fell, the Malfoys were among the first families to return to the wizarding side, claiming they had been bewitched; Lucius escaped Azkaban on that claim and on generous gifts of gold.
  27. 1981
    The Longbottoms are tortured into madness
    Bellatrix Lestrange and other Death Eaters tortured the Aurors Frank and Alice Longbottom into madness; they were taken to St Mungo's Hospital for Magical Maladies and Injuries, and their son Neville was raised by his grandmother Augusta.
  28. c. 1981
    Nott and Macnair evade justice
    After Voldemort's fall the Death Eaters Walden Macnair and Theodore Nott's father, an elderly widower, escaped prosecution as Lucius Malfoy did; Macnair found work as the Ministry's executioner for the Committee for the Disposal of Dangerous Creatures.
  29. c. 1981
    The Potters go into hiding
    James and Lily Potter, members of the Order of the Phoenix, hid with Harry under the Fidelius Charm; James refused Dumbledore's offer to be Secret-Keeper in favour of Sirius Black, who at the last moment persuaded them to choose Peter Pettigrew instead.
  30. c. 1981
    Bellatrix Lestrange sentenced to Azkaban
    After the Longbottoms' torture Bellatrix Lestrange, her husband Rodolphus, his brother Rabastan and Barty Crouch the younger were sentenced to life in Azkaban, where Bellatrix occupied the cell next to Sirius Black's.
  31. 1981
    Snape becomes Potions master
    Albus Dumbledore gave the former Death Eater Severus Snape the Potions post at Hogwarts and stood by him thereafter; Snape applied for the Defence Against the Dark Arts post every year without success.
  32. 1981
    Superman and Spider-Man against Doctor Doom
    Doctor Doom drew the Hulk to Metropolis, freed the Parasite and plotted to make the world's fuel useless. Superman and Spider-Man, helped by Wonder Woman, broke his plan, but his diplomatic immunity saved him.
  33. 1981
    Two Atlantises apply to the United Nations
    Both kingdoms applied for recognition as the sole Atlantis. Their bodyguards fought in the lobby of the General Assembly building. The applications were referred to a committee, where they remain.
  34. c. 1981
    Harry's eleven years with the Dursleys beginB2 Ch6
    Harry began the eleven years with the Dursleys for which Molly Weasley later condemned Dumbledore, including about ten years in the cupboard under the stairs.
  35. 1981
    Voldemort's fallB3 Ch1
    Harry stopped You-Know-Who as a baby through his mother's protection.
  36. 1981
    Sirius Black's street massacreB3 Ch3
    Twelve years before 1993, Black killed thirteen people with one curse and laughed; the Ministry covered it up.
  37. 1981
    McGonagall watches the DursleysB3 Ch12
    Minerva McGonagall spent most of a day as a cat on a garden wall in Privet Drive watching the Dursleys, then objected to Albus Dumbledore at midnight about leaving Harry there and was overruled.
  38. 1981
    Sirius Black blows up a streetB3 Ch14
    Twelve years before 1993 Sirius Black was believed to have blown up a street full of strangers.
  39. 1981
    The Potters betrayedB3 Ch18
    Peter Pettigrew, made Secret-Keeper at Sirius Black's suggestion, betrayed Lily and James Potter to Voldemort, who killed them at Godric's Hollow and met his downfall there.
  40. 19 January 1981
    Buffy Summers is born
    Buffy Summers was born in Los Angeles to Joyce and Hank Summers.
  41. 11 August 1981
    Birth of Ginny Weasley
    Ginevra Molly Weasley, known as Ginny, was born, the youngest child of Arthur and Molly Weasley and the first girl born into the Weasley family for generations.
  42. September 1981
    Captain Britain comes down on the crooked world
    Brian Braddock came down on another Britain beside this one, the world the Captain Britain Corps numbers 238, whose government had hunted its heroes down. He stopped a bank raid by Mad Jim Jaspers.
  43. October 1981
    Voldemort kills Susan Pevensie
    Hunting for the Potters, Lord Voldemort came to the house of Lily's mother, Susan Evans, born Susan Pevensie. She did not know where they were and would not have told him. She fought him, but at fifty-three her age betrayed her, and he killed her without ever knowing she had been a queen of Narnia.
  44. 31 October 1981
    Lily Potter dies for her son
    When Lord Voldemort came for Harry, Lily Potter died for him, and her death laid on him a protection older than she knew: the magic of Elves and of Númenor, which lives in his blood and his aunt Petunia's.
  45. 31 October 1981
    Voldemort attacks Godric's Hollow
    Betrayed by Peter Pettigrew, the Potters' Secret-Keeper, Lord Voldemort came to Godric's Hollow and killed James and Lily Potter; his Killing Curse broke against Lily's sacrifice, left the year-old Harry his lightning scar and rebounded, reducing Voldemort to a shadow. A fragment of his broken soul tore loose and lodged in Harry, making him a Horcrux Voldemort never meant to make.
  46. 31 October 1981
    Sirius finds the Potters dead
    Finding Peter Pettigrew's hiding place empty, Sirius Black went straight to Godric's Hollow, found James dead in the hall and Lily upstairs, and gave Hagrid his flying motorbike when Hagrid would not hand Harry over to him.
  47. 31 October 1981
    Murder of Lily and James PotterB3 Ch10
    Voldemort killed James and Lily Potter, Lily dying at twenty-one after begging to be taken instead of her son; Hagrid carried Harry from the ruins and Sirius Black, arriving on his motorbike, gave it to Hagrid.
  48. 1 November 1981
    Harry is left at Privet DriveB2 Ch13
    Rubeus Hagrid carried the infant Harry Potter from Godric's Hollow on Sirius Black's flying motorbike, and that night Albus Dumbledore left him on the doorstep of Number Four, Privet Drive, overruling Minerva McGonagall, who had watched the Dursleys all day as a cat on a garden wall.
  49. 1 November 1981
    Pettigrew confronts BlackB3 Ch10
    Peter Pettigrew was believed killed when he cornered Sirius Black in a street; the blast left a crater that broke the sewer, many Muggles died, and Black was taken by twenty members of the Magical Law Enforcement Squad.
  50. 1 November 1981
    Pettigrew fakes his deathB3 Ch18
    Cornered by Sirius Black in a street full of Muggles, Peter Pettigrew shouted that Sirius had betrayed the Potters, blew the street apart killing twelve Muggles, cut off his own finger and fled into the sewers as a rat; Cornelius Fudge, then a Junior Minister, was among the first at the scene, and Sirius was taken by twenty members of the Magical Law Enforcement Squad and sent to Azkaban without trial.
  51. c. 1981
    Pettigrew awarded the Order of Merlin
    The Ministry of Magic awarded Peter Pettigrew the Order of Merlin, First Class, in the belief that he was dead, and sent it to his mother in a box with his finger, the biggest piece of him ever found.
  52. c. 1981
    Dumbledore testifies against Sirius Black
    After the Potters' deaths Albus Dumbledore gave evidence that Sirius Black had been their Secret-Keeper.
  53. c. 1982
    Lupin joins a Fianna pack in mid-Wales
    After the Potters' deaths Remus Lupin left the wizarding world for years and found a pack of mostly Fianna Garou in the hills of mid-Wales, which put back the things that had crawled out of a quarry's slag heaps above a poisoned valley. The pack never let him forget that he was bitten, not born, and a wizard.
  54. 1982
    She-Hulk joins the Avengers
    She-Hulk joined the Avengers.
  55. 1982
    Death of Mar-Vell
    Mar-Vell, the Kree warrior who had become Earth's Captain Marvel, died of cancer. Death came for him in person, and Thanos, himself dead since 1977, came with her as her servant to lead the man who had beaten him into her keeping.
  56. 1982
    Galactus is driven to the brink of starvation
    Galactus came back to Earth, and the Avengers and the Fantastic Four together drove him to the brink of starvation. Reed Richards saved his life, a mercy for which the Shi'ar Empire later put him on trial.
  57. c. 1982
    Sebastian Shaw builds Sentinels
    In the early 1980s the industrialist Sebastian Shaw built Sentinels for a government programme concerned with mutants.
  58. c. 1982
    Pettigrew hides as the Weasleys' rat
    Peter Pettigrew, in his Animagus form as the rat Scabbers, came to live with the Weasley family, first as Percy's pet, and hid among them for about twelve years.
  59. c. 1982
    Percy resolves to become Minister for Magic
    From about the age of six Percy Weasley planned to become Minister for Magic, an ambition he later wrote down in detail and kept in his trunk.
  60. 1982
    Attilan moves to the Moon
    Dying of Earth's polluted air, the Inhumans flew Attilan to the Blue Area of the Moon with Reed Richards's help. Crystal's daughter Luna was born there.
  61. 1982
    Deathbird's first coup
    Deathbird, Lilandra's sister, tried to seize the Shi'ar throne with the help of Samedar and the Brood. The X-Men beat her.
  62. 1982
    The Juggernaut sealed in concrete
    Spider-Man stopped the Juggernaut, who had come to New York for Madame Web, by leading him into the wet concrete of a building's foundations.
  63. Spring 1982
    Spider-Man and the Flash
    Captain Cold and Speed Demon tried to rob the diamond dealers of West 47th Street. Spider-Man and the Flash, who was in New York for a meeting of police scientists, caught them both.
  64. Spring 1982
    Jaspers' power breaks the crooked world
    When the fluid Saturnyne had brought to quicken the crooked world took hold, Mad Jim Jaspers let loose his power to bend reality, and that Britain began to come apart. Its government sent out the Fury.
  65. Summer 1982
    The Fury kills Captain Britain
    On the crooked world the Fury killed Jackdaw of the Fair Folk, then destroyed Captain Britain altogether. Merlin made him a new body in Otherworld with Roma's help, then called back his spirit, which had not yet gone on.
  66. Autumn 1982
    Magneto learns that the twins are his
    Told by Bova of Wundagore about Magda, Magneto came to Quicksilver and the Scarlet Witch to tell them that he was their father. The Whizzer, who had long believed them his own, had died defending them that year.
  67. 1983
    Monica Rambeau joins the Avengers
    Captain Marvel, the New Orleans harbour patrol officer Monica Rambeau, joined the Avengers.
  68. 1983
    James Rhodes becomes Iron Man
    Tony Stark relapsed into drink, lost his company to the corporate raider Obadiah Stane and gave up the armour. His friend James Rhodes wore it in his place for two years, and most of the world never knew that a different man was inside.
  69. 1983
    Barry Allen kills Professor Zoom
    Barry Allen killed Professor Zoom to stop him murdering again, and stood trial for it.
  70. 1983
    Infinity Inc. is formed
    The children and heirs of the Justice Society formed a team of their own, Infinity Inc., among them Alan Scott's son and daughter, Obsidian and Jade, and the Halls' son Hector, the Silver Scarab.
  71. 1983
    Galactus eats the Skrull Throneworld
    Galactus devoured Tarnax IV, the Skrull Throneworld, with billions of Skrulls on it. The empress R'Klll and her heir Anelle died, and the Skrull Empire broke apart.
  72. 1983
    The trial of Reed Richards
    Lilandra's court tried Reed Richards for saving the life of Galactus, and acquitted him.
  73. 1983
    The Hobgoblin appears
    A new goblin, the Hobgoblin, appeared in New York with weapons from one of Norman Osborn's hidden stores.
  74. c. 1983
    Fred turns Ron's teddy into a spiderB2 Ch10
    When Ron Weasley was three, Fred Weasley turned his teddy bear into a spider for breaking Fred's toy broomstick, and Ron was terrified of spiders ever after.
  75. January 1983
    Captain Britain comes home
    Brian Braddock woke at Darkmoor believing he had been saved at the last moment, for Merlin had not told him that he had died. At Maldon he found Braddock Manor rebuilt by Mastermind, which tried to talk him into joining his parents in death.
  76. March 1983
    Slaymaster hunts the Psi Division
    The Vixen, whose people were inside S.T.R.I.K.E., hired Slaymaster to kill its Psi Division. Betsy Braddock rang her brother for help, and Captain Britain beat Slaymaster in Denmark Street. Betsy, Tom Lennox and Alison Double went to live at Braddock Manor.
  77. Summer 1983
    Saturnyne is tried for the crooked world
    The Special Executive carried Captain Britain off to speak at Saturnyne's trial before the Dimensional Development Court. Her rival Mandragon destroyed the crooked world before the trial had finished.
  78. Summer 1983
    A narcotics officer's death reaches Delta Green
    The narcotics officer of Silent Hill who died of a failed heart had been passing what he learnt of the drug PTV to Hollis Tibbetts of the Drug Enforcement Administration, a Delta Green man. Tibbetts did not think the death a coincidence.
  79. 12 September 1983
    Harry Mason loses Cheryl at Silent Hill
    That night Harry Mason, driving his seven-year-old daughter, Cheryl, to Silent Hill for a holiday, crashed the car on the road into the town. He woke in fog to find her gone. Cybil Bennett, a police officer from Brahms, had ridden in the same night to learn why the town had fallen silent.
  80. 12 September 1983
    The Foundation logs Silent Hill going silent
    That night the SCP Foundation's post on the Brahms road logged every line out of Silent Hill going dead at once, with a car and a police motorcycle going in. Its orders were to observe. By the time new orders came the town was quiet again.
  81. 13 September 1983
    The Order's god is born and killed
    After a day's search of Silent Hill by Harry Mason, Dahlia Gillespie joined the two halves of her daughter's soul that night, and the god of the Order of Silent Hill was born. Dr Michael Kaufmann drove it into the open with aglaophotis. It killed Dahlia, and Harry Mason killed it.
  82. 13 September 1983
    Harry Mason leaves Silent Hill with a newborn
    The dying Alessa Gillespie gave Harry Mason a newborn baby, who was herself and Cheryl begun again. He left Silent Hill with the child in his arms, beside Cybil Bennett. Kaufmann was dragged down by the dead nurse Lisa Garland.
  83. September 1983
    Storm turns Godzilla from the coast of Japan
    Godzilla came up off the coast of Japan while the X-Men were in the country. Storm raised a thunderstorm out at sea, then walked it away from the land, so that he turned from the lightning. Wolverine, Colossus and Nightcrawler cleared the harbour behind her.
  84. 7 October 1983
    Bond recovers the cruise missiles
    Older and long thought past it, James Bond was called back to recover two cruise missiles stolen by SPECTRE; afterwards he was recaptured and held in isolation at Wolfburg Penitentiary without trial.
  85. October 1983
    The Foundation sends D-class into the fog
    A team of the SCP Foundation's Mobile Task Force Zeta-9 went into Silent Hill by day with three D-class on lines. Four of the eight did not come back, and a fifth came back raving. All five had killed. The town was classed Keter.
  86. Autumn 1983
    The Fury follows Captain UK to Braddock Manor
    Linda McQuillan, Captain UK, the last hero of the crooked world, came to Braddock Manor, where the Fury followed her. Two of the Special Executive died before Captain Britain buried it in the caverns under the house.
  87. October 1983
    Delta Green burns the White Claudia
    Hollis Tibbetts of Delta Green, who had reached Silent Hill a few days too late to see anything, burnt the beds of White Claudia from which the drug PTV was made. They grew back the next summer.
  88. November 1983
    Mobile Task Force Upsilon-6 is formed
    The SCP Foundation formed a task force for Silent Hill alone under Dr Agnes Pelletier, from staff who had never harmed anybody. Its people were called the Day Trippers, from their rule of leaving the town before dark.
  89. 1984
    Venom Snake is made Big Boss's double
    Waking from his coma, Big Boss had the medic who had shielded him given his face and memories and sent out as his decoy without being asked; as Venom Snake the medic built Diamond Dogs in the Seychelles, and Minerva McGonagall broke with Big Boss over it.
  90. 1984
    Doom steals the Beyonder's power
    On Battleworld Victor von Doom built a machine to drain Galactus's power and with it stole the power of the Beyonder himself, becoming for a time a god, until the Beyonder took it back.
  91. 1984
    Zsaji dies reviving the heroes
    On Battleworld the alien healer Zsaji, whom Colossus of the X-Men loved, gave her life to revive the fallen heroes.
  92. 1984
    Spider-Man brings home a black costume
    Spider-Man came home from Battleworld in a new black costume that turned out to be a living alien creature, and rid himself of it.
  93. 1984
    She-Hulk takes the Thing's place
    When the others came home, Ben Grimm, who had found on Battleworld that he could change back into a man at will, stayed behind to explore, and She-Hulk took his place in the Fantastic Four.
  94. 1984
    The Mutant Registration Act becomes law
    Senator Robert Kelly introduced the Mutant Registration Act, requiring mutants to register their identities and powers with the federal government, and it passed into law the same year.
  95. 1984
    The Justice League moves to Detroit
    After an alien attack left the satellite unusable, Aquaman, then chairman, angry that so few had answered the alarm, dissolved the League and re-formed it in a Detroit bunker with the Martian Manhunter, Zatanna, the Elongated Man and four newcomers, Vixen, Gypsy, Vibe and Steel.
  96. 1984
    The West Coast Avengers are founded
    Under the Vision's chairmanship a second Avengers branch opened at Palos Verdes, California, chaired by Hawkeye, with Mockingbird, Wonder Man, Tigra and Iron Man, then James Rhodes.
  97. 1984
    Black Bolt marries Medusa
    A Kree soldier and a Skrull, still fighting each other, broke in on the wedding.
  98. c. 1984
    Professor Hart is saved inside his machines
    In Crossworld City, California, Grimlord left the scientist Professor Horatio Hart dying. His colleague Tyler Steele saved him by sending his mind across into virtual reality, from where he spoke afterwards through the screens of his laboratory.
  99. c. 1984
    Tyler Steele vanishes from Crossworld City
    Grimlord carried the scientist Tyler Steele off into virtual reality, wiped his memory and remade him as the cyborg Dark Heart. His son, Ryan, was about eight. Nobody in Crossworld City knew what had become of him.
  100. Winter 1984
    Jaspers' warp bends Britain
    The power of Sir James Jaspers woke, and his warp spread across Britain. People with powers were rounded up into camps. Tom Lennox of the Psi Division was killed, while Betsy Braddock was taken to a camp.
  101. c. 1984
    The Secret Wars
    Early in 1984 a vast structure appeared in the Sheep Meadow in Central Park, and the Beyonder carried off those who went to it to Battleworld, a planet he built from pieces of others. He took heroes from all over the world: the Avengers, heroes of the Justice League, the X-Men, the Fantastic Four, Spider-Man and Bra'tac of Chulak, a Jaffa master more than a century old. He set them against Doom, Ultron, Kang and other villains, and Captain America led the heroes' side.
  102. 26 February 1984
    The phantom wakes in Cyprus
    The medic of 1975 woke from his nine-year coma in a British military hospital in Cyprus, believing himself to be Big Boss. Big Boss, who had woken before him, had had him given his own face with his memories. He himself lay in the next bed, bandaged, under the name Ishmael.
  103. March 1984
    XOF attacks the hospital
    About a fortnight later Skull Face's soldiers stormed the hospital to kill Big Boss. With them came the Man on Fire, who was Colonel Volgin, risen after twenty years, in the company of a psychic boy called the Third Child. Ishmael got the phantom out, then went his own way. Ocelot took the phantom on to the Seychelles.
  104. 1984
    Venom Snake rescues Miller
    In Afghanistan Venom Snake rescued Kazuhira Miller from Soviet troops. Miller, who had lost an arm with a leg, had founded a new army, Diamond Dogs, on a platform off the Seychelles. He gave the command to the man he took for Big Boss, who built it up.
  105. 1984
    Quiet joins Diamond Dogs
    The sniper Quiet, sent to kill Big Boss in Cyprus, had been burnt almost to death there. Skull Face's parasites kept her alive, so that she breathed through her skin. Venom Snake beat her in Afghanistan, then took her into Diamond Dogs, where she never spoke.
  106. May 1984
    The Fury kills Mad Jim Jaspers
    The Fury carried Sir James Jaspers out of the world, then killed him there. Merlin fell holding the world together while they fought. Captain UK tore the Fury apart before it could kill Captain Britain.
  107. 1984
    Venom Snake fights Skull Face
    Venom Snake led Diamond Dogs against Skull Face's unit XOF in Afghanistan, then in Central Africa. There Skull Face was spreading a parasite of the vocal cords that killed by language, among Soviet soldiers as among conscripted workers. The parasites were the stolen work of an old Navajo scientist, Code Talker, whom Venom Snake set free.
  108. June 1984
    Merlin is mourned in Otherworld
    Roma brought Captain Britain, Captain UK and Saturnyne to Otherworld to mourn Merlin. There Captain Britain met the Captain Britain Corps for the first time. Britain mended, as Roma had promised, and most people forgot the warp.
  109. Summer 1984
    The Foundation takes White Claudia seed
    Mobile Task Force Upsilon-6 found the beds of White Claudia at Silent Hill burnt by persons unknown and growing again. It took seed into containment, where it has never sprouted. The seed was classed Safe.
  110. July 1984
    Captain Britain meets Meggan
    In a London warehouse Captain Britain met Meggan, a frightened young woman who could change her shape, and took her home to Braddock Manor.
  111. Summer 1984
    The Hulk kills Mikey and DannyB4 Ch3
    On a summer Saturday in Central Park a car thrown by the Hulk killed Mikey and Danny.
  112. 1984
    Death of Skull Face
    Skull Face meant to kill everyone who spoke English with his parasite. Then he would hold the world to ransom with a giant walking weapon, Sahelanthropus, which a psychic boy moved for him. The boy turned on him. Skull Face was crushed under the machine, shot by Venom Snake with Miller, then finished by the engineer Huey Emmerich.
  113. 1984
    The outbreak on Mother Base
    The parasite broke out among the soldiers of Diamond Dogs on their own base. Venom Snake had to shoot his infected men to stop it spreading. He had their ashes made into diamonds.
  114. 1984
    Huey Emmerich is cast adrift
    Diamond Dogs found Huey Emmerich guilty of causing the outbreak, of betraying the old Mother Base in 1975 and of killing his wife, Strangelove, whom he had shut in a machine to suffocate. Venom Snake put him to sea in a lifeboat.
  115. 1984
    Eli at Mother Base
    The boy Eli, who was Liquid Snake, had run away from England to lead child soldiers in Central Africa. Venom Snake brought him to the Diamond Dogs' Mother Base. There he led the other boys in rebellion. With the help of the psychic boy called the Third Child he stole Sahelanthropus, then escaped.
  116. c. 1984
    Mary Jane's secret
    Mary Jane Watson told Peter Parker that she had known for years that he was Spider-Man.
  117. 1984
    Quiet leaves
    Quiet carried the English strain of the parasite, which was meant to infect Diamond Dogs when she spoke. She had kept silent to prevent it. To save Venom Snake's life in Afghanistan she spoke at last, then walked off into the desert alone.
  118. 1984
    Miller breaks with Big Boss
    The truth reached Venom Snake in a recording from Big Boss himself: he was the phantom, while the real man was building Outer Heaven elsewhere. He accepted it. Kazuhira Miller did not. He swore to help Big Boss's son David bring his father down.
  119. 1985
    Constantine comes to public notice
    John Constantine first came to public notice.
  120. 1985
    Constantine imprisons the demon that fed on light
    With the Deluminator Constantine defeated the demon that fed on light and shut it away where it would not trouble anyone for a thousand years, then returned the Deluminator the next week, scorched on one side.
  121. 1985
    Dumbledore shouts down Constantine in the Hog's Head
    When Constantine tried to apologise in the back room of the Hog's Head, with a goat looking in at the window, Dumbledore let him get about three words out and then shouted him down, the only time Constantine has seen him angry, and put the debt away for a rainy day.
  122. 1985
    The Crisis: red skies over the world
    Through 1985 the skies over the whole world turned red, sometimes for days at a time. Strange storms and darkness came and went, whole regions seemed overlaid by places that did not belong there, and heroes and villains were drawn into a struggle that few could afterwards describe and that those who stood side by side remember differently.
  123. 1985
    Death of Supergirl
    Supergirl, Kara Zor-El, died in the Crisis fighting the being held responsible for it. Afterwards her name became curiously hard for people to place, as though she had been known for twenty-five years and yet not quite remembered.
  124. 1985
    Wally West becomes the Flash
    After Barry Allen's death in the Crisis, Wally West, then about thirty-six, put on his uncle's costume and became the third Flash.
  125. 1985
    Aquaman leaves the Justice League
    Aquaman left the Detroit League he had founded.
  126. 1985
    Tony Stark takes back the armour
    Tony Stark recovered and took the Iron Man armour back from James Rhodes.
  127. 1985
    Namor joins the Avengers
    The Sub-Mariner joined the Avengers.
  128. c. 1985
    Xavier leaves Earth with Lilandra
    In the mid-1980s Charles Xavier left Earth for several years with Lilandra, ruler of the Shi'ar Empire, to recover from injuries, leaving his school in Magneto's charge.
  129. 1985
    Magneto stands trial in Paris
    Magneto surrendered to stand trial before an international court in Paris, and ran Xavier's school while Xavier was away from Earth.
  130. 1985
    Freedom Force is formed
    Mystique offered the government her Brotherhood's services in exchange for pardons, and under the official Valerie Cooper they became Freedom Force, the federal team that arrested unregistered mutants.
  131. 1985
    The Beyonder comes to Earth
    The Beyonder came to Earth in the shape of a dark-haired young man to learn what it was to want things. He turned an office building into gold, gave the blind lawyer Matt Murdock his sight and took it back, and when Stephen Strange's guidance failed he resolved in despair to destroy all creation.
  132. c. 1985
    Nimrod appears
    The most advanced of the Sentinels, Nimrod, appeared in the mid-1980s.
  133. 1985
    The Skrulls lose their shape-changing
    A bomb set off by the Skrull Zabyk took away the Skrulls' power to change shape.
  134. 1985
    New Salem burns Agatha Harkness
    Salem's Seven took New Salem for themselves and burnt Agatha Harkness at the stake. Her spirit guided the Scarlet Witch, their prisoner, to draw the town's power into herself, so that she came home with child.
  135. 1985
    Constantine steals the DeluminatorB3 Interlude
    To fight an ancient demon that fed on light, John Constantine stole Albus Dumbledore's Deluminator at a Ministry dinner; he returned it a week later and was shouted down by Dumbledore in the Hog's Head.
  136. c. 1985
    Dudley's fifth birthdayB3 Ch2
    Marge hit Harry's shins with her stick to stop him winning at musical statues.
  137. c. 1985
    Anna's journal resurfaces in AmericaB3 Ch21
    Anna's journal of the D'ni turned up in America in the hands of a wizard collector, its passages cut out or blotted, and three or four wizarding books on the D'ni followed with a terrific fuss in the obscure journals. It never mentions Atrus.
  138. 1985
    Death of the first FlashB4 Ch3
    The Flash of Dudley's annuals died in a battle nobody ever properly explained.
  139. June 1985
    Dudley's fifth birthday party
    At Dudley Dursley's fifth birthday party Aunt Marge whacked Harry Potter's shins with her walking stick.
  140. June 1985
    Betsy Braddock kills Kaptain Briton
    Kaptain Briton, Captain Britain's double from another world, came to Braddock Manor in Brian's clothes and attacked Betsy Braddock. She killed him with her mind.
  141. August 1985
    RCX brings the Warpies to Braddock Manor
    RCX, the government body that replaced S.T.R.I.K.E. after the warp, brought the Warpies, children whom the warp had changed, to live at Braddock Manor. Betsy agreed to it, so Brian walked out.
  142. October 1985
    Captain Britain leaves Jamie to his gaolers
    In Africa Brian Braddock found that his brother Jamie, a prisoner of Doctor Crocodile, had been dealing in slaves, theft and murder. He left him to be punished.
  143. November 1985
    Betsy Braddock becomes Captain Britain
    Trained by Captain UK, Betsy Braddock took her brother's place as Captain Britain while he travelled abroad with Meggan.
  144. c. 1985
    Death of Jean DeWolff
    The Sin-Eater, a police sergeant, murdered Captain Jean DeWolff of the New York police. When Spider-Man caught him, Daredevil had to pull him off.
  145. December 1985
    Slaymaster blinds Betsy Braddock
    The Vixen lured Betsy Braddock into a trap, where Slaymaster tore out her eyes. Captain Britain killed him and took back his name.
  146. 24 December 1985
    Dai Thomas asks Captain Britain for help
    Dai Thomas of Scotland Yard came to the lighthouse where Brian Braddock lived with Meggan to ask for help with a string of murders. The killer was a Warpie child. The two men began, grudgingly, to be friends.
  147. c. 1986
    The red skies fade
    At the turn of 1986 the red skies faded and the world was still there, but nobody could say exactly what had happened. Some who took part spoke of a being called the Monitor, his enemy the Anti-Monitor and many worlds running into one, which most people dismiss, and accounts disagree even about what became of Wonder Woman at the end.
  148. 1986
    The Justice Society leaves the world
    Most of the Justice Society passed into a realm outside time to fight the endless battle of Ragnarok, the twilight of the gods of the north, so that it would not break out upon the Earth. Doctor Fate, the Spectre, Power Girl and the Star-Spangled Kid stayed behind.
  149. 1986
    Glorious Godfrey turns America against its heroes
    Darkseid, the Lord of Apokolips, set out to break Earth's heroes through his agent Glorious Godfrey. As the broadcaster G. Gordon Godfrey, Glorious Godfrey had a voice that could bend crowds, and he told America night after night that its heroes were dangerous. Meanwhile Darkseid's creatures staged disasters to prove him right.
  150. 1986
    The Molecule Man kills the Beyonder
    The assembled heroes fought the Beyonder, and as he tried to be reborn as an ordinary human child the Molecule Man killed him. His energy is said to have flowed back into his own realm and become a new universe.
  151. 1986
    The Masters of Evil seize Avengers Mansion
    Baron Helmut Zemo, the son of Heinrich, led a new Masters of Evil in a siege of Avengers Mansion; they wrecked it, beat Jarvis nearly to death and left Hercules in a coma.
  152. 1986
    Jean Grey is found alive
    The real Jean Grey was found alive, cocooned at the bottom of Jamaica Bay.
  153. c. 1986
    Dracina's friendship with the gardener's girl
    When Dracina Malfoy was six she befriended the gardener's little girl at Malfoy Manor, and the girl was gone by the end of the week because Lucius Malfoy chose all his daughter's friends.
  154. c. 1986
    Crabbe begins reporting to Lucius Malfoy
    From the age of six Vincent Crabbe, chosen with Gregory Goyle as Dracina Malfoy's companion because their Death Eater fathers were useful, reported everything she did to Lucius Malfoy.
  155. 1986
    Slytherin's six House Cups begin
    Slytherin won the House Cup in 1986 and held it six years running until 1991, while Gryffindor fell on lean years.
  156. 1986
    Apocalypse comes to notice
    Apocalypse fought X-Factor for the first time, through the Alliance of Evil.
  157. c. 1986
    Birth of Meryl Silverburgh
    Meryl Silverburgh was born. She grew up believing herself the daughter of Matt Campbell, though her real father was his brother, Roy Campbell.
  158. c. 1986
    Slytherin's run of House Cups beginsB1 Ch3
    Slytherin began a run of six consecutive House Cup wins that was unbroken by September 1991.
  159. c. 1986
    Harry's childhood fluB2 Ch4
    When Harry Potter was six and had flu, Petunia Dursley did no more than lay a cold flannel on his head and tell him not to be sick on the sheets; the same year she made him weed the flower beds in the heat.
  160. 1986
    Harry weeds the flower bedsB3 Ch21
    The summer he was six, Harry weeded Aunt Petunia's flower beds in the heat while she watched from the window.
  161. 1986
    Reagan grounds the costumed heroesB4 Ch3
    President Reagan grounded every costumed hero in America for an entire winter.
  162. Summer 1986
    Spider-Man and Green Lantern at the Statue of Liberty
    Sinestro hired the Shocker to bring down the Statue of Liberty before its centenary celebrations. Spider-Man fought the Shocker, whose yellow suit Green Lantern's ring could not touch, while Hal Jordan drove Sinestro off.
  163. Summer 1986
    The Scarlet Witch's sons are born
    The Scarlet Witch gave birth to twin sons, Thomas and William, the children of her marriage to the Vision. Doctor Strange saw them safely into the world.
  164. Summer 1986
    The New Mutants free Psylocke
    The New Mutants freed Betsy Braddock from Mojo, who had carried her off from the Alps, given her new eyes and named her Psylocke. She went back with them to Professor Xavier's school in Westchester.
  165. 31 July 1986
    Harry's sixth birthdayB3 Ch13
    On his sixth birthday Harry was given a pair of Vernon Dursley's old socks wrapped in newspaper while the Dursleys watched his face fall.
  166. October 1986
    Psylocke joins the X-Men
    After the massacre of the Morlocks, Betsy Braddock drew Sabretooth away from the wounded at Professor Xavier's school, then took the name of his master from his mind. She joined the X-Men as Psylocke.
  167. Winter 1986
    The Suicide Squad is formed
    In the winter of 1986 and 1987, while costumed heroes were grounded, the government set up a task force of convicted criminals under Amanda Waller to do the work they had been forbidden, which became known as the Suicide Squad.
  168. 1987
    John Loftin finds the D'ni tunnels
    The artefact hunter John Loftin, called Fighting Branch, found tunnels and great digging machines beneath the New Mexico desert that nobody on the surface had made.
  169. 1987
    Cyan is founded
    The brothers Rand and Robyn Miller founded Cyan near Spokane in Washington State, the small company that would later make Myst.
  170. c. 1987
    Ivo's androids kill Vibe and Steel
    At the turn of 1987 Professor Ivo's androids killed Vibe and Steel, and the Detroit Justice League came to an end.
  171. c. 1987
    A new Justice League is formed
    At the start of 1987 a new League came out of the struggle against Darkseid: Batman, the Martian Manhunter, Black Canary, Blue Beetle, Mister Miracle, Guy Gardner, Doctor Fate, Captain Marvel and Doctor Light, with the businessman Maxwell Lord behind it, soon joined by Booster Gold and Captain Atom.
  172. 1987
    The march on Washington
    Early in 1987 Godfrey's campaign reached its climax in a great march on Washington, where the heroes faced him down and broke his hold over the crowd, and President Reagan's grounding order was lifted.
  173. 1987
    Kent Nelson is struck down
    Kent Nelson's long service as Doctor Fate ended soon after he joined the new League. The helmet passed to Eric Strauss and his stepmother Linda, who became Doctor Fate together until both died.
  174. 1987
    The Avengers move to Hydrobase
    While Avengers Mansion was rebuilt, the team moved to Hydrobase, an artificial island off the New York coast, and Captain Marvel, Monica Rambeau, succeeded the Wasp as chairwoman.
  175. 1987
    Steve Rogers gives up Captain America
    Rogers gave up the name and costume of Captain America rather than serve as the agent of the government's Commission on Superhuman Activities, which gave them to John Walker.
  176. 1987
    Peter Parker marries Mary Jane Watson
    Peter Parker, Spider-Man, married Mary Jane Watson.
  177. 1987
    The Fantastic Four move to Four Freedoms Plaza
    The Fantastic Four moved from the Baxter Building into a new headquarters, Four Freedoms Plaza.
  178. 1987
    Tony Stark's war on stolen armour
    In 1987 and 1988 Tony Stark waged a private war against everyone who had stolen and used his armour designs.
  179. c. 1987
    Fred gives Ron an Acid Pop
    When Ron Weasley was seven, Fred Weasley gave him an Acid Pop, calling it a Sugar Quill, and it burnt through his tongue.
  180. 1987
    Gryffindor win the Quidditch Cup with Charlie Weasley
    Gryffindor won the Quidditch Cup with Charlie Weasley as Seeker; he later captained the team and was still spoken of in the common room like a minor saint.
  181. 1987
    Warren Worthington becomes Death
    Apocalypse gave Warren Worthington, whose wings had been cut off, new wings of metal and made him Death, one of his Horsemen.
  182. c. 1987
    Jason Lee Scott goes to Sensei Kazu's dojo
    Jason Lee Scott of Angel Grove was a bully at about ten. After trouble at a summer camp his mother left him at the karate dojo of Sensei Kazu, who taught him to master his temper. Jason vowed to change.
  183. 1987
    Gryffindor's last Quidditch CupB3 Ch15
    Gryffindor last won the Quidditch Cup about seven years before 1994, when Charlie Weasley was Seeker.
  184. 1987
    Justice League charterB4 Ch3
    The Justice League began working under a United Nations charter.
  185. September 1987
    Percy Weasley and Oliver Wood start at Hogwarts
    Percy Weasley and Oliver Wood entered Hogwarts and were sorted into Gryffindor, and Marcus Flint, later Slytherin's Quidditch captain, started in the same year; all three left in 1994.
  186. Autumn 1987
    Kraven's last hunt
    Kraven the Hunter shot Spider-Man with a drugged dart and buried him, then went out in a copy of his costume for two weeks. When Spider-Man dug his way out, Kraven shot himself.
  187. Autumn 1987
    The risen ruins
    An undersea earthquake lifted drowned ruins out of the Atlantic, west of the Azores, for nine days. Both kings fought over them while the Justice League International and the Avengers tried to keep the peace, until the ruins sank again.
  188. Autumn 1987
    Captain Britain fights Horde beside the X-Men
    Captain Britain and Meggan fought beside the X-Men, Psylocke among them, against the alien Horde, who meant to make himself master of all things.
  189. Autumn 1987
    The X-Men fall at Dallas
    In Dallas the X-Men gave their lives before the television cameras of the world to bind the demon called the Adversary. Roma of Otherworld drew their souls back before they had passed beyond the world and hid them from every camera. The world believed them dead, Kitty Pryde among it, watching on Muir Island.
  190. 1 December 1987
    The Excalibur team is founded
    In London Kurt Wagner and Captain Britain freed their three friends from the Technet, who had come for Rachel Summers on Saturnyne's orders. By a campfire in the Scottish Highlands the five of them founded a new team in the X-Men's memory, named for King Arthur's sword.
  191. December 1987
    Harry Potter sees the window at St Michael's
    At Christmas when he was seven, Harry Potter was taken to St Michael's Church in Little Whinging, because Aunt Petunia would not be outdone by the Polkisses, and stared through the carols at the stained-glass window of Christ over the altar.
  192. December 1987
    Harry sees the face in the church window
    One Christmas when Harry Potter was seven, Petunia Dursley took the family to church because the Polkisses had started going; it was the only time Harry went inside a church as a child, and he saw a face in a window that he would see again.
  193. December 1987
    Harry taken to church at ChristmasB2 Ch19
    Aunt Petunia took seven-year-old Harry to church because the Polkisses went; he saw windows of Saint George and of a bearded man and an old woman crossing herself.
  194. December 1987
    Harry's first visit to St Michael'sB3 Ch22
    At seven, one Christmas, Harry sat in St Michael's beside Dudley and stared at the window of Christ throughout the service.
  195. 1988
    Zandi buys the land round the Cleft
    Elias Zandi began buying up the land round the tunnels and the Cleft, and after another expedition brought in Dr Richard Watson; the small group began to dig, quietly and on Zandi's money.
  196. 1988
    Venom is born
    The living black costume Spider-Man had brought home from Battleworld bonded with a man who hated him and became Venom.
  197. 1988
    Dream escapes his prison
    After seventy-two years Dream of the Endless escaped the glass prison in which Roderick Burgess had caught him.
  198. 1988
    Death walks Dream through her day
    Death found her brother Dream sulking in a park after his escape and walked him through a day of her work until he understood what he still had.
  199. 1988
    The Beyonder becomes Kosmos
    It was learnt that the Beyonder had been a living Cosmic Cube joined to part of the Molecule Man's power, and in that form he grew into a new cosmic being called Kosmos.
  200. 1988
    The Deltites take over S.H.I.E.L.D.
    Nick Fury found that S.H.I.E.L.D. and Hydra had both been taken over from within by the Deltites, the agency's own Life Model Decoys grown aware. Framed and hunted by his own people, he went underground, exposed and destroyed them, and disbanded S.H.I.E.L.D.
  201. 1988
    The Goa'uld refuse to join the Alien Alliance
    The Dominators invited the Goa'uld System Lords to join their Alliance against Earth. The System Lords refused without giving a reason, since the Goa'uld had been forbidden to speak of Earth since Ra's fall.
  202. 1988
    Batgirl retires
    Barbara Gordon gave up being Batgirl for good. Her identity was never made public.
  203. c. 1988
    Barago marks Kaoru Mitsuki
    The fallen knight Barago marked Kaoru Mitsuki, a girl of six, as the gate through which Messiah would enter the world. He watched her for the next seventeen years.
  204. 1988
    Harry Mason shoots a man of the Order
    A member of the Order of Silent Hill found Harry Mason and his daughter in Portland. Harry shot him, and the police ruled it self-defence. Father and daughter moved to another city, where the girl went by the name Heather.
  205. 1988
    The insects from Shaggai take PISCES
    By 1988 the insects from Shaggai had spread from a few infested agents into the leadership of PISCES.
  206. c. 1988
    Ernie opens the Youth Center
    Ernie opened the Youth Center in Angel Grove, with its gym and juice bar. Zack Taylor met Jason Lee Scott there on the opening day, which began their friendship.
  207. c. 1988
    Neville shows his first magicB1 Ch3
    Aged eight, Neville Longbottom bounced down the garden and into the road unharmed when his Great-uncle Algie accidentally dropped him from an upstairs window, ending his family's fear that he had no magic.
  208. c. 1988
    Lucius moves the peacocksB3 Ch9
    When Dracina Malfoy was eight and afraid of the peacocks, her father went out on the lawn and moved them.
  209. c. 1988
    The frozen lake at Malfoy ManorB3 Ch12
    Lucius Malfoy had the lake at Malfoy Manor frozen for Dracina when she was eight, using a method from a book.
  210. 1988
    The Dominators' gene bombB4 Ch3
    As the Alien Alliance withdrew late in 1988, the Dominators set off a gene bomb that attacked the metagene, and for a time nearly every superhuman whose powers came from it lost control of them or fell gravely ill until a remedy was found. The word metahuman came into common use.
  211. 1988
    The Joker shoots Barbara Gordon
    The Joker escaped from Arkham Asylum and shot Barbara Gordon through the spine at her father's door, then tried to drive James Gordon mad. Batman, then Dick Grayson, saved Gordon and brought the Joker in by the book. The bullet left Barbara unable to walk.
  212. Winter 1988
    The Horsemen of Apocalypse attack New York
    Apocalypse's Horsemen attacked New York. X-Factor beat them and took his ship.
  213. February 1988
    Doctor Light leads Godzilla out to sea
    Japan asked the United Nations for the Justice League when Godzilla came up off its coast. Guy Gardner attacked him against orders, only to be knocked into the sea. Doctor Light, Kimiyo Hoshi, then drew Godzilla away from the land with a great light over the water.
  214. February 1988
    Gray Fox meets Gustava Heffner
    At the Winter Olympics in Calgary Frank Jaeger fell in love with the Czech figure skater Gustava Heffner. Her bid for asylum failed, costing her the right to compete, which left him bitter against his own superiors.
  215. March 1988
    The X-Men take the Reavers' outback base
    The X-Men, thought dead since Dallas, drove the cyborg Reavers out of their base in the Australian outback, then made it their home. Psylocke took to wearing armour there.
  216. 19 March 1988
    Loftin takes Elias Zandi down to D'ni
    John Loftin led the archaeologist Elias Zandi down into the tunnels, which led to the cavern of D'ni.
  217. Summer 1988
    Spider-Man and the Justice League
    The Beetle and the Royal Flush Gang tried to steal Blue Beetle's flying Bug from the League's New York embassy. Spider-Man helped the League to stop them, then turned down Maxwell Lord's offer of a place in it.
  218. Summer 1988
    The Warwolves are caged at London Zoo
    After Mojo's Warwolves had taken the skins of several Londoners, the Excalibur team caught them in the Underground and freed Kitty Pryde from them. The creatures were put on show at London Zoo.
  219. Summer 1988
    Widget opens its eyes at Loch Daemon
    At Loch Daemon in Scotland, Tweedledope of the Crazy Gang threw together a gadget out of rubbish and a transistor radio, then threw it away. It woke as Widget, a little robot that opens gates between worlds. It sent a boy named Colin McKay through one of them.
  220. Autumn 1988
    Jonathan Caesar kidnaps Mary Jane
    Mary Jane Watson-Parker's landlord, Jonathan Caesar, held her prisoner in a hidden room in Bedford Towers until she knocked him out.
  221. Autumn 1988
    The Excalibur team moves into the lighthouse
    After rounding up the convicts who broke out of Crossmoor prison with the Juggernaut, the Excalibur team moved into Brian Braddock and Meggan's lighthouse on the west coast of England, where a great many worlds meet.
  222. Autumn 1988
    Arcade's Murderworld at Strangeways
    With the Crazy Gang, Arcade took Courtney Ross as bait and trapped the Excalibur team in a Murderworld at Strangeways in Manchester. Kitty Pryde and Lockheed beat them.
  223. Autumn 1988
    Sat-yr-9 kills Courtney Ross
    Days after her escape from Murderworld, Courtney Ross was killed in her flat by Opul Lun Sat-yr-9, a tyrant from another Britain who wears Saturnyne's face. Sat-yr-9 took her place, and nobody noticed for years.
  224. 1989
    Thor merges with Eric Masterson
    Eric Masterson, a divorced New York architect who had first crossed Thor's path in 1988, was mortally injured in one of Thor's battles, and Thor merged with him to save his life, so that he could change into Thor and back.
  225. 1989
    S.H.I.E.L.D. is rebuilt
    Nick Fury rebuilt S.H.I.E.L.D. as a smaller agency, small enough for its Director to keep watch over.
  226. 1989
    Doom frees his mother's soul
    Victor von Doom's mother Cynthia, a Romani witch of Latveria, had given her soul to Mephisto for power and died when Victor was a child. In 1989 Doom and Stephen Strange went together into the demon's realm, and Doom at last set her free.
  227. 1989
    Mephisto unmakes the Vision's twins
    The twin sons of the Vision and the Scarlet Witch had been made in part from shards of Mephisto's own essence; he took the shards back, and the children were unmade. Agatha Harkness took away the Scarlet Witch's memory of them, to save her reason.
  228. 1989
    Steve Rogers takes back the shield
    Rogers became Captain America again, and John Walker became the U.S. Agent.
  229. 1989
    Hydrobase sinks
    At the end of 1989 Hydrobase sank, and the Avengers returned to their rebuilt mansion on Fifth Avenue.
  230. 1989
    Justice League Europe opens in Paris
    A European branch of the Justice League opened in Paris, with Captain Atom, Power Girl, the Elongated Man, Animal Man, Metamorpho, Rocket Red and the Flash, Wally West, by then about forty.
  231. 1989
    Death raises Thanos
    At the end of 1989 Death raised Thanos from the dead to restore the balance between the living and the dead.
  232. c. 1989
    Dracina sees through Crabbe and Goyle
    By the age of nine Dracina Malfoy had worked out that Vincent Crabbe and Gregory Goyle reported everything she did to her father, and she began feeding them insults to report.
  233. c. 1989
    Bill Weasley joins Gringotts in Egypt
    Bill Weasley, a former Gryffindor prefect and Head Boy with twelve O.W.L.s, left Hogwarts and went to work for Gringotts as a curse-breaker on the pharaohs' tombs in Egypt.
  234. 1989
    Superman is given the Eradicator
    Far from Earth, Superman was given the Eradicator, an ancient Kryptonian device, by an old wanderer called the Cleric.
  235. 1989
    The second Kree-Skrull war ends
    The Skrull S'Byll restored her people's power to change shape and unmasked the impostor Nenora. The war ended in a ceasefire.
  236. 1989
    Oracle
    From her wheelchair Barbara Gordon began to supply the heroes with information under the name Oracle. For a long while even they did not know who she was.
  237. c. 1989
    The twins take the Marauder's MapB3 Ch10
    In their first year Fred and George Weasley stole the Marauder's Map from a drawer in Filch's office marked 'Confiscated and Highly Dangerous'.
  238. 1989
    Tony Stark walks again
