    Tony Stark was shot through the spine. An implant built by his own engineers let him walk again.
  239. Winter 1989
    The Excalibur team in demon-haunted Manhattan
    Rachel Summers flew to New York, dreaming that her baby brother Nathan was in danger, and found Manhattan overrun by demons out of Limbo. The demons made Meggan their Goblin Princess until Kitty Pryde called up Illyana Rasputin's Soulsword and set her free.
  240. Winter 1989
    The Vision is taken apart
    Agents of several governments seized the Vision of the Avengers and took him apart. He was rebuilt without his feelings.
  241. Spring 1989
    Mojo's X-Babies run to London
    Small copies of the X-Men called the X-Babies fled Mojo's world for London, with his enforcer after them. Kitty Pryde took them in, and the Excalibur team saw off their pursuer at St Paul's Cathedral.
  242. Spring 1989
    The Lightning Squad attacks the Tower of London
    Nazi doubles of the Excalibur team, the Lightning Squad, came from a world the Nazis had won to fetch home their own Moira MacTaggert and Callisto. They attacked the Weird Happenings Organisation's headquarters in the Tower of London, where Captain Britain sank his double in the Thames.
  243. Spring 1989
    The Excalibur team vanishes from Fenborough
    At an exchange of prisoners at the old Fenborough station a small atomic bomb came through the closing gate between the worlds. Rachel Summers held the blast, but the backlash carried the whole team away aboard the Nazis' train. So began the Cross-Time Caper.
  244. Summer 1989
    Spider-Man and Wonder Woman
    The Cheetah came to New York for Wonder Woman's golden lasso, with the Kingpin's men to help her. Spider-Man and Wonder Woman stopped them, though the Cheetah escaped.
  245. September 1989
    Fred, George and Lee Jordan start at Hogwarts
    Fred and George Weasley, Lee Jordan, Angelina Johnson and Alicia Spinnet entered Hogwarts and were sorted into Gryffindor, while Cedric Diggory of the same intake went to Hufflepuff.
  246. September 1989
    Psylocke sends the X-Men through the Siege Perilous
    Foreseeing the Reavers' return, Psylocke sent the last of the X-Men through the Siege Perilous, forcing Havok through with her mind. She followed them as the Reavers came in.
  247. October 1989
    The Hand makes Psylocke its assassin
    Psylocke came out of the Siege Perilous on an island in the South China Sea with no memory. Spiral exchanged her with Kwannon, an assassin of the Hand, mind for body, and the Hand made her its assassin Lady Mandarin.
  248. Autumn 1989
    The Technet free Jamie Braddock
    Hired by Nigel Frobisher on Sat-yr-9's behalf, the Technet freed Jamie Braddock from Doctor Crocodile in Mbangawi and brought him to Brighton. There Jamie's own power woke, and he beat them all.
  249. Autumn 1989
    Kitty Pryde falls home alone
    Passing through one of Widget's gates to Jamie Braddock's house in London, Kitty Pryde was cut off from the rest of the Excalibur team. She spent the winter in London with the woman she took for Courtney Ross.
  250. November 1989
    Lady Mandarin breaks free of the Hand
    Sent against Wolverine, Lady Mandarin drew up his memories of her with her psychic blade, which broke the Hand's hold on her. She escaped with Wolverine and Jubilee.
  251. December 1989
    Solidus Snake in Liberia
    Civil war broke out in Liberia. Solidus Snake, fighting there, killed the parents of a small boy, Jack, whom he then brought up as a child soldier. At ten the boy led the Small Boy Unit, feared as Jack the Ripper.
  252. c. 1990
    The Myst linking book is sold for fifty dollars
    A digger at the Cleft sold Atrus's Myst linking book for fifty dollars to Ephraim Shacklewell of Shacklewell House, who put it in a glass case in his trophy room and never touched it.
  253. 1990
    The Excalibur shuttle disaster
    The space shuttle Excalibur, commanded by Hank Henshaw, was struck by radiation in orbit. Henshaw's body broke down and his mind passed into machinery, his wife Terri died soon afterwards, and Henshaw, blaming Superman, left Earth in the Kryptonian birthing matrix that had once carried the infant Kal-El.
  254. 1990
    Lex Luthor stages his own death
    Dying of cancer caused by his Kryptonite ring, Lex Luthor was reported dead when his private jet crashed late in 1990. His brain had been placed in a young cloned body, and he reappeared as his own long-lost Australian son and heir, Lex Luthor II, and took over LexCorp.
  255. c. 1990
    Sersi joins the Avengers
    At the turn of 1990 Sersi, one of the immortal Eternals, joined the Avengers.
  256. 1990
    Spider-Man joins the Avengers' reserve
    Early in 1990 Spider-Man, then a man of about forty-three, became a reserve member of the Avengers.
  257. c. 1990
    Alicia Spinnet becomes reserve Chaser
    Alicia Spinnet served as a reserve Chaser for Gryffindor in the 1990 to 1991 season, the season before Harry Potter joined the team.
  258. 1990
    Fudge becomes Minister for Magic
    Cornelius Fudge succeeded Millicent Bagnold as Minister for Magic and at first relied heavily on Albus Dumbledore's advice.
  259. c. 1990
    Quirrell meets Voldemort in Albania
    Quirinus Quirrell, a Ravenclaw who had taught Muggle Studies at Hogwarts, took time away to travel and as a foolish young man met Lord Voldemort in the forests of Albania, who taught him that there is no good and evil, only power.
  260. 1990
    Darkseid and Thanos race for the Infinity Gems
    All through 1990 Darkseid and Thanos raced each other for the six Infinity Gems, then held by the Elders of the Universe. Thanos won every race.
  261. 1990
    Cable arrives from the future
    The soldier Cable, Nathan Summers grown old in a future century, came back to the present.
  262. 1990
    The salvage war
    Namor's company, Oracle Incorporated, bought salvage rights to stretches of the Atlantic seabed that Aquaman counts as his. Aquaman set the whales of the North Atlantic on its cables. The Justice League and the Avengers spent a fortnight at sea between them.
  263. c. 1990
    Barago kills Taiga Saejima
    Taiga Saejima, the Golden Knight Garo, was killed by his former pupil Barago while shielding his young son, Kouga. His sword was left standing in the ground, with the title of Garo unclaimed for more than ten years.
  264. 1990s
    The Mi-go fall silent
    In the late 1990s the Mi-go fell silent. They cut off Majestic 12, which heard no more from the Greys.
  265. 1990
    Immortus turns the Scarlet Witch
    Immortus, a master of time, worked on the Scarlet Witch's grief for her lost sons until she turned on the Avengers. When the truth came out, Agatha Harkness gave back the memory she had taken. Wanda parted from the Vision.
  266. 1990
    Hagrid buys FluffyB1 Ch7
    Hagrid bought the three-headed dog Fluffy from a man he met in a pub.
  267. c. 1990
    Ripper chases Harry up a treeB3 Ch2
    On Marge's last visit before Hogwarts, Ripper kept Harry up a tree until past midnight.
  268. 1990
    The Lightning Squad's world reaches out again
    Late in 1990 the Excalibur team was thrown into the Nazi world of the Lightning Squad, and had to fight its way home.
  269. c. 1990
    Spider-Man's cosmic power
    For a few weeks Spider-Man carried the power of Captain Universe. With the last of it he stopped the Tri-Sentinel from causing a nuclear disaster in New York.
  270. Winter 1990
    Barbara Gordon walks again
    Advanced cybernetics from Stark Enterprises took over the work of the nerves the Joker's bullet had cut, so Barbara Gordon walked again.
  271. Spring 1990
    Saturnyne sends the Excalibur team home
    At the end of the Cross-Time Caper Saturnyne summoned the team to her Hub, mended Widget's sense of direction and sent them home. The train came up beneath their lighthouse.
  272. Spring 1990
    Galactus comes for Rachel Summers
    Galactus waited at the Braddock Lighthouse to destroy Rachel Summers's body, with the Phoenix Force inside it. The Excalibur team could not stop him, but when Rachel resolved to give herself up for the Earth, he let her be.
  273. Summer 1990
    Dick Grayson gives up the cowl
    Dick Grayson, who still looked like a man in his mid-twenties after a Lazarus Pit, put the cowl away of his own choice to make a life with his wife, Barbara Gordon. For a year Gotham had no Batman.
  274. Summer 1990
    The return of the Sinister Six
    Doctor Octopus gathered a new Sinister Six for a scheme that would have eaten away the ozone layer. Spider-Man beat them.
  275. Summer 1990
    Rachel Summers meets her mother
    An adult Franklin Richards from Rachel Summers's own future appeared in New York. Rachel went to him, and over the Statue of Liberty she met Jean Grey properly for the first time. Jean and Scott Summers would not accept her as their daughter.
  276. Summer 1990
    Doctor Strange frees Meggan
    A dark enchantment turned Meggan for one night into a bat-winged creature that attacked her friends at the Braddock Lighthouse. Doctor Strange drew it out of her with the Eye of Agamotto.
  277. August 1990
    Death of Nathan Lubensky
    Aunt May's companion, Nathan Lubensky, died in her arms after a struggle with the Vulture.
  278. September 1990
    Katie Bell and Cho Chang start at Hogwarts
    Katie Bell entered Hogwarts and was sorted into Gryffindor, and Cho Chang was sorted into Ravenclaw, where she became the house Seeker.
  279. Autumn 1990
    Psylocke goes to Genosha
    Psylocke went to Genosha with Wolverine and Jubilee, where they helped to free the New Mutants.
  280. Autumn 1990
    Kitty Pryde saves St Searle's
    Kitty Pryde, teaching at St Searle's School for Young Ladies, entered the senior girls in a cheerleading contest at Wembley Stadium to save the school from closure. The girls saw off the Strucker twins of Fenris with hockey sticks, and a new tenant for the playing fields saved the school.
  281. 13 December 1990
    Birth of Kit Taylor
    Kit Taylor, later the Kamen Rider called Dragon Knight, was born in the United States, the son of Frank Taylor.
  282. c. 1991
    Barbara Gordon becomes commissioner
    By 1991 Barbara Gordon had become Commissioner of the Gotham police, the post her father had held for so long.
  283. 1991
    John Loftin dies in the cavern
    John Loftin died during one of the expeditions into the cavern of D'ni.
  284. 1991
    Constantine cheats the three lords of Hell
    Dying of lung cancer, John Constantine sold his soul separately to the Second and the Third of the Fallen and cut his wrists. When the First of the Fallen, the Devil, came to collect, the other two arrived to claim their purchase, and rather than fight a war in Hell the First cured his cancer and let him live.
  285. 1991
    The Infinity Gauntlet
    Thanos gathered all six Infinity Gems in a single gauntlet and, to prove his devotion to Death, erased half of all living things with a gesture. His granddaughter Nebula seized the gauntlet and undid the day, so that almost nobody remembers it, and Death still would not have him.
  286. 1991
    Kent and Inza Nelson return to life
    Kent and Inza Nelson came back to life in younger bodies, and Inza took up the work of Doctor Fate.
  287. 1991
    Wonder Woman fights Circe
    In a conflict among the gods that spilt across the Earth, Wonder Woman fought the sorceress Circe.
  288. 1991
    The Hulk's personalities are merged
    Bruce Banner's personalities were merged into a single Hulk.
  289. 1991
    Xavier returns to Earth
    Charles Xavier came back to Earth after his years with the Shi'ar.
  290. c. 1991
    Magneto gathers the Acolytes
    By 1991 Magneto had broken with the X-Men again and was gathering a band of devoted followers, the Acolytes.
  291. 1991
    The X-Men split into two squads
    The X-Men had grown so large that the team split into two squads.
  292. 1991
    Freedom Force breaks up
    Freedom Force broke up after a disastrous mission in Kuwait during the Gulf War, and since then the Mutant Registration Act has been enforced only fitfully.
  293. 1991
    S.H.I.E.L.D. takes a new name
    S.H.I.E.L.D. took a new name to fit the old initials, the Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate.
  294. c. 1991
    Graydon Creed founds the Friends of Humanity
    In the early 1990s the political organiser Graydon Creed, secretly the abandoned son of the mutants Mystique and Sabretooth, built up the Friends of Humanity, which campaigned against mutants in public while some of its cells turned to terror.
  295. 1991
    The Justice League breaks apart
    In 1991 and 1992 a run of disasters shook the League: Maxwell Lord fell into a coma, Despero rampaged through New York, members were killed or walked out, and the United Nations withdrew its support for a time.
  296. 1991
    Odin banishes Thor
    Late in 1991 Odin banished Thor, and Eric Masterson was given Thor's form, strength and hammer to serve in his place, as Thor, among the Avengers.
  297. c. 1991
    The Avengers take a United Nations charter
    As the Cold War ended, the Avengers' American charter was given up under a treaty between Washington and Moscow, and the team took a charter from the United Nations instead, the accord under which it still operates.
  298. 1991
    Percy is made a prefect
    Percy Weasley was made a Gryffindor prefect; his parents bought him the screech owl Hermes, named after the messenger of the Greek gods, and his old rat Scabbers passed to Ron.
  299. c. 1991
    Charlie Weasley goes to Romania
    After leaving Hogwarts Charlie Weasley went to Romania to study and keep dragons.
  300. 1991
    Vernon nails up the letter box
    When Harry Potter's Hogwarts letters began to arrive at Number Four, Privet Drive, Vernon Dursley nailed planks across the letter box and swore when they came down the chimney.
  301. c. 1991
    Yeesha gives Catherine's journals to the Miller brothers
    About 1991 Yeesha, the daughter of Atrus, gave her mother Catherine's journals to the brothers Rand and Robyn Miller of Cyan. From them the brothers made Myst and the games that followed it. It was Yeesha's plan: the games were meant to draw people of D'ni blood to the Cleft and the caverns of D'ni.
  302. 1991
    Thanos turns Darkseid to glass
    When Thanos wiped out half of all living things with the Infinity Gauntlet, Darkseid came in person to fight him beside the cosmic powers and Earth's heroes. Thanos turned him into a statue of glass. The day was undone, but Darkseid remembers it.
  303. 1991
    Apocalypse infects Nathan Summers
    Apocalypse infected Cyclops's small son Nathan with a techno-organic virus. Askani took the boy into the future to be cured.
  304. 1991
    Crystal joins the Avengers
    Crystal of the Inhumans joined the Avengers.
  305. 1991
    Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn seize the Kree Empire
    The Kree generals Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn seized power in the Kree Empire.
  306. 1991
    The Warskrull plot
    Warskrulls had taken the places of Charles Xavier and others. The X-Men freed Xavier, and Deathbird let Lilandra keep the throne.
  307. 1991
    Solid Snake in the Gulf War
    David, the future Solid Snake, still in his teens, went into western Iraq with the Green Berets.
  308. 1991
    Slytherin win the Quidditch finalB1 Ch5
    Slytherin flattened Gryffindor in the final Quidditch match of the 1990 to 1991 season.
  309. 1991
    Charlie's tentacled idolB1 Ch13
    Charlie Weasley sent Percy an idol from Romania that Mrs Weasley confiscated.
  310. 1991
    The enchanted tea set incidentB2 Ch3
    An enchanted tea set sold to a Muggle came alive and sang; its owner died of shock and Arthur Weasley and Perkins used Memory Charms to cover it up.
  311. 1991
    Harry talks to the boa constrictorB2 Ch12
    At the zoo, before he knew he was a wizard, Harry Potter spoke to a boa constrictor without knowing it was Parseltongue and accidentally set it on Dudley Dursley.
  312. 1991
    Liquid Snake is captured in Iraq
    David's twin, serving with the British Special Air Service, was sent to destroy Scud missile launchers behind Iraqi lines, where he was taken prisoner. Roy Campbell's brother, Matt, was killed in the same war.
  313. Winter 1991
    D'spayre is driven out of London
    Rachel Summers and Commander Dai Thomas tracked a stolen child, Amy Keats, to a mill on the moors, where D'spayre, a creature that feeds on despair, was feeding on the grief of London. Dai Thomas pulled the girl out of a flooded well, and her hope drove the creature off.
  314. Winter 1991
    Arnim Zola is found at Darkmoor
    At the Darkmoor Research Centre, where Brian Braddock had once worked, the Excalibur team and Silver Sable's Outlaws found that the director, Professor Walshe, was a robot body of Arnim Zola's. Meggan destroyed it.
  315. Spring 1991
    Myrd helps to free Meggan
    An old man calling himself Myrd helped the Excalibur team free Meggan from the wraith of the Changeling at Braddock Manor. Nobody guessed that he was Merlin, whom Brian Braddock had mourned as dead since 1984.
  316. Spring 1991
    Doom and the Soulsword
    Victor von Doom persuaded Kitty Pryde to draw Illyana Rasputin's Soulsword from its stone at the Braddock Lighthouse, meaning to turn Limbo into promethium and sell its power to the world. The Excalibur team stopped him with the West Coast Avengers, though Limbo was all but destroyed and Lockheed gravely hurt.
  317. Spring 1991
    The Flock try Lockheed
    While surgeons fought for Lockheed's life, his spirit was carried aboard a ship of his own people, the Flock, to be tried for deserting them. Found guilty, he was sent into exile on good terms after saving their ship.
  318. Spring 1991
    Venom left on an island
    Spider-Man faked his own death on a deserted island, where Venom stayed, believing him dead.

Book One: 1991 to 1992

  1. Summer 1991
    Terry McGinnis becomes the third Batman
    In the summer of 1991, after a year in which Gotham had no Batman, Terry McGinnis took up the cowl. He was a Gotham teenager who found his way into the cave beneath Wayne Manor and took the last Batsuit on the night Derek Powers's men murdered his father. The old Bruce Wayne became his mentor and his handler.
  2. Summer 1991
    The Warwolves come as the X-Men
    Mojo's Warwolves came to the Excalibur team in London in the shapes of six X-Men and tried to carry Rachel Summers back to Mojo. After Captain Britain had sent them through a portal, the team sent word to the real X-Men, and Cable answered.
  3. Summer 1991
    Legion wrecks Muir Island
    The Shadow King, a mind that feeds on others, took hold of David Haller, the patient called Legion, and turned his powers on Muir Island. Moira MacTaggert's research centre was wrecked. Charles Xavier, home from space only that year, lost the use of his legs again.
  4. c. 1991
    Hagrid gives Dudley a pig's tailB4 Ch4
    Hagrid, the first grown wizard Dudley Dursley ever met, gave him a curly pig's tail, which a private hospital in London removed.
  5. 31 July 1991
    Harry's eleventh birthdayB3 Ch1
    Hagrid kicked down the door of the hut on the rock and gave Harry a squashed cake.
  6. 31 July 1991
    Harry learns he is a wizardB2 Ch1
    Almost exactly a year before his twelfth birthday, Harry found out he was a wizard.
  7. 31 July 1991
    Hagrid tells Harry he is a wizardB2 Ch18
    In a hut on a rock in the sea, Rubeus Hagrid brought Harry a squashed birthday cake and told him he was a wizard, a memory Harry later used for his first true Patronus.
  8. 31 July 1991
    Hagrid buys Hedwig
    Rubeus Hagrid bought the snowy owl Hedwig at Eeylops Owl Emporium in Diagon Alley as Harry Potter's eleventh birthday present; Harry named her after a name in A History of Magic.
  9. 31 July 1991
    Quirrell's attempt on vault 713
    Quirinus Quirrell tried to steal the Philosopher's Stone from vault seven hundred and thirteen at Gringotts on the very day Rubeus Hagrid emptied it, and Voldemort punished his failure by taking to share his body.
  10. 31 July 1991
    Harry meets Dracina at Madam Malkin'sB1 Ch1
    Harry Potter and Dracina Malfoy met while being fitted for Hogwarts robes in Diagon Alley, about a month before term.
  11. 31 July 1991
    Gringotts break-inB1 Ch5
    The Daily Prophet reported a break-in at Gringotts in the summer of 1991, after Hagrid had removed a package from vault seven hundred and thirteen.
  12. c. 1991
    Harry sees London with HagridB4 Ch5
    The summer he was eleven, Harry saw the streets of London with Hagrid, which later shaped his view of the people coming to Britain.
  13. August 1991
    The Technet attack the lighthouse
    The Technet, mercenaries from another world, tried to carry off Rachel Summers for Saturnyne with a chicken bred to explode over the breakfast table of the Excalibur team. Saturnyne withdrew her warrant. Stranded on Earth, the mercenaries were taken in to mend the damage.
  14. 1 September 1991
    Hogwarts Express departsB1 Ch2
    Harry met Ron Weasley, Hermione Granger and Neville Longbottom on the Hogwarts Express and rejected Dracina Malfoy's offer of guidance.
  15. 1 September 1991
    The 1991 SortingB1 Ch3
    On the evening of 1 September 1991, after the Hogwarts Express had brought them north and Hagrid had taken them across the lake by boat, the new first-years were sorted in the Great Hall at Hogwarts, at the start-of-term feast. The Sorting Hat put Dracina Malfoy into Slytherin, and Harry Potter, Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger into Gryffindor.
  16. 1 September 1991
    Sorting Hat considers Slytherin for HarryB2 Ch10
    At his Sorting the Hat told Harry that Slytherin would set him on the road to greatness, then placed him in Gryffindor when he silently refused.
  17. 1 September 1991
    Harry's scar hurts at the feastB1 Ch3
    Harry's scar hurt when Professor Snape looked at him past Quirrell's turban at the start-of-term feast.
  18. c. 1991
    Harry's first Astronomy lessonB1 Ch4
    Harry's class had its first midnight Astronomy lesson on Wednesday of the first week.
  19. c. 1991
    Harry's first Potions lessonB1 Ch4
    On the Friday of the first week Snape humiliated Harry in Potions; afterwards Harry and Ron had tea with Hagrid.
  20. c. 1991
    Harry becomes Gryffindor SeekerB1 Ch5
    At the first flying lesson, on Thursday of the second week, Harry caught Neville's Remembrall after a fifty-foot dive and was made Gryffindor Seeker.
  21. c. 1991
    Discovery of the three-headed dogB1 Ch5
    Lured out at midnight by Dracina's fake duel, Harry, Ron, Hermione and Neville found the three-headed dog in the third-floor corridor.
  22. September 1991
    Magneto learns what Moira MacTaggert did
    Magneto found out that Moira MacTaggert had altered his genes, years before, while he was a child again in her care. He carried her off to Asteroid M, his fortress in orbit, then made her use her science against the X-Men.
  23. September 1991
    Quidditch trialsB1 Ch3
    House Quidditch trials were held in the second week of the 1991 autumn term.
  24. September 1991
    Dracina calls Hermione a MudbloodB1 Ch4
    Outside History of Magic in the first week of term, Dracina Malfoy called Hermione Granger a Mudblood and Harry rejected her offer of an alliance.
  25. September 1991
    Harry's first flightB3 Ch12

  37. November 1991

    In Harry's first match Gryffindor beat Slytherin 170 to 60 after his broom was jinxed and he caught the Snitch in his mouth.

    The day before his first match Harry saw Snape's leg, bitten by Fluffy, being bandaged by Filch.

    Malfoy Christmas invitationB1 Ch8
    Dracina delivered Narcissa Malfoy's invitation for Harry to spend Christmas at Malfoy Manor; Harry laughed it off.

    Harry received his first Christmas presents, including his father's Invisibility Cloak from an anonymous sender.

    On Christmas night Harry fled the Restricted Section under the Cloak and found the Mirror of Erised.

    Molly Weasley sent Harry a green jumper and fudge, the first proper present he had ever received; Harry gave Ron a 50p coin.

    On Harry's third night at the mirror Dumbledore explained it to him and had it moved the next day.

    Superman was killed in a fight in Metropolis while Harry was at school.
  46. 1992
    Zandi resolves to restore D'ni
    Elias Zandi told the other excavators that he wanted not merely to study D'ni but to restore it, and one day to see it lived in again.

    The Justice League was rebuilt with its United Nations charter intact, its American and European branches carrying on under new leadership.

    The Avengers were caught up in the war between the Kree and the Shi'ar that spilt into Earth's part of space, and split over Iron Man's decision to execute the Kree Supreme Intelligence, which went ahead over Captain America's objection.

    The Black Widow becomes the Avengers' chairwoman
    Natasha Romanoff, the Black Widow, became chairwoman of the Avengers.

    With his nervous system failing, Tony Stark faked his own death and left James Rhodes a heavier gunmetal armour, the Variable Threat Response Battle Suit, which Rhodes wore as War Machine.

    The Society's members were brought home from the battle of Ragnarok, others being sent to take their places, and through 1992 and into 1993 they acted together often, though most were by then in their seventies and eighties.

    At the end of 1992 Thor returned, Eric Masterson gave up the hammer, and Odin rewarded him with an enchanted mace, Thunderstrike, whose name he took.
  53. 1992

    When the Shi'ar took over the broken Kree Empire after Operation Galactic Storm, they found Goa'uld ships picking over the wreckage on the Kree frontier. The Shi'ar Imperial Guard drove them off in an afternoon.

    After the Nega-Bomb the Shi'ar took over what was left of the Kree Empire, and Deathbird was made its viceroy.

    At the end of 1992 a scientist working for Mister Sinister opened the canister that Stryfe had left him. The Legacy Virus got out into the world.

    Harry found Flamel's name on a Dumbledore Chocolate Frog card and Hermione identified him as maker of the Philosopher's Stone.

    Refereed by Snape and watched by Dumbledore, the match ended when Harry caught the Snitch after about five minutes; Ron fought Dracina and Neville fought Crabbe and Goyle in the stands.

    Quirrell abandoned Harry, Hermione, Neville and Dracina in the Forest; a unicorn was killed before Harry.

    Percy Weasley corresponded secretly with Penelope Clearwater through summer 1992.

    In the summer before Harry's second year Ron Weasley arrived at Privet Drive in a flying car and found bars on Harry's bedroom window.

    Doomsday knocked down buildings in Metropolis.

    Albus Dumbledore wrote to both kings about Númenor for the fourth time. Namor's lawyers replied. Aquaman's letter came back unopened.

    In County Sligo the team met Feron, the last of a line of sentinels, whom monks had kept from touching the ground since his birth. He had expected the Phoenix Force for his own, and was furious to find it in Rachel Summers. His teacher, Brother Francis, sent him away with the team.

    At the start of the spring term Dracina sat beside Harry at the Gryffindor table until Ron and Hermione arrived.

    Ashamed of what Magneto had made her do to the X-Men, Moira MacTaggert left Xavier's school and went home to Scotland.

    Gandalf, whom Captain Britain knew as Merlin and had mourned in 1984, came back to him openly in the war against Necrom. The Fury had truly struck him down, and he had been sent back, though not at once, as he was once sent back after Moria. He had kept his return secret for seven years to watch Necrom, a hard counsel kept for good reason: Necrom had to believe that he was gone.
  69. c. 1992
    Snape confronts Quirrell in the ForestB1 Ch9
    Harry overheard Snape pressuring Quirrell about the Philosopher's Stone in the Forbidden Forest on the evening of the Hufflepuff match.
  70. March 1992
    Rachel Summers destroys Necrom
    Necrom, a sorcerer of Ee'rath, threatened to crush the worlds that lie alongside this one into one unless Rachel Summers gave him the Phoenix Force. When he tried to take it, its power overwhelmed him and destroyed him. Rachel was left with her memory in pieces. Meggan then pulled down the tower that crossed the worlds, and with it every tower of its kind.
  71. c. 1992
    Hermione's revision timetablesB1 Ch10
    Ten weeks before the end-of-year exams Hermione began drawing up revision timetables.

    Cletus Kasady became Carnage, killing people across New York. Spider-Man beat him at Madison Square Garden with the help of Venom. He was locked up in Ravencroft.

    After the war with Necrom, Roma of Otherworld sent the team home to Braddock Manor, Captain Britain's family house at Maldon, which became its new base. Kylun and Cerise moved in with it.

    Hagrid won a Norwegian Ridgeback egg in a card game with a stranger in the village.

    Norbert hatched in Hagrid's hut, watched by Harry, Ron, Hermione and, through the curtains, Dracina Malfoy.

    Professor McGonagall took fifty points each from Harry, Hermione and Neville, dropping Gryffindor to last place.

    During a detention in the Forbidden Forest Harry and Dracina saw a hooded figure kill a unicorn and drink its blood; Firenze rescued Harry.

    Quirrell was found at dawn after the detention, covered in cuts and howling in tongues; the school blamed centaurs.

    A masked killer calling itself Bloodaxe began to hunt drug dealers in New York, armed with the axe of Skurge the Executioner. Eric Masterson, then serving as Thor, fought it later that year.

    Harry's year sat their end-of-year exams in a sweltering June, ending with History of Magic.

    The same morning John Constantine walked into a nearly empty Hogwarts, was hugged by Hagrid, and delivered the Myst book to Dumbledore, who called the burglary a kindness.
  21. August 1993
    Lucius Malfoy meets HarryB3 Ch4
    Lucius walked Harry back down Diagon Alley and urged him to give up living like a Muggle.
  22. c. 1993
    Sirius glimpses HarryB3 Ch22
    Sirius frightened Harry on the night Harry left his uncle's house, having hoped only to glimpse him before going north.
  23. August 1993
    The great blackoutB4 Ch3
    One mutant on a space station caused a blackout in which every machine failed; eleven people died on one floor at Bellevue, and Harry slept through it at the Leaky Cauldron.
  24. August 1993
    Lucius Malfoy and Florean Fortescue in Diagon AlleyB4 Ch3
    While Harry stayed at the Leaky Cauldron, Lucius Malfoy walked with him in Diagon Alley and Florean Fortescue helped with his History of Magic essay.
  25. August 1993
    Ministry wizards puncture Aunt MargeB4 Ch4
    Two Ministry wizards came to Privet Drive to puncture Aunt Marge.
  26. August 1993
    Harry first flatters FudgeB4 Ch6
    At the Leaky Cauldron Fudge handled Harry over crumpets, and Harry first tried flattering him in return.
  27. August 1993
    Harry asks Lucius about the Muggle warB4 Ch6
    In Diagon Alley Harry asked Lucius Malfoy about a Muggle war and a masked man who climbed walls; Lucius later made quiet enquiries.
  28. August 1993
    Onslaught is conceived
    When Charles Xavier shut down Magneto's mind on Avalon, the darkness in Magneto passed into Xavier and joined the anger he had kept buried all his life. Nobody saw it happen, Xavier least of all.
  29. 31 August 1993
    Reunion in Diagon AlleyB3 Ch4
    Harry met Ron and Hermione, Hermione bought Crookshanks, and Harry overheard that Black was after him.
  30. 1 September 1993
    Dementor on the Hogwarts ExpressB3 Ch5
    A Dementor searched the train; Harry collapsed and Lupin drove it off.
  31. 1 September 1993
    Start-of-term feastB3 Ch5
    Dumbledore announced the Dementors and appointed Lupin and Hagrid; Harry opened Dracina's violets.
  32. 1 September 1993
    Ministry cars to King's CrossB4 Ch4
    The Ministry of Magic lent the Weasleys two cars to get to King's Cross.
  33. 2 September 1993
    The Grim in Harry's cupB3 Ch6
    In his first Divination lesson Trelawney saw the Grim in Harry's tea leaves.
  34. 2 September 1993
    Buckbeak injures DracinaB3 Ch6
    In Hagrid's first lesson Harry rode Buckbeak, who then slashed Dracina's arm after she insulted him.
  35. 2 September 1993
    Hospital wing quarrelB3 Ch6
    At half past ten Harry visited Dracina; her outburst got him thrown out.
  36. c. 1993
    Dracina writes to her fatherB3 Ch6
    By morning Dracina had written to Lucius about her arm, intending ruin for Hagrid and Buckbeak.
  37. c. 1993
    Dracina returns to PotionsB3 Ch7
    Dracina came back to double Potions with a sling, quarrelled with Harry, apologised and claimed she had decided not to send her complaint to her father.
  38. c. 1993
    Black sighted by a MuggleB3 Ch7
    The Daily Prophet reported that a Muggle woman walking her dog had seen Sirius Black not far off and rung the number on the television.
  39. c. 1993
    The boggart lessonB3 Ch7
    Lupin's third-years faced a boggart in the staffroom; Dracina's boggart was her father, and Lupin's own became a blood-soaked werewolf.
  40. 9 September 1993
    Dracina returns; the boggart lessonB3 Ch7
    Dracina returned to Potions in a sling and apologised to Harry; Lupin's boggart lesson revealed Dracina's fear of Lucius and Lupin's own Garou boggart.
  41. September 1993
    Matt Cook comes home at Homecoming
    Matt Cook escaped from Rita Repulsa's palace on the Moon, then stumbled on to the stage at the Homecoming dance of Angel Grove High School. The Putty Infiltrator, unmasked, was destroyed as a false Megazord.
  42. September 1993
    Alpha 1 turns on Zordon
    Alpha 1, the robot built for Zordon on Edenoi long ago, came back to him after centuries lost. He shot Goldar in the back, trapped the Rangers when they would not finish Goldar off, then turned on Zordon for his mercy. Beaten, he blew himself up.
  43. September 1993
    Rita wakes the Dragon Coin with her mother's life
    On the planet Breel Rita Repulsa took the Dragon Coin from the Temple of Repulsa. To wake it she burnt the spirit of her mother, Lady Fienna, whose last words were that she loved her daughter. Fienna's essence became the Dragon Shield.
  44. September 1993
    Rita tempts Zack Taylor
    A month before Tommy Oliver came to Angel Grove, Goldar carried Zack Taylor off to Rita Repulsa's palace on the Moon. She offered him the Dragon Coin, with the Green Ranger's powers. He refused her and told Zordon.
  45. September 1993
    The Excalibur team moves to Muir Island
    Kurt Wagner, Kitty Pryde and Rachel Summers caught Spoor, an escaped Acolyte who had killed more than a hundred people, then stayed on Muir Island at Moira MacTaggert's invitation. The team that grew up there took on her work, meaning to stop trouble before it became disaster.
  46. September 1993
    Hagrid begins teachingB3 Interlude
    Hagrid began teaching Care of Magical Creatures at Hogwarts from September 1993.
  47. c. 1993
    Dracina's unsent letterB3 Ch14
    After Buckbeak injured her arm, Dracina Malfoy wrote four pages to her father in the hospital wing about the hippogriff and Hagrid, decided not to send them and left them on her bedside table, from which someone took and posted them.
  48. September 1993
    Hermione receives a Time-TurnerB3 Ch20
    Professor McGonagall gave Hermione Granger a Time-Turner on the first day back, after writing to the Ministry on her behalf.
  49. September 1993
    Dracina's brooch stolenB3 Ch20
    Hermione Granger took Dracina Malfoy's brooch from her hair in a corridor and left it on the dungeon steps for Peeves; Dracina fished it out of a fire bucket.
  50. September 1993
    Kitty Pryde brings Piotr Rasputin to Muir Island
    With Charles Xavier's help Kitty Pryde drew Piotr Rasputin down from Avalon to Muir Island, where Moira MacTaggert mended the injury that had locked him in steel. He was flesh again, but he went back to Avalon all the same.
  51. 24 September 1993
    Myst is released
    Cyan's computer game Myst was published by Broderbund on CD-ROM. Rand and Robyn Miller had made it from the journals of Catherine, the wife of Atrus, and it retold the history of Atrus and his sons. It became the best-selling computer game of the decade.
  52. October 1993
    The Ranger Slayer comes to Angel Grove
    The Ranger Slayer, the Kimberly Hart of Lord Drakkon's world, arrived from a later day by mistake. This world's Kimberly broke the Bow of Darkness that bound her to Drakkon. Matt Cook worked out who the Rangers were. When none of them would tell him the truth, he walked out, which ended his time as Kimberly's sweetheart.
  53. c. 1993
    Lupin's vampire lessonB3 Ch8
    In the second week of October Lupin taught general defences against vampires, including the Masquerade, the Camarilla, the Sabbat and the rule never to ask one in.
  54. October 1993
    Tommy Oliver becomes the Green Ranger
    Rita Repulsa gave the stolen Green Power Coin to Tommy Oliver, a martial artist new to Angel Grove, and bound him with a spell to destroy the Rangers. When Jason Lee Scott broke her spell, Tommy joined Zordon's team as the sixth Ranger.
  55. Autumn 1993
    Thor's warrior madness
    A madness that had grown in Thor through 1993 broke out among the stars. He fought Beta Ray Bill, the Silver Surfer and Adam Warlock's Infinity Watch, then came against Asgard itself. Odin went into his son's mind, where Thor destroyed the madness with Mjolnir.
  56. October 1993
    Wood's final-season team meetingB3 Ch8
    At the start of October Oliver Wood told the Gryffindor team that his seventh year was his last chance to win the Quidditch Cup.
  57. October 1993
    Lavender's rabbit killedB3 Ch13
    Lavender Brown's rabbit was killed by a fox, and Hermione Granger lent her a handkerchief.
  58. October 1993
    The Black Dragon wrecks the Command Center
    At the end of October Rita Repulsa's Green Chaos Crystal let through the Black Dragon, a Zord steered by Lord Drakkon from another world. It wrecked the Command Center, cut Zordon adrift, then stripped the Rangers of their powers. Rita turned their Zords on the cities of the world in full view, which is when many people began to fear the Rangers.
  59. 16 October 1993
    Binky's death and Trelawney's predictionB3 Ch8
    Lavender Brown learned that a fox had killed her rabbit Binky, fulfilling, she believed, Trelawney's warning about the sixteenth of October; McGonagall refused Harry's Hogsmeade request that day.
  60. 16 October 1993
    Lavender's rabbit diesB3 Ch8
    Lavender's rabbit Binky was killed by a fox, as Trelawney had foretold.
  61. 31 October 1993
    First Hogsmeade visit of the yearB3 Ch8
    Third-years with signed forms visited Hogsmeade on Halloween; Harry stayed behind and took tea with Lupin.
  62. 31 October 1993
    Attack on the Fat LadyB3 Ch8
    After the Halloween feast the Fat Lady's portrait was found slashed; Peeves said Sirius Black had done it, and the school slept in the Great Hall while the castle was searched.
  63. c. 1993
    Gryffindor against HufflepuffB3 Ch9
    In a storm, more than a hundred Dementors came onto the pitch; Harry fell fifty feet, Dumbledore drove them off with a silver Patronus, and Cedric Diggory caught the Snitch for a hundred-point win.
  64. c. 1993
    Nimbus Two Thousand destroyedB3 Ch9
    The wind carried Harry's Nimbus Two Thousand into the Whomping Willow, which smashed it to splinters.
  65. c. 1993
    Dracina's hospital visitsB3 Ch10
    Dracina paid Harry a formal visit with her friends on the Sunday morning and a private call after visiting hours that evening.
  66. c. 1993
    Crocodile heart incidentB3 Ch10
    In Potions Ron threw a crocodile heart into Dracina's face after she mimicked a Dementor and Harry's fall, costing Gryffindor sixty points.
  67. c. 1993
    Lupin agrees to teach HarryB3 Ch10
    Lupin returned to teaching and agreed to teach Harry a defence against Dementors after the Christmas holidays.
  68. November 1993
    Cain removed from Harry's dream
    On the hospital-wing Saturday Cain watched Harry's revenge dream about Privet Drive until a beam of white light burned him away.
  69. Autumn 1993
    The Fortress of Solitude collapses
    The Fortress crumbled. The Eradicator, with David Connor's mind in it, joined the Outsiders.
  70. November 1993
    Tommy and Billy in the World of the Coinless
    Tommy Oliver and Billy Cranston wrecked the Black Dragon from inside, which threw them into Lord Drakkon's world. They found its Saba, then the Coinless, the powerless Rangers of that world, who took them in.
  71. November 1993
    Siena Blaze attacks Muir Island
    Siena Blaze, a mutant of the Upstarts, set off an explosion on an oil rig off Muir Island, then attacked the island itself for the records of Proteus, Moira MacTaggert's dead son. Rachel Summers drove her off.
  72. November 1993
    Sir Cadogan guards Gryffindor TowerB3 Ch9
    The Fat Lady was found hiding in a painting of Tuscan hills and Sir Cadogan, the only volunteer, took over her post.
  73. November 1993
    Aunt Petunia's first letterB3 Ch9
    Aunt Petunia wrote to Harry for the first time, saying the family would be away and he was not to come home for Christmas; he burned the letter.
  74. November 1993
    Snape's Garou lessonB3 Ch9
    Covering for an absent Lupin on the Friday before the match, Snape taught the Garou and set an essay on recognising and killing them.
  75. November 1993
    Ravenclaw beat HufflepuffB3 Ch10
    At the end of November Ravenclaw flattened Hufflepuff, putting Gryffindor back in contention for the Cup.
  76. c. 1993
    Ravenclaw flatten HufflepuffB3 Ch10
    At the end of November a tiny Ravenclaw girl beat Diggory to the Snitch.
  77. November 1993
    Harry falls at the Hufflepuff matchB3 Ch12
    Dementors invaded the Gryffindor versus Hufflepuff match and Harry fell about fifty feet; Albus Dumbledore threw a Patronus across the flooded pitch, and Cedric Diggory caught the Snitch without knowing Harry had fallen.
  78. November 1993
    Lord Drakkon falls into this world
    Stripped of his powers by the Coinless, Lord Drakkon threw himself into a chasm rather than be taken. The Rangers' road home dragged him into this world, where soldiers of Promethea found him. Grace Sterling locked him in a secret cell. Saba came home with the Rangers to hold Zordon fast until the Command Center was rebuilt.
  79. November 1993
    Rory Campbell comes to Muir Island
    Dr Rory Campbell of the University of Strathclyde, a geneticist sent by Charles Xavier to help Moira MacTaggert, was found half drowned on the shore of Muir Island after his boat went down.
  80. November 1993
    Rita drains the Green Ranger's powers
    Rita Repulsa drained Tommy Oliver's powers with a cursed green candle; what Zordon could give back was not permanent, and by the summer of 1994 the Green Ranger's powers kept running out.
  81. 11 December 1993
    Flitwick pays Hobday's debtB3 Ch12
    Hobday, a Slytherin fifth-year, confessed to Professor Flitwick that he had lost nine Galleons of his father's money at cards to a seventh-year; Flitwick paid it from his own pocket and told no one.
  82. c. 1993
    Hal Jordan destroys the Green Lantern Corps
    Rebuked by the Guardians for using his ring to raise a ghost of Coast City, Hal Jordan flew to Oa, took the rings of the Lanterns sent against him, killed Kilowog and Sinestro and drained the Central Power Battery into himself. The Guardians died, the Corps fell, and at the turn of 1994 Jordan vanished.
  83. Winter 1993
    Grace Sterling defends the Rangers
    A great many people had feared the Power Rangers since the autumn. Grace Sterling, the head of Promethea, sent relief crews to the cities that had suffered, then went on television to speak up for them.
  84. December 1993
    Wood tells Harry he will be captainB3 Ch10
    After a sleet-bound practice in the second week of December, Oliver Wood told Harry that one day he would be captain because others followed him.
  85. c. 1993
    Harry's secret Hogsmeade visitB3 Ch10
    On the last weekend of term Harry used the Marauder's Map and the one-eyed witch passage to reach Hogsmeade, and overheard the truth about Sirius Black in the Three Broomsticks.
  86. c. 1993
    Harry's breakdownB3 Ch11
    On the last morning of term Harry broke down before Ron and Hermione, then read the Committee letter about Buckbeak.
  87. December 1993
    Fudge overheard at the Three BroomsticksB3 Ch12
    At Christmas Harry hid in the Three Broomsticks and overheard Cornelius Fudge telling Madam Rosmerta and several teachers about Sirius Black, including that Black had been James Potter's best man, Harry's godfather and Secret-Keeper.
  88. December 1993
    Lucius Malfoy lobbies the CommitteeB3 Ch14
    From Christmas 1993 Lucius Malfoy wrote repeatedly to the Committee for the Disposal of Dangerous Creatures, wanting Buckbeak's case settled before Easter.
  89. December 1993
    The Garou pack summons LupinB3 Ch19
    Lupin's old Garou pack in mid-Wales sent for him at Christmas.
  90. December 1993
    Complaint against BuckbeakB3 Ch20
    At Christmas a complaint about Buckbeak led to a hearing before the Committee for the Disposal of Dangerous Creatures; Hermione believed Dracina's letter to her father had caused it.
  91. December 1993
    The twins give Harry the Marauder's MapB4 Ch4
    Just before Christmas, in an empty classroom on the third floor, Fred and George handed Harry the Marauder's Map.
  92. c. 1993
    Hagrid receives the Committee's letterB3 Ch11
    On the last morning of term Harry, Ron and Hermione found Hagrid weeping over a letter referring Buckbeak to the Committee for the Disposal of Dangerous Creatures.
  93. 25 December 1993
    Lupin's pack sends for him
    On Christmas Day Remus Lupin's Fianna pack in mid-Wales sent for him, and he was away with them while Albus Dumbledore told the Hogwarts table that he was unwell.
  94. 25 December 1993
    Christmas 1993 at HogwartsB3 Ch11
    Harry received an anonymous Firebolt; McGonagall told of Siberia at Christmas lunch and confiscated the broom that afternoon after Hermione reported it.
  95. 25 December 1993
    Ron refuses maroonB4 Ch5
    Ron told his mother at Christmas that he would sooner be seen dead than in maroon.
  96. 1994
    The Abydos mission
    Colonel Jack O'Neill led a team through the Stargate to Abydos with the archaeologist Daniel Jackson, and there they overthrew the Goa'uld Ra. O'Neill learnt that the Goa'uld exist.
  97. 1994
    Fury learns of Strucker's plan
    Early in 1994 Nick Fury learnt that much of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s turmoil since 1988 had been staged to keep him busy while Strucker prepared Hydra's return, and set about putting a stop to it.
  98. 1994
    Richard Watson explores the D'ni cavern
    The American professor and cave explorer Dr Richard Watson, one of the few who had not laughed at Daniel Jackson, was working in New Mexico on the D'ni cavern, a project he would not discuss.
  99. c. 1994
    Death of Charlie O'Neill
    Shortly before the Abydos mission Charlie, son of Jack and Sara O'Neill, shot himself by accident with his father's pistol; O'Neill blamed himself, his marriage broke and he retired from the Air Force until it called him back.
  100. c. 1994
    Most Augment rulers are overthrown
    In the year after the fall of New Delhi most of the other genetically engineered rulers were overthrown by their own people, and the rest swore allegiance to Khan Noonien Singh or were destroyed by him.
  101. 1994
    Apophis begins to take Ra's place
    With Ra dead above Abydos, the System Lords were left without a Supreme System Lord, and Apophis moved fastest to take over Ra's domains.
  102. 1994
    Scott Summers and Jean Grey raise Nathan in the future
    Scott Summers and Jean Grey were carried two thousand years into the future, where they spent twelve years raising the boy Nathan before coming back to the moment they had left.
  103. c. 1994
    David becomes Solid Snake
    David joined FOXHOUND under Big Boss, who gave him the codename Solid Snake. His survival instructor there was Kazuhira Miller.
  104. 1994
    Firebolt chosen for the World ChampionshipB3 Ch13
    According to Which Broomstick, the Firebolt was to be the broom of choice for national teams at that year's Quidditch World Championship.
  105. 1994
    Daniel Jackson's pyramid lectureB4 Ch3
    Early in 1994 the Egyptologist Daniel Jackson lectured that the Great Pyramid had not been built by the pharaohs of the Fourth Dynasty; much of his audience walked out and his funding was withdrawn, and Catherine Langford recruited him to translate the Giza cover stones for the United States Air Force.
  106. 1994
    Transylvania beat EnglandB4 Ch4
    England went out of the Quidditch World Cup to Transylvania, 390 to 10.
  107. 1994
    Uganda beat WalesB4 Ch4
    Wales lost to Uganda at the Quidditch World Cup.
  108. 1994
    Luxembourg beat ScotlandB4 Ch4
    Scotland was slaughtered by Luxembourg at the Quidditch World Cup.
  109. 1994
    Ireland beat Peru in the semi-finalsB4 Ch4
    Ireland flattened Peru in the semi-finals of the Quidditch World Cup.
  110. c. 1994
    Ton-Tongue Toffees developedB4 Ch5
    Fred and George spent six months developing Ton-Tongue Toffees, which their parents told them to destroy.
  111. Winter 1994
    Finster's village of Putties
    Searching for a Promethea aeroplane lost over the Carpathians, the Rangers found a village on no map whose people were Putties in human shape. Finster, who had made them, surrendered. Grace Sterling offered the Rangers an alliance, which Jason Lee Scott refused.
  112. January 1994
    Rachel Summers gives way to Captain Britain
    Home from the wedding of Scott Summers to Jean Grey, Rachel Summers learnt that she and Captain Britain could not both live in the same stretch of time. She dived into the stream of time in his place. He came home calling himself Britanic.
  113. January 1994
    First anti-dementor lessonB3 Ch12
    On a Thursday at eight o'clock in the History of Magic classroom Remus Lupin began teaching Harry the Patronus Charm; Harry heard his father's voice for the first time.
  114. January 1994
    Hogwarts term resumesB3 Ch12
    The rest of the school returned a few days after the New Year, and Oliver Wood spoke to Harry about dementors the night before term began.
  115. January 1994
    Slytherin beat RavenclawB3 Ch12
    About a week after term began, Slytherin narrowly beat Ravenclaw at Quidditch when Dracina Malfoy caught the Snitch with inches to spare.
  116. January 1994
    The Hogwarts lake freezesB3 Ch12
    In the second week of January the lake froze hard to the middle; soon after, a Hufflepuff second-year walked out on it, looked down and fell through, and was hauled out by a sixth-year.
  117. January 1994
    Skimming stones on the frozen lakeB3 Ch20
    On an afternoon in January, Harry and Dracina Malfoy skimmed stones across the frozen Hogwarts lake and spent four comfortable minutes in silence, the memory that later powered Harry's Patronus.
  118. January 1994
    The Hufflepuff boy on the frozen lakeB3 Ch22
    A little Hufflepuff walked far out on the frozen lake, looked down, went through and was pulled out.
  119. January 1994
    A new Green Lantern appearsB4 Ch3
    A young new Green Lantern turned up out of nowhere after the old one vanished.
  120. January 1994
    Daytripper joins the team
    Amanda Sefton, Kurt Wagner's foster-sister and his old love, came to Muir Island as Daytripper. She helped to send Rachel Summers into the stream of time.
  121. Winter 1994
    Grace Sterling tells the Rangers about 1969
    With Finster's disguised monsters loose in the world, Grace Sterling came to the door of the Command Center. She told the Rangers she had been Zordon's first Red Ranger, on the Moon in 1969, and they watched that night on the viewing globe. Jason Lee Scott agreed to work with her.
  122. February 1994
    Kurt Wagner and Amanda Sefton free Margali
    At Cottbus, in eastern Germany, Kurt Wagner and Amanda Sefton freed his foster-mother, Margali Szardos, from the demon D'Spayre, who had been feeding on riots against the Romani there.
  123. February 1994
    Dracina lends Harry her NimbusB3 Ch12
    At the start of the last week of February Dracina offered Harry her spare Nimbus Two Thousand and One; the same day Flitwick shamed Hobday for bullying a first-year over two Sickles.
  124. c. 1994
    Firebolt returned and Scabbers vanishesB3 Ch12
    On the Thursday before the Ravenclaw match McGonagall returned Harry's Firebolt; that night Scabbers disappeared, leaving blood and ginger hairs on Ron's sheet.
  125. 25 February 1994
    Major General Reginald Fairfield is killed
    Reginald Fairfield, a retired general who was the informal head of Delta Green, was shot dead at his farm. Delta Green blamed NRO DELTA, the enforcers of Majestic 12.
  126. c. 1994
    The Ravenclaw match
    Gryffindor beat Ravenclaw 230 to 70; Harry cast his first corporeal Patronus at fake dementors, who were Dracina, Crabbe, Goyle and Flint.
  127. March 1994
    Revanche dies of the Legacy Virus
    Revanche, who was Kwannon in Betsy Braddock's first body, died of the Legacy Virus. Before she died she saw the truth, then gave back to Psylocke what was hers, her full telepathy among it.
  128. March 1994
    Into Jamie Braddock's mind
    In the Proteus Room on Muir Island, Captain Britain and his sister Psylocke went into the mind of their brother Jamie, who lay there in a coma. They could not bring him back.
  129. c. 1994
    Dementor's Kiss authorised for BlackB3 Ch12
    The Daily Prophet reported that the Ministry of Magic had given the dementors permission to perform the Kiss on Sirius Black if they found him.
  130. March 1994
    Gryffindor beat RavenclawB3 Ch13
    On a Saturday in early March Gryffindor beat Ravenclaw 230 to 70; Harry repelled fake dementors with a full Patronus before catching the Snitch.
  131. March 1994
    Sirius Black's dormitory break-inB3 Ch13
    On the night of the Ravenclaw match Sirius Black entered Gryffindor Tower using a written list of passwords, slashed Ron Weasley's bed curtains with a knife, was punched by Ron and escaped.
  132. March 1994
    Sir Cadogan dismissedB3 Ch14
    After the break-in Sir Cadogan was sacked and returned to the seventh floor, and the Fat Lady came back under the guard of security trolls.
  133. March 1994
    Neville's Howler and Lucius's letterB3 Ch14
    Two days after the break-in Neville Longbottom received a Howler from his grandmother, and Dracina Malfoy received a letter from her father thanking her for the four pages he had put before the Committee.
  134. March 1994
    Mud at the Shrieking ShackB3 Ch14
    On a Hogsmeade Saturday an invisible Harry pelted Dracina, Crabbe and Goyle with mud by the Shrieking Shack; Dracina reported it to Snape, who confronted Harry and lost the Marauder's Map to Lupin.
  135. c. 1994
    Lucius's green-wax letterB3 Ch14
    On the Monday Dracina learned her four pages were before the Committee and begged her father to drop it.
  136. March 1994
    The fight on the castle stepsB3 Ch15
    On a Wednesday after Care of Magical Creatures, Hermione Granger punched Dracina Malfoy and the two fought on the castle steps; Harry then chose to believe Dracina about the letter. The same day Hermione walked out of Divination and Harry spoke with the Fat Friar.
  137. March 1994
    The coalition offensive south of DelhiB4 Ch3
    Under a United Nations mandate the largest multinational force since the Gulf War crossed Khan's front line south of Delhi, with American, Russian, British and French troops fighting side by side for the first time since 1945.
  138. Spring 1994
    American soldiers at GizaB4 Ch4
    From the spring of 1994 American soldiers were all over the plateau at Giza.
  139. March 1994
    Snape sees Dracina after the mudB4 Ch6
    After Harry threw mud at Dracina near the Shrieking Shack, Snape cared coldly about the state in which she reached his door.
  140. March 1994
    Zero finds Douglock
    In the woods of Maine, Zero, a teleporting machine that had served Stryfe, found a creature of the Phalanx that wore the face of Doug Ramsey, the dead New Mutant, and carried his memories. Zero cut it loose from the rest. It called itself Douglock.
  141. 3 April 1994
    Dracina's Easter eggB3 Ch15
    On Easter Sunday Harry woke to find a hand-made chocolate egg from Dracina Malfoy on his pillow, the first Easter egg he had ever been given.
  142. Spring 1994
    Doomsday is carried to the end of time
    In the spring of 1994 Doomsday rose again far from Earth and fought its way across Apokolips. Superman went after it, learnt that it had been made on prehistoric Krypton by the scientist Bertron, and with the time-traveller Waverider carried it to the end of time, the one place it could not adapt to survive.
  143. Spring 1994
    Darkseid imprisons the Cyborg Superman
    Hank Henshaw surfaced on Apokolips at the time of Doomsday's second rampage. Darkseid, the Lord of Apokolips, compressed what remained of his life force into a small sphere and kept it.
  144. Spring 1994
    The Molecule Man draws out the Beyonder
    In the spring of 1994 the Molecule Man drew the Beyonder out of Kosmos again, and the struggle between them threatened every universe at once.
  145. Spring 1994
    Rita Repulsa goes to Japan
    With a gem stolen from a temple, Rita Repulsa went to Japan, a country with no Power Rangers, where she joined the Xiliens of Planet X. Tommy Oliver, the Green Ranger, was carried there with her. His Dragonzord fought Godzilla, who wrecked it.
  146. Spring 1994
    Delta Green is rebuilt as cells
    After Fairfield's death the old agent Joseph Camp, known as Alphonse, rebuilt Delta Green as a conspiracy of cells lettered A to Z. Each agent took a code name beginning with his cell's letter.
  147. April 1994
    Charles Xavier comes to Muir Island
    Charles Xavier left his school in Hank McCoy's charge and came to Muir Island to work beside Moira MacTaggert against the Legacy Virus.
  148. c. 1994
    The black dog and CrookshanksB3 Ch15
    The night before the Quidditch final Harry saw an enormous shaggy black dog crossing the lawn with Crookshanks.
  149. c. 1994
    Gryffindor win the Quidditch CupB3 Ch15
    On the first Saturday after the Easter holidays Gryffindor beat Slytherin by more than two hundred points to win the Quidditch Cup for the first time in seven years, Harry catching the Snitch with Gryffindor leading 80 to 20.
  150. c. 1994

    By Monday the crowd protesting against superhumans outside the United Nations had grown to three hundred thousand, arriving by coach from all over America.
  63. 22 August 1994
    The Weasley party's Portkey arrivesB4 Ch6
    The Weasley party's Portkey reached the World Cup site at seven minutes past five in the morning.
  64. 22 August 1994
    Mr Roberts Obliviated mid-wordB4 Ch6
    In the morning Obliviators caught Mr Roberts halfway through saying 'mutie', in front of Harry.
  65. 22 August 1994
    Fred and George prepare the fixB4 Ch6
    At lunchtime Fred made a rude sign at Percy, and in the afternoon the twins went to 'look at the pitch', returning smelling of broom polish.
  66. 22 August 1994
    Constantine trails HarryB4 Ch6
    All day John Constantine followed Harry around the World Cup site, leaving cigarette smoke and glimpses of his raincoat.
  67. 22 August 1994
    Harry meets WinkyB4 Ch6
    In the Top Box Harry met Winky, Barty Crouch's house-elf, who was saving her master a seat and disapproved of Dobby's freedom.
  68. 22 August 1994
    Harry handles FudgeB4 Ch6
    Harry flattered Fudge and then unsettled him with talk of mutants, Magneto, Augments and Sentinels, until Fudge fled.
  69. 22 August 1994
    Lucius Malfoy thanks HarryB4 Ch6
    Lucius Malfoy thanked Harry privately for saving Dracina from the werewolf, then broke off on glimpsing Constantine on the stairs.
  70. 22 August 1994
    Narcissa Malfoy meets HarryB4 Ch6
    Narcissa Malfoy called Harry Dracina's knight, told him of her and her twin's rivalry over James, and hinted at what Lily did to Bellatrix.
  71. 22 August 1994
    Dracina sees that Pansy loves RonB4 Ch6
    Watching Pansy Parkinson through her Omnioculars, Dracina realised that Pansy was in love with Ron Weasley.
  72. 22 August 1994
    The 422nd World Cup final beginsB4 Ch6
    Ludo Bagman opened the final of the 422nd Quidditch World Cup, and the Bulgarian veela and Irish leprechauns performed.
  73. 22 August 1994
    Krum's Wronski FeintB4 Ch6
    Viktor Krum drew Aidan Lynch into the ground with a Wronski Feint and hunted the Snitch during Lynch's time out.
  74. 22 August 1994
    The fake whistleB4 Ch6
    With Ireland 130 to 10 up, George Weasley's fake whistle stopped the Bulgarian Chasers and Troy scored.
  75. 22 August 1994
    Mostafa tries to send off the veelaB4 Ch6
    Entranced by the veela, Mostafa had to be kicked awake, tried to send off the mascots and gave Ireland two penalties.
  76. 22 August 1994
    The veela attack the leprechaunsB4 Ch6
    Provoked by a rude leprechaun hand sign, the veela turned bird-headed and hurled fire at the leprechauns.
  77. 22 August 1994
    Quigley breaks Krum's noseB4 Ch6
    An Irish Bludger broke Krum's nose, and he played on.
  78. 22 August 1994
    Ireland win the 1994 World CupB4 Ch6
    Krum caught the Snitch with Ireland 170 to 10 up, and Ireland won 170 to 160.
  79. 22 August 1994
    The Bulgarian Minister speaks EnglishB4 Ch6
    After the match the Bulgarian Minister for Magic revealed he spoke English, having let Fudge mime to him all day.
  80. 22 August 1994
    The World Cup presentedB4 Ch6
    The World Cup was carried into the lit Top Box, the teams came up, and Troy and Quigley lifted the Cup.
  81. 22 August 1994
    Fred and George are paidB4 Ch6
    Ludo Bagman paid Fred and George in full for their bet.
  82. 22 August 1994
    Constantine exposed in the Top BoxB4 Ch6
    John Constantine trod on Winky, whose shriek exposed him to Lucius Malfoy in the Top Box.
  83. 22 August 1994
    Lucius chases ConstantineB4 Ch6
    Lucius Malfoy jinxed and chased Constantine through the stadium until Constantine escaped over the last barrier and leprechauns swarmed Lucius.
  84. 22 August 1994
    Plan A beginsB4 Ch6
    Pansy took Dracina into the wood on the pretext of a lost earring while Ron led Harry towards the forked pine.
  85. 23 August 1994
    Security Council to meet againB4 Ch3
    The UN Security Council was due to meet again on Tuesday, and the protest was to continue until then.
  86. August 1994
    Billy Cranston finds Lord Drakkon at Promethea
    Puzzled that a Promethea building drew only half its power, Billy Cranston found Lord Drakkon in a secret cell beneath it, where Grace Sterling had held him since the autumn before. Jason Lee Scott ended the Rangers' alliance with her.
  87. 1 September 1994
    Mrs Weasley to take the children to King's CrossB4 Ch5
    Mrs Weasley planned to take the children to King's Cross for the Hogwarts Express the week after the World Cup.
  88. 3 September 1994
    Professor Hart calls the VR Troopers
    A message from Professor Hart brought Ryan Steele, Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese to his laboratory outside Crossworld City, where each was given a Virtualizer. Grimlord attacked the same day, and his swordsman Decimator left Ryan for dead in a quarry.
  89. 10 September 1994
    The Troopers turn back Grimlord's first assault
    Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese brought Ryan Steele back from the quarry to be mended. The three then fought together for the first time, turning back the army Grimlord had massed against the Earth. In the laboratory that week a surge of power left Ryan's dog, Jeb, able to talk.
  90. September 1994
    Saba dies in Lord Drakkon's cell
    The Saba of Drakkon's world went to Drakkon's cell at Promethea to kill him, but set him loose by accident. Drakkon struck off Saba's head, then worked what was left into one of Rita's incantations to open a way out, taking the blade with him.
  91. c. 1994
    Oliver Wood to begin RAF trainingB4 Ch5
    Oliver Wood was soon to begin an RAF Basic Recruit Training Course, following his father.
  92. September 1994
    Ninjor mends Lord Drakkon's powers
    Lord Drakkon passed Ninjor's trials at the Temple of Power, keeping his purpose to himself. Ninjor mended his link to the Power. Drakkon carried him off in a jar, then stole the Green Chaos Crystal from the Command Center.
  93. September 1994
    The murder of Tommy Oliver
    On the night of Tommy Oliver's first proper date with Kimberly Hart, Lord Drakkon ran him through from behind in an alley with the blade that had been Saba, drawing off his power. Tommy died in Kimberly's arms. Angel Grove buried him.
  94. September 1994
    Drakkon makes war on the Rangers of every year
    Tommy Oliver's murder broke the Power apart, shutting each team of Rangers of later years away in a time of its own. Lord Drakkon went from one to the next, taking their powers into himself. Zordon called on the Emissaries Three, who would not act, then warned every Ranger the Power could reach.
  95. September 1994
    The storming of Drakkon's tower
    The Rangers of every year stormed Lord Drakkon's tower on the Moon of his own world. Grace Sterling flew Promethea in to free his prisoners. Rita Repulsa burnt a green candle against him. Drakkon killed Finster-5, then took every stolen power into himself at once.
  96. September 1994
    Lord Drakkon unmakes the world
    Lord Drakkon broke into the Morphin Grid, beat the Emissaries Three, then used the heart of a Morphin Master to unmake everything. In its place he made one world, with himself as its hero. Promethea, armoured with Psycho Green's dagger, was thrown clear into a dark place without the Power.
  97. September 1994
    The world is mended
    Tommy Oliver's spirit, held between the worlds by the Ranger Slayer's arrow, beat Lord Drakkon in his made world, then took the heart from him. The Rangers mended everything with it. Tommy was alive, his first date with Kimberly Hart ended in a kiss, and nobody on Earth remembered. Drakkon chose to stay in the wreck.
  98. Autumn 1994
    Lord Zedd comes to the Moon
    Lord Zedd came to Rita Repulsa's palace on the Moon, angry at her long failure, and banished her into space in a dumpster.
  99. 25 September 1994
    James Sunderland comes to Silent Hill
    James Sunderland came to Silent Hill after a letter from his dead wife, Mary Shepherd-Sunderland. The town set the Red Pyramid Thing on him, with Maria of Silent Hill, who wore his wife's face. Angela Orosco walked into a fire there, and James killed Eddie Dombrowski under Toluca Prison.
  100. 26 September 1994
    James Sunderland leaves Silent Hill
    In the night, at the Lakeview Hotel, James Sunderland remembered that he had smothered his sick wife himself. He read her last letter. In the morning he walked out of Silent Hill with Laura, an orphan of eight who had been her friend.
  101. 30 September 1994
    Kaitlin Star photographs Grimlord's prisoner
    In the woods outside Crossworld City Kaitlin Star photographed a prisoner who looked like Tyler Steele. He had been moved by the time Ryan Steele reached the place, but the Troopers now knew that Grimlord held him alive.
  102. October 1994
    The bottling of Angel Grove
    Lord Zedd made a bargain with Brainiac, an alien machine mind who collects cities, and Brainiac shrank Angel Grove into a bottle. The Power Rangers fought beside the Justice League for the first time to win it back, in full view of the world.
  103. October 1994
    The Blue Emissary comes to Jason
    The Blue Emissary, a servant of the Morphin Masters, came in secret to Jason Lee Scott and gave him back his memory of Lord Drakkon's war. At Jason's price the Emissary showed Zordon the way to the White Light. Zack Taylor and Trini Kwan, who walked in on them, joined too.
  104. Autumn 1994
    Kitty Pryde draws the Soulsword
    On Muir Island Kitty Pryde drew the Soulsword out of her own body, where it had lain since Illyana Rasputina's death. The sorcerer Gravemoss came for it wearing Kurt Wagner's body, until Kitty drove him out and Amanda Sefton killed him with the sword.
  105. October 1994
    Lord Zedd tries to make Kimberly Hart his queen
    Goldar carried Kimberly Hart off to the Moon, where Lord Zedd meant to make her his queen. The Rangers brought her home.
  106. Autumn 1994
    Margali Szardos takes the Soulsword
    Amanda Sefton gave the Soulsword to her mother, Margali Szardos, which was what Margali had wanted all along. With it Margali killed every witch and wizard who stood ahead of her on the Winding Way.
  107. October 1994
    Tommy Oliver becomes the White Ranger
    Tommy Oliver came back to the Rangers as the White Ranger, and their leader.
  108. 15 November 1994
    Dark Heart is shown to be Tyler Steele
    Grimlord's cyborg warrior Dark Heart, whom Ryan Steele had beaten and spared, proved to be Ryan's own father with his memory wiped. Professor Hart restored his mind, though not his body, by giving him Ryan's memories.
  109. November 1994
    The power transfer
    Jason, Zack and Trini told everybody they knew, Zordon first, that they were leaving for the World Peace Conference in Geneva. With the Sword of Light their powers passed to Rocky, Adam and Aisha. The three never went to Geneva: on Safehaven, far out in space, they took up the Omega powers in secret.
  110. November 1994
    The Omega Rangers carry off Lord Zedd
    Late in November the Omega Rangers took Dayne, the bounty hunter Lord Zedd had hired, then stormed the Moon Palace. Jason Lee Scott brought the Red Omegazord down on the giant Zedd, who was carried off to a cell on Safehaven.
  111. 17 November 1994
    Grimlord blows up his dungeon
    While Grimlord's aircraft bombed Professor Hart's laboratory, Ryan Steele went into virtual reality with his father to face Grimlord, who blew up his own dungeon round them. Tyler Steele, wounded by Decimator, came back to human shape, only for Grimlord to carry him off again.
  112. December 1994
    Kiya kills the Blue Emissary
    Kiya Kyatyl, the Blue Omega Ranger, murdered the Blue Emissary on Safehaven, then freed the prisoners in its vault, calling them the Anointed. The first of the Empyreals rose from the Emissary's death.
  113. December 1994
    Pete Wisdom leaves Black Air
    Sickened by what he had done for it at Ronsaphan, in Thailand, Pete Wisdom asked to leave Black Air. It let him go on condition that he went first with the Excalibur team to Genosha as its observer.
  114. December 1994
    The Omega Rangers' secret comes out
    Kiya struck Jason Lee Scott down. Xi brought the three Omega Rangers of Earth to the Command Center with their faces bare, which is how Zordon and the Rangers learnt that the peace conference had been a lie. Zordon forgave them at once.
  115. December 1994
    Kurt Wagner learns Moira's secret
    Kurt Wagner worked out that Moira MacTaggert had the Legacy Virus, and she told him the truth.
  116. December 1994
    The Anointed are beaten
    Both teams of Rangers, helped by the Ranger Slayer, beat Kiya's Anointed at Safehaven. The Solarix drained the Empowered of their stolen Power. Kiya went back into a cell, while Dayne let Lord Zedd go free.
  117. December 1994
    The team on Genosha
    Black Air sent the team to Genosha to look into bullets made to pierce mutant skin. There, fighting beside the island's refugees, Pete Wisdom showed for the first time that he was a mutant himself, with knives of heat at his fingertips.
  118. December 1994
    The Red Emissary dies in the wreck
    The Red Emissary went into the ruin of Lord Drakkon's made world to look for him, where an Empyreal tore the Emissary to pieces. The Empyreals offered Drakkon his freedom if he would bring them to the Yellow Emissary.
  119. December 1994
    Lord Drakkon falls to Earth
    In the middle of December Lord Drakkon fell beside the Command Center inside what looked like a meteor, half mad with terror. Tommy Oliver knocked him senseless. Zordon locked him in a cell under the Command Center.
  120. December 1994
    Matt Cook becomes the Green Ranger
    Grace Sterling and Billy Cranston woke the dead Dragon Coin with the energy of Psycho Green's dagger. In a battle with Lord Zedd's Dark Rangers, Grace's teleporter snatched Matt Cook from under a falling wall, and he became the second Green Ranger.
  121. December 1994
    The dome over Angel Grove
    Over Christmas Lord Zedd shut Angel Grove under a dome of green Chaos energy. From inside it Matt Cook took off his helmet on every screen in the city, the first Ranger whose name the public knew, then brought the dome down with the Dragonzord. Zordon barred Billy Cranston from the Command Center for his part in making Matt a Ranger.
  122. 1995
    The fall of Outer Heaven
    The Western powers learnt that Outer Heaven, Big Boss's fortified mercenary state two hundred kilometres north of Galzburg in South Africa, had built the walking nuclear weapon Metal Gear. FOXHOUND sent in Gray Fox, who was captured. Then Big Boss, who secretly ruled the place through his phantom, sent the rookie Solid Snake alone on Operation Intrude N313, expecting him to fail. Helped by a resistance inside the fortress, Snake freed Gray Fox, destroyed Metal Gear and brought down Venom Snake at its head.
  123. 1995
    Apocalypse returns
    Apocalypse came back from the Moon, where he had been left for dead.
  124. 1995
    Outer Heaven is bombed
    Days after Solid Snake came out, NATO aircraft bombed what was left of Outer Heaven flat. Mercenaries, resistance fighters and civilians died alike. The world was told that there had been an earthquake in southern Africa.
  125. 1995
    Roy Campbell takes command of FOXHOUND
    With Big Boss unmasked, command of FOXHOUND passed to his deputy, Colonel Roy Campbell. Solid Snake left the unit. Gray Fox, whom he had rescued, disappeared.
  126. January 1995
    The Omega Rangers take Lord Drakkon
    Against Zordon's orders, Jason, Zack and Trini took Lord Drakkon from his cell under the Command Center to guide them against the Empyreals. Zordon called it a betrayal, then disowned them.
  127. January 1995
    The Empyreals destroy Hartunia
    The Orange Empyreal, which answered to Zartus of Eltar, burnt the world of Hartunia while the Omega Rangers got its people away. Its empress, Evor Til, died saving them.
  128. January 1995
    Lord Drakkon betrays the Yellow Emissary
    Lord Drakkon led the Omega Rangers to the Yellow Emissary's hiding place, having led the Empyreals there too. They killed the Emissary. Drakkon slipped his collar, took back his powers, wrecked Xi, then flew off in the Omega Rangers' ship, leaving them stranded.
  129. January 1995
    Zartus breaks Zordon's tube
    Zartus, Supreme Guardian of Eltar, came to the Command Center, smashed Zordon's tube and claimed the Earth for Eltar. Zordon, a Maia, lost only the form he wore. He came back in a body of metal.
  130. January 1995
    The Empyreals destroy the Command Center
    Zartus's Empyreals destroyed Promethea's headquarters, Lord Zedd's palace on the Moon and the Command Center. Eltarian ships held the sky for a matter of days.
  131. January 1995
    The Empyreals are destroyed
    Once Grace Sterling had broken Zartus's hold on them, the Rangers of both teams destroyed all three Empyreals. The Blue Emissary rose alive from the first to fall.
  132. January 1995
    Zordon kills Zartus
    On the Moon Zordon laid down his weapon before Lord Zedd, who saw at last that Zartus had cursed the Zeo Crystal. Together they turned on Zartus, and Zordon killed him with a piece of the Crystal.
  133. January 1995
    Zordon goes into a new tube
    Eltar called its armies home. Zordon gave up his failing body of metal for a new tube that Grace Sterling made, then made his peace with her.
  134. January 1995
    The Death Ranger wakes
    A visitor to Safehaven took the Gold Omega morpher from its vault to wake a friend. What woke was Spa'ark, the Death Ranger, who struck down Jason Lee Scott and Yale, then wore their bodies.
  135. January 1995
    Jason Lee Scott loses his link to the Power
    Shown his mother alive, days after her death at home, Jason refused the vision and broke the Gold morpher from within. It ended the Death Ranger's hold, but it tore out his own link to the Power.
  136. January 1995
    Trini Kwan becomes the Red Omega Ranger
    Trini Kwan sent Jason home to his father, then took the Red Omega powers herself. Kevor Vrin, a Hartunian orphan, became the Yellow Omega Ranger.
  137. February 1995
    Rita Repulsa becomes Mistress Vile
    Fished out of her dumpster by Divatox, Rita Repulsa overthrew her father, Master Vile, to become Dark Specter's general, Mistress Vile. With Alpha 1 she fetched the Vessel, the body Zordon had lost long ago, from the planet Bizerk.
  138. February 1995
    Mistress Vile takes the Zeo Crystal
    Mistress Vile beat Lord Zedd on the Moon with an army of Thralls, then seized the Zeo Crystal. Matt Cook stayed behind to hold her off while the other Rangers got away, which is how she took him prisoner.
  139. February 1995
    Matt Cook is bound with the Sword of Darkness
    Mistress Vile bound Matt Cook to her with a new Sword of Darkness. Under her spell he led her Putties against the Youth Center in Angel Grove. Breaking the sword, which had once freed Tommy Oliver, did not free him.
  140. February 1995
    Lord Drakkon frees Kiya Kyatyl
    At the beginning of February Lord Drakkon walked into the vault on Safehaven, let out Kiya Kyatyl, then took her through the Master Arch to his own world.
  141. February 1995
    The Drakkon Rangers
    In his own world, which Dark Specter's creatures were overrunning, Lord Drakkon talked the Ranger Slayer round. Finster-5 made six suits of Ranger armour, for Drakkon, Bulk, Trini, Scorpina, Kiya and the Ranger Slayer. Five of them came through into this world to fight Dark Specter.
  142. February 1995
    Grace Sterling is killed at the Arch
    Mistress Vile opened the Arch, an ancient gate into the Morphin Grid in the Bermuda Triangle, with the Zeo Crystal. There Matt Cook, still under her spell, killed Grace Sterling of Promethea.
  143. February 1995
    Dark Specter comes through the Arch
    Made to choose between saving Matt Cook and shutting the gate, the Rangers saved Matt. Dark Specter came through the Arch to take the Vessel for his body. His corruption spread through the Morphin Grid, turning every Ranger who morphed.
  144. February 1995
    The death of Lord Drakkon
    Inside the Morphin Grid Lord Drakkon burnt Dark Specter's corruption out of the Ranger Slayer with his White Tiger coin, as her arrow went through his heart. Dying, he gave her the coin, telling her to save the universe. He stayed dead when the world was mended.
  145. February 1995
    The Grid is cleansed and the world mended
