    The Rangers of both teams cleansed the Morphin Grid. The Vessel was destroyed, while Dark Specter was thrown back into the dark, much reduced. The world was mended a second time, keeping no memory of the weeks since Lord Zedd's dome. Grace Sterling stayed dead; the world remembered her as lost with a Promethea research ship.
  146. February 1995
    Zordon wards the Zeo Crystal
    Zordon put the Zeo Crystal back in the caves beneath the Moon Palace and set on it a ward that no evil hand can pass. Master Vile found it there in November 1995.
  147. February 1995
    Jason Lee Scott goes to Geneva in earnest
    After his mother's funeral Jason Lee Scott took up his place at the peace conference in Geneva, months late, so that the lie became the truth for him. He stayed in Switzerland until the autumn of 1996.
  148. February 1995
    Rita Repulsa marries Lord Zedd
    Rita Repulsa came back to the Moon and, with the help of a love potion, married Lord Zedd.
  149. 22 February 1995
    Proof that Tyler Steele is alive
    Dr Monroe of the National Space Laboratory found a film of Tyler Steele on an old satellite, for which Grimlord's Skugs kidnapped him. The VR Troopers freed him, and the film showed Ryan Steele that his father was still alive.
  150. February 1995
    The Wizard of Deception takes the Dragon Coin
    The Wizard of Deception took the Dragon Coin from Matt Cook to arm his evil copy of Tommy Oliver. When Tommy destroyed the Wizard, the freed copy stayed in the Angel Grove of the 1700s with the coin and the Dragonzord.
  151. 28 February 1995
    The Red Python is destroyed
    Grimlord had shut Amy, a friend of Kaitlin Star's, inside the Red Python, an armoured warrior built from Tyler Steele's stolen knowledge. It nearly killed Kaitlin on 27 February. The next day its powers failed, and the Troopers brought Amy out alive before it destroyed itself.
  152. Spring 1995
    The Juggernaut is found beaten in Hoboken
    The X-Men found the Juggernaut lying beaten in Hoboken, New Jersey, after something stronger than himself had attacked him in Canada. He could say only one word before he passed out: 'Onslaught'.
  153. May 1995
    Kimberly in the Old West
    Kimberly Hart fell through a hole in time into the Angel Grove of the Old West. She found her way home again.
  154. Summer 1995
    Operation ALICE finds the Night Floors
    The painter Abigail Wright vanished from the Macallistar Building in Manhattan, where a copy of The King in Yellow had been passing from tenant to tenant. Delta Green sent agents under the name Operation ALICE. After dark they found the Night Floors above the building, and beyond them the Night World of the King.
  155. Summer 1995
    The Cooks move to Florida
    Matt Cook's family moved from Angel Grove to Florida. He had been close to Aisha Campbell that spring. He kept the Rangers' secret.
  156. Summer 1995
    Avalon falls from the sky
    Magneto's space station, Avalon, was wrecked and fell from the sky. Piotr Rasputin got the helpless Magneto into an escape pod with him, which came down in Antarctica. There Magneto disappeared.
  157. Summer 1995
    Death of Thunderstrike
    Eric Masterson took up the cursed Bloodaxe to stop a demon that threatened every life on Earth, and the curse took him. Thor came home from the war to face him. Inside his own mind Masterson broke the curse, but the blast that destroyed the axe and the mace Thunderstrike killed him.
  158. Summer 1995
    Dream Nails is blown up
    Kitty Pryde went with Pete Wisdom to find out what had killed his friend Ed Culley, and the trail led to Dream Nails, a Black Air base in the Midlands. There a Black Air telepath, Shrine, all but killed him, before the two of them blew the place up.

Book 5: 1995 to 1996

  1. August 1995
    Rahne Sinclair comes home to Muir Island
    Rahne Sinclair came to Muir Island on leave from X-Factor, and stayed to look after Moira MacTaggert. She joined the Excalibur team that autumn.
  2. August 1995
    Rory Campbell loses a leg
    Rory Campbell lost a leg to a laser on Muir Island, in a struggle with Spoor, the Acolyte he had been trying to treat.
  3. August 1995
    Pete Wisdom joins the team
    After Dream Nails, Kitty Pryde asked Pete Wisdom to join the team, and kissed him.
  4. 12 September 1995
    Ryan Steele goes back to his boyhood
    Strickland, an inventor of Karl Ziktor's, went back through time to do away with Ryan Steele as a boy. Ryan followed him, fought beside his own younger self, and saw his father, though he had to return before he could speak to him.
  5. September 1995
    Rito Revolto destroys the Thunderzords
    Rita's brother Rito Revolto destroyed the Rangers' Thunderzords, and Ninjor gave them new powers.
  6. September 1995
    Piotr Rasputin attacks Pete Wisdom
    Having crossed half the world to find Kitty Pryde, Piotr Rasputin reached Muir Island and saw her kiss Pete Wisdom on the quay. He went for him. Pete burnt his spine with his knives of heat before Brian Braddock and Meggan could stop the fight.
  7. September 1995
    The Ninja coins
    After the Thunderzords were destroyed, Ninjor gave the Rangers new powers, the Ninja coins. Tommy Oliver became the White Ninja Ranger with the Falconzord. Kimberly Hart took the Crane.
  8. 18 September 1995
    Grimlord drains Tyler Steele's knowledge
    Grimlord began to draw Tyler Steele's knowledge of virtual reality into a prism, making the VR Troopers watch. The next day he blew up his dungeon with Ryan Steele inside it. Ryan survived, as did his dog, Jeb.
  9. 20 September 1995
    Ryan Steele rescues his father
    In a cavern where Grimlord was holding him, Ryan Steele freed his father, Tyler Steele, after more than ten years. He brought out Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese as well. Grimlord's lightning destroyed Ryan's Virtualizer, leaving him without his armour.
  10. 21 September 1995
    Grimlord raises the Virtual Dark Fortress
    With the prism Grimlord gave himself new strength, abandoned his ruined dungeon and raised the Virtual Dark Fortress on the far side of the reality barrier. He made new commanders, Despera, Doom Master and Oraclon. In Crossworld City the karate master Tao Chong nursed Tyler Steele back to health.
  11. 22 September 1995
    Ryan Steele's second armour
    Tyler Steele built his son a new suit of blue armour, powered by a crystal that Tao Chong supplied. Ryan Steele wore it for the first time that day, when the three VR Troopers beat Doom Master's army in a quarry.
  12. 2 October 1995
    The Skybase becomes the Troopertron
    Grimlord trapped Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese between the worlds, meaning to send the whole Earth after them. With a command given him by his father, Ryan Steele turned the Troopers' Skybase into the Troopertron, a fighting robot, then broke Grimlord's machine.
  13. 4 October 1995
    Kaitlin Star becomes two
    A mirror machine of Grimlord's had split Kaitlin Star into herself and an evil double. The double turned against Grimlord, Professor Hart joined the two again, and Kaitlin kept the power to become two Troopers at will.
  14. 11 October 1995
    Tyler Steele leaves Crossworld City
    Tyler Steele said goodbye to his son, then went away to secret work on a way of destroying Grimlord's world. He came home that Christmas.
  15. Autumn 1995
    Onslaught gathers the Sentinels
    The word Onslaught turned up in a Sentinel laboratory in Kentucky whose best scientists had vanished, and on the walls of a Sentinel base stripped bare. Through the winter Onslaught's herald, Post, fought the X-Men in his name.
  16. 3 November 1995
    Ryan Steele passes up Grimlord's secret
    Inside a pyramid opened by the archaeologist Nebraska Smith, Ryan Steele came within reach of learning who Grimlord was. He turned back to save Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese instead. Oraclon sealed the doorway behind them.
  17. November 1995
    Kimberly leaves for the Pan Global Games
    Kimberly Hart left Angel Grove to train for the Pan Global Games in Florida. She gave her coin to Katherine Hillard, the new Pink Ranger.
  18. November 1995
    Master Vile's Orb of Doom
    Rita's father, Master Vile, came to the Moon and used the Orb of Doom to turn back time on Earth.
  19. Autumn 1995
    Sabretooth nearly kills Psylocke
    Sabretooth broke out of his cell at Professor Xavier's school and nearly killed Psylocke. A draught from the dark realm of the Crimson Dawn saved her life. It left a red mark over her left eye.
  20. November 1995
    Rahne Sinclair learns who her father is
    After a fire in the Kinross woods across the water from Muir Island, Rahne Sinclair faced the Reverend Craig, who had brought her up, and learnt that he was her father.
  21. November 1995
    Kimberly Hart in France
    Days after leaving for Florida, Kimberly Hart went to St Moineau in France, where her mother and stepfather had vanished. Zack Taylor and Trini Kwan came from the Omega Rangers to help her. With two young people of the town, Serge and his sister, Britt, they beat Goldar, who had a new ally, Verto.
  22. 1996
    John Mason helps retake Alcatraz
    John Mason was brought out of Wolfburg to guide a naval team into Alcatraz, which renegade Marines had seized with rockets of poison gas aimed at San Francisco.
  23. 1996
    Buffy Summers is called as the Slayer
    Buffy Summers, a fifteen-year-old Los Angeles schoolgirl, was called as the Slayer and trained by the Watcher Merrick. After he was killed and she burned down her school gymnasium full of vampires, her parents' marriage broke up.
  24. 1996
    Whistler shows Angel the Slayer
    A demon named Whistler found Angel starving in the streets of New York and showed him the newly called Slayer, Buffy Summers.
  25. c. 1996
    A Prague mob nearly destroys Drusilla
    Shortly before 1997 a mob in Prague nearly destroyed Drusilla, leaving her weakened.
  26. 1996
    Elias Zandi dies
    Elias Zandi died of a massive heart attack, leaving his fortune to the restoration of D'ni with Richard Watson as sole chairman, and his land round the Cleft to his estranged son, Jeff.
  27. 1996
    Bond retakes Alcatraz
    When renegade Marines under General Francis Hummel seized Alcatraz and threatened San Francisco with rockets of VX gas, James Bond was brought out of Wolfburg as the only man who had ever escaped the island, to take a team back in.
  28. February 1996
    The Command Center is destroyed
    A bomb destroyed the Command Center outside Angel Grove.
  29. February 1996
    Black Air hunts Alistaire Stuart
    Black Air hunted Alistaire Stuart, once of the Weird Happenings Organisation. It shot down the aircraft that was bringing him to Muir Island with Kurt Wagner and Meggan, but all three lived. Alistaire told the team that Black Air had begun in the Ministry of Defence, and had taken over his old organisation's work by a vote that the Hellfire Club had bought.
  30. 20 February 1996
    Knighttime stops time
    Grimlord's ally Knighttime betrayed him by stopping time over the whole Earth, which nobody else in the world noticed. Ryan Steele destroyed his machine with Grimlord's help, after which Grimlord kept Knighttime a prisoner.
  31. 21 February 1996
    The raid on the Virtual Dark Fortress
    Skugs stole Galileo, a robot the VR Troopers had built to hold the knowledge of their laboratory. The Troopers followed it into the Virtual Dark Fortress, where Kaitlin Star and J.B. Reese overloaded Oraclon, leaving the fortress crippled. Grimlord was neither beaten nor unmasked, and nothing more is recorded of the VR Troopers.
  32. March 1996
    Brian Braddock joins the Hellfire Club
    Brian Braddock took the seat of Black Bishop in the London Inner Circle of the Hellfire Club, his father's old society, winning it in a duel.
  33. April 1996
    The Machine Empire arrives
    The Machine Empire drove Rita and Zedd from the Moon, and the Rangers took up the powers of the Zeo Crystal.
  34. April 1996
    Black Air takes Douglock
    Black Air harpooned Douglock from a jet and carried him off to be taken apart. The team raided its Acquisition Station in North Yorkshire, where Meggan buried the place in molten rock, but Douglock had already been moved to London.
  35. April 1996
    Tommy Oliver becomes the Red Zeo Ranger
    The Zeo Crystal gave the Rangers new powers. Tommy Oliver became the Red Zeo Ranger, the leader of the Zeo Rangers.
  36. May 1996
    Kimberly's letter
    Kimberly Hart wrote to Tommy Oliver from Florida to tell him that she had met someone else.
  37. May 1996
    Tommy Oliver finds his brother
    Tommy Oliver found the brother he had never known, David Trueheart, whom Sam Trueheart had brought up.
  38. June 1996
    Britanic becomes Captain Britain again
    Brian Braddock, who had called himself Britanic since 1994, took up the name of Captain Britain again.
  39. June 1996
    Charles Xavier is revealed as Onslaught
    The Juggernaut came back to Xavier's school and asked Jean Grey to look into his mind, where she learnt that Charles Xavier was Onslaught. Onslaught shut the Juggernaut inside his own crimson gem, beat the X-Men and left their mansion in ruins.
  40. June 1996
    London burns
    Black Air and the London Inner Circle of the Hellfire Club, which had been buying votes in Parliament, joined Douglock's captive body to a demon that lay beneath London. The city broke out in fires and riots. Then the team stormed Blackwall, Black Air's headquarters, and Amanda Sefton bound the demon.
  41. June 1996
    Onslaught carries off Franklin Richards
    Wearing Xavier's face, Onslaught came to Four Freedoms Plaza for Franklin Richards, the grown son of Reed and Sue Richards. He struck down the Fantastic Four and the Avengers who came to help, then carried Franklin away to use his power.
  42. July 1996
    Moira MacTaggert keeps the team at home
    The X-Men came to Muir Island to tell the team that Charles Xavier had become Onslaught, and Moira MacTaggert forbade it to go to America. That summer the battle with Onslaught in New York ended with the Avengers and the Fantastic Four giving their lives.
  43. Summer 1996
    Thor comes home to fight Onslaught
    Heimdall saw the shadow of Onslaught fall over New York, so Odin called Thor home from the war in the Pegasus galaxy. He came down the Rainbow Bridge to stand with the Avengers and the Fantastic Four.
  44. July 1996
    Alistaire Stuart heads a new department
    The government folded what was left of Black Air and of the Weird Happenings Organisation into a new department under Alistaire Stuart. He offered Rory Campbell its work with mutants.
  45. Summer 1996
    Retired heroes answer the Avengers' call
    With Franklin Richards in Onslaught's hands, the Avengers called on everyone who had ever served. Tony Stark put on the armour one last time. Hank Pym, Janet van Dyne, Clint Barton, Wanda Maximoff, the Vision, Pietro Maximoff and Sam Wilson came out of retirement with him. Spider-Man declined, to go on raising his little daughter.
  46. Summer 1996
    Onslaught's Sentinels seal off Manhattan
    Onslaught's Sentinels came down on Manhattan and sealed it off from the world. He made Franklin Richards raise a black fortress in Central Park, then loosed a pulse that killed every machine in New York and brought down S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Helicarrier.
  47. Summer 1996
    Thor drags Charles Xavier out of Onslaught
    Thor smashed through the crack that Cable, Cyclops and Sue Richards had made in Onslaught's armour, then dragged Charles Xavier out alive. Xavier's telepathy was gone.

Book 6: 1996 to 1997

  1. August 1996
    The heroes give themselves to Onslaught
    In Central Park the Hulk's blow broke Onslaught's armour and tore Bruce Banner from him, leaving Onslaught as pure force. To give it a body that could be struck, Thor, the Fantastic Four, eight more Avengers, Banner and Victor von Doom went into it. The X-Men destroyed it, and the world believed the heroes dead with it.
  2. August 1996
    Franklin Richards makes a world
    As Onslaught came apart, Franklin Richards fell free with Nate Grey. Without knowing it, he caught the fallen and carried them into a world of his own making, held in a small blue ball.
  3. August 1996
    Charles Xavier gives himself up
    Blaming himself for Onslaught, Charles Xavier gave himself up to Valerie Cooper of the American government. He was held in secret, where a man called Bastion questioned him.
  4. 7 September 1996
    The wish at Hillhurst Mansion
    At Hillhurst Mansion, outside Charterville, Drew McCormick, his sister, Jo, and their friend Roland Williams let the phasm Flabber out of a pipe organ. He granted their wish to be the Beetleborgs, the heroes of a comic book. The wish also let the comic's villains, Vexor's Magnavores, out into the town.
  5. 12 September 1996
    Wolfgang Smith comes to Hillhurst
    Wolfgang Smith, a Garou whose mind was gone, turned up in Charterville. The Magnavores tried to recruit him, but he settled at Hillhurst Mansion as the household's pet.
  6. 5 October 1996
    Art Fortunes meets the Beetleborgs
    At a comic convention Vexor tried to have the artist Art Fortunes kidnapped. The Beetleborgs, whom Art had invented, fought the monsters off in front of him.
  7. October 1996
    Jason Lee Scott becomes the Gold Ranger
    Home from Switzerland, Jason Lee Scott took up the Gold Ranger's powers from the injured Trey of Triforia. He had been without powers since January 1995, but these were Triforia's, held in a staff, and did not need the link he had lost. They had been meant for Billy Cranston.
  8. October 1996
    The Mutant Liberation Front raids Muir Island
    The Mutant Liberation Front raided Muir Island for Charles Xavier's secret files on his X-Men. Moira MacTaggert held them off behind a force field, and Dani Moonstar, who had been among the raiders as an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., called the raid off.
  9. Autumn 1996
    The Black Widow stands the Avengers down
    Every hero the Black Widow asked to join a new team of Avengers turned her down, so she stood the team down and went back to the life of a spy.
  10. October 1996
    Kitty Pryde opens Doug Ramsey's grave
    In Salem Center Kitty Pryde phased into the grave of Doug Ramsey and found his bones still in it, so Douglock could not be Doug come back. She said goodbye to her old friend, then introduced herself to Douglock.
  11. Autumn 1996
    The Thunderbolts appear in New York
    A new band of heroes called the Thunderbolts appeared in New York, and the city gave them the Fantastic Four's empty headquarters. They were the Masters of Evil in new masks, under Baron Helmut Zemo.
  12. 19 October 1996
    The Zeo Rangers come to Charterville
    Prince Sprocket of the Machine Empire sent Klank, Orbus and a company of Cogs to Charterville, where Vexor supplied a monster for them to make into a giant. Jason Lee Scott, the Gold Ranger, came with Tommy Oliver's Zeo Rangers to help the Beetleborgs. The Zeo Megazord destroyed the monster, Scrapjaw.
  13. 11 November 1996
    Shadowborg takes the Beetleborgs' powers
    Vexor made Shadowborg, a black Beetleborg, from a piece of the Blue Stinger's armour. Shadowborg beat Drew McCormick, Jo McCormick and Roland Williams, then took their powers.
  14. 13 November 1996
    Josh Baldwin becomes the White Blaster Beetleborg
    Art Fortunes drew a fourth Beetleborg, the White Blaster, which Flabber brought to life for Josh Baldwin, a boy new to Charterville. Josh won back the powers that Shadowborg had taken.
  15. November 1996
    Billy Cranston leaves for Aquitar
    Billy Cranston, ageing at great speed, was made young again in the Eternal Falls on Aquitar. He stayed there with Cestria.
  16. November 1996
    Graydon Creed is shot dead
    Graydon Creed, the founder of the Friends of Humanity, who had run for President of the United States on a promise to lock mutants away, was shot dead at a rally on the eve of the election.
  17. 16 November 1996
    Shadowborg is destroyed
    Drew McCormick, in the Mega Blue armour, destroyed Shadowborg in Charterville. The White Blaster's powers ended with the enemy they had been made to fight, so Josh Baldwin was an ordinary boy again.
  18. 23 November 1996
    The Gold powers go back to Trey
    The Gold Ranger's powers, which were draining Jason Lee Scott's life, went back to Trey of Triforia.
  19. Winter 1996
    The Sullivan murders begin again
    Two and a half years after the suicide of Walter Sullivan, Peter Walls, a schoolboy, was beaten to death in a hotel room in South Ashfield. His body was found six months later, in the summer of 1997, with 12121 cut into it. The police blamed an imitator.
  20. December 1996
    Flabber keeps his first Christmas
    At Hillhurst Mansion the three Beetleborgs helped Flabber to keep Christmas for the first time. The Magnavores tried to steal it, without success.
  21. December 1996
    Piotr Rasputin refuses the Acolytes
    The Acolytes, rebuilding Avalon from its wreckage under Exodus, asked Piotr Rasputin to come back to them. He met two of them under the Australian outback and refused.
  22. 1997
    Riven released
    The game Riven was released.
  23. 1997
    Buffy Summers moves to Sunnydale
    Buffy and her mother moved to Sunnydale, California, a town built over a Hellmouth, where her new Watcher, Rupert Giles, worked as the school librarian.
  24. 1997
    Angel goes to Sunnydale
    Angel went to Sunnydale to help Buffy, and fought beside her against the Master's followers and his own former companions.
  25. 1997
    Jenny Calendar watches Angel for the Kalderash
    Janna of the Kalderash, living as the computer teacher Jenny Calendar, was in Sunnydale on her clan's orders to watch Angel, and her uncle Enyos came to hold her to the task.
  26. 1997
    Spike brings Drusilla to Sunnydale
    William the Bloody brought the weakened Drusilla to Sunnydale, where he met Angel again.
  27. 1997
    The D'ni Restoration Council is founded
    Richard Watson founded the D'ni Restoration Council with Dr Ikuro Kodama, Victor Laxman and Dr Marie Sutherland to survey the city, make it safe, restore its machinery and record what it found.
  28. 1997
    The Goa'uld return through the Stargate
    Apophis, who had been taking over Ra's domains since Ra's death and had heard that Thor was busy elsewhere, broke Ra's ban on Earth and came through the Stargate. His Jaffa killed the soldiers guarding it and carried one off. On Abydos he took Sha'uri and Skaara as hosts. The programme was reopened with teams sent out to other worlds; Jack O'Neill was recalled to command SG-1, and Daniel Jackson returned to Earth.
  29. 1997
    Zanzibar Land declares independence
    Zanzibar Land in Central Asia rose against the Commonwealth of Independent States, beat back its armies with mercenaries gathered from all over the world and declared itself an independent military state with Big Boss behind it.
  30. 1997
    Teal'c turns against Apophis
    Teal'c, Bra'tac's best pupil and his successor as First Prime of Apophis, turned against his master and joined SG-1, and Bra'tac became one of Earth's closest allies and a leader of the free Jaffa.
  31. 1997
    Darla is destroyed in Sunnydale
    Serving the imprisoned Master in Sunnydale, Darla was staked by Angel as she tried to kill the Slayer Buffy Summers.
  32. 1997
    Thor's Hammer destroyed
    On Cimmeria the device called Thor's Hammer seized the Jaffa Teal'c for the larva he carried, and SG-1 destroyed it to free him.
  33. 1997
    Nirrti wipes out Hanka
    To hide her breeding of a perfect host, Nirrti killed the people of Hanka with a plague. Only Cassandra survived.
  34. 1997
    The Supreme Intelligence returns
    The Supreme Intelligence, believed dead since the Avengers executed it in 1992, was found to have survived.
  35. c. 1997
    Joseph Schreiber writes about Wish House
    The journalist Joseph Schreiber published five pages in the magazine Concord about Wish House, the orphanage at Silent Hill. He accused the charity that ran it of being a mask for a cult called the Order.
  36. 1997
    Huey Emmerich drowns himself
    Huey Emmerich drowned himself in his family's swimming pool, nearly drowning his six-year-old stepdaughter, Emma, with him. His son Hal, who was seventeen, left home soon afterwards.
  37. January 1997
    Brian Braddock gives Meggan a ring
    In London, where many people blamed the team for the losses of the year before, Brian Braddock told Meggan that he wanted to be a scientist rather than a hero. He gave her a diamond ring. Then Spiral attacked them in the street for the Dragons of the Crimson Dawn.
  38. February 1997
    The Dragons of the Crimson Dawn take Brian Braddock
    At Piccadilly Circus the three Dragons of the Crimson Dawn carried Brian Braddock off. The same month Amanda Sefton left the team, saying goodbye to nobody but Piotr Rasputin.
  39. Spring 1997
    Divatox kidnaps Jason and Kimberly
    The space pirate Divatox took Jason Lee Scott and Kimberly Hart prisoner, meaning them as sacrifices to Maligore.
  40. March 1997
    Tommy Oliver becomes the Red Turbo Ranger
    With the Turbo powers the Rangers beat Divatox. Tommy Oliver became the Red Turbo Ranger.
  41. 10 April 1997
    Jo McCormick's face is changed
    Wolfgang Smith set off a spell from Flabber's spellbook that changed Jo McCormick's face for good. Flabber laid a second spell over it, so that Charterville went on seeing the girl it knew.
  42. Spring 1997
    Buffy Summers destroys the Master
    In the spring the Master fed on Buffy and left her to drown, and her brief death freed him; revived the same night, she destroyed him, and later ground his bones to powder when his followers tried to raise him.
  43. April 1997
    Zordon returns to Eltar
    Zordon went back to Eltar and left Earth in the keeping of others.
  44. April 1997
    Brian Braddock loses his powers
    Spiral took the team to the Dragons' fortress in Hong Kong. Brian Braddock turned their machine against them while Meggan took in the power that broke loose, so that the rift between the worlds could be sealed. It cost Brian his powers, and he left the team to find himself.
  45. 3 May 1997
    Divatox's wish
    The space pirate Divatox had her nephew, Elgar, carry Flabber off from Hillhurst Mansion, with Vexor's help, to grant her a wish. Her wish for treasure brought a monster out of a comic book with it, which Tommy Oliver's Turbo Rangers destroyed beside the Beetleborgs. That evening the Blue Turbo Ranger, Justin Stewart, made friends with the three.
  46. 20 May 1997
    Nukus is brought to life
    The Magnavores stole a drawing by Les Fortunes from the office of his brother, Art, then brought it to life. It was Nukus, who built the giant Borgslayer from every monster the Beetleborgs had beaten.
  47. 21 May 1997
    The Magnavores go back into the comics
    The Beetleborgs destroyed Borgslayer in Charterville with their lasers fired together. The blast swept Vexor, Typhus, Noxic and Jara back into the comic book they had come from. Nukus, who had planned it, was left without rivals.
  48. June 1997
    A bomb over the Swiss Alps
    A bomb brought down the aeroplane carrying Piotr Rasputin and Meggan over the Swiss Alps. Both lived. Piotr carried Meggan through the snow until the Knights of Wundagore took them in.
  49. c. 1997
    Asgard loses ground without Thor
    With its supreme commander believed dead, Asgard's fleet fought on in the Pegasus galaxy. It lost ships, worlds and Aesir that it could not replace. Asgard told the Goa'uld nothing, so that its bluff should hold.
  50. Summer 1997
    The thirteenth sacrament
    Sharon Blake, whose family belonged to the Order of Silent Hill, went into the woods by Wish House to look for them. She was drowned there, the thirteenth sacrament of the dead Walter Sullivan. Her body was not found until 2001.
  51. Summer 1997
    Archangel frees Psylocke from Kuragari
    Kuragari, the master of the Crimson Dawn, tried to take Psylocke as his bride. Warren Worthington, Archangel, beat him, and paid for her freedom with part of his own life.
  52. Summer 1997
    Delta Green reads the twelfth number
    When Peter Walls was found in South Ashfield with 12121 cut into him, Hollis Tibbetts of Delta Green read it as the police had not, as twelve of twenty-one. He never found out who the other nine were to be.

Book 7: 1997 to 1998

  1. August 1997
    Sari St Hubbins takes Pete Wisdom
    In Kassel, in Germany, Pete Wisdom fell into the hands of Sari St Hubbins, a contract killer and his old lover, who was working for what was left of Black Air. He burnt through his shackles and walked away.
  2. 8 September 1997
    Nukus destroys the Beetleborgs' armour
    In Charterville Nukus beat the Beetleborgs in a single fight, destroying their armour, weapons and powers. He turned Flabber to ice.
  3. 9 September 1997
    The Metallix armour
    The Crustaceans broke Les Fortunes out of Charterville Prison to draw monsters for Nukus. The same day Art Fortunes drew new armour for the Beetleborgs, which Flabber brought to life: Chromium Gold for Drew McCormick, Titanium Silver for Roland Williams, Platinum Purple for Jo McCormick.
  4. September 1997
    Tommy Oliver passes on the Red Turbo powers
    When he finished school, Tommy Oliver handed the Red Turbo powers to T.J. Johnson.
  5. 20 September 1997
    The changelings
    Divatox and Nukus made changelings that wrecked the park at Angel Grove as false Beetleborgs, while others wrecked Charterville as false Power Rangers. The two teams fought briefly until Justin Stewart stopped them. They joined the Turbozords to the Beetleborgs' Battle Vehicles to destroy the changelings.
  6. October 1997
    Moira MacTaggert goes into quarantine
    Moira MacTaggert, who had found that the Legacy Virus could now pass through the air to any mutant, sealed herself into quarantine in her laboratory on Muir Island. Rahne Sinclair leapt in after her as the doors closed.
  7. Autumn 1997
    Ashema comes to Franklin Richards
    As the weather went wrong all over the Earth, Ashema the Listener, a Celestial in the shape of a woman, came to Franklin Richards. She told him that his family was alive in the world in his blue ball, and that the Celestials meant him to choose between the two Earths.
  8. Autumn 1997
    The fallen of Onslaught come home
    Ashema took Franklin Richards into his world, where the fallen learnt who they were. They came home through the Negative Zone in a ship that Reed Richards, Tony Stark and Victor von Doom had built, each of them exactly as old as on the day they fell.
  9. Autumn 1997
    Doom is left in Franklin's world
    On the way home Victor von Doom tried to seize Franklin Richards's power. Thor stopped him with Reed Richards, then put him off the ship before it crossed into this world.
  10. Autumn 1997
    The Hulk and Bruce Banner are made one
    When the fallen came home, the Hulk and Bruce Banner, parted since Central Park, were joined into one being again.
  11. Autumn 1997
    Tony Stark retires again
    Home from Franklin's world, Tony Stark took off the armour he had put on one last time against Onslaught, and went back to his retirement. James Rhodes kept War Machine.
  12. 25 October 1997
    Divatox steals Les Fortunes
    Divatox carried Les Fortunes off to Angel Grove to draw monsters for her, not knowing that only Nukus could bring his drawings to life. Nukus came to fetch him, with the Beetleborgs behind him. The Turbo Rangers destroyed the one monster that came of it, Cutlass, with the Rescue Megazord.
  13. 7 November 1997
    The hunt for the Lost Comic
    Les Fortunes led the Crustaceans to the comic that he had made as a boy with his brother, Art, who took the Beetleborgs after them. Its Astral Coins called up the four Astralborgs to help the Beetleborgs. They also called up the four Mantrons, who served Nukus.
  14. Autumn 1997
    Drusilla is restored with her sire's blood
    Late in the year Drusilla was restored to strength in Sunnydale with the blood of her own sire, Angel.
  15. November 1997
    Dark Specter captures Zordon
    Eltar fell to evil, and Dark Specter took Zordon prisoner.
  16. November 1997
    The Sidri in Venice
    Black Air handed Kurt Wagner over to the Sidri, alien hunters whom he had once helped to save, and the team followed them to their ship beneath the Grand Canal in Venice. Douglock's Phalanx parts healed the Sidri, who left for space. Douglock declared himself his own person at last.
  17. 26 November 1997
    Roboborg is summoned
    Drew McCormick brought the Astral Sword together with all eight Astral Coins, which summoned the giant Roboborg. Roboborg sent the Mantrons back into the Lost Comic.
  18. December 1997
    The Avengers come together again
    A little over a year after the Black Widow had stood them down, the Avengers came together again.
  19. c. 1997
    Thor returns to Asgard's fleet
    Brought home by Franklin Richards with the other fallen heroes, Thor went straight back to the war in the Pegasus galaxy. He found Asgard losing it.
  20. 1998
    Angelus kills Jenny Calendar and Enyos
    After the curse broke, Angelus killed Janna, the Kalderash woman known as Jenny Calendar, and her uncle Enyos; her translation of the ritual survived her.
  21. 1998
    Buffy sends Angel into a hell dimension
    Buffy Summers was forced to send Angel into a hell dimension.
  22. 1998
    Apophis's motherships destroyed above Earth
    Apophis and Klorel brought two motherships against Earth. SG-1 and Bra'tac destroyed both. Apophis and Klorel escaped through the Stargate on board.
  23. January 1998
    Nightmare traps the team in dreams
    A fortnight after New Year the creatures called Bamfs ran riot on Muir Island and carried off Lockheed the dragon for Nightmare, a demon of dreams. He trapped the team in their worst dreams until Pete Wisdom broke out and beat him.
  24. 19 January 1998
    Angel's curse breaks
    On Buffy's seventeenth birthday Angel knew a moment of true happiness with her, the Kalderash curse broke, and Angelus returned and turned on everyone who had trusted Angel.
  25. 9 February 1998
    The Mega Spectra armour
    A machine built by Les Fortunes made Nukus far stronger. Roboborg answered by joining the Beetleborgs' first powers to their Metallix armour, which gave them the winged Mega Spectra armour.
  26. 10 February 1998
    Boron is summoned
    Les Fortunes drew the Astral Axe, which summoned Boron, a giant made to match Roboborg. Boron obeyed whoever held the Axe.
  27. 16 February 1998
    Roboborg fights Boron on the Moon
    Roboborg fought Boron on the Moon while the Beetleborgs fought the Crustaceans in Charterville.
  28. 21 February 1998
    Ecliptor takes the Astral Axe
    Astronema sent Ecliptor to the Charterville cemetery with her Quantrons to take the Astral Axe from Nukus. The Space Rangers followed him. Andros, the Red Space Ranger, pulled the Axe out of his hand with the help of Drew McCormick, but it went back to the Crustaceans.
  29. 2 March 1998
    Repgillian is destroyed
    Nukus loosed his worst monster, Repgillian, which emptied Urbana City. Roland Williams took the Astral Axe from the Crustaceans, so that Boron changed sides. Roboborg, Boron and the Beetleborgs destroyed the monster together.
  30. 2 March 1998
    Les Fortunes goes back to prison
    Les Fortunes walked back into Charterville Prison of his own accord, which left Nukus with nobody to draw monsters for him. Nukus was still at large, but the Beetleborgs had both giants.
  31. March 1998
    Pete Wisdom leaves Muir Island
    Pete Wisdom's love affair with Kitty Pryde ended, and he left Muir Island on a fishing boat while she watched from a window.
  32. Spring 1998
    Willow Rosenberg restores Angel's soul
    In the spring the witch Willow Rosenberg used Jenny Calendar's translation to restore the Kalderash curse.
  33. April 1998
    Legion in Jerusalem
    At the asking of Sabra, the Israeli heroine, the team went to Jerusalem, where three of the personalities of David Haller, called Legion, had seized the ground by the Wailing Wall. Meggan calmed them until they faded away.
  34. Spring 1998
    Amanda Sefton takes Limbo
    In Limbo Amanda Sefton and Kurt Wagner beat Belasco, who had held her mother prisoner there. Amanda stayed to rule it, so that its demons could not use its stepping discs to reach the Earth.
  35. May 1998
    Psylocke cages the Shadow King
    The Shadow King tricked Psylocke into a blow that silenced every telepath on Earth. She caught him in turn, but to keep him caged she could use her telepathy for nothing else.
  36. July 1998
    Heru'ur driven from Cimmeria again
    Heru'ur invaded Cimmeria after Thor's Hammer fell. Thor came himself in his ship, the Biliskner, and met SG-1 for the first time. Heru'ur escaped through the gate, leaving his army behind.

After the saga

  1. August 1998
    The Mimic in Peru
    In Peru the team broke into a base of Operation: Zero Tolerance, Bastion's campaign against mutants, hoping to find Charles Xavier there. They found the Mimic instead, a mutant who copies the powers of others.
  2. August 1998
    Brian Braddock comes home
    Brian Braddock came home to Muir Island on a trawler at dusk, still without his powers. Meggan had waited on the quay every morning for a week. He asked her to marry him the next week.
  3. August 1998
    Feron attacks Braddock Manor
    On the eve of the wedding Feron, lost since 1993, attacked Braddock Manor as the new Executioner of the Crazy Gang during Brian Braddock's last night as a bachelor.
  4. 19 August 1998
    Brian Braddock marries Meggan in Otherworld
    Brian Braddock married Meggan in a chapel in Otherworld, with Roma of Otherworld to marry them and Kurt Wagner as his best man. Gandalf, whom Brian knew as Merlin, watched the feast.
  5. 19 August 1998
    The Excalibur team breaks up
    At the wedding feast Kurt Wagner, Kitty Pryde and Piotr Rasputin said that they were going home to the X-Men. With that the Excalibur team came to an end.
  6. 21 November 1998
    Zordon gives up his form
    Zordon gave up the form he had worn for ten thousand years, and his light went out across the universe. It destroyed the armies of evil and purified Rita Repulsa and Lord Zedd.
  7. 1999
    The Demon Castle War destroys Dracula for good
    When Dracula's castle rose for the last time, Julius Belmont, with Alucard beside him, destroyed Dracula so completely that he could not return, and the castle was sealed inside a solar eclipse. Julius lost his memory in the struggle.
  8. 1999
    Angel sets up as a detective in Los Angeles
    Angel moved to Los Angeles and set up as a private detective, helping those who came to him in trouble.
  9. 1999
    Spike is implanted with a chip
    A secret military project in Sunnydale implanted a device in William the Bloody's head that stopped him from harming people.
  10. 1999
    Michael Engberg joins the D'ni Restoration Council
    Michael Engberg joined the D'ni Restoration Council.
  11. 1999
    The Society of Leopold wakes Christof
    The Society of Leopold excavated Vyšehrad and carried Christof Romuald to London, where he woke after more than eight hundred years.
  12. 1999
    Christof destroys Vukodlak
    In the Cathedral of Flesh in New York Christof Romuald destroyed the Tzimisce Methuselah Vukodlak, and Embraced Anezka, the nun he had loved in Prague, so that she would not die.
  13. 1999
    Sokar demands Apophis from Earth
    Sokar fired a beam through the wormhole at Earth's iris until the body of Apophis, who had died at the base, was sent to him.
  14. 1999
    The destruction of Netu
    A Tok'ra bomb destroyed Sokar's prison moon and his ship, killing Sokar. Apophis escaped and took over his forces.
  15. 1999
    The Kilaaks seize Monsterland
    The Kilaaks, an alien people with a base on the Moon, took control of the monsters kept on Monsterland in the Ogasawara Islands. Godzilla attacked New York, Rodan Moscow, Mothra Beijing, Manda London, with Gorosaurus in Paris; four of them then destroyed Tokyo. It happened in the year of the Demon Castle War, which went almost unnoticed beside it.
  16. 1999
    Zanzibar Land seizes Dr Marv
    In a year when the world was running short of oil, the Czech biologist Dr Kio Marv revealed OILIX, a tiny organism that made petroleum. Soldiers of Zanzibar Land kidnapped him on his way to America. Zanzibar Land had already armed itself with nuclear warheads taken from disposal sites.
  17. 1999
    King Ghidorah dies at Mount Fuji
    Captain Katsuo Yamabe's ship Moonlight SY-3 broke the Kilaaks' control from their base on the Moon. The freed monsters marched on the Kilaak stronghold at Mount Fuji, where ten of them killed King Ghidorah. Godzilla broke the stronghold open, which let in the cold that the Kilaaks could not bear.
  18. 1999
    Dracula's castle rises for the last time
    Dracula rose in 1999, fifty-five years after his last destruction. Julius Belmont led the hunters who went against him, with Alucard at his side.
  19. 1999
    The Hakuba priests seal the castle in an eclipse
    Priests of the Hakuba shrine in Japan worked the rite that shut Dracula's castle inside the eclipse of the sun that crossed Europe on 11 August. The castle was the seat of his power, so once he was cut off from it he could be destroyed for good.
  20. 1999
    Three claimants are born as Dracula dies
    Three children were born on the day of Dracula's destruction who would one day claim his inheritance: Graham Jones, Dario Bossi and Dmitrii Blinov. None of them was his heir.
  21. 1999
    The prophecy of 2035
    Dracula's power did not die with him. A prophecy held that in 2035 a new master would come to his castle, to inherit it all.
  22. January 1999
    The Asgard free O'Neill of the Ancients' knowledge
    Jack O'Neill, whose head an Ancient repository had filled with more knowledge than any man could carry, built a device that took him through the Stargate to Othala, the chief of Asgard's worlds in the Pegasus galaxy. The Asgard took the knowledge out of his head. Thor told him that the people of Earth were on their way to becoming a fifth great race.
  23. February 1999
    Terra Venture leaves Earth
    Terra Venture, a space colony built from Promethea's designs with the Global Space Alliance, left Earth to look for a new world. The Galaxy Rangers defended it on the way.
  24. July 1999
    Earth is added to the Protected Planets Treaty
    Thor himself opened talks on Earth with Cronus, Nirrti and Lord Yu. Nirrti's attempt to wreck them failed, and Earth was put under the treaty.
  25. 24 December 1999
    Solid Snake defeats Big Boss at Zanzibar Land
    On Christmas Eve Colonel Roy Campbell of FOXHOUND sent the retired Solid Snake alone into Zanzibar Land to bring out Dr Marv, on Operation Intrude F014. Marv was already dead, tortured by Dr Madnar, the builder of Metal Gear, who had changed sides. Snake destroyed the new Metal Gear D. Then, with every weapon gone, he burnt the real Big Boss down with a lighter held to an aerosol can.
  26. 24 December 1999
    Death of Gray Fox
    Gray Fox had gone over to Big Boss after Outer Heaven. At Zanzibar Land he piloted Metal Gear D, killing Gustava Heffner, the woman he loved, with one of its missiles. When Solid Snake had destroyed the machine, the two friends fought with their bare hands in a minefield, where Gray Fox fell.
  27. 1999
    The Patriots keep Big Boss alive
    Big Boss, burnt almost to death by his son at Zanzibar Land, was carried off by the Patriots, who kept him in an endless sleep. Dr Clark took the body of Gray Fox too, which she fitted with an armoured skeleton for her experiments.
  28. 2000
    The monks make the Key into Dawn Summers
    When the hell-god Glory came hunting the Key, the last of the monks who guarded it made it into a living girl of about fourteen, Dawn, sent to Buffy Summers as her sister, and altered everyone's memories so that she seemed always to have been there.
  29. 2000
    Wolfram and Hart raise Darla
    The Los Angeles law firm Wolfram and Hart raised Darla as a mortal woman dying once more of her old disease, and Drusilla sired her again.
  30. c. 2000
    George Sears reaches the presidency
    By the start of the new century Solidus Snake, under the name George Sears, had risen in Washington as far as the presidency of the United States.
  31. 2000
    Death of Heru'ur
    Apophis lured Heru'ur to the Tobin minefield to talk of an alliance, destroyed his ship with a cloaked fleet and took his forces.
  32. 2000s
    Kouga Saejima becomes Garo
    More than ten years after his father's death, Kouga Saejima drew the Garoken from the ground. He took up the title of Garo under the Eastern Watchdog of the Makai Order.
  33. 2000
    SaucerWatch collapses
    In 2000 SaucerWatch, a respectable American society for the study of flying saucers, collapsed under lawsuits and a criminal charge against its leader, Denton Schaeffer. NRO DELTA had planted the evidence.
  34. 2000s
    Delta Green breaks the Fate
    In the 2000s Nyarlathotep stopped answering the Fate of New York, and its master, Stephen Alzis, vanished. Delta Green killed most of the order's Lords, and the survivors fled with what they could carry of its holdings.
  35. c. 2000
    Liquid Snake leads FOXHOUND
    After Zanzibar Land Roy Campbell retired, while Solid Snake went to live alone in Alaska with his sled dogs. Liquid Snake joined FOXHOUND, becoming its field commander. Revolver Ocelot had been recruited the year before.
  36. March 2000
    The Replicators take the Biliskner
    Replicators overran Thor's ship, the Biliskner, which came to Earth with Thor badly hurt aboard. SG-1 sent it down to burn up over the Pacific, then escaped through a Stargate they had beamed aboard. Thor lived.
  37. June 2000
    The O'Neill is destroyed with a Replicator swarm
    A Replicator that had survived the Biliskner's fall seized a Russian submarine, which had to be destroyed. In the Pegasus galaxy Samantha Carter used Asgard's newest warship, the O'Neill, as bait, and it blew itself up with a great swarm of Replicators inside.
  38. 16 September 2000
    Harry Mason is murdered
    Claudia Wolf, a priestess of the Order of Silent Hill, had traced the daughter of Harry Mason through the detective Douglas Cartland. While the girl was at a shopping centre, Claudia had Harry killed in his own home by one of the Order's creatures, so that she would come to Silent Hill full of hatred.
  39. 17 September 2000
    Heather Mason returns to Silent Hill
    Heather Mason, four days past her seventeenth birthday, reached Silent Hill with Douglas Cartland. At Brookhaven Hospital she killed Leonard Wolf, the father of Claudia Wolf, for the Seal of Metatron. On a carousel she fought the memory of Alessa Gillespie, whom she had once been.
  40. 17 September 2000
    The Order's god is killed a second time
    That night, in the church of the Order of Silent Hill, Claudia Wolf stabbed the priest Vincent Smith, and Heather Mason drove the unborn god out of her own body with aglaophotis. Claudia swallowed it, bore it and died. Heather killed what was born, then took back her first name, Cheryl.
  41. 2001
    Myst III released
    Myst III was released.
  42. 2001
    Glory opens the way with Dawn's blood
    Glory used Dawn Summers's blood to open the way between worlds.
  43. 2001
    Buffy Summers dies to save Dawn
    Buffy, who shared her sister's blood, closed the way between worlds by dying in Dawn's place, and was brought back.
  44. 2001
    Daniel Holtz wakes in Los Angeles
    Daniel Holtz woke from his long sleep in Los Angeles to find Angelus become Angel, and still meant to have his revenge.
  45. 2001
    Darla dies giving birth to Connor
    Darla bore Angel's son Connor in an alley in Los Angeles and died to give him life.
  46. 2001
    Death of Cronus
    On Juna, Cronus was shot by a machine copy of Teal'c, and SG-1 took his mothership.
  47. 2001
    Death of Apophis
    Flung into another galaxy by the supernova at Vorash, Apophis lost his ship to the Replicators. The ship he took from SG-1 fell on Delmak with him aboard.
  48. 2001
    The Karotechia is broken
    In 2001 Delta Green, Majestic 12 and GRU SV-8 worked together for the only time known, in an operation that broke the Karotechia.
  49. 14 June 2001
    Joseph Schreiber finds Walter Sullivan's grave empty
    Joseph Schreiber, the tenant of Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights, had been investigating the Sullivan murders since April. His diary for this day records that he had opened the grave of Walter Sullivan at Silent Hill. The coffin was empty, with 11/21 scratched on it.
  50. Summer 2001
    The fourteenth sacrament
    Toby Archbolt, a priest of the Holy Mother sect of the Order of Silent Hill, was pushed off a cliff in Mexico, seven years after the death of Walter Sullivan.
  51. July 2001
    The sun of K'Tau dims
    SG-1's wormhole damaged the sun of K'Tau, a protected world whose people pray to Freyr. Freyr and the Asgard High Council would not mend it, since using Asgard's science there would have broken the Protected Planets Treaty. The sun cleared in the end, though nobody could say quite why.
  52. 2 August 2001
    Joseph Schreiber is shut in Room 302
    Joseph Schreiber wrote that the walls of Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights were covered in blood and rust. He could not get out. On 7 August, in his last dated entry, he listed himself as the fifteenth sacrament.
  53. Autumn 2001
    Delta Green divides into the Program and the Outlaws
    After the attacks of 11 September Delta Green was brought back into the government with a budget, under cover of the war on terror, and Majestic 12 was folded into it. The old agents who refused to join carried on without leave as the Outlaws.
  54. October 2001
    Majestic 12 is taken over from within
    After the attacks of 11 September 2001 Majestic 12 was disgraced, then taken over from within, and what remained of it was folded into the newly sanctioned Delta Green. A company called March Industries took many of its assets.
  55. Winter 2001
    Joseph Schreiber dies in Room 302
    Joseph Schreiber died shut inside Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights, seven and a half years after the death of Walter Sullivan. He left his diary for the next tenant.
  56. 2002
    Spike wins back a soul
    William the Bloody went to Africa and won back a soul.
  57. 2002
    The System Lords take Anubis back
    Seven System Lords met under truce in the Hasara system. Osiris came for Anubis, and all but Yu voted to take him back. Daniel Jackson, there to poison them for the Tok'ra, held back.
  58. 2002
    Svarog's attack on Latona
    Svarog invaded Latona. The Sentinel, restarted when Grieves of the NID joined himself to it, swept his Jaffa away.
  59. 2002
    The Red Rangers on the Moon
    Tommy Oliver led ten Red Rangers against the last generals of the Machine Empire, who were digging Lord Zedd's war machine Serpentera out of the Moon.
  60. 2002
    Earth launches its first warship
    Earth's Stargate programme launched the Prometheus, its first starship, built in secret under the Nevada desert from captured Goa'uld engines. It was crude, ruinously expensive and seldom able to go far.
  61. Spring 2002
    The Foundation surveys Room 302
    On the trail of the missing journalist Joseph Schreiber, the SCP Foundation measured Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights twice and left a D-class to sleep there for a week. It found nothing, and it closed its file on the flat. Henry Townshend moved in that summer.
  62. April 2002
    SG-1 finds Reese
    On a dead world SG-1 found Reese, the android who had made the Replicators, and brought her to Earth. When she was crossed she set them loose in Stargate Command. Jack O'Neill shot her, and they fell still.
  63. May 2002
    Anubis takes Thor prisoner
    Over Adara II Anubis, half-ascended through the Devil's trick, captured Thor and tried to read his mind. Thor turned the link against him, and SG-1 freed him.
  64. June 2002
    SG-1 brings Thor's mind home
    Anubis's ship came to Earth empty of Goa'uld, with Thor's mind caught in its computer, then fell into the northern Pacific. SG-1 brought out the crystals that held his mind, and Asgard restored him to his body.
  65. Summer 2002
    Henry Townshend moves into Room 302
    Henry Townshend, a photographer, took Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights, six months after Joseph Schreiber had vanished from it.
  66. August 2002
    The Replicators overrun Othala
    Thor came aboard Earth's first warship, the Prometheus, to say that the Replicators had overrun Othala, the chief of Asgard's worlds in the Pegasus galaxy.
  67. 2003
    Uru released
    Uru was released.
  68. 2003
    Sunnydale is destroyed
    Buffy Summers led the fight in which the town of Sunnydale collapsed into the ground over its Hellmouth and was destroyed; Dawn stayed with her sister afterwards.
  69. 2003
    Spike dies saving the world
    William the Bloody died to save the world when Sunnydale was destroyed, though he did not stay dead.
  70. 2003
    Anubis destroys Abydos
    With the six Eyes of the Goa'uld, Anubis destroyed the System Lords' fleet, then Abydos.
  71. 2003
    Death of Nirrti
    Wodan, one of the people she had experimented on, broke Nirrti's neck.
  72. 2003
    Gray Fox kills Dr Clark
    Gray Fox broke out of the laboratory, killing Dr Clark, the former Para-Medic, who had led Les Enfants Terribles. Her death was recorded as an accident. Naomi Hunter, his foster-sister, took charge of FOXHOUND's medical staff.
  73. January 2003
    The trap on Hala
    Asgard had lured the Replicators to Hala, its first world in the Pegasus galaxy, to shut them inside a field where time ran slow. They turned the field round and took human form in the centuries it gave them. SG-1 set it right, leaving them trapped.
  74. February 2003
    Thor speaks for SG-1 at the Pentagon
    When the Stargate was revealed to the governments of Britain, France and China, Thor appeared before their envoys at the Pentagon. He told them that Asgard wished the gate to stay where it was. It stayed there.
  75. Summer 2003
    An Outlaw burns the White Claudia again
    When the Program sent for White Claudia from Silent Hill to study, Hollis Tibbetts, by then one of the Outlaws, burnt the beds a week before its people came. They took seed from the new growth the following summer.
  76. 2004
    Myst IV released
    Myst IV was released.
  77. 2004
    Death of Moloc
    Missiles sent through the Stargate from Earth killed Moloc. Ba'al took his domain.
  78. 2004
    The System Lords' embassy to Earth
    Camulus, Amaterasu and Yu came to Stargate Command to ask for help against Ba'al. Camulus stayed behind and asked for asylum.
  79. 2004
    Camulus handed to Ba'al
    After Ba'al falsely claimed to hold SG-1, Earth sent Camulus to him carrying a dead power source.
  80. 2004
    Tommy Oliver becomes the Black Dino Ranger
    In Reefside, California, Dr Tommy Oliver became the Black Dino Ranger. In the last battle his team gave up their powers to defeat Mesogog.
  81. 12 June 2004
    Henry Townshend is sealed in Room 302
    Henry Townshend woke to find the door of Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights chained from the inside. For five days nobody outside could hear him.
  82. 17 June 2004
    A hole opens in Room 302
    A hole opened in the wall of Henry Townshend's bathroom, leading into the world of the dead Walter Sullivan. There he saw Cynthia Velasquez stabbed to death in a railway station, the sixteenth sacrament. Her body was found in South Ashfield soon afterwards.
  83. 20 June 2004
    Three more sacraments in three days
    Henry Townshend saw three more people die in the world of Walter Sullivan: Jasper Gein, burnt at Wish House on 18 June; Andrew DeSalvo, drowned in the Water Prison on 19 June; Richard Braintree, electrocuted on 20 June.
  84. 21 June 2004
    Walter Sullivan attacks Eileen Galvin
    That evening Walter Sullivan beat Eileen Galvin, of Room 303, who was to be his twentieth sacrament. The child he had once been stopped him from killing her. Henry Townshend found her in the dark copy of St Jerome's Hospital.
  85. 22 June 2004
    Henry Townshend kills Walter Sullivan
    Guided by the ghost of Joseph Schreiber, Henry Townshend found the body of Walter Sullivan hidden in Room 302 of South Ashfield Heights. With the cord that Frank Sunderland had kept since 1970, he made Walter mortal again and killed him. Eileen Galvin lived, and the 21 Sacraments were never completed.
  86. Summer 2004
    The Foundation recovers Walter Sullivan's body
    Posing as officials of the state, Mobile Task Force Upsilon-6 took Walter Sullivan's body from the coroner at South Ashfield, ten years after losing it. The Foundation reclassed Silent Hill as Euclid, on the ground that the town contains itself.
  87. July 2004
    The Replicators come to Orilla
    Escaping Hala as Asgard crushed its sun into a black hole, the Replicators came to Orilla, Asgard's new chief world. Thor woke Jack O'Neill from his frozen sleep in the Antarctic. The weapon O'Neill built broke the Replicators on Orilla apart, though Fifth got away.
  88. 2005
    Murder of Master Miller
    Liquid Snake murdered Kazuhira Miller, FOXHOUND's old survival instructor, at his home in Alaska. In the days that followed he used Miller's name to advise Solid Snake by radio, steering him into arming Metal Gear REX.
  89. 2005
    Myst V released
    Myst V was released.
  90. 2005
    The Shadow Moses incident
    Renegades of FOXHOUND under Liquid Snake seized the nuclear disposal site on Shadow Moses Island in Alaska, with the walking tank Metal Gear REX. They demanded the body of Big Boss within twenty-four hours. Roy Campbell brought Solid Snake out of retirement to go in alone. With the help of REX's designer, Hal Emmerich, Snake destroyed the machine. Liquid told him that they were twin clones of Big Boss, then died.
  91. 2005
    Oma Desala takes Anubis
    As Anubis prepared to fire the weapon on Dakara, Oma Desala drew him into a struggle without end.
  92. 2005
    Ba'al's war on the System Lords
    The Tok'ra reported that Bastet and Olokun were dead and Morrigan had surrendered, while Yu and Amaterasu gathered for a last stand.
  93. 2005
    The Ori are found
    Daniel Jackson and Vala Mal Doran found the galaxy of the Ori, using a device of the Ancients. Soon afterwards the Ori's Priors began coming through the Stargates into this one.
  94. 2005
    Death squads strike the DeMonte clan
    After Hurricane Katrina in 2005, death squads of Delta Green's outlaw faction fell on the DeMonte clan, a family of ghouls in New Orleans.
  95. 2005
    The first BC-304 battlecruisers
    The Stargate programme launched the Daedalus, the first of the larger BC-304 battlecruisers, and soon afterwards the Odyssey. Their drives filled much of their hulls, and without Asgard's help none of them ever crossed from one galaxy to another.
  96. 2005
    FOXDIE
    Unknown to himself, Solid Snake had been injected by Dr Naomi Hunter with FOXDIE, a virus made to kill chosen people. It stopped the hearts of the ArmsTech president, of the impostor Decoy Octopus and finally of Liquid Snake. The real head of DARPA, Donald Anderson, once called Sigint, had already died under Ocelot's torture.
  97. 2005
    The Cyborg Ninja
    Gray Fox reappeared at Shadow Moses in his armoured skeleton, half mad. He cut off Revolver Ocelot's right hand. He guided Snake by radio under the name Deepthroat, then died under the foot of Metal Gear REX while breaking its radar for him.
  98. 2005
    Meryl Silverburgh at Shadow Moses
    Meryl Silverburgh, aged eighteen, refused to join the mutiny on her first posting. The psychic Psycho Mantis, formerly of the KGB, whose powers were real, turned her against Snake by force of mind until Snake freed her. Later the sniper called Sniper Wolf shot her down. She left the island alive with Snake.
  99. 2005
    President Sears stops the bombing
    The Secretary of Defence, Jim Houseman, ordered Shadow Moses bombed to bury the evidence, with Snake still there. President George Sears, who was Solidus Snake, stopped the bombing. The scandal cost him his office all the same. The Patriots replaced him with James Johnson.
  100. 2005
    Ocelot sells Metal Gear
    Revolver Ocelot, the only renegade to survive, sold the design of Metal Gear REX round the world. In Lyon a surgeon gave him the dead Liquid Snake's right arm in place of the hand he had lost. After that Liquid's voice spoke through him from time to time.
  101. 2005
    Philanthropy is founded
    Solid Snake joined Hal Emmerich, REX's repentant designer, to found Philanthropy, a small body recognised by the United Nations. Its work was to find the new Metal Gears, then expose them. An account of Shadow Moses by their colleague Nastasha Romanenko was widely read.
  102. January 2005
    A Replicator in Carter's likeness takes command
    A Replicator that Fifth had made in the likeness of Samantha Carter came to the Tau'ri as a friend. She made the Replicators proof against O'Neill's weapon, then destroyed Fifth and took his place.
  103. February 2005
    Death of Lord Yu
    A Replicator in Samantha Carter's likeness killed Yu at the Hasara space station.
  104. March 2005
    The Replicators are destroyed
    The Replicators invaded this galaxy and boarded Thor's ship, the Daniel Jackson. Samantha Carter, her father, Jacob, with Ba'al turned the Ancients' weapon on Dakara against them, and every Replicator in the galaxy fell apart.
  105. 7 October 2005
    Kouga Saejima spares Kaoru Mitsuki
    The Golden Knight Kouga Saejima destroyed the Horror Anglay at an art gallery in Japan, where its blood stained the painter Kaoru Mitsuki. The law of the Makai Order required him to kill her. He spared her, though she had a hundred days to live.
  106. 18 November 2005
    Garo fights Zero
    Rei Suzumura, the Silver Fanged Knight Zero, believed that Garo had murdered his foster father, Douji, with his betrothed, Shizuka. He fought Kouga Saejima in armour through the streets, where Kouga beat him.
  107. 2006
    A Prior's plague reaches Earth
    A plague spread by one of the Ori's Priors reached Earth, and a cure was found only just in time.
  108. 2006
    Birth of Adria
    Adria, the Orici, was born to Vala Mal Doran by the power of the Ori alone, with no father, and grew to a woman in a matter of days.
  109. 2006
    The Ori fleet comes through
    The Priors opened a great gate, large enough for warships. The Ori's fleet came through it, breaking the ships of Earth, the free Jaffa and Asgard that stood against it. Then its crusade began.
  110. 2006
    The Mystic Mother
    The woman who had been Rita Repulsa was known as the Mystic Mother.
  111. February 2006
    The priest Amon is murdered
    Amon, the Makai Priest who had made the Madou Ring Zaruba, was murdered. His pupil Jabi, who was blamed, took twelve sealed Horror blades from the Eastern Watchdog to send them back to the Makai herself. The Watchdog's servant Kodama struck her down, leaving only her brush.
  112. 24 February 2006
    Kouga cures Kaoru of the Horror's blood
    Kouga Saejima entered the Crimson Forest of the Makai, fought the dragon that guards the fruit of Barankas, then brought the fruit back to Kaoru Mitsuki before her hundred days ran out.
  113. March 2006
    Barago is unmasked
    Kaoru Mitsuki's counsellor, Karune Ryuzaki, proved to be Barago, the knight Kiba, the murderer of Taiga Saejima, Douji and Shizuka. The three priestesses of the Eastern Watchdog were his allies. He carried Kaoru off to be Messiah's gate.
  114. 31 March 2006
    Kouga Saejima defeats Messiah
    Messiah, the mother of the Horrors, entered the world through Kaoru Mitsuki, having devoured Barago. Kouga Saejima struck her down in golden armour winged by Kaoru's painting, then destroyed the empty armour of Kiba. The ring Zaruba crumbled in that fight, while Rei Suzumura killed Gulm of the Eastern Watchdog.
  115. December 2006
    Kouga destroys Legules at Kantai
    Kouga Saejima woke the priestess Jabi from a Makai Tree at Kantai, the priests' village in the north of Japan. With Rei Suzumura and Tsubasa Yamagatana he defended the rite of the Midnight Sun against the ancient Horror Legules, whom he destroyed with the Phosphorus Arrow.
  116. 2007
    The Ori are cast down
    A weapon made long ago by one of the Ancients broke the power of the Ori and drove them out into the outer darkness with Melkor. Adria rose to a higher plane and took up what was left of their power.
  117. c. 2007
    Adam of Ventara lets Xaviax in
    Xaviax came to the Dragon Knight, Adam of Ventara, as Paragon, a friend of the lost Eubulon. He offered to free him from his Advent Deck. Adam of Ventara led him to the base where the Kamen Riders slept.
  118. c. 2007
    The Ventaran Riders are vented
    Xaviax vented the Kamen Riders of Ventara as they lay in suspended animation, which sent them into the Advent Void. He took their Advent Decks. Len, the Wing Knight, got away to Earth, while Kase, the Rider called Siren, survived without Xaviax knowing it.
  119. c. 2007
    Xaviax empties Ventara
    With its guardians gone, Xaviax carried off the whole people of Ventara to Karsh as slaves. He shut Adam of Ventara up with Sarah, the woman he loved, in a false Ventara of his own making.
  120. 30 April 2007
    Jack meets Rosemary
    The young soldier Jack, later called Raiden, met Rosemary, an Army analyst, outside Federal Hall in New York. The Patriots had set her to watch him. She fell in love with him.
  121. June 2007
    Asgard withdraws from the stars
    Too few Aesir were left among the stars to hold Asgard's worlds there, so the High Council gave the Tau'ri the lore of the Aesir, though none of Asgard's machines. When the Ori's warships came, Asgard destroyed Orilla, then brought its last star-faring people home to the Realm Eternal.
  122. 8 August 2007
    Solid Snake and the tanker on the Hudson
    Solid Snake slipped aboard a disguised Marine Corps tanker on the Hudson River to photograph the new Metal Gear RAY in her hold. Russian mercenaries under Sergei Gurlukovich seized the ship. Their ally Revolver Ocelot shot Gurlukovich, stole RAY, then sank the tanker with the Marine commandant Scott Dolph aboard. Snake was believed drowned, yet the blame for the sinking was laid on him.
  123. 2007
    Birth of Sunny
    Olga Gurlukovich, who had escaped the sinking tanker, gave birth to a daughter. The Patriots took the baby at once, which forced Olga to work for them. The child was later named Sunny.
  124. c. 2007
    Frank Taylor disappears
    Frank Taylor vanished from an American city, about a year before his son's eighteenth birthday. Xaviax had drained the life out of him. His son, Kit, was put into foster care.
  125. 2008
    The last clone of Ba'al
    The Tok'ra extracted the last of Ba'al's clones on their homeworld.
  126. 2008
    The Ark of Truth
    The Ark of Truth, a device of the Ancients, was turned on the Doci at Celestis, and the followers of Origin saw that the Ori were no gods. Ganos Lal took Adria out of the world into a struggle without end.
  127. 2008
    May Parker becomes Spider-Girl
    At fifteen May Parker found she had her father's powers. She saved Normie Osborn, who had put on the Green Goblin's mask, and soon afterwards went out as Spider-Girl.
  128. c. 2008
    The Osborn feud ends
    Normie Osborn seized Spider-Girl while she was without her powers, then cut her free. From that day the feud between the two families was over.
  129. 2008
    Dead Cell is destroyed
    Dead Cell, an anti-terrorist unit that President Sears had founded, had run wild after its leader died in prison. American forces lured it into a trap. Three lived: the knife-fighter Vamp, the bomber Fatman and their dead leader's widow, Fortune.
  130. 13 December 2008
    Kit Taylor finds the Dragon Knight's deck
    On his eighteenth birthday Kit Taylor, led by visions of his missing father, found an Advent Deck in the family's empty flat. Len of Ventara, the Wing Knight, saved Maya Young from mirror monsters in front of him. Kit was knocked through a mirror into Ventara, where he first met the dragon Dragreder.
  131. 2009
    Birth of Benjy Parker
    Benjamin Richard Parker was born at Midtown Medical Hospital while his sister fought alone in Central Park.
  132. 2009
    Spider-Man and Spider-Girl against the Hobgoblin
    Peter Parker took his costume out of storage to fight the Hobgoblin, Roderick Kingsley, beside his daughter. He gave her his own web-shooters.
  133. 10 January 2009
    Kit Taylor becomes Dragon Knight
    Kit Taylor made a contract with the red dragon Dragreder. As Kamen Rider Dragon Knight he saved Len of Ventara from a mirror monster the same day.
  134. 24 January 2009
    Len vents Richie Preston
    Len of Ventara challenged Richie Preston, whom Xaviax had armed as Incisor, to single combat. He vented him, the first of Xaviax's Riders to be sent into the Advent Void.
  135. 7 February 2009
    Frank Taylor is found
    Maya Young and Trent Moseley found Frank Taylor lying in a hospital, alive but drained of life by Xaviax. That month Drew Lansing, the Rider called Torque, persuaded Kit Taylor that Len of Ventara was the true traitor of Ventara.
  136. 28 February 2009
    Torque vents Camo
    Drew Lansing, as Torque, vented Grant Staley, the Rider called Camo, whom Kit Taylor had been trying to talk round. Kit learnt that Drew Lansing served Xaviax, so he went back to Len of Ventara.
  137. 7 March 2009
    Len reveals the mirror twins
    Len of Ventara showed Kit Taylor a photograph of Adam of Ventara, the first Dragon Knight, who had Kit's face. He explained that every Rider armed by Xaviax was the mirror twin of a Ventaran Rider.
  138. 4 April 2009
    Strike vents Thrust and Torque
    James Trademore, as Strike, used Brad Barrett, the Rider called Thrust, as a shield, then vented him. The same day he vented Drew Lansing, who had plotted against Xaviax. Chris Ramirez, the Rider called Sting, came over to Len of Ventara's side.
  139. 29 April 2009
    The Big Shell incident
    Solidus Snake, the former President George Sears, led the Sons of Liberty in seizing the Big Shell, a clean-up plant in New York Bay, with President Johnson as hostage. With him were Revolver Ocelot, the survivors of Dead Cell and a company of Russian mercenaries. The Patriots sent in a young soldier, Raiden, alone. Solid Snake was already there under the name Iroquois Pliskin.
  140. 29 April 2009
    Death of Emma Emmerich
    Hal Emmerich's stepsister Emma, who had built the Patriots' computer GW, wrote a virus to destroy it. Vamp stabbed her on the Big Shell before it was fully loaded. Vamp was a living Romanian, not one of the Kindred: machines in his blood healed his wounds, while his taste for blood went back to a childhood disaster.
  141. 29 April 2009
    Death of President Johnson
    President James Johnson, a hostage on the Big Shell, told Raiden that the Patriots ruled America. Beneath the plant, he said, lay their fortress, Arsenal Gear. Revolver Ocelot shot him dead. Olga Gurlukovich, who had been guarding Raiden in a ninja's armour for her baby's sake, was killed by Solidus.
  142. 30 April 2009
    Arsenal Gear comes ashore in Manhattan
    At dawn Arsenal Gear, out of control, drove up out of New York Bay through lower Manhattan as far as Federal Hall. The Patriots' computers told Raiden that the whole incident had been an experiment of theirs, the S3 plan, in governing what people think. Its full name was Selection for Societal Sanity.
  143. 30 April 2009
    Death of Solidus Snake
    On the roof of Federal Hall Raiden fought Solidus Snake, the former President Sears, with swords. He killed him. It was the anniversary of George Washington's inauguration on that spot, the day Solidus had chosen to declare America free of the Patriots.
  144. 8 August 2009
    Xaviax arms the Cho brothers
    Xaviax, posing as a crime boss, armed two thieves, the Cho brothers. Danny Cho became the Rider called Axe, with his brother Albert as Spear.
  145. 22 August 2009
    Chris Ramirez is vented
    Strike aimed a Final Vent at Len of Ventara during a battle with the Cho brothers. Chris Ramirez, the Rider called Sting, took the blow in his place, which vented him. His last words were 'Semper Fi'.
  146. 4 September 2009
    Kit Taylor refuses Strike's bargain
    Strike, who had carried Frank Taylor off from his hospital, offered him to Kit Taylor in return for Len of Ventara's Advent Deck. Kit refused. Maya Young got Frank Taylor away during the fight, in which Kit vented Albert Cho, the Rider called Spear.
  147. 5 September 2009
    Kase of Ventara returns
    Kase, the Rider called Siren, whom Xaviax believed he had destroyed, saved Kit Taylor from Danny Cho. She joined Len of Ventara on Earth.
  148. 19 September 2009
    Xaviax tempts Kit Taylor
    Xaviax woke Frank Taylor for a few moments in his hospital bed. He promised to wake him for good if Kit Taylor vented Len of Ventara. A week later Kit told Len everything.
  149. 26 September 2009
    Strike vents Axe
    Danny Cho, the Rider called Axe, attacked Kit Taylor against Xaviax's orders, to avenge his brother. Strike vented him for it.
  150. 3 October 2009
    The No-Men seize Kit Taylor
    Agents of the No-Men seized Kit Taylor at his father's hospital, then locked him in a cell. About the same time Xaviax took over the body of Vic Frasier, which let him fight in the armour of Wrath.
  151. 17 October 2009
    Kit Taylor escapes the No-Men
    Kit Taylor escaped from the No-Men's cell through the reflection in a puddle of spilt water. Xaviax wounded him as he came out, until Len of Ventara rescued him with Kase.
  152. 31 October 2009
    Strike vents Kase
    Kase gave Survive cards to Len of Ventara and Kit Taylor. The same day James Trademore, as Strike, stole the decks of Thrust and Sting from Len, then vented her.
  153. 7 November 2009
    Kit Taylor is vented
    Len of Ventara, in Survive Mode, vented Strike. Xaviax, in the armour of Wrath, then vented Kit Taylor, losing Wrath's armour in the same fight. He took the Dragon Knight's deck, which left Len the last Rider on either world.
  154. 14 November 2009
    Len wakes the Advent Master
    At the headquarters of the No-Men, Len of Ventara woke Eubulon with his Advent Deck. Eubulon altered Kase's deck so that Maya Young could fight as Siren. Xaviax, who had begun planting teleport beacons across the Earth, forced Adam of Ventara to wear the Dragon Knight's armour again as his spy.
  155. 21 November 2009
    Eubulon opens the Advent Void
    Eubulon brought the Ventaran Riders Chance, Price and Hunt out of the Advent Void. Kit Taylor followed, with Kase. Eubulon gave Kit a new deck, Onyx.
  156. 28 November 2009
    Kit Taylor returns as Onyx
    Kit Taylor fought for the first time as Kamen Rider Onyx. He met his mirror twin, Adam of Ventara, whom he would have vented if Eubulon had not stopped him.
  157. 5 December 2009
    Maya Young returns the Siren deck
    Maya Young gave the deck of Siren back to Kase. Adam of Ventara told the Kamen Riders how Xaviax had deceived him as Paragon.
  158. 18 December 2009
    Adam of Ventara confesses
    In Australia, at the last of Xaviax's transmitters, Adam of Ventara attacked Len on Xaviax's orders but could not vent him. He confessed that the transmitters had never really been shut down. Len took his Advent Deck.
  159. 18 December 2009
    Xaviax is destroyed
    Maya Young and Trent Moseley opened a way through a mirror into Xaviax's stronghold. Thirteen Kamen Riders came through it, with Adam of Ventara as Dragon Knight beside Kit Taylor as Onyx. Their Link Vent destroyed Xaviax.
  160. 18 December 2009
    Ventara is restored
    The people of Ventara came home from Karsh. Eubulon freed the last Riders from the Advent Void. The men of Earth whom Xaviax had armed were sent home with no memory of the war.
  161. 18 December 2009
    Kit Taylor keeps the Dragon Knight's deck
    Adam of Ventara gave up being a Kamen Rider. Eubulon offered Kit Taylor the choice of the two dragon decks, of which Kit chose Dragon Knight. Frank Taylor, his father, woke from his long sleep.
  162. 2010
    The Carnage fragment
    A fragment of the Carnage creature took hold of Moose Mansfield, then carried off Peter Parker with his baby son. Spider-Girl destroyed it with a sonic blaster.
  163. c. 2010
    The Russian government revives GRU SV-8
    After 2010 the Russian government gave GRU SV-8 a large budget and turned it to the service of the Kremlin's ambitions abroad.
  164. c. 2010
    Solid Snake begins to age
    Soon after the Big Shell the haste of his making caught up with Solid Snake. He began to age many years in each one.
  165. 2010
    Wild Card
    During a gang war in New York Peter Parker went out at night as a masked vigilante called Wild Card.
  166. October 2010
    Kouga and Rekka destroy Karma
    Kouga Saejima hunted Karma, an Apostle Horror who lived in mirrors, with the Makai Priestess Rekka, whose father she had killed. The priest Akaza, who had sheltered Karma, gave his life so that Rekka's flute could call her victims' souls to Garo's aid.
  167. 2011
    Raiden rescues Sunny
    Raiden took Olga Gurlukovich's daughter, Sunny, out of the Patriots' hands. He left her with Solid Snake's friend Hal Emmerich, who brought her up.
  168. 2011
    The Sons of the Patriots system
    With private armies now fighting most of the world's wars, the Patriots put nanomachines into every soldier. A system called Sons of the Patriots watched each man, deciding whether his weapon would fire.
  169. 6 October 2011
    Kouga is marked with the Seal of Destruction
    On the night the Senate of the Makai Order made Kouga Saejima one of its own knights, a man in a red mask cut the Seal of Destruction into his chest. The same mark was soon found on Rei Suzumura, Tsubasa Yamagatana and many other knights.
  170. 15 December 2011
    Kouga destroys Zaji
    At the tower where the dead Golden Knights are laid to rest, Kouga Saejima fought Zaji, a creature made of the malice of every Horror the holders of Garo have slain. He destroyed it with the spirits of his ancestors behind him.
  171. c. 2012
    The Cult of Transcendence falls apart
    About 2012 the Cult of Transcendence, the web of secret societies that served Nyarlathotep from its House beyond the world, fell apart.
  172. 2012
    Raiden is rebuilt as a machine
    The Patriots captured Raiden. At Area 51 they replaced most of his body with machinery. The resistance fighters of Big Mama, who was EVA, broke him out.
  173. February 2012
    Sigma Fudou is unmasked
    The man in the red mask proved to be Sigma Fudou, a Makai Priest, the twin of Kouga Saejima's partner Leo. He meant to replace the knights with an engine called Idea, fed on human lives. Aboard the Madou Train Kouga cut off Sigma's arm, which broke every seal.
  174. 22 March 2012
    Gyanon and Sigma Fudou are destroyed
