    In the true Makai the Horror Gyanon swallowed Sigma Fudou's engine, Idea, with Kouga Saejima sealed at its heart. Kaoru Mitsuki, Jabi and Rekka freed him, so that the assembled knights could destroy it. Sigma died by Kouga's sword at the Saejima house, after which Kouga left for the Promised Ground to pay his debt to Gajari.
  175. February 2013
    Kouga returns from the Promised Ground
    In the Promised Ground, a country of discarded things, Kouga Saejima defeated its queen, Judam, with the dragon she had joined herself to. He came home to Kaoru Mitsuki, whose first picture book had just been published.
  176. April 2013
    Another world: Ryuga Dougai comes to Vol City
    In another world, where the armour of Garo had long been black, the young knight Ryuga Dougai came to Vol City. He found it full of Madou Horrors, people planted with the seeds of the ancient Horror Zedom.
  177. September 2013
    Another world: Garo's gold is restored
    In another world Ryuga Dougai cut down the fallen knight Sonshi, at which the armour of Garo turned gold again. His mother, Hakana, who was becoming a Horror, died by his sword at her own wish. A week later he destroyed Zedom with the knights Aguri Kusugami and Takeru Jakuzure.
  178. 2014
    Old Snake's last mission
    Solid Snake, aged far beyond his forty-two years, was sent by Roy Campbell to kill Liquid Ocelot, who owned the five largest private armies in the world. In the Middle East he met Meryl Silverburgh's Army team. There too he met the arms dealer Drebin, who injected him with fresh nanomachines. Liquid Ocelot showed that he could switch off every soldier who carried them.
  179. 2014
    The Legendary Battle
    Rangers of every generation came to the help of the Mega Rangers against the Armada. Tommy Oliver led them as the Green Ranger once more.
  180. c. 2014
    Birth of Raiga Saejima
    Raiga Saejima was born to Kouga Saejima, the Golden Knight, by Kaoru Mitsuki, whom he had married after his return from the Promised Ground.
  181. 2014
    Naomi Hunter in South America
    In South America Old Snake found Dr Naomi Hunter, a prisoner of Liquid Ocelot. She told him that he had about a year to live. The old FOXDIE inside him was changing, so that before long it might kill anybody at all. Raiden, by now more machine than man, fought Vamp there.
  182. 2014
    Death of EVA
    In eastern Europe Snake met Big Mama, the leader of the Paradise Lost Army, who was EVA. She told him how the Patriots had begun. Liquid Ocelot took the body she guarded, used it to unlock the Patriots' control of every weapon, then burnt it. EVA died soon afterwards, killed by a new FOXDIE in Snake's blood that the Patriots had made to be rid of their founders.
  183. 2014
    Snake returns to Shadow Moses
    Snake went back to Shadow Moses for the one weapon the Patriots could not lock, the great gun of the wrecked Metal Gear REX. Raiden killed Vamp there. Naomi Hunter, who was dying of cancer, switched off the machines that kept her alive. Snake fought Liquid Ocelot's Metal Gear RAY in the patched-up REX.
  184. 2014
    The fall of the Patriots
    Aboard Liquid Ocelot's warship Outer Haven Snake carried a virus to the computer GW. Naomi Hunter had written it; the child Sunny had finished it. It destroyed JD together with every other computer of the Patriots, yet left the world's lights on.
  185. 2014
    Death of Revolver Ocelot
    On top of Outer Haven Liquid Ocelot fought Snake with his fists until he fell. He died as Ocelot, aged seventy, killed by the new FOXDIE. His years as Liquid's double had been a deception worked by hypnosis, to turn the Patriots' own machines against them.
  186. 2014
    Meryl Silverburgh marries Johnny Sasaki
    Meryl Silverburgh, who had fought through Outer Haven beside Snake, married her soldier Johnny Sasaki. Roy Campbell, now known to be her father, gave her away. Rosemary brought Raiden their son, John, whom he had never seen.
  187. 2014
    Big Boss kills Major Zero
    Big Boss was not dead. The body burnt in Europe had been that of Solidus, while his own had been mended with parts of his sons. At Arlington he showed Solid Snake the last of the Patriots: Major Zero, about a hundred and five years old, aware of nothing. He switched off the old man's oxygen.
  188. 2014
    Death of Big Boss
    At the grave of The Boss in Arlington National Cemetery Big Boss made his peace with the son who had brought him down. The new FOXDIE in Snake's blood killed him there, as it had been made to do. He was nearly eighty. Snake went away to live out the short time he had left.
  189. March 2014
    Rei Suzumura destroys Ring's commune
    The Horror Ring kept a commune where people lived beside Horrors, at the price of one human life a month. Rei Suzumura destroyed it with the priest Kain and the swordswoman Yuna, whose mother, Iyu, had sung for Ring.
  190. March 2015
    Another world: Ryuga Dougai in Line City
    In another world the priestess Ryume cleansed the armour of Garo for Ryuga Dougai at Line City. He stopped Ago, a living Madou tool that meant to end the Horrors by ending mankind.
  191. 6 May 2015
    The Night World reaches Dorchester House
    The Night World of the King in Yellow began to show itself in Dorchester House, a psychiatric hospital in Boston.
  192. 18 September 2015
    Another world: Jinga raises Radan
    In another world the fallen knight Jinga raised the flying fortress Radan over Line City with his wife, Amily. Ryuga Dougai destroyed him, while the priest Gald sealed Radan away.
  193. Autumn 2015
    Operation INDIA MOON begins in Boston
    Four patients vanished from the secure floor of Dorchester House, among them former agents of Delta Green. The Outlaws called back the survivors of Operation ALICE to look into it. The evidence led back to the Night Floors of 1995.
  194. Autumn 2015
    The agents of INDIA MOON reach Carcosa
    Hunted by the authorities and by Delta Green's own cleaners, the agents of INDIA MOON were invited by the long-lost Abigail Wright to the Hotel Broadalbin, which has no fixed place in the world. From the labyrinth beneath it they went on into Carcosa, to the masquerade in the King's palace. Not all of them came home.
  195. Spring 2016
    Jabi and Tsubasa Yamagatana hunt together
    By the spring of 2016 the knight Tsubasa Yamagatana was hunting Horrors with the priestess Jabi, whom he had once called an abomination. That season he came down from Kantai to the city to cut down a man who had become a Horror. The priestess Rekka played the dead of the Makai Order to rest at a grave-keeper's asking.
  196. March 2017
    Rei Suzumura and the last dragon
    Edel, a Dragon Knight of ancient days, woke hating mankind. He sought the last dragon egg, which hatched for the photographer Alice Hiromi. Rei Suzumura stopped her dragon from burning a city with the help of the priestess Rekka, though Alice died with it.
  197. 2018
    The murder of Prime Minister N'mani
    In an African country rebuilding after civil war, the mercenaries of Desperado Enforcement killed the prime minister, N'mani. His bodyguard was Raiden, of Maverick Security Consulting. The Brazilian swordsman Samuel Rodrigues cut out Raiden's eye, taking an arm as well.
  198. 2018
    Raiden in Abkhazia
    Three weeks later Raiden, rebuilt with a stronger body, went to Abkhazia, where Desperado had staged a coup. He killed its commander there, a woman called Mistral. The fighting machine sent against him became his ally under the name Blade Wolf.
  199. 2018
    The children's brains at Guadalajara
    Under Guadalajara in Mexico Raiden found a laboratory where the brains of orphans were cut out to be trained as soldiers for machine bodies. Desperado ran it for the American company World Marshal. He got the children out.
  200. 2018
    Raiden attacks World Marshal
    Raiden resigned from Maverick, then attacked World Marshal's headquarters in Denver alone. He killed two of Desperado's leaders, Monsoon and Sundowner. From them he learnt of a plot to kill the American President at an airbase in Pakistan.
  201. 2018
    Death of Senator Armstrong
    At Shabhazabad airbase in Pakistan Raiden killed Samuel Rodrigues in a duel, then destroyed the giant machine Metal Gear EXCELSUS. Its pilot was Senator Steven Armstrong of Colorado, who had meant to start a war that would carry him to the presidency. Raiden killed him with Rodrigues's sword.
  202. January 2018
    Another world: the ark of the Horrors
    In another world Horrors raised Jinga from the dead to launch an ark that would carry their kind to the Moon, where Messiah could be woken. Ryuga Dougai, Aguri Kusugami and Takeru Jakuzure broke it. Jinga fell into the true Makai, where Messiah destroyed him.
  203. August 2018
    Lord Draven's attack
    Lord Draven, who was taking Rangers prisoner from world after world, put a robot in Tommy Oliver's place. Tommy escaped and fought him.
  204. 2019
    The Sowers follow Azazel
    In the decaying towns of the American Rust Belt a movement calling itself Christian, the Sowers, followed a voice that named itself Azazel. Delta Green believes the voice was Nyarlathotep's.
  205. c. 2020
    Kouga and Kaoru Saejima vanish
    A rift in time, opened by the Horror Eyrith, carried off Kaoru Mitsuki in front of her husband and son. Kouga Saejima went in after her, promising six-year-old Raiga that he would return. The butler Gonza Kurahashi brought the boy up.
  206. Spring 2020
    Another world: the contest called Versus Road
    In a third world, which had lost its Golden Knight, Shosetsu Hagiri lured a hundred young men into a killing contest in the Makai, promising the winner the title of Garo. The winner, Sena Kuon, defeated Hagiri in the golden armour, then gave back the sword.
  207. 2022
    Trini Kwan is killed
    Billy Cranston's attempt to bring Zordon back gave Rita Repulsa's old evil a body of its own, Robo-Rita. Trini Kwan was killed shielding Billy from her blast.
  208. 2023
    Robo-Rita takes Tommy, Jason and Kimberly prisoner
    Robo-Rita drained the three of them to open a door into the past. The other Rangers freed them, and they were taken to Aquitar to heal.
  209. 2023
    Robo-Rita is destroyed
    Trini Kwan's daughter, Minh, became the Yellow Ranger. With Zack Taylor she destroyed Robo-Rita at the Moon Palace.
  210. c. 2024
    Rei Suzumura takes Raiga as his pupil
    On the eve of Raiga Saejima's tenth birthday Rei Suzumura took him on his first hunt, as he had promised Kouga. Raiga chose to become a Makai Knight, with Rei as his teacher.
  211. 28 March 2024
    Another world: the Gate of Destruction is resealed
    In another world the priestess Mutsugi opened the Gate of Destruction at Crea City to reach a forbidden fruit, which made a Horror of her. Ryuga Dougai sealed the gate again with Souma Shirahane, the son of the knight who had held it shut.
  212. 2026
    The Third World War begins
    The Third World War broke out on Earth in 2026. It went on, in one form or another, for twenty-seven years.
  213. c. 2027
    The great powers call up their mutants
    Soon after the Third World War broke out, the great powers began to call up the mutants among their people as soldiers, as the Weapon programme had once taken Logan. Mutants who refused were treated as enemies.
  214. c. 2028
    The Kree and the Skrulls fall out
    A Kree admiral of the joined Kree and Skrull empire was unmasked as a Skrull. The Kree would not believe that the Skrulls had not known, so the old war began again inside the empire that had been meant to end it.
  215. c. 2028
    The last of the first X-Men
    The last of the five teenagers whom Charles Xavier gathered as the first X-Men in 1963 died of old age, at about eighty. By then most of the X-Men of the old teams had died of old age too.
  216. 2030
    Birth of Zefram Cochrane
    Zefram Cochrane, who would make Earth's first warp flight, was born while the Third World War was being fought.
  217. c. 2030
    The Sentinels are built again
    One power after another built Sentinels again, to find the mutants fighting for its enemies. The machines could detect the mutant gene, but they could not tell one side's mutants from another's.
  218. c. 2030
    Earth's Stargate is destroyed in space
    Early in the Third World War the Stargate programme sent Earth's Stargate into space aboard one of its BC-304s, to keep it out of the war. The ship was destroyed in space with the gate aboard. Nobody who knew of it lived through the war, and nobody on Earth ever learnt what had become of the gate.
  219. c. 2030
    The lore of the Aesir goes into hiding
    As the Stargate programme collapsed early in the Third World War, copies of the lore of the Aesir passed into the keeping of Delta Green and the SCP Foundation, which classified it.
  220. c. 2031
    The last Goa'uld queen is killed
    Free Jaffa killed the last Goa'uld queen they knew of. With no Jaffa willing to carry their larvae, the Goa'uld had been dying out since the fall of the System Lords in 2005.
  221. c. 2032
    The Kree come for the Inhumans
    In their last war with the Skrulls the Kree came to Attilan, in the Blue Area of the Moon, to take the Inhumans as the soldiers they had first been made to be. The Royal Family held the city while Lockjaw carried as many of their people as he could to Earth, and none of them survived the fight.
  222. c. 2033
    The Dominators poison Daxam
    The Dominators filled the air of Daxam with lead dust, to which every Daxamite was fatally weak. It was their revenge for 1988, when the Daxamites had turned on their Alliance under Earth's sun. No Daxamite survived it.
  223. c. 2034
    The Brood come into the Shi'ar Imperium
    The last Empress of the Brood, driven out of the ruins of Kree space, brought what was left of her people into the Shi'ar Imperium. The Shi'ar began to burn every world where the Brood took hold, Shi'ar and all.
  224. c. 2034
    The mutant camps
    By the middle of the 2030s the Sentinels had herded the mutants of several countries into camps, as in the world Rachel Summers came from.
  225. 2035
    Soma Cruz learns he is Dracula reborn
    During the solar eclipse of 2035 the student Soma Cruz was drawn into Dracula's castle within the eclipse and found that he was the reincarnation of Dracula. He refused the inheritance.
  226. 2035
    Soma Cruz is drawn into Dracula's castle
    On 2 September 2035, the day of a solar eclipse, the eighteen-year-old Soma Cruz climbed to the Hakuba shrine in Japan with his friend Mina Hakuba, the shrine-keeper's daughter. Both were drawn into Dracula's castle, sealed inside the eclipse since 1999, where the government agent Genya Arikado, who was Alucard, was waiting.
  227. 2035
    Graham Jones comes to claim Dracula's power
    Graham Jones, a missionary with a sect of his own, had been born on the day of Dracula's destruction, so he believed himself Dracula reborn. He entered the sealed castle to take its power. The Church sent the witch Yoko Belnades after him.
  228. 2035
    Soma Cruz finds the power of dominance
    Inside the castle Soma Cruz found that he could take the souls of the monsters he destroyed, using their powers as his own. Genya Arikado sent him towards the throne room.
  229. 2035
    Graham Jones stabs Yoko Belnades
    Yoko Belnades called Graham Jones a fraud to his face, so he stabbed her. Soma Cruz drove him off, while Genya Arikado kept her alive.
  230. 2035
    J remembers that he is Julius Belmont
    A hunter called J, who had lost his memory in 1999, had been drawn to the castle as well. There he knew himself again as Julius Belmont, the man who had destroyed Dracula.
  231. 2035
    Soma Cruz destroys Graham Jones
    Graham Jones took the castle's power in the throne room, where Soma Cruz destroyed him. As that power passed into Soma he understood that he, not Graham, was Dracula reborn.
  232. 2035
    Julius Belmont spares Soma Cruz
    Julius Belmont fought Soma Cruz, then held his hand when he sensed Soma's own spirit resisting the darkness. Soma made him promise to kill him if he ever became the Dark Lord.
  233. 2035
    Soma Cruz destroys the chaos
    Soma Cruz went into the realm of chaos at the heart of the castle, the source of Dracula's power, to destroy it. He woke at the Hakuba shrine beside Mina Hakuba as the eclipse ended, having refused his inheritance.
  234. 2036
    Celia Fortner sets her monsters on Soma Cruz
    Celia Fortner, priestess of a cult called With Light, set monsters on Soma Cruz while he was out walking with Mina Hakuba. Genya Arikado threw him a weapon. The power of dominance, which Soma had thought gone, woke in him again.
  235. 2036
    Celia Fortner presents her two candidates
    Celia Fortner held that the world needed a lord of darkness. She had two candidates for the place, Dario Bossi and Dmitrii Blinov, each born on the day Dracula died. Either could win it by destroying Soma Cruz, who followed them to their stronghold.
  236. 2036
    Soma Cruz destroys the demon in Dario Bossi
    Dario Bossi drew his command of fire from Aguni, a demon bound to his soul. Soma Cruz passed through a mirror to destroy Aguni, which left Dario powerless.
  237. 2036
    The false Mina is killed
    Celia Fortner had a double of Mina Hakuba killed in front of Soma Cruz to drive him into the dark. A talisman from the real Mina slowed the change until Genya Arikado could tell him the truth.
  238. 2036
    Julius Belmont breaks the barrier
    Julius Belmont, past seventy, spent all his strength to break the barrier that guarded the way down to the Abyss. It left him too weak to go further.
  239. 2036
    Dmitrii Blinov sacrifices Celia Fortner
    Dmitrii Blinov had copied Soma Cruz's power of dominance. He sacrificed Celia Fortner to seal Genya Arikado's strength, but the souls he had taken proved too much for him. They tore free of his body, becoming the monster Menace.
  240. 2036
    Soma Cruz refuses Celia Fortner's cult
    Soma Cruz destroyed Menace in the Abyss, then let go the souls he had taken, so the cult's castle fell. He had refused Dracula's inheritance a second time, helped by Genya Arikado, Yoko Belnades and Julius Belmont.
  241. c. 2037
    The last war of Apokolips and New Genesis
    Darkseid, the Lord of Apokolips, made his last war on New Genesis. Neither world survived it. The New Gods of the twin worlds died in it, Darkseid among them, with the Lowlies and the Bugs.
  242. c. 2038
    Rann falls into Polaris
    The old war between the Rannians and the Thanagarians broke out again on Rann, the world they had shared since 2005 with the Tamaranean refugees. Losing, the Rannians tried to carry their world away with the zeta-beam, which failed. Rann fell into the star Polaris with everyone on it.
  243. c. 2038
    Death of Ganthet, the last Guardian
    Ganthet, the last of the Guardians of the Universe, had come to Rann to stop the war. He died with that world, and the Guardians of the Universe came to an end with him.
  244. c. 2039
    The Dominators' plague
    The Dominators tried to give the metagene to their own highest caste. The change ran wild in their blood, killing every one of them. The Khunds, who plundered the dying Dominion, carried the plague home to Khundia.
  245. c. 2040
    The fall of the mutant heroes
    The mutant heroes still alive when the war began fell in it one after another, holding back the Sentinels and the purges or getting the hunted out. Among them were Kitty Pryde, Piotr Rasputin, Kurt Wagner, Storm, Psylocke, Rahne Sinclair and Rachel Summers. Of them all, only Wolverine lived.
  246. April 2040
    Eyrith is set loose
    The knight Eiji Busujima broke the stone slab that held the Horror Eyrith with nine others, hoping that her flower would bring back his dead lover. The Senate sent Raiga Saejima, by then the Golden Knight, to hunt the nine with Crow the Phantom Knight and the young woman Mayuri.
  247. September 2040
    Raiga Saejima destroys Eyrith
    Eyrith grew into a great tree at a lake, threatening to open the Makai onto the world. Raiga Saejima became a Lost Soul Beast, mastered it, then destroyed her. Mayuri sealed her remains in the slab again.
  248. c. 2041
    The end of the Kree and the Skrulls
    The last war between the Kree and the Skrulls, fought with gene bombs on one side, Nega-Bombs on the other, left no living world in either empire. The Cotati died in the same bombs.
  249. c. 2041
    The Inhumans die with the Kree
    The Inhumans whom the Kree had taken died with the last Kree worlds. Attilan stood empty on the Moon, and the Terrigen Mists were never breathed again.
  250. c. 2042
    Rekka meets a priestess of another world
    Zaji dragged the priestess Rekka into a rift between worlds. There she met Rian, a Makai Priestess from a world with a Golden Knight of its own. Kouga Saejima, long lost in the rift, cut Zaji down before vanishing again.
  251. c. 2043
    The Durlans die out
    The Durlans, the shape-changers of the 1988 Alliance, died out. They had been few ever since the atomic war that gave them their power ruined their world in ancient days.
  252. c. 2044
    The Shi'ar burn Chandilar
    On the last order of the Majestor, the Imperial Guard burnt Chandilar, the Shi'ar throneworld, to destroy the Brood on it. The last of the Brood died with their last hosts. No Shi'ar were left to keep the M'Kraan Crystal.
  253. c. 2044
    The war strain of the Legacy Virus
    A new strain of the Legacy Virus, made as a weapon of the war, was let loose. It killed anybody who carried the X-gene, whether or not their powers had ever shown, so no mutant was born again. The cure of 2001 was useless against it.
  254. c. 2045
    The last Goa'uld dies
    The last of the Goa'uld died on a world whose name the free Jaffa did not trouble to record. The Jaffa lived on, and their children, who were never given a larva, grew up as other children do.
  255. October 2045
    Three Golden Knights destroy Kiba
    The evil left in Barago's armour, wearing a white mask as Shiroku, seized Mayuri to lure Raiga Saejima aboard a black train bound for the Makai. Raiga destroyed Kiba beside his father, Kouga, with the spirit of his grandfather Taiga. Mayuri was found to be carrying Raiga's child.
  256. c. 2048
    The last of the Tok'ra
    The Tok'ra, who had had no queen since Egeria, took no more hosts once the Goa'uld were gone. The last symbiote died with the host whose life it had shared.
  257. c. 2048
    Colonel Green hunts the genetically unfit
    Colonel Phillip Green's militia hunted down the mutants who were left, with everyone else it called genetically unfit.
  258. c. 2050
    The last of the Badoon
    The last of the Badoon Sisterhood died on Lotiara, a swamp world of the star Capella. The Brotherhood's ships had stopped coming home in the 2030s, so the Sisters had borne no more children.
  259. c. 2050
    The Andorians settle Weytahn
    Andorian settlers came to Weytahn, a world on the Vulcan frontier, and began to make it fit to live on.
  260. c. 2050
    The Watchers die out
    The Watchers, the oldest of the alien peoples, died out as they had lived, watching. Their vow never to interfere had kept them out of every other people's ending, and it kept them out of their own.
  261. 2053
    Nuclear war ends the Third World War
    The Third World War ended in an exchange of nuclear weapons that killed some six hundred million people. Most of the world's great cities were destroyed, and most of its governments fell with them.
  262. 2053
    Delta Green is destroyed
    The nuclear exchange that ended the Third World War destroyed what was left of Delta Green, with the government it served. A few of its agents lived, with some of its files and a copy of the lore of the Aesir.
  263. c. 2053
    The post-atomic horror
    In the lawless decades after the war much of Earth was ruled by whoever had guns. Among the things kept through those years was the lore of the Aesir that Asgard had given the Tau'ri in 2007. The survivors of Delta Green and the SCP Foundation kept it, in secret.
  264. 2053
    The end of the SCP Foundation
    The nuclear exchange of 2053 destroyed the last sites of the SCP Foundation, which had been losing them one by one since the war began. A few of its people lived, with copies of its files and of the lore of the Aesir.
  265. 2053
    Wolverine, the last mutant
    The nuclear exchange that ended the Third World War burnt the last refuges of the mutants. Of all the mutants on Earth, only Logan, called Wolverine, was still alive, because his healing power would not let him die. He went into hiding.
  266. 2053
    The last Inhumans on Earth
    The few Inhumans who had lived on Earth, where the air had always made them ill, did not outlive the war. With them the Inhumans came to an end.
  267. 5 April 2063
    Zefram Cochrane makes the first warp flight
    From a missile complex near Bozeman, Montana, Zefram Cochrane flew the Phoenix at warp speed, the first warp flight by a ship from Earth. What the lore of the Aesir told of the Rainbow Bridge had shown him that space could be folded, and his engine fitted inside an old missile. Only what touched warp flight was made public. The rest of the lore stayed classified.
  268. 5 April 2063
    The Vulcans come to Bozeman
    A Vulcan survey ship saw the trace of the Phoenix's flight. That night it came down near Bozeman, and its captain greeted Cochrane: the first open meeting between the Vulcans and the people of Earth.
  269. c. 2069
    The last Klingon emperor dies
    The last of the Klingon emperors died. For three centuries no other took his place, while the High Council governed the Empire under its Chancellor.
  270. 2097
    The Vulcans annex Weytahn
    The Vulcans claimed Weytahn, calling it Paan Mokar. When the Andorians refused to let the Vulcan High Command inspect their colony there, the Vulcans annexed the planet.
  271. 2105
    The Territorial Compromise
    After eight years of talks the Vulcans and the Andorians agreed the Territorial Compromise over Weytahn. The Andorians never thought it fair, and the two peoples came close to war over it more than once.
  272. 2117
    Zefram Cochrane leaves Earth
    At the age of eighty seven Zefram Cochrane set off alone into deep space, and was never heard of on Earth again.
  273. 2125
    The Yahg kill the alliance's envoys
    Envoys of the Asari, Salarian and Turian alliance reached the Yahg of Parnack, treating them as equals. The Yahg, who follow only a master, took it for contempt and killed them all. Parnack was declared forbidden.
  274. c. 2130
    Arik Soong steals Augment embryos
    The geneticist Arik Soong stole nineteen frozen Augment embryos, left from the programme that had made Khan Noonien Singh. He raised the children who grew from them in secret until he was caught, about 2144.
  275. April 2151
    Earth launches the Enterprise NX-01
    Earth launched the Enterprise NX-01, the first of its ships able to reach warp five, under Captain Jonathan Archer. The Vulcans, who thought Earth not yet ready, sent Sub-Commander T'Pol with it as science officer.
  276. April 2151
    Klaang crashes at Broken Bow
    Klaang, a Klingon courier hunted by Suliban, crashed his ship in a cornfield near Broken Bow, Oklahoma, where the farmer shot him. It was the first meeting between the Klingons and the people of Earth.
  277. April 2151
    Klaang is brought home to Qo'noS
    Against the Vulcans' advice, Captain Jonathan Archer took Klaang home in the Enterprise NX-01, winning him back from the Suliban on the way. A message written into Klaang's blood proved that the Suliban Cabal had been behind attacks on Klingon houses.
  278. April 2151
    The old powers are gone
    When the Enterprise NX-01 set out from Earth, the Goa'uld were extinct, as was every other alien people that had troubled the Earth in the twentieth century. Nobody on Earth yet knew it. The stars round Earth belonged to the Vulcans, the Andorians and the Klingons.
  279. 2151
    The secret of P'Jem is exposed
    Commander Shran of the Andorian Imperial Guard seized the Vulcan monastery at P'Jem, with Captain Archer's landing party inside, sure that the Vulcans were spying from it. Archer found that he was right: a long-range sensor array lay hidden beneath it. He let the Andorians go with the proof.
  280. 2151
    The Andorians destroy P'Jem
    Soon afterwards the Andorians destroyed the monastery at P'Jem with the listening post beneath it. The Vulcan High Command blamed Captain Archer and tried to recall T'Pol from the Enterprise.
  281. Autumn 2151
    A Kree Sentry still on guard
    On an airless moon a landing party from the Enterprise NX-01 was challenged by a Kree Sentry, still guarding an outpost whose garrison had long gone. Its last orders had come in 2041, and none had come since.
  282. 2152
    Earth meets the Romulans in a minefield
    Near an uncharted world the Enterprise NX-01 struck a cloaked minefield, and two Romulan warships ordered it away. It was Earth's first meeting with the Romulan Star Empire, though nobody aboard saw a Romulan.
  283. c. 2152
    Archer is sent to Rura Penthe
    A Klingon tribunal found Captain Jonathan Archer guilty of helping rebels against the Empire, though the old advocate Kolos defended him well. He was sentenced to the frozen prison world of Rura Penthe, from which T'Pol of the Enterprise won his release.
  284. 2152
    A Goa'uld mothership adrift
    The Enterprise NX-01 found a Goa'uld mothership adrift, its sarcophagus empty. Hoshi Sato, the ship's linguist, read its log: free Jaffa had taken it from the last of its lords, then left it to the dark.
  285. 2152
    Archer brings a ceasefire at Weytahn
    Shran reoccupied the Andorian settlement on Weytahn, bringing the Vulcans to the edge of war with Andoria. He would trust no mediator but Captain Archer, who brought the two sides to a ceasefire and talks on Andoria.
  286. 2152
    The empty towns of Lotiara
    At Lotiara, a swamp world of the star Capella, the Enterprise NX-01 found the towns of the Badoon Sisterhood empty. A last record told how the Brotherhood's ships had stopped coming home.
  287. 2152
    The Enterprise NX-01 meets a Quarian pilgrim
    The Enterprise NX-01 came upon a young Quarian woman alone on her Pilgrimage, her engine failing. Commander Charles Tucker mended it, and she took the ship's star charts home to the Migrant Fleet as her gift. From her Earth first heard of Rannoch and the Geth.
  288. 2153
    Shran in the Delphic Expanse
    Shran followed the Enterprise NX-01 into the Delphic Expanse to help Captain Archer against the Xindi. With his help Archer obtained detailed scans of the Xindi weapon.
  289. 2153
    Duras falls at the Delphic Expanse
    The Klingon captain Duras, who had hunted the Enterprise on the High Council's orders, attacked it again as it reached the Delphic Expanse. Archer's torpedoes destroyed his ship.
  290. 2153
    The last Skrull
    The Enterprise NX-01 came upon a Skrull scout ship bound for Earth, its pilot long dead at the controls in the shape of an Earthman. His log told of the last war between the Kree and the Skrulls.
  291. 2154
    Section 31 and the Klingon plague
    Section 31, an idea held in secret by a few people inside United Earth's Starfleet, woke to deal with the Klingon plague, wanting the Klingons to find a cure. Harris, one of the few, told Malcolm Reed of the Enterprise NX-01, who had once been one of them himself, to keep the ship from finding Dr Phlox. Reed did so at first, then told Captain Archer the truth.
  292. 2154
    The ring round Rao
    The Enterprise NX-01 charted Rao, the red sun of Krypton, and found a ring of rubble shot through with kryptonite. On Dr Phlox's advice none of it was brought aboard.
  293. 2154
    The Augments raid Cold Station 12
    Led by Malik, Soong's Augments took the eighteen hundred frozen Augment embryos kept at Cold Station 12, a secret Starfleet medical station. They took samples of its deadliest diseases too.
  294. 2154
    A Shi'ar beacon on a burnt world
    On a world burnt to the bedrock the Enterprise NX-01 found a Shi'ar beacon still warning ships away from the Brood. Its records told how the Shi'ar had burnt their own worlds to be rid of them.
  295. 2154
    The Augments fire on Qu'Vat
    To start a war between Earth and the Klingons, Malik fired a torpedo armed with a disease at the Klingon colony of Qu'Vat. The Enterprise destroyed it in flight. Malik scuttled his ship above the colony, then died by Archer's hand.
  296. 2154
    Klingon scientists recover Augment embryos
    From the wreck of the Augments' ship above Qu'Vat, Klingon scientists under Dr Antaak recovered some of the embryos. Fearing an army of Augments from Earth, the High Council set them to make Augment warriors of its own.
  297. 2154
    The Klingon Augment virus breaks out
    One of Antaak's subjects had the Levodian flu, which took up the Augment genes to become an airborne plague. It spread across the Empire, dissolving the forehead ridges of its victims before it killed them.
  298. 2154
    Phlox cures the Klingon Augment virus
    The Klingons had Dr Phlox of the Enterprise kidnapped to find a cure. Working with Antaak, he used Archer's antibodies to stop the virus in its first stage, which saved the infected but left them without their ridges. The change passed to their children.
  299. May 2154
    Soong's Augments seize a Bird-of-Prey
    The Augments raised by Arik Soong killed the crew of a Klingon Bird-of-Prey to take the ship. The Klingons threatened Earth with war over it.
  300. 2154
    Orion slavers raid the Enterprise NX-01
    In the Borderland between Klingon and Orion space, Orion slavers raided the Enterprise NX-01. They carried several of its crew, T'Pol among them, to a slave market. Captain Archer got them back, and the market's other captives broke loose.
  301. 2154
    Batarian slavers at the Orion slave market
    At the Orion slave market humans saw Batarians for the first time: four-eyed slavers from Khar'shan, who had joined the Orion Syndicate. They were bidding for the Enterprise's crew.
  302. 2154
    The bombing of Earth's embassy on Vulcan
    A bomb wrecked the United Earth embassy on Vulcan, killing twelve Vulcans and thirty-one humans. Vice-Admiral Maxwell Forrest died shielding Ambassador Soval. Administrator V'Las blamed the Syrrannites, a sect who held to Surak's first teachings.
  303. 2154
    Surak's katra passes to Captain Archer
    In the Forge the dying Syrrannite leader, Syrran, passed to Captain Archer what his followers held to be the katra of Surak. Guided by it, Archer found the Kir'Shara, Surak's own teachings, at the sanctuary of T'Karath.
  304. 2154
    The Vulcan fleet moves against Andoria
    On the pretext that the Andorians were building a weapon like the Xindi's, V'Las sent the Vulcan fleet against Andoria. Ambassador Soval warned the Andorians, and Andorian ships stood with the Enterprise NX-01 against the Vulcans.
  305. 2154
    The Vulcan High Command is dissolved
    Captain Archer and T'Pau brought the Kir'Shara before the Vulcan High Command. High Minister Kuvak ordered the fleet home, the High Command was dissolved and Vulcan turned back to Surak's teachings as he had first given them.
  306. 2154
    V'Las and the Romulan agent Talok
    The dismissed V'Las met in secret with Talok, a Romulan agent who had served on Vulcan as a major. Talok told him that the reunification of their two worlds was only a matter of time.
  307. 2154
    A Romulan drone destroys the Kumari
    A Romulan drone ship, able to disguise itself as any vessel, destroyed Shran's ship, the Kumari, while posing as a Tellarite. The Romulans meant to set the Andorians and the Tellarites at war before their talks at Babel could settle their old quarrel over trade.
  308. 2154
    Four peoples hunt the Romulan drone
    Captain Archer gathered ships from Earth, Vulcan, Andoria and Tellar into one fleet to hunt the drone. He fought Shran in an ushaan, an Andorian duel to the death, in place of the Tellarite who had killed Shran's lieutenant, then spared his life.
  309. 2154
    The Aenar end the Romulan drones
    The drones were flown by Gareb, an Aenar of Andoria's far north, whom the Romulans had taken and deceived. His sister Jhamel reached his mind, and he turned the drones on each other before Admiral Valdore killed him.
  310. 2155
    A Khund plague ship
    Dr Phlox of the Enterprise NX-01 found the Dominators' plague in the dead crew of a drifting Khund warship, which Captain Archer had destroyed. Its records told of the end of the Dominion, and of Daxam.
  311. 2155
    A Thanagarian police cruiser's records
    The records of a wrecked Thanagarian police cruiser, found by the Enterprise NX-01, told how Rann had fallen into Polaris with the last of the Guardians of the Universe.
  312. 2155
    Metron's empty chair
    The Enterprise NX-01 found the Mobius Chair of Metron, of New Genesis, empty in deep space. Its memory held pictures of two worlds burning.
  313. 2155
    Harrad-Sar's gift
    Harrad-Sar, a captain of the Orion Syndicate, gave Captain Archer three Orion women, whose scent set the men of the Enterprise NX-01 against one another. The ship was nearly taken. Harrad-Sar admitted afterwards that the women were his masters, not he theirs.
  314. 2155
    Krogan mercenaries attack the Enterprise NX-01
    The Orion Syndicate, which wanted Captain Archer's head, sent a Krogan mercenary crew after the Enterprise NX-01. Archer beat them off. Treating a wounded prisoner, Dr Phlox found an engineered disease in his blood that let almost none of his people's children be born.
  315. 2155
    The first Vorcha
    Among the Krogan mercenaries were Vorcha, small, savage people from Heshtok whose bodies remake themselves to suit wherever they are. They were the first that humans had seen, and they were very hard to stun.
  316. 2155
    The Coalition of Planets is formed
    Delegates of many worlds, Vulcan, Andoria and Tellar among them, met on Earth to form the Coalition of Planets. John Frederick Paxton's movement, Terra Prime, seized an array on Mars and demanded that every alien leave Earth. Captain Archer stopped him, then urged the delegates to explore the galaxy together.
  317. 2155
    The Enterprise NX-01 meets the Salarians
    Far beyond the frontier of Tellar the Enterprise NX-01 came upon a Salarian ship, and so found the Salarians of Sur'Kesh. They had been watching it for three days before they let it see them.
  318. 2155
    The Salarians tell Archer of the genophage
    Asked about the disease Dr Phlox had found, the Salarians told Captain Archer the story of the Rachni, the Krogan and the genophage. They did not tell him how the genophage was made.
  319. 2156
    The Enterprise NX-01 meets the Asari
    Far beyond the frontiers of Vulcan the Enterprise NX-01 answered a distress call from a damaged Asari survey ship, and so met the Asari of Thessia. Its commander, a matron of some four hundred years, asked Captain Archer a great many questions.
  320. 2156
    The Enterprise NX-01 meets the Hanar
    Through the Asari the Enterprise NX-01 met the Hanar of Kahje, who look like jellyfish and speak in patterns of light. Ensign Hoshi Sato found them the politest people she had ever met.
  321. 2156
    The Enterprise NX-01 meets the Drell
    Among the Hanar the Enterprise NX-01 met the Drell, whom the Hanar had carried from their dying world some 170 years before, and who served them under the Compact.
  322. 2156
    The Earth-Romulan War begins
    War broke out between Earth and the Romulan Star Empire. It was fought with atomic weapons, by ships that gave no quarter and took no prisoners. Neither side ever saw the other's face.
  323. 2160
    The Earth-Romulan War ends
    The Earth-Romulan War ended with a treaty settled over subspace radio, which set a Neutral Zone between the two powers. For either side to enter it was an act of war. The Romulans never forgot their humiliating defeat at the Battle of Cheron.
  324. 2160
    The Enterprise NX-01 meets the Turians
    On the far side of Andorian space the Enterprise NX-01 met a Turian patrol from Palaven. The Turians had heard of the war with the Romulans, and their officers wanted to know everything about how it had been fought.
  325. 2160
    The Enterprise NX-01 meets the Volus
    Soon after it met the Turians, the Enterprise NX-01 met the Volus, short, stout bankers from Irune who live in pressure suits among other peoples. They had been clients of the Turians for centuries.
  326. 2160
    The Enterprise NX-01 meets the Elcor
    The Enterprise NX-01 met an Elcor envoy, a massive, slow-moving creature from heavy Dekuuna, who named each feeling before speaking. The talks were very long and very courteous.
  327. 2160
    Archer is warned away from Parnack
    The Turians told Captain Archer of the Yahg, who had massacred the alliance's envoys in 2125, and warned him to keep the Enterprise NX-01 well away from Parnack. He did.
  328. 2161
    The United Federation of Planets is founded
    United Earth, the Tellarites, the Vulcans and the Andorians signed the charter of the United Federation of Planets on Earth. Captain Archer spoke at the signing. The Enterprise NX-01 was retired that year, after ten years of service.
  329. 2161
    Starfleet's report on the old powers
    Starfleet gathered the findings of the Enterprise NX-01 into a single report, the first full account of the passing of the old powers.
  330. c. 2162
    The Asari join the United Federation of Planets
    The Asari of Thessia joined the United Federation of Planets, the first people to do so after its four founders. By Asari reckoning they had made up their minds very quickly indeed.
  331. c. 2163
    The Salarians join the United Federation of Planets
    The Salarian Union joined the United Federation of Planets, once the dalatrasses of its great clans had agreed the terms among themselves.
  332. c. 2164
    The Quarians refuse the Federation's first offer
    The United Federation of Planets offered the Quarians of the Migrant Fleet medicine and a world to settle. The Admiralty Board refused. It wanted the Federation's help to take Rannoch back from the Geth, which the Federation would not give.
  333. 2165
    Birth of Sarek
    Sarek, who would be Vulcan's most famous ambassador, was born on Vulcan.
  334. c. 2165
    The Turians join the United Federation of Planets
    After long debate the Primarchs of the Turian Hierarchy voted to join the United Federation of Planets. Turian officers soon began to serve in Starfleet.
  335. c. 2223
    Seventy years of enmity begin
    Relations between the Klingon Empire and the United Federation of Planets turned to open hostility, which lasted seventy years.
  336. 2230
    Birth of Spock
    Spock was born in ShiKahr on Vulcan, the son of the ambassador Sarek and his human wife, Amanda Grayson.
  337. 22 March 2233
    Birth of James T. Kirk
    James Tiberius Kirk was born in Riverside, Iowa, the younger son of George and Winona Kirk.
  338. c. 2245
    The Battle of Donatu V
    The Klingons fought the Federation at Donatu V, near Sherman's Planet, in a region both of them claimed. The battle settled nothing.
  339. 2246
    Kodos the Executioner
    When a fungus destroyed the food stores of the Earth colony on Tarsus IV, its governor, Kodos, put four thousand of its eight thousand colonists to death so that the rest might live. The thirteen-year-old James T. Kirk was one of the few who saw it and lived.
  340. c. 2249
    Spock joins Starfleet
    Spock turned down the Vulcan Science Academy to join Starfleet. His father did not speak to him as a son for eighteen years.
  341. c. 2250
    The Quarians refuse a second offer
    The United Federation of Planets offered the Quarians several worlds to settle. They refused again, since the Federation would still not make war on the Geth for them.
  342. 29 May 2251
    Garth of Izar finds the Klingons at Axanar
    Captain Garth of Izar, commanding the destroyer Xenophon, sighted a Klingon cruiser near Axanar. Following it, he found that a Klingon force under Admiral Kkorhetza had occupied the Axanar system.
  343. 29 August 2251
    The First Battle of Axanar
    Garth's ships fought the Klingon force at Axanar, in the first battle of the Four Years War. Garth offered Admiral Kkorhetza the choice of surrender or a withdrawal under escort. Kkorhetza refused both, declaring an alliance with the people of Axanar.
  344. September 2251
    The Four Years War is declared
    Pressed by the Empire's militant houses, the Klingon High Council went to open war with the United Federation of Planets, the first such war between them.
  345. 29 September 2251
    The Second Battle of Axanar
    Garth beat Admiral Kkorhetza's invasion fleet of seven warships at Axanar and took his surrender. Starfleet made Garth a fleet captain, with a squadron to hold the Axanar system for the rest of the war. His victory became required reading at Starfleet Academy.
  346. c. 2251
    The Axanar Peace Mission
    The Federation sent a peace mission to Axanar, hoping to end the Four Years War before it spread. Among the cadets with it was James T. Kirk, not long at Starfleet Academy, who was given the Palm Leaf of the Axanar Peace Mission. The Klingon militant houses would not hear of peace, and the war went on.
  347. 2252
    The Shepards settle on Mindoir
    Hannah and Hank Shepard, both Starfleet officers, resigned their commissions to raise a family on the farming colony of Mindoir.
  348. 11 April 2253
    Birth of John Shepard
    John Shepard was born on Mindoir, a farming colony on the Federation's frontier.
  349. February 2254
    The Klingons strike at Zal Vhros
    The Klingon attack on Zal Vhros showed how frustrated the Empire had grown with a war it could not win. The militant houses that had wanted the war blamed the Chancellor's caution.
  350. May 2255
    Peace talks open at Axanar
    After the war's last battle, fought at Alaris on 7 May, envoys of the Federation and the Empire met at Axanar, where the war had begun. The fighting stopped.
  351. 13 June 2255
    The Treaty of Axanar
    The talks at Axanar ended in the Treaty of Axanar, which redrew the border in the Federation's favour. Several worlds along it passed to the Federation.
  352. July 2255
    Klingon settlers leave the ceded worlds
    Klingons living on the worlds that the Treaty of Axanar gave to the Federation began to be moved to the Klingon side of the new border. The last of them had gone by April 2256.
  353. 2257
    The creature at Tycho IV
    Aboard the USS Farragut Lieutenant James T. Kirk hesitated for a moment before firing at a gaseous creature at Tycho IV. It killed two hundred of the crew, Captain Garrovick among them.
  354. 2258
    Birth of Jane Shepard
    Jane Shepard, the younger sister of John Shepard, was born on Mindoir.
  355. c. 2261
    Birth of David Marcus
    The scientist Carol Marcus bore James T. Kirk a son, David. At her wish Kirk kept away, and David grew up without him.
  356. 2265
    Kirk takes command of the Enterprise
    James T. Kirk took command of the USS Enterprise from Christopher Pike, with Spock as his science officer. Her five-year mission began.
  357. 2265
    Kirk kills Gary Mitchell
    Changed by the barrier at the edge of the galaxy, Gary Mitchell grew powers past anything human. On Delta Vega his oldest friend, Captain Kirk, killed him.
  358. 2266
    The Romulans cross the Neutral Zone
    A cloaked Romulan bird-of-prey crossed the Neutral Zone and destroyed the outposts along it. The USS Enterprise under Captain James T. Kirk crippled it, and its commander destroyed his ship rather than surrender. For the first time humans saw a Romulan's face, and it looked like a Vulcan's.
  359. 2266
    The death of Kodos
    Kirk found Kodos of Tarsus IV alive, acting under the name Anton Karidian. Kodos was killed by his own daughter, Lenore, with a shot she had meant for Kirk.
  360. 2267
    Spock's pon farr and T'Pring's challenge
    Seized by the pon farr, Spock went home to Vulcan to marry T'Pring, who demanded instead that he fight a champion of her choosing, Captain Kirk. T'Pau, who had carried the Kir'Shara to the High Command in 2154, presided.
  361. 2267
    The Klingons occupy Organia
    As war broke out with the Federation, a Klingon force under Kor occupied Organia, a neutral world on the border. Kor ruled it as military governor, while Kirk and Spock of the Enterprise worked against him in disguise.
  362. 2267
    Death of Sam Kirk
    Kirk's brother, George Samuel Kirk, died on Deneva, killed by the parasites that had overrun the colony.
  363. 2267
    The court martial of James T. Kirk
    Kirk was court-martialled for the death of Ben Finney, who was found alive and hiding aboard the Enterprise, meaning to take his revenge.
  364. 2267
    Kirk finds Zefram Cochrane
    On Gamma Canaris N Kirk found Zefram Cochrane alive, kept young for a hundred and fifty years by a being he called the Companion. Kirk kept his secret.
  365. 2267
    Kirk lets Edith Keeler die
    Through the Guardian of Forever Kirk followed McCoy into New York in 1930. There he fell in love with Edith Keeler. To set history right he had to let her die.
  366. 2267
    Kirk crosses to the mirror universe
    A transporter accident in an ion storm carried Captain Kirk and three of his officers into a mirror universe, where a cruel Terran Empire stood in the Federation's place. The technique was later used in secret to reach the Galactic Empire.
  367. 2267
    The Babel conference
    Sarek led the Vulcans to the Babel conference, which was to decide whether Coridan should join the United Federation of Planets. On the way the Tellarite ambassador, Gav, was murdered by an Orion spy disguised as an Andorian. Spock gave his father blood for an operation that saved his life, which ended eighteen years of silence between them.
  368. 2267
    The Organians impose peace
    The Organians, beings without bodies who had seemed to be simple villagers, stopped the Klingon fleet where it stood, with the Federation's. They were not gods, but neither side could resist them. Both had to accept the Organian Peace Treaty.
  369. 2267
    Nimbus III, the Planet of Galactic Peace
    The United Federation of Planets, the Klingons and the Romulans founded a colony together on Nimbus III, which they called the Planet of Galactic Peace. It never lived up to its name.
  370. 2268
    The Vulcan starship Intrepid is lost
    The USS Intrepid, crewed entirely by Vulcans, was destroyed by a vast single-celled creature in space. Spock felt all four hundred of them die.
  371. c. 2268
    The poisoned grain for Sherman's Planet
    Under the Organian treaty, Sherman's Planet would go to whichever power could develop it best. Arne Darvin, a Klingon agent disguised as a human, poisoned the Federation's grain for it aboard Space Station K-7, where Captain Koloth's crew were on leave. The station's tribbles gave him away.
  372. c. 2268
    Captain Kirk finds the Free Jaffa Nation
    The USS Enterprise, under Captain James T. Kirk, came upon the worlds of the Free Jaffa Nation. Earth had forgotten the Jaffa, for the Stargate programme had been secret and was lost in the Third World War. The Jaffa had not forgotten Earth. They greeted the crew as Tau'ri, then told Kirk everything, from the rule of the Goa'uld to the deeds of SG-1.
  373. 2268
    Kirk destroys the creature of Tycho IV
    Kirk destroyed the gaseous creature that had killed two hundred of the Farragut's crew in 2257, with the son of Captain Garrovick beside him.
  374. 2268
    Kirk marries Miramanee
    On a world of transplanted Native American people Kirk lost his memory and married the priestess Miramanee. She died carrying his child.
  375. 2268
    Kirk and Spock steal a Romulan cloaking device
    Captain Kirk and Spock stole a cloaking device from a Romulan flagship, whose commander had tried to win Spock over to the Empire.
  376. c. 2268
    Kang and the creature that fed on violence
    A creature without a body, which fed on violence, set Commander Kang's Klingons against the crew of the Enterprise. When Kang made a truce with Kirk, it left the ship.
  377. c. 2268
    The Klingons arm the villagers of Neural
    The Klingons gave flintlocks to the villagers of Neural, a world without starships. To keep the balance, Kirk armed the hill people.
  378. c. 2268
    Romulans in Klingon-built ships
    The Romulans were flying warships of Klingon design, the fruit of dealings between the two empires.
  379. 21 August 2268
    The raid on Mindoir
    Slavers of the Orion Syndicate raided the Federation colony of Mindoir. They tortured Hannah, Hank and ten-year-old Jane Shepard to death in front of fifteen-year-old John Shepard. Captain Kirk of the USS Enterprise saved him at the last moment, and the boy swore vengeance on the Syndicate to Kirk's face.
  380. c. 2270
    The Free Jaffa Nation joins the Federation
    The Free Jaffa Nation joined the United Federation of Planets, out of respect and thanks for the Tau'ri who had helped to free the Jaffa from the Goa'uld. The stories of those years had passed from generation to generation.
  381. 2270
    Kirk is promoted to admiral
    The Enterprise came home at the end of her five-year mission, and Kirk was promoted to admiral.
  382. c. 2271
    Kor wins at Klach D'kel Brakt
    Klingon forces under Kor defeated the Romulans at the Battle of Klach D'kel Brakt.
  383. 2271
    Shepard enters Starfleet Academy
    Inspired by Kirk, with whom he had kept up a long correspondence, John Shepard entered Starfleet Academy to become an officer of the Starfleet Marines. He was commissioned in June 2275.
  384. c. 2273
    Spock leaves the kolinahr unfinished
    Spock went to the masters at Gol to complete the kolinahr, the discipline that purges every emotion. At the very end he felt the call of the vast machine called V'Ger, and he left Gol to rejoin the Enterprise.
  385. 2273
    V'Ger destroys three Klingon cruisers
    Three Klingon battle cruisers fired on a vast cloud that was making for Earth. The machine at its heart, V'Ger, destroyed them all.
  386. 14 June 2277
    The Skyllian Blitz
    The Orion Syndicate, with Batarian slavers and Krogan mercenaries in its pay, attacked the Federation colony of Elysium in the Skyllian Verge. John Shepard, there on shore leave, rallied the colonists and held a breach almost alone until the USS Agincourt came. He was awarded the Star of Terra.
  387. 9 March 2278
    The thresher maws of Akuze
    Lieutenant Shepard's unit of fifty Starfleet Marines was sent to Akuze, where a new colony had fallen silent. Thresher maws rose out of the ground beneath their camp and killed every one of them but Shepard, who walked for two days to be rescued.
  388. 27 October 2279
    Torfan
    Shepard led the assault on the Syndicate's slaving base under the moon Torfan and gave no quarter. Three quarters of his own Marines died taking it, and the slavers who surrendered were shot. Some called him a hero for it, others the Butcher of Torfan.
  389. 2281
    Shepard earns N7
    John Shepard completed the Starfleet Marines' Interplanetary Combatives Training at Vila Militar, in Rio de Janeiro, earning the N7 badge.
  390. 2285
    Death of Spock
    Spock died of radiation, restoring the engines of the Enterprise so that it could escape the Genesis Device. Before he died he placed his katra, as Vulcans call a person's living spirit, in the mind of Dr Leonard McCoy.
  391. 2285
    Kirk kills Commander Kruge
    Commander Kruge came to steal the secret of a Federation device for remaking dead worlds. On the new world it had made, his men killed Kirk's son. Kirk killed Kruge, then took his Bird-of-Prey.
  392. 2285
    Kirk meets his son
    Kirk met his son, David Marcus, now a scientist of the Genesis project, and the two were reconciled. Soon afterwards David was killed on the Genesis planet by the men of the Klingon commander Kruge.
  393. 2285
    The fal-tor-pan on Mount Seleya
    Spock's body, reborn on the Genesis planet, was carried to Vulcan by Kirk's officers in a captured Klingon ship. On Mount Seleya the priestess T'Lar joined his katra to it again in the ancient rite of fal-tor-pan.
  394. 2286
    The Klingons demand Kirk's extradition
    Before the Federation Council the Klingon ambassador demanded that Kirk be handed over to the Empire. The Federation tried him itself, on lesser charges.
  395. 2286
    Kirk is given the Enterprise-A
    A probe calling for the whales that no longer lived on Earth began to destroy the planet. Kirk brought two humpback whales from the twentieth century to answer it. The Federation Council reduced him to captain for his crimes of the year before and gave him the new USS Enterprise-A.
  396. 2287
    Sybok seizes the envoys on Nimbus III
    Sybok, Spock's half-brother, banished from Vulcan for rejecting logic, seized the envoys on Nimbus III to take a starship in search of Sha Ka Ree, the paradise of Vulcan legend. At the centre of the galaxy he found only a cruel prisoner that called itself God, which it was not. Sybok gave his life so that his brother could escape.
  397. 2287
    Klaa at Nimbus III
    Captain Klaa, a young Klingon hungry for glory, pursued the Enterprise to Nimbus III, the Planet of Galactic Peace. General Korrd, the Klingon consul there, ordered him to stand down.
  398. 2289
    Shepard is made commander
    After years of raids against the Orion Syndicate John Shepard was promoted to commander. Admirals who had known Kirk as a young man had begun to call him the next Kirk.
  399. 12 February 2293
    Praxis explodes
    The Klingon moon Praxis exploded. The Klingons suspected the Federation, and the two powers moved towards war. The Galactic Empire had destroyed it, and its envoys soon made a secret alliance with the Klingons.
  400. March 2293
    Shepard joins the Enterprise-A
    Commander John Shepard, Lieutenant Kaidan Alenko and Corporal Richard Jenkins were posted to Captain Kirk's USS Enterprise-A as a Marine detachment, to lead away missions in place of the ship's senior officers.
  401. 17 May 2293
    The Imperial Entanglement
    A fleet of the Galactic Empire under Darth Vader attacked Starbase Side 7, where the USS Enterprise-A had come to collect the RX-78-2 Gundam. Shepard's Marines fought through the starbase, where Corporal Jenkins was killed. Amuro Ray flew the Gundam against the Imperial fighters. The Klingons under Char of Aznable turned on the Empire when its part in the destruction of Praxis came out. Kirk and Shepard beat Vader together, and the Empire withdrew.
  402. 30 June 2293
    The Enterprise-A is retired
    The USS Enterprise-A was decommissioned. On Kirk's personal recommendation John Shepard was promoted to captain and named to command the new USS Enterprise-B.
  403. 20 August 2293
    The Khitomer Accords
    The United Federation of Planets and the Klingon Empire, which had fought side by side at Side 7, signed a treaty of peace at Khitomer.
  404. 14 October 2293
    Shepard takes command of the Enterprise-B
    The USS Enterprise-B left spacedock under Captain John Shepard, unfinished, with James T. Kirk aboard as a guest. She saved forty-seven refugees from two ships caught in the Nexus. Kirk was lost when the ribbon tore open her hull, and Starfleet listed him as killed.
  405. 21 March 2299
    The Empire returns at Morska
    Forty Star Destroyers of the Galactic Empire appeared over the Klingon outpost of Morska and destroyed its defence fleet. Char of Aznable's Zakus covered the survivors' escape. The Intergalactic War had begun.
  406. 2 April 2299
    The Battle of Vega
    An Imperial fleet struck the Federation colony of Vega. Starfleet lost eleven of its twenty-six ships. The USS Enterprise-B and Captain Sulu's USS Excelsior were driven off, in Captain Shepard's first great defeat.
  407. 28 April 2299
    The siege of Palaven begins
    The Galactic Empire laid siege to Palaven, the homeworld of the Turians. The Turian legions held out for nine months.
  408. 11 June 2299
    The Battle of Cestus III
    The USS Enterprise-B dropped her cloak inside an Imperial convoy landing troops on the Gorn colonies near Cestus III and destroyed it beside a Gorn squadron. The Gorn Hegemony joined Shepard's alliance.
  409. 17 August 2299
    The webs of Tholia
    Three Star Destroyers appeared inside Tholian space. Forewarned by Captain Shepard, the Tholians spun their webs around them and crushed all three. The Tholian Assembly joined the alliance on its own terms.
  410. 5 October 2299
    The Battle of Rannoch
    The Galactic Empire tried to rewrite the minds of the Geth from a command ship above Rannoch, and the Quarians' Migrant Fleet came in to destroy them. Captain Shepard and Tali'Zorah broke the Empire's hold, then held the two fleets apart. The Geth and the Quarians made peace, and the Quarians returned to their homeworld after four hundred years.
  411. 23 November 2299
    The relief of Romulus
    A Federation and Klingon force relieved Romulus from an Imperial fleet, with the USS Enterprise-B dropping her cloak among the Romulan warbirds. The Romulans joined the alliance. They did not forgive the Federation for its cloaked ship.
  412. 29 December 2299
    The fall of Thessia
    Darth Vader led the assault on Thessia, the homeworld of the Asari. The USS Enterprise-B and the Asari fleet could not hold it. It was the worst defeat of the war.
  413. 19 January 2300
    The relief of Palaven
    A Klingon fleet broke the Imperial siege of Palaven, carrying an army of Krogan to fight on the ground beside the Turians.
  414. 8 March 2300
    The Battle of Earth begins
    The Galactic Empire's main fleet appeared in Earth's system with Darth Vader's flagship at its head. Ships of the Federation, the Klingons, the Romulans, the Gorn, the Tholians, the Geth and the Quarians met it in one line of battle. Amuro Ray's Gundam fought beside Char of Aznable's red Zaku, while Captain Shepard boarded the flagship and fought Vader a second time.
  415. 10 March 2300
    The Barrier is lit
    The Barrier, a device built in secret at Utopia Planitia by the engineers of every allied people, turned the Empire's transporter bridge back on itself. Every Imperial ship in Earth's system was thrown home across the gulf, and the bridge could not be opened again. The Intergalactic War was over.
  416. 2311
    The Tomed Incident
    The Federation and the Romulans clashed at Tomed, with the loss of thousands of Federation lives. The USS Enterprise-B, whose cloak the Romulans had never forgiven, was destroyed. Captain Shepard got her whole crew away and was the last to leave her. He retired afterwards with his wife, Ashley Williams, to raise their children.
  417. 2311
    The Treaty of Algeron
    After the Tomed Incident the Federation and the Romulans signed the Treaty of Algeron. It redrew the Neutral Zone and forbade the Federation to use cloaking devices.
  418. 2350
    Rannoch joins the Federation
    Fifty years after the Intergalactic War the Quarians and the Geth of Rannoch joined the United Federation of Planets together. Many Quarians entered Starfleet, where their engineers had a hand in the Galaxy-class starships.
  419. c. 29,800
    The Emperor of Mankind unites Terra
    At the end of the Age of Strife Conan, coming first as Revelation, united the warring peoples of Terra as the Emperor of Mankind, founded the Imperium of Man and began the Great Crusade.
  420. c. 30,014
    The Emperor is set upon the Golden Throne
    After the Siege of Terra, in which he cast down his rebel son Horus and was wounded past healing, the Emperor of Mankind was set upon the Golden Throne, where he has sat ever since, worshipped as the God-Emperor.

An encyclopaedia of the series

The Malfoid Saga

The story of Harry Potter and the girl who noticed him. Every character, place, spell and secret is here, with a timeline from the Elder Days to the books still to come.

Read the Malfoid SagaEvery book, free to read online at malfoid.lol

Here be spoilers

This wiki covers every book published so far, up to the latest chapters of Book Four, and it holds nothing back. It includes secrets, true identities and history the books themselves have not revealed yet. If you have not caught up, read with care.

A work in progress

The saga is still being written, and so is this wiki. Every page is subject to additions, edits and changes as new chapters arrive.

Recommended reading

The pages that matter most for understanding the saga.

About the saga

The Malfoid Saga retells the Harry Potter story with one great change: the Malfoy heir is a girl, Dracina Malfoy, silver-blonde and silver-eyed, who noticed Harry before anybody else did. Around them the world is wider and stranger than the wizards know. Middle-earth, Narnia and the D’ni were real. Superheroes, genetically engineered warlords and alien gods share the Muggle century. Faith in God is as true as any spell.

The Malfoid Saga is free, unofficial, non-profit fan fiction. This wiki is not affiliated with the creators or owners of Harry Potter.
